ex.zh: 通知里请用简单的词。

ex.en: The simple act of sorting rubbish fails if the bins are too far from the canteen.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶离食堂太远，垃圾分类这个简单的行为也会失败。

tip: simple 的副词是 simply。

senses.en: British spelling of favor
to prefer or support

ex.en: Could you do me a favour and lock the door?
ex.zh: 请帮个忙，把门锁上好吗？

ex.en: A favour for one class should not hide the bus from the others.
ex.zh: 给一个班的帮助，不应当把公交瞒着其他班。

col: do sb a favour｜帮某人一个忙
tip: favour 是英式，favor 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: not anything

ex.en: There is nothing in the lost-and-found box.
ex.zh: 失物招领箱里什么都没有。

ex.en: Nothing improves a river if factories upstream are allowed to pour waste into it at night.
ex.zh: 如果允许上游工厂在夜里排污，什么办法也改善不了这条河。

tip: nothing 作主语时谓语用单数。形容词后置：nothing new。

senses.en: the story of a book or film

ex.en: The plot is simple and the ending is not.
ex.zh: 情节简单，结局并不简单。

ex.en: A plot about a flood should not hide who had to leave their house.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的情节不应当藏起谁不得不离开自己的家。

tip: plot 也可指小块土地，或密谋。作动词是密谋或绘制。本条以故事情节为主。

senses.en: until now, often in questions and negatives
but at the same time

ex.en: She has not finished the poster yet.
ex.zh: 她还没有完成海报。

ex.en: The town has not yet decided where the new clinic will stand, though the old one is already unsafe.
ex.zh: 尽管旧诊所已经不安全，镇上还没有决定新诊所建在哪里。

tip: yet 多用于否定和疑问；already 多用于肯定。yet 也可作连词“然而”。

senses.en: strong trust, or a religion

ex.en: She has faith in the team's hard work.
ex.zh: 她相信队伍的努力。

ex.en: Public rules should protect every faith without making one of them the school rule.
ex.zh: 公共规则应当保护每一种信仰，而不把其中一种变成校规。

tip: faith 可指对人的信任，也可指宗教信仰。

senses.en: the amount produced, or what a machine sends out

ex.en: The output of the garden is tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这个园子的产出是西红柿。

ex.en: Output numbers without a source are not a report.
ex.zh: 没有来源的产量数字不是报告。

tip: output 也可作动词“输出”。

senses.en: below the ground
an underground railway

ex.en: The underground station is closed.
ex.zh: 地铁站关了。

ex.en: An underground path still needs a light.
ex.zh: 地下通道仍然需要灯。

tip: 英式 the underground 可指地铁。ground 已在本库。

senses.en: to say no

ex.en: She refused to hide the broken step.
ex.zh: 她拒绝把坏台阶藏起来。

ex.en: A school should refuse a drink ad that hides the sugar.
ex.zh: 学校应当拒绝隐瞒含糖量的饮料广告。

tip: refuse to do。名词垃圾也拼作 refuse，读 /ˈrefjuːs/，本条是动词。

senses.en: unwilling to work

ex.en: A lazy afternoon is not the same as a tired student.
ex.zh: 懒散的下午不等于一个疲惫的学生。

ex.en: Calling a classmate lazy ignores the student who works at night.
ex.zh: 说同学懒，会忽略那个晚上还在干活的学生。

tip: lazy 用在人身上会伤人。可以形容一段轻松的时间。

senses.en: a long metal weapon used in the past

ex.en: The sword is in the museum, behind glass.
ex.zh: 剑在博物馆的玻璃后面。

ex.en: A history chapter can show a sword and still not teach how to use one.
ex.zh: 历史课可以展示一把剑，同时仍然不教如何使用。

tip: 本条只作历史词汇。不写使用方法。

senses.en: a part of a tree, or a local office

ex.en: A branch fell across the path.
ex.zh: 一根树枝横在小路上。

ex.en: The library branch near the station stays open after the main one closes.
ex.zh: 车站附近的图书馆分馆，在总馆关门后还开着。

tip: branch 可指树枝、分公司、支部或学科分支。

senses.en: an injury to the body
to injure someone

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the wound.
ex.zh: 护士清理了伤口。

ex.en: A wound should be seen at the clinic, not hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 伤口应当去医务室看，而不是藏到周五。

tip: 名词伤口读 /wuːnd/。wind 的过去式 wound 读 /waʊnd/。本条是伤口，不写如何造成伤害。

senses.en: a covering for the head

ex.en: Take off your hat in the hall.
ex.zh: 在礼堂里摘下帽子。

ex.en: A hat in strong sun is a health tool, not only a fashion.
ex.zh: 烈日下的帽子是健康用具，而不只是打扮。

tip: hat 通常有边。cap 多指无边或只有前面有沿的帽子，本批另有词条。

senses.en: a person who works

ex.en: The worker locked the gate.
ex.zh: 工作人员锁了门。

ex.en: A night worker needs the late bus as much as a student does.
ex.zh: 上夜班的人需要晚班车，和学生一样。

tip: worker 可数。work 已在本库。

senses.en: very great fear

ex.en: The story uses terror, then it returns to the classroom.
ex.zh: 故事用了恐惧，然后回到教室。

ex.en: Terror in a headline is not the same as a fact.
ex.zh: 标题里的恐惧不等于事实。

tip: terror 通常不可数。本条不写如何恐吓。

senses.en: to become smaller in amount
A reduction in the size, number, or amount of something.

ex.en: Pollution may decrease if we use less plastic.
ex.zh: 如果我们少用塑料，污染可能会减少。

ex.en: Improved public transport could decrease traffic congestion and reduce air pollution in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以缓解人口密集城市的交通拥堵，并减少空气污染。

col: a decrease in demand｜需求下降
tip: 动词重音在后，名词/ˈdiːkriːs/重音在前。

senses.en: in or to any place

ex.en: You may sit anywhere in the front two rows.
ex.zh: 前两排你可以随便坐。

ex.en: A student who cannot find anywhere quiet will not finish the same essay as a classmate with a desk.
ex.zh: 找不到安静地方的学生，完成不了和有书桌的同学同样的作文。

tip: anywhere 多用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句常用 somewhere。

senses.en: a piece of cloth used as a symbol

ex.en: The flag is raised at eight.
ex.zh: 旗在八点升起。

ex.en: A flag at the gate does not tell a new student where the clinic is.
ex.zh: 门口的旗告诉不了新生医务室在哪里。

tip: flag 作动词可以是标出或衰退。国旗前常用 the。

senses.en: to become someone's husband or wife

ex.en: They will marry in the spring.
ex.zh: 他们将在春天结婚。

ex.en: A form about who may marry should not shame the student who fills it in.
ex.zh: 关于谁可以结婚的表格，不应当让填写的学生感到羞耻。

tip: 名词 marriage 已在本库。不说 marry with。

senses.en: a wild animal, especially a large or dangerous one

ex.en: The story has a beast, not a pet.
ex.zh: 故事里有一只野兽，不是宠物。

ex.en: Calling a person a beast is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 把人叫做野兽，不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: beast 可数。用在人身上会伤人。

senses.en: a spoken or written remark
to give an opinion

ex.en: She left a short comment under the article.
ex.zh: 她在文章下面留了一条短评。

ex.en: A rude comment online can follow a student longer than the lesson it interrupted.
ex.zh: 网上一句粗鲁的评论，可能比它打断的那节课跟学生更久。

tip: comment 作动词时，说 comment on something。

senses.en: the top layer of earth in which plants grow

ex.en: The soil here is good for tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这里的土壤适合种西红柿。

ex.en: Soil on a school path becomes mud when the drain is blocked.
ex.zh: 排水口堵住时，学校小路上的土会变成泥。

tip: soil 通常不可数。

senses.en: the chance of something bad
to do something that may cause harm

ex.en: There is a risk of rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午有下雨的风险。

ex.en: The risk of flooding rises when a town builds houses on the cheapest land beside a river.
ex.zh: 当城镇把房子建在河边最便宜的地上时，洪水风险会上升。

tip: risk doing 表示冒险做可能带来坏结果的事。

senses.en: the space between two lines, or a way of looking

ex.en: Measure the angle before you cut.
ex.zh: 切割前先量角度。

ex.en: From the student angle, the last bus is the whole plan.
ex.zh: 从学生的角度看，末班车就是整个计划。

tip: angle 可数。

senses.en: existing in nature, or normal

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前感到紧张是自然的。

ex.en: Natural shade from trees costs less over time than machines that cool one classroom.
ex.zh: 树木的天然荫凉，长期来看比只冷却一间教室的机器更省。

tip: natural 是形容词；nature 是名词。

senses.en: a plan of times
to plan a time for something

ex.en: The schedule is on the door.
ex.zh: 时间表在门上。

ex.en: A schedule that ignores the last bus will look neat and still fail.
ex.zh: 不考虑末班车的日程看起来整齐，仍然会失败。

tip: 英式常读 /ˈʃedjuːl/，美式常读 /ˈskedʒuːl/。作动词是安排。

senses.en: a mistake
the difference between a measured value and the true value

ex.en: Check your work for any error.
ex.zh: 检查作业有没有错误。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。

senses.en: to stay in a state, or to continue to have

ex.en: Please keep the door closed.
ex.zh: 请让门保持关着。

ex.en: Cities that keep old trees during construction save shade that new saplings cannot provide for years.
ex.zh: 施工时保留老树的城市，留住了新树苗多年内无法提供的荫凉。

tip: keep doing 表示持续做；keep sb from doing 表示阻止某人做。

senses.en: on the side opposite the right

senses.zh: 离开；留下（leave 的过去式）
senses.en: past form of leave

ex.en: Turn left after the school gate.
ex.zh: 出校门后向左转。

ex.en: The shops on the left bank of the river closed when the new road drew customers away.
ex.zh: 河左岸的商店在新路把顾客引走之后关门了。

tip: left 也是 leave 的过去式和过去分词。看上下文才能区分“左边”和“离开”。

senses.en: a person or thing that carries something

ex.en: The carrier on the bicycle is loose.
ex.zh: 自行车上的货架松了。

ex.en: A carrier of an illness should be able to stay home without shame.
ex.zh: 带病的人应当能待在家里，而不被羞辱。

tip: carrier 可数。健康课里可指带菌者。本条不写传播的做法。

senses.en: a person who uses something

ex.en: The user guide is on the desk.
ex.zh: 用户指南在桌子上。

ex.en: A library user who cannot log in still needs a way to borrow a book.
ex.zh: 登不进去的图书馆用户，仍然需要一种借书的办法。

tip: user 可数。计算机和图书馆都可以用。

senses.en: words spoken to a god

ex.en: The visit included a moment of prayer for those who wanted it.
ex.zh: 参观包括片刻祈祷，给想参加的人。

ex.en: A school can explain prayer without telling every student to join.
ex.zh: 学校可以讲解祈祷，而不要求每个学生参加。

tip: 动词 pray 是本批的另一词。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: the area around a place; American spelling

ex.en: The neighborhood shares one clinic.
ex.zh: 这个街区共用一家诊所。

ex.en: A quiet neighborhood can still be far from the last bus.
ex.zh: 安静的街区仍然可能离末班车很远。

tip: neighborhood 是美式。英式是 neighbourhood。本库用考纲里的 neighborhood。

senses.en: to move something into a place

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: If a city puts all new housing on the edge, workers spend hours travelling to jobs in the centre.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市把新住房都放在边缘，工人就要花数小时去市中心上班。

tip: put 的过去式和过去分词都是 put，不是 putted。

senses.en: to put a name on an official list
an official list, or a person who keeps it

ex.en: Please register before the first class.
ex.zh: 第一节课前请登记。

ex.en: A school that can register a new student in one morning keeps that child in class the same day.
ex.zh: 能在一个上午给新生登记的学校，能让那个孩子当天就上课。

tip: register 作名词是登记簿或注册员。

senses.en: to rescue, to avoid spending, or to keep

ex.en: Save your work before you close the computer.
ex.zh: 关电脑前先保存作业。

ex.en: Towns that save old trees save shade that new saplings cannot give for years.
ex.zh: 保住老树的城镇，也保住了新树苗多年内给不了的荫凉。

tip: save 表示拯救或节省，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: to fasten or join
Consider something to have a particular value or importance

ex.en: Please attach your photo to the form.
ex.zh: 请把照片附在表格上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: used for a possibility that is not certain

ex.en: It might snow tonight, so take a coat.
ex.zh: 今晚可能会下雪，带件外套。

ex.en: A new subway line might help the centre while making outer villages feel even farther away.
ex.zh: 一条新地铁线可能方便市中心，同时让外围村庄感觉更远。

tip: might 比 may 语气更不确定，两者后面都接动词原形。

senses.en: a high opinion, or regard for someone's rights
to admire and treat well

ex.en: Students show respect by listening.
ex.zh: 学生用倾听来表示尊重。

ex.en: Respect for local knowledge means asking residents where the flood actually reached.
ex.zh: 尊重本地知识，意味着询问居民洪水实际淹到了哪里。

tip: respect 作动词直接接宾语：respect sb。

senses.en: the bottom support, or a main place
to use something as the starting point

ex.en: Trust is the base of the club.
ex.zh: 信任是这个社团的基础。

ex.en: A flood plan with no local base of volunteers will be slow on the first wet night.
ex.zh: 没有本地志愿者基础的防汛计划，会在第一个雨夜行动迟缓。

tip: be based on 表示以……为基础。base 作动词是“以……为根据”。

senses.en: a light artificial material
made of plastic

ex.en: The bottle is plastic, not glass.
ex.zh: 这个瓶子是塑料的，不是玻璃的。

ex.en: Plastic that leaves the school bin can reach a river if nobody stops it.
ex.zh: 离开学校垃圾桶的塑料，如果没人拦住，可以一直到河里。

tip: plastic 作材料时常不可数。作形容词是塑料的。

senses.en: in the direction of, or in relation to

ex.en: We walked towards the gate.
ex.zh: 我们朝校门走去。

ex.en: Attitudes towards night buses change when people have to use them themselves.
ex.zh: 当人们不得不自己去坐夜班公交时，他们对它的态度会改变。

tip: 英式常用 towards，美式常用 toward，意思相同。

senses.en: to keep safe from harm

ex.en: Trees protect the playground from the sun.
ex.zh: 树木保护操场不受日晒。

ex.en: Laws that protect a river also protect the drinking water of the next town.
ex.zh: 保护河流的法律，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。

col: protect sb from｜保护某人免受
tip: protect 后接宾语，再加 from 或 against。

senses.en: unusual, or not familiar

ex.en: The noise was strange for a Sunday.
ex.zh: 这声音在周日很奇怪。

ex.en: A strange result in one lab is a reason to measure again, not to hide the page.
ex.zh: 一次实验里奇怪的结果，是再测一次的理由，不是把那页藏起来。

tip: stranger 是陌生人。feel strange 可表示不舒服。

senses.en: a long reptile with no legs

ex.en: The snake is in the nature book, not in the lab.
ex.zh: 蛇在自然课本里，不在实验室。

ex.en: A lesson about the snake should say where it lives, not how to harm it.
ex.zh: 关于蛇的课应当说它住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。

tip: snake 可数。表里这一行的音标少了词尾的 k，本库不用。

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay

ex.en: The hotel near the station is full.
ex.zh: 车站附近的旅馆满了。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill every hotel while ordinary rents rise for the rest of the year.
ex.zh: 大型体育赛事可以住满每家旅馆，同时让普通房租在这一年的其余时间上涨。

tip: hotel 是可数名词。

senses.en: serious pain or difficulty

ex.en: The novel does not describe the suffering in detail.
ex.zh: 小说没有详细描写那些痛苦。

ex.en: Flood suffering is reduced by a dry room, not only by a speech.
ex.zh: 洪水带来的苦难靠一间干房间来减轻，而不只是靠一篇讲话。

tip: suffering 可数也可不可数。动词 suffer from 表示患有或遭受。

senses.en: something that is needed or demanded

ex.en: Sleep is a requirement, not a reward.
ex.zh: 睡眠是要求，不是奖赏。

ex.en: A requirement that families cannot read is not one they can meet.
ex.zh: 家庭读不懂的要求，不是他们能达到的要求。

tip: 动词 require 已在本库。

senses.en: clever, or neat and fashionable

ex.en: That was a smart way to save time.
ex.zh: 那是个省时间的聪明办法。

ex.en: A smart uniform does not tell a teacher who prepared and who copied.
ex.zh: 整齐时髦的校服并不能告诉老师谁做了准备、谁抄了作业。

tip: smart 可指聪明，也可指衣着整齐时髦。美式口语里很常见。

senses.en: to try to find or get

ex.en: They seek advice before they change the rule.
ex.zh: 他们在改规则之前寻求建议。

ex.en: Students who seek help early avoid the week when the work is already late.
ex.zh: 早点求助的学生，能避开作业已经迟了的那一周。

tip: seek 的过去式和过去分词是 sought。比 look for 正式。

senses.en: to have enough money or time for
to provide something useful or desirable

ex.en: We cannot afford to waste water.
ex.zh: 我们浪费不起水。

ex.en: Without financial assistance, many students cannot afford to attend university despite having strong academic potential.
ex.zh: 如果没有经济援助，许多学生即使有很强的学术潜力，也无力负担大学费用。

col: can afford to do｜有能力负担做某事
cannot afford to lose｜承受不起失去
tip: 常用can afford sth或can afford to do，不接doing。

senses.en: an edge, a face, or one of two groups

ex.en: Please write notes on the side of the page.
ex.zh: 请把笔记写在页边。

ex.en: Both sides of a noisy road need a safe crossing if children walk to school there.
ex.zh: 如果孩子从那里走路上学，嘈杂马路的两边都需要安全的过街处。

col: on the other side｜在另一边
tip: side 是名词；旁边用 beside 或 by the side of。

senses.en: a thing you can see or touch, an aim, or a grammar object
to say that you disagree

ex.en: The object on the desk is a model.
ex.zh: 桌上的物体是一个模型。

ex.en: The object of the rule is safety, and the sign should say that.
ex.zh: 这条规则的目的是安全，牌子上应当写出来。

tip: 名词物体读 /ˈɒbdʒɪkt/。动词反对读 /əbˈdʒekt/，后接 to doing。

senses.en: pleasant to look at
fairly

ex.en: The pretty garden is behind the hall.
ex.zh: 漂亮的花园在大厅后面。

ex.en: A pretty river view does not mean the water is clean enough for children to play in.
ex.zh: 河景漂亮并不意味着水干净到可以让孩子玩。

tip: pretty 作副词表示“相当”，语气比 very 弱。

senses.en: to get to a place

ex.en: The bus arrives at four.
ex.zh: 公交四点到达。

ex.en: Students who arrive after the gate closes still need a number to call.
ex.zh: 门关了之后才到的学生，仍然需要一个能打的电话。

tip: 小地点用 arrive at，城市和国家用 arrive in。名词 arrival 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: worry caused by difficulty, or special importance
to give special importance

ex.en: Exam stress is common in May.
ex.zh: 五月考试压力很常见。

ex.en: Teachers who stress sleep as well as scores give students a fairer message.
ex.zh: 同时强调睡眠和分数的老师，给学生的信息更公平。

tip: stress 作动词是强调。语音里的重读也叫 stress。

senses.en: easy to understand or see
to remove, or to become bright

ex.en: Please write a clear title.
ex.zh: 请写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: Clear signs at a junction matter more at night, when drivers and children share a narrow road.
ex.zh: 路口清楚的标志在夜里更重要，那时司机和孩子共用一条窄路。

tip: clear 作动词是“清除”或“放晴”。It is clear that...

senses.en: using numbers, or stored as computer data

ex.en: The digital clock in the hall is wrong.
ex.zh: 大厅里的数字钟不准。

ex.en: Digital notes are easy to share and easy to lose if nobody keeps a copy.
ex.zh: 数字笔记容易分享，如果没人留备份也容易丢失。

tip: digital 与 analogue 相对。不要和 traditional 的反义 modern 混用。

senses.en: a government department

ex.en: The ministry published the new school rule.
ex.zh: 该部公布了新的学校规定。

ex.en: A ministry that funds buses should also say which villages are left out.
ex.zh: 资助公交的部，也应当说明哪些村子被落下了。

tip: ministry 可数。部长是 minister，已在本库。

senses.en: a hard clear material, or a cup made of it

ex.en: There is a glass of water on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯水。

ex.en: Broken glass on a playground is a safety problem, not only a cleaning job.
ex.zh: 操场上的碎玻璃是安全问题，不只是打扫的事。

tip: glass 作材料不可数。a glass 是一只杯子。眼镜用复数 glasses。

senses.en: the group of people who govern a country or city

ex.en: The government plans to repair the old bridge.
ex.zh: 政府计划修缮那座旧桥。

ex.en: A local government that publishes its spending makes it easier for citizens to ask useful questions.
ex.zh: 公开支出的地方政府，让公民更容易提出有用的问题。

tip: government 作整体时谓语常用单数。

senses.en: necessary for life or success

ex.en: Sleep is vital before an exam.
ex.zh: 考前睡眠极其重要。

ex.en: A vital notice should be on paper when the network fails.
ex.zh: 至关重要的通知，在网络断了时应当有纸质的。

tip: It is vital to do。

senses.en: something that makes an illness better
to make an illness go away

ex.en: Rest is not a cure for every illness.
ex.zh: 休息不是每种病的疗法。

ex.en: A claim of a cure should name the source.
ex.zh: 声称能治愈，应当写明来源。

tip: cure 作动词是治愈。本条不写药方。

senses.en: very unusual or surprising

ex.en: The result was extraordinary, so they measured again.
ex.zh: 结果很离奇，所以他们又测了一次。

ex.en: An extraordinary storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
ex.zh: 一场异常的风暴仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。

tip: ordinary 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: one time, or at some time in the past
as soon as

ex.en: I have been to the museum only once.
ex.zh: 我只去过一次博物馆。

ex.en: Once a wetland is filled in for housing, the birds do not return just because a sign says they are welcome.
ex.zh: 一旦湿地被填平用来建房，鸟儿不会因为一块欢迎的牌子就回来。

tip: once 引导条件从句时表示“一旦”，主句常用将来或情态。

senses.en: just, or reasonably good
an outdoor sale or exhibition

ex.en: The rule is fair if it applies to everyone.
ex.zh: 如果规则适用于所有人，它就是公平的。

ex.en: A fair chance to learn includes a quiet room, not only an equal test paper.
ex.zh: 公平的学习机会包括一间安静的房间，而不只是一份相同的试卷。

tip: fair 作名词是“集市、义卖”。

senses.en: a holiday; especially American

ex.en: The vacation starts next Friday.
ex.zh: 假期下周五开始。

ex.en: A long vacation still needs someone to feed the school cat.
ex.zh: 长假仍然需要有人喂学校的猫。

tip: vacation 是美式。英式常用 holiday，已在本库。

senses.en: important; large
a main university subject, or a student studying that subject
to study a particular subject as your main university subject

ex.en: Traffic is a major problem.
ex.zh: 交通是一个重大问题。

ex.en: Access to affordable childcare remains a major concern for parents who wish to return to work.
ex.zh: 对于希望重返职场的父母而言，能否获得负担得起的托育服务仍是一个主要顾虑。

tip: 动词主修用major in；主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: a written message, or a sign in the alphabet

ex.en: I wrote a letter to my cousin.
ex.zh: 我给表哥写了一封信。

ex.en: A letter to the council should name the street and the problem, not only the feeling.
ex.zh: 给市政会的信应该写明街道和问题，而不只是情绪。

tip: letter 的两个常见义是信和字母。

senses.en: unpleasant, poor, or serious

ex.en: The weather was bad, so the match was delayed.
ex.zh: 天气不好，比赛推迟了。

ex.en: Bad air on the walk to school can harm children even when their classrooms are clean.
ex.zh: 即使教室很干净，上学路上的糟糕空气仍可能伤害孩子。

tip: bad 的比较级是 worse，最高级是 worst，不是 more bad。

senses.en: to kick or throw toward a goal, or to take a photograph
a new growth, or an act of firing

ex.en: She can shoot from the corner.
ex.zh: 她能从角球位置射门。

ex.en: Students may not shoot photos during an exam, even if the phone is already in their hand.
ex.zh: 即使手机已经拿在手里，考试时学生也不可以拍照。

tip: shoot 的过去式和过去分词是 shot。名词还可指嫩芽。射击是词典里的另一个意思；本库不写操作方法。

senses.en: to slide and lose your balance
a small mistake, or a small piece of paper

ex.en: You may slip on the wet path.
ex.zh: 你可能会在湿路上滑倒。

ex.en: A slip at the gate is a reason to dry the floor the same hour.
ex.zh: 门口滑一跤，是在同一小时把地擦干的理由。

tip: slip 作名词可以是纸片或疏忽。

senses.en: an order
to order, or to be in charge

ex.en: The captain gave a clear command.
ex.zh: 队长下了一道清楚的命令。

ex.en: A command that nobody understands is not safer than a short explanation.
ex.zh: 谁也听不懂的命令，并不比一句短说明更安全。

col: at one command｜听某人的命令
tip: command 作动词是命令。计算机里的指令也叫 command。

senses.en: familiar with something, or not new

ex.en: I am used to getting up early on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我习惯早起。

ex.en: A used textbook can be as useful as a new one if the notes in the margin are clear.
ex.zh: 如果页边的笔记清楚，旧课本可以和新的一样有用。

col: be used to do｜被用来做
tip: used to do 是过去常常；be used to doing 是习惯于。不要混用。

senses.en: something you use to do a job

ex.en: The tool is on the bench.
ex.zh: 工具在工作台上。

ex.en: A map is a tool, and so is the person who knows which stop is safe at night.
ex.zh: 地图是工具，知道哪个车站夜里安全的人也是。

tip: tool 可数。计算机里的工具也叫 tool。

senses.en: a particular published form of a book or paper

ex.en: We use the new edition of the textbook.
ex.zh: 我们用这本教材的新版。

ex.en: The evening edition of the paper corrected a name that the morning edition had wrong.
ex.zh: 晚报更正了早报写错的一个名字。

tip: edition 是一版出版物。软件或文本的另一种形式也可用 version。

senses.en: to try hard to do something difficult
a hard effort

ex.en: He struggled to hear at the back.
ex.zh: 他在后排努力想听清。

ex.en: Students who struggle with one subject still belong in the lab.
ex.zh: 某一科吃力的学生，仍然应当进实验室。

tip: struggle 也可作名词。后接 to do 表示费力地做。

senses.en: the making of goods, or a branch of business

ex.en: The town grew around the steel industry.
ex.zh: 这个城镇是围绕钢铁工业发展起来的。

ex.en: An industry beside a river should pay for the water it dirties, not only for the jobs it creates.
ex.zh: 河边的工业应该为它弄脏的水付费，而不只为它创造的工作。

tip: industry 的复数是 industries。

senses.en: and not, used after a negative

ex.en: He cannot swim, nor can his brother.
ex.zh: 他不会游泳，他弟弟也不会。

ex.en: The hall has neither a ramp nor a clear sign, so some parents never come in.
ex.zh: 礼堂既没有坡道，也没有清楚的标志，所以有些家长从不进来。

tip: neither...nor 连接并列成分。nor 放在句首时，后面的句子常用倒装。or 已在排除的虚词里，nor 作为考纲词头保留。

senses.en: a game played with small bats and a light ball

ex.en: Table tennis practice is at four.
ex.zh: 乒乓球训练在四点。

ex.en: A table tennis room that locks before the last class leaves is not a plan for sport.
ex.zh: 在最后一节课离开之前就锁上的乒乓球室，不是体育方案。

tip: play table tennis 不加 the。

senses.en: the part of the face used for breathing and smelling

ex.en: Cover your nose when you sneeze.
ex.zh: 打喷嚏时捂住鼻子。

ex.en: A nosebleed in class is a reason to call the clinic, not to laugh.
ex.zh: 课上流鼻血是叫医务室的理由，不是嘲笑的理由。

tip: nose 可数。

senses.en: spoken, not written

ex.en: The oral test is on Thursday.
ex.zh: 口试在周四。

ex.en: An oral warning at the gate helps the student who cannot read the sign.
ex.zh: 门口的口头警告能帮助看不懂牌子的学生。

tip: oral 与 aural（听觉的）拼写接近。

senses.en: a person who controls a business or team

ex.en: The shop manager checked the list.
ex.zh: 店经理核对了清单。

ex.en: A hospital manager who walks the night ward sees problems a report can miss.
ex.zh: 走夜班病房的医院经理，能看到报告可能漏掉的问题。

tip: manager 是人；management 是管理这个工作。

senses.en: running side by side and never meeting
a similar case, or a line of latitude

ex.en: The two paths are parallel.
ex.zh: 这两条路是平行的。

ex.en: A parallel example from another town helps, if the numbers are real.
ex.zh: 另一个城镇的平行例子有帮助，如果数字是真的。

tip: parallel 作名词可以是相似的人或纬线。

senses.en: the top of the body, or the person in charge
to go towards, or to lead

ex.en: She nodded her head to show she understood.
ex.zh: 她点头表示听懂了。

ex.en: A club needs a head who listens, or the loudest member will decide everything.
ex.zh: 社团需要一个肯听意见的负责人，否则声音最大的人会决定一切。

col: from head to foot｜从头到脚
tip: head for 表示朝某地去。head 作动词是“前往”或“率领”。

senses.en: on the day before today
the day before today

ex.en: Yesterday we practised the play in the hall.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在大厅里排戏。

ex.en: A storm yesterday closed two roads, so some students arrived after the first lesson.
ex.zh: 昨天的暴风雨封了两条路，所以有些学生第一节课后才到。

tip: yesterday 前不用介词，不说 on yesterday。

senses.en: a large organization, especially for education or care

ex.en: The library is a public institution.
ex.zh: 图书馆是一个公共机构。

ex.en: An institution that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的机构更难让家庭信任。

tip: institute 已在本库，常指研究所或学院。institution 更泛，也可以是制度。

senses.en: a thing that is not named

ex.en: There is something wrong with the clock.
ex.zh: 这只钟有点问题。

ex.en: Something as small as a leaked battery can pollute the soil around a school for years.
ex.zh: 一块泄漏的电池这样小的东西，也可能污染学校周围的土壤很多年。

tip: 形容词放在 something 后面：something important。

senses.en: an animal kept at home

ex.en: The office pet is a cat.
ex.zh: 办公室的宠物是一只猫。

ex.en: A school pet needs a named person for the holiday, not only a photo.
ex.zh: 学校的宠物在假期需要一个写明姓名的人，而不只是一张照片。

tip: pet 作动词是抚摸。

senses.en: without other people

ex.en: She walked home alone.
ex.zh: 她独自走回了家。

ex.en: A child should not wait alone for a late bus on a road without lights.
ex.zh: 孩子不该独自在没有灯的路上等晚点的公交。

tip: alone 强调独自；lonely 强调孤独的感觉。alone 不作定语放在名词前。

senses.en: to stop something from happening

ex.en: Wash your hands to prevent a cold from spreading.
ex.zh: 洗手以防止感冒传播。

ex.en: Street lights prevent some night accidents, and they do not replace a crossing.
ex.zh: 路灯能防止一些夜间事故，但不能代替斑马线。

col: prevent sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip: 固定搭配是 prevent somebody from doing something。

senses.en: angry, or mentally ill; also very keen

ex.en: She was mad at me for being late.
ex.zh: 她因为我迟到而生气。

ex.en: Being mad about a subject is useful only when the student also sleeps.
ex.zh: 对一门学科着迷只有在学生也睡觉时才有用。

tip: 英式口语 mad 常指发疯或着迷；美式常指生气。描述疾病时要用更尊重的说法。

senses.en: to end an activity or prevent something
a halt, or a place where a bus stops

ex.en: Please stop talking when the bell rings.
ex.zh: 铃响时请停止讲话。

ex.en: Cities that stop cars from idling outside schools cut the fumes children breathe at the gate.
ex.zh: 禁止汽车在校门外怠速的城市，减少了孩子在门口吸入的废气。

col: stop sb from doing｜阻止某人做
tip: stop doing 是停下正在做的事；stop to do 是停下来去做另一件事。

senses.en: meat from a cow

ex.en: The soup has beef in it.
ex.zh: 这汤里有牛肉。

ex.en: Beef on a menu should say so, for the student who does not eat it.
ex.zh: 菜单上的牛肉应当写明，给不吃牛肉的学生看。

tip: beef 作肉通常不可数。

senses.en: a day or period when you do not work or study

ex.en: The holiday starts next Friday.
ex.zh: 假期下周五开始。

ex.en: A long holiday still needs someone to feed the school cat and lock the lab.
ex.zh: 长假仍然需要有人喂学校的猫、锁实验室。

tip: 英式 holiday 常指假期。美式 vacation 更常见。on holiday 不加 the。

senses.en: the side that faces forward
at the front

ex.en: Please come to the front if you cannot see.
ex.zh: 如果看不见，请到前面来。

ex.en: Shops in front of a school affect what students buy more than a poster inside the classroom does.
ex.zh: 学校前面的商店对学生买什么的影响，大于教室里的一张海报。

tip: in front of 在外部前面；in the front of 在内部的前部。

senses.en: well known
having knowledge or experience of something

ex.en: This song sounds familiar.
ex.zh: 这首歌听起来很熟悉。

ex.en: Students who are familiar with digital tools may adapt more easily to online learning environments.
ex.zh: 熟悉数字工具的学生可能更容易适应在线学习环境。

tip: 人熟悉事物用with；事物为人熟悉用to。

senses.en: the dark part of the day

ex.en: I review new words at night.
ex.zh: 我在晚上复习生词。

ex.en: Bright signs at night may help shops, but they can also keep nearby residents awake.
ex.zh: 夜间明亮的招牌也许有助于商店，但也会让附近居民睡不着。

tip: at night 不加 the；on 加具体的某个夜晚，如 on Sunday night。

senses.en: to put a question, or to request

ex.en: Ask the teacher if you do not understand.
ex.zh: 不懂就问老师。

ex.en: Cities should ask residents where floods actually reach, not only where the map predicts them.
ex.zh: 城市应该询问居民洪水实际淹到哪里，而不只是看地图的预测。

col: ask sb to do｜请某人做
tip: ask sb sth 或 ask sb to do。ask 后不接 sb doing。

senses.en: a clever act to deceive, or a skill that entertains
to deceive

ex.en: The trick question hid the real date.
ex.zh: 这道陷阱题藏起了真正的日期。

ex.en: A magic trick is fine; a trick that takes a classmate money is not.
ex.zh: 魔术把戏可以，骗同学钱的诡计不行。

tip: trick 作动词是欺骗。

senses.en: a short coat

ex.en: Hang the jacket on the hook.
ex.zh: 把夹克挂在钩子上。

ex.en: A spare jacket at school matters when the rain soaks the first one.
ex.zh: 雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用夹克就有用。

tip: jacket 可数。

senses.en: having good luck

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus.
ex.zh: 我们运气好，赶上了末班车。

ex.en: A lucky guess on one question should not be treated as mastery of the chapter.
ex.zh: 一道题上的幸运猜测，不该被当成已经掌握了这一章。

tip: 名词运气是 luck，已在本库。lucky 是形容词。

senses.en: British spelling of honor
to show respect, or to give an award

ex.en: It was an honour to speak for the class.
ex.zh: 代表班级发言是一种荣誉。

ex.en: An honour roll that lists only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
ex.zh: 只列分数的光荣榜，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。

tip: honour 是英式，honor 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

senses.en: a copy, a good example, or a design

ex.en: We built a model of the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们做了一个桥的模型。

ex.en: A role model in a textbook helps less than a neighbour who does the job the student hopes to learn.
ex.zh: 课本里的榜样，不如一个正在做学生想学的工作的邻居有用。

tip: model 作动词是“做模特”或“以……为榜样”。

senses.en: something that joins people, or a written promise to pay

ex.en: Sport can create a bond between classes.
ex.zh: 体育能在班级之间建立联系。

ex.en: A bond between a school and a clinic matters on the day a child is ill.
ex.zh: 学校和诊所之间的联系，在孩子生病的那天很重要。

tip: bond 也可指债券。作动词是建立联系。

senses.en: the world, or a model of the earth

ex.en: The globe is on the desk.
ex.zh: 地球仪在书桌上。

ex.en: A globe in the classroom should show more than one ocean.
ex.zh: 教室里的地球仪应当显示不止一片海洋。

tip: globe 可数。the globe 常指地球。

senses.en: letters and parcels, or the system that sends them
to send by post

ex.en: The mail arrives after lunch.
ex.zh: 邮件午饭后到。

ex.en: School mail that names a child should not sit open on a public desk.
ex.zh: 写有孩子姓名的学校邮件，不应当拆开摊在公共桌子上。

tip: 美式 mail 相当于英式 post。作动词是邮寄。email 是电子邮件。

senses.en: burning, or a destructive burning
to shoot, or to dismiss from a job

ex.en: We had a fire drill on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一我们进行了消防演习。

ex.en: A hillside fire can reach a village faster than a warning if the road out is narrow.
ex.zh: 如果出去的路很窄，山火到达村庄的速度可以快过警报。

tip: fire 作“火”时常不可数；一场火灾用 a fire。

senses.en: who a person is

ex.en: The form asks for identity, not a nickname.
ex.zh: 表格要的是身份，不是绰号。

ex.en: A student identity card should open the library, not only the front gate.
ex.zh: 学生证应当能打开图书馆，而不只是前门。

tip: identity 可数。证明身份用 prove your identity。

senses.en: a girl or woman with the same parents

ex.en: My sister walks home with me.
ex.zh: 我姐姐和我一起走回家。

ex.en: A sister who leaves for the city may still call home, but the daily help is gone.
ex.zh: 去城市的姐妹也许仍会打电话回家，但日常的帮忙没有了。

tip: sister 的复数是 sisters。

senses.en: what is actually true

ex.en: The film is fun, but it is not reality.
ex.zh: 这部电影好看，但它不是现实。

ex.en: Budget reality returns when a school must choose between a new lab and repairing the roof.
ex.zh: 当学校必须在新实验室和修屋顶之间选择时，预算的现实就回来了。

tip: reality 通常不可数。in reality 用来纠正一种看起来相反的印象。

senses.en: a judgement of the value or level of something

ex.en: The assessment is a short essay, not only a score.
ex.zh: 这次评价是一篇短文，而不只是一个分数。

ex.en: Fair assessment looks at the work, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
ex.zh: 公平的评价看的是作业，而不是谁坐着安静的车来的。

tip: assessment 可数。

senses.en: not strong

ex.en: The tea is weak.
ex.zh: 这茶很淡。

ex.en: A weak signal in the hall is a reason to print the notice, not only to post it online.
ex.zh: 大厅信号弱，是把通知印出来的理由，而不只是发到网上。

tip: 人身体弱、味道淡、论据弱都可以用 weak。名词是 weakness。

senses.en: a speed, a proportion, or a price

ex.en: The heart rate rises when you run.
ex.zh: 跑步时心率会上升。

ex.en: A high absence rate may show a bus problem, not only a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 高缺勤率可能说明公交有问题，而不只是缺乏兴趣。

col: at a rate of｜以……的速度
tip: rate 作动词是“评价”。

senses.en: the coldest season

ex.en: Winter here lasts from December to February.
ex.zh: 这里的冬天从十二月持续到二月。

ex.en: Schools in a long winter need heating plans that poor families can still afford.
ex.zh: 漫长冬天里的学校需要穷人家庭仍然负担得起的供暖方案。

tip: 季节前通常不用 the：in winter。特指某一年的冬天可以用 the winter of。

senses.en: a person who treats illness, or a holder of a doctorate

ex.en: The doctor asked him to rest for two days.
ex.zh: 医生让他休息两天。

ex.en: A school doctor can notice a hearing problem early, before it affects every lesson.
ex.zh: 校医可以早发现听力问题，免得它影响到每一节课。

tip: 称谓缩写是 Dr.，本库已有单独词条。博士和医生都可能用 doctor，要看语境。

senses.en: a building used for worship

ex.en: The old temple is quiet in the morning.
ex.zh: 清晨的古庙很安静。

ex.en: A visit to a temple should explain whose festival it is, and who does not celebrate it.
ex.zh: 参观寺庙应当说明这是谁的节日，以及谁不过这个节。

tip: temple 可数。参观时保持安静。

senses.en: to behave toward someone, or to give medical care
something special that you pay for

ex.en: Treat the equipment with care.
ex.zh: 小心使用这些设备。

ex.en: Clinics that treat a cut the same day keep a small injury from stopping a week of school.
ex.zh: 当天处理伤口的诊所，能避免小伤耽误一周的课。

tip: treat 还可表示请客。治疗的名词是 treatment，已在本库。

senses.en: to be worthy of

ex.en: You deserve a rest after such hard work.
ex.zh: 这么辛苦之后你应得休息。

ex.en: Healthcare workers deserve greater recognition because their dedication contributes directly to the wellbeing of society.
ex.zh: 医护人员值得获得更多认可，因为他们的奉献直接促进了社会福祉。

tip: 接名词或to do；不用deserve doing表示主动。

senses.en: of the mind

senses.zh: 脑力的；在头脑中进行的
senses.en: Using thought rather than physical action or written calculation.

ex.en: mental health matters as much as body health.
ex.zh: 心理健康与身体健康同样重要。

ex.en: Employers should give mental wellbeing the same priority as physical safety when designing workplace policies.
ex.zh: 雇主制定职场政策时，应将心理健康与人身安全放在同等重要的位置。

tip: mental侧重心理或脑力；口语中形容人疯狂可能冒犯。

senses.en: a large sports ground with seats

ex.en: The match is in the city stadium.
ex.zh: 比赛在市体育场。

ex.en: A stadium that is full on Saturday can be empty of buses on Sunday.
ex.zh: 周六满座的体育场，周日可能没有公交。

tip: stadium 可数。复数 stadiums 或 stadia。

senses.en: to say that something or someone is good or suitable

ex.en: The teacher recommended a short novel.
ex.zh: 老师推荐了一部短篇小说。

ex.en: Doctors recommend sleep before an exam more often than another late lesson.
ex.zh: 医生建议考前睡觉，这比再加一节晚课更常见。

tip: recommend 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。比 suggest 更明确地表示这是好的选择。

senses.en: money paid in advance, or a layer left by water
to put money or a layer somewhere

ex.en: The deposit is returned in June.
ex.zh: 押金在六月退还。

ex.en: A deposit that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
ex.zh: 没写下来的押金，不是家庭能核对的价格。

tip: deposit 作动词是存放或沉积。

senses.en: two things of the same kind used together

ex.en: I need a new pair of shoes.
ex.zh: 我需要一双新鞋。

ex.en: A pair of students sharing one text still need two chances to speak.
ex.zh: 合用一本课文的两名学生，仍然需要两次发言的机会。

tip: a pair of trousers 谓语用单数。两条裤子是 two pairs。

senses.en: a part of something

ex.en: Read the first section of the text.
ex.zh: 读课文的第一部分。

ex.en: The sports section of a newspaper rarely explains who pays for the new stadium.
ex.zh: 报纸的体育版很少解释新体育场的钱是谁出的。

tip: section 可指文章的一部分，也可指机构的部门。

senses.en: a group of things kept together

ex.en: The library has a collection of old maps.
ex.zh: 图书馆收藏了一批旧地图。

ex.en: A collection of photos taken each spring can show how a river changes.
ex.zh: 每年春天拍摄的一组照片，可以展示一条河如何变化。

tip: collection 是可数名词。

senses.en: a person who studies

ex.en: Every student has a library card.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有借书证。

ex.en: A student who works nights to pay rent may still care deeply about the class.
ex.zh: 为付房租上夜班的学生，仍然可能非常在意这门课。

tip: student 是可数名词。

senses.en: the reflexive form of you

ex.en: Please help yourself to the fruit.
ex.zh: 请随便吃水果。

ex.en: You should ask yourself who benefits before you share a story that sounds too perfect.
ex.zh: 在转发一个听起来过于完美的故事之前，你应该问问自己谁从中获益。

tip: 对多人用 yourselves。

senses.en: the amount of money something costs

ex.en: The price of the ticket is twenty yuan.
ex.zh: 票价是二十元。

ex.en: A low ticket price means little if the bus never reaches the villages that need it.
ex.zh: 如果公交根本到不了需要它的村子，低票价也没什么意义。

col: at a price of｜以……的价格
tip: price 是卖方标出的价格；cost 常指买方付出的代价。

senses.en: a way of communicating or doing something
of middle size or degree

ex.en: Video is one medium for the notice.
ex.zh: 视频是发布通知的一种媒介。

ex.en: The medium of a message matters less than whether the last bus is named.
ex.zh: 信息用什么媒介，不如有没有写上末班车重要。

tip: 复数是 media，已在本库。作形容词是中等的。

senses.en: to be good for
to help someone or receive help or an advantage
money provided by the government to people needing support

ex.en: Exercise can benefit both body and mind.
ex.zh: 锻炼有益于身心。

ex.en: Rural communities can benefit from improved internet access through greater opportunities for education and employment.
ex.zh: 更好的互联网接入能增加教育和就业机会，让农村社区受益。

tip: benefit sb指使某人受益；benefit from指得益于。

senses.en: a being believed to control nature or life

ex.en: In the story, the villagers thanked the god of the river.
ex.zh: 故事里，村民感谢河神。

ex.en: Ancient myths about a god of rain show how closely people once tied weather to survival.
ex.zh: 古代关于雨神的神话表明，人们曾经把天气和生存联系得多么紧密。

tip: god 指神灵；God 大写时常特指基督教等宗教中的上帝。

senses.en: a place where legal cases are heard, or a sports ground

ex.en: The tennis court is behind the gym.
ex.zh: 网球场在体育馆后面。

ex.en: A court that takes years to hear a simple case leaves families waiting for a decision.
ex.zh: 审理一件简单案件要花数年的法院，会让家庭一直等一个决定。

tip: court 既可指法庭也可指球场，要看搭配。

senses.en: done for only part of the usual working time

ex.en: She has a part-time job at the library.
ex.zh: 她在图书馆有一份兼职。

ex.en: Part-time jobs can teach responsibility, but they should not replace the sleep teenagers still need.
ex.zh: 兼职可以培养责任感，但不该取代青少年仍然需要的睡眠。

tip: part-time 作定语时通常加连字符；作状语有时写成 part time。

senses.en: coming after all others, or most recent
to continue for a period of time

ex.en: I sat in the last row during the talk.
ex.zh: 讲座时我坐在最后一排。

ex.en: Last year's flood still shapes where the town is willing to build new houses.
ex.zh: 去年的洪水仍然影响着这座城镇愿意在哪里建新房。

col: the last but not least｜最后但同样重要
tip: last 作动词是“持续”。过去式和过去分词仍是 last。

senses.en: to pay attention to sound

ex.en: Listen to the recording twice.
ex.zh: 把录音听两遍。

ex.en: Planners who listen to night-shift workers hear problems a daytime meeting never raises.
ex.zh: 倾听夜班工人的规划者，会听到白天的会议从不提出的问题。

tip: listen 是不及物动词，必须加 to 再接宾语。

senses.en: having little money, or not good

ex.en: The recording quality is poor.
ex.zh: 录音质量很差。

ex.en: Poor families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，贫穷家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: the poor 表示穷人这一类，谓语用复数。

senses.en: as much as is needed, or more

ex.en: There is plenty of time before the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前时间很充裕。

ex.en: Plenty of posters do not replace one working clock in the hall.
ex.zh: 再多海报也代替不了大厅里一块能走的钟。

tip: plenty of 后接可数复数或不可数名词。表里这一行的音标是 pleased，本库不用。

senses.en: the state of being real

ex.en: The rule is in existence, but nobody reads it.
ex.zh: 规定存在着，但没人读。

ex.en: The existence of a late bus matters only if students know the time.
ex.zh: 晚班车的存在，只有在学生知道时间时才有意义。

tip: 动词 exist 已在本库。existence 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place for indoor sport

ex.en: The gym is open after four.
ex.zh: 体育馆四点以后开放。

ex.en: A gym that locks before the last class leaves is not a plan for sport.
ex.zh: 在最后一节课离开之前就锁上的体育馆，不是体育方案。

tip: gym 是 gymnasium 的简称。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a number of different types

ex.en: The canteen offers a variety of fruit.
ex.zh: 食堂提供各种各样的水果。

ex.en: A variety of routes to school matters when one road floods.
ex.zh: 一条路被淹时，多种上学路线就很重要。

tip: a variety of 后接复数名词时，谓语可用复数。

senses.en: the chance that someone will be hurt

ex.en: The sign says danger because the step is broken.
ex.zh: 牌子写着危险，是因为台阶坏了。

ex.en: Danger on the walk home is a planning problem, not a test of courage.
ex.zh: 回家路上的危险是规划问题，不是勇气测验。

tip: dangerous 形容事物，已在本库。人处于危险中用 in danger。

senses.en: the activity of reading

ex.en: Quiet reading starts at eight.
ex.zh: 安静阅读八点开始。

ex.en: Reading with an adult at home helps a child more than an extra worksheet.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人陪着阅读，比多一张练习纸更有帮助。

tip: reading 作“阅读”时常不可数。

senses.en: a musical instrument with strings

ex.en: The guitar is in the music room.
ex.zh: 吉他在音乐教室。

ex.en: A guitar that students can borrow matters more than a poster of a concert.
ex.zh: 学生能借到的吉他，比一张音乐会海报更重要。

tip: 乐器前常用 the：play the guitar。

senses.en: the star that gives the earth light

ex.en: The sun was hot at noon.
ex.zh: 中午太阳很晒。

ex.en: Shade from trees matters most when the sun is high and the walk to school is long.
ex.zh: 当太阳高、上学的路又长时，树荫最为重要。

tip: the sun 通常加 the。

senses.en: a person who believes in Christianity
of Christianity

ex.en: The guide said this church is still used by local Christians.
ex.zh: 导游说这座教堂仍供当地基督徒使用。

ex.en: A history lesson about Christian festivals should also explain who does not celebrate them.
ex.zh: 关于基督教节日的历史课，也应当说明谁不过这些节日。

tip: Christian 作名词和形容词都要大写。

senses.en: the reason for doing something

ex.en: The purpose of the survey is to plan lunch.
ex.zh: 这次调查的目的是安排午餐。

ex.en: A rule without a clear purpose is hard to defend when students ask why it exists.
ex.zh: 没有明确目的的规定，在学生追问它为什么存在时很难辩护。

tip: on purpose 是故意，反义是 by accident。

senses.en: in the middle, or most important

ex.en: The central library is near the station.
ex.zh: 中心图书馆在车站附近。

ex.en: Central heating in a school matters in a town where winter lasts five months.
ex.zh: 在冬天长达五个月的城镇，学校的集中供暖很重要。

tip: central 是形容词；centre / center 是名词。

senses.en: an official paper that allows something

ex.en: The driver showed a license.
ex.zh: 司机出示了执照。

ex.en: A license to run the canteen should say who checks the food.
ex.zh: 经营食堂的许可证应当写明谁检查食物。

tip: license 是美式拼写。英式名词常用 licence，动词常用 license。本库用考纲里的 license。

senses.en: a person who directs a film or an organisation

ex.en: The director of the club explained the plan.
ex.zh: 社团负责人解释了计划。

ex.en: A hospital director who never walks the night ward may miss what the staff already know.
ex.zh: 从不走夜班病房的医院主任，可能会错过员工已经知道的事。

tip: director 是人；direction 是方向或指导。

senses.en: a planned set of actions

ex.en: The school started a campaign to save water.
ex.zh: 学校开展了节水运动。

ex.en: A campaign against litter fails if the bins are farther away than the habit of dropping rubbish.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾桶比随手扔垃圾的习惯更远，反垃圾运动就会失败。

tip: campaign 作动词是“参加运动”。

senses.en: all of space and everything in it

ex.en: The lesson starts with the universe and ends with the town.
ex.zh: 这课从宇宙讲起，讲到我们的城镇结束。

ex.en: A picture of the universe does not replace a working clock in the hall.
ex.zh: 一张宇宙的图代替不了大厅里一块能走的钟。

tip: universe 通常用 the universe。

senses.en: feeling or showing anger

ex.en: He was angry about the broken window.
ex.zh: 他对打碎的窗户很生气。

ex.en: An angry notice rarely explains the rule as clearly as a calm one.
ex.zh: 一张怒气冲冲的通知，很少能像一张平静的通知那样把规则讲清。

col: be angry with sb｜生某人的气
tip: 对人生气用 angry with，对事用 angry about。

senses.en: the centre of a city

ex.en: The library is downtown.
ex.zh: 图书馆在市中心。

ex.en: A downtown school still needs a bus for students who live past the last stop.
ex.zh: 市中心的学校仍然需要公交，给住在末站以外的学生。

tip: downtown 是美式，也可作副词。英式常说 the city centre。

senses.en: the season after winter, a coil, or a source of water

ex.en: We plant flowers in spring.
ex.zh: 我们在春天种花。

ex.en: A spring of clean water can matter more to a village than a new sign at the roadside.
ex.zh: 一口干净的泉对村子的意义，可以大于路边一块新牌子。

tip: 季节前用 in spring，通常不加 the。spring 的三个义靠搭配区分。

senses.en: past experience or setting
Information or events needed to understand a situation
The part of a scene behind the main subject

ex.en: Her family background shaped her views.
ex.zh: 她的家庭背景塑造了她的观点。

ex.en: Universities should provide equal opportunities for applicants from different social backgrounds, regardless of their family income.
ex.zh: 大学应为来自不同社会背景的申请者提供平等机会，不论其家庭收入如何。

col: a disadvantaged background｜弱势家庭背景
tip: 经历领域用background in；背景中用in the background。

senses.en: straight; clear
To guide or control an activity, performance, or group.
To show the way or aim something towards a place.

ex.en: Take the direct route home.
ex.zh: 走直接回家的路。

ex.en: Improved public transport can have a direct impact on employment by connecting residents with more job opportunities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能让居民获得更多就业机会，从而对就业产生直接影响。

col: direct attention to｜将注意力转向
tip: direct可作形容词或动词；常见读音也有/daɪˈrekt/。

senses.en: fighting between countries or groups

ex.en: The history class discussed the cost of war.
ex.zh: 历史课讨论了战争的代价。

ex.en: After a war, schools are often rebuilt later than roads, though children need them first.
ex.zh: 战争之后，学校的重建常常晚于道路，尽管孩子最先需要的是学校。

tip: war 前常用 in：in the war。

senses.en: the land along the edge of a sea or lake

ex.en: The path follows the shore.
ex.zh: 这条路沿着岸走。

ex.en: A lesson about the shore should say who fishes there.
ex.zh: 关于岸边的课应当说谁在那里捕鱼。

tip: shore 可数。

senses.en: teaching and learning

ex.en: Public education should not depend on a family's income.
ex.zh: 公共教育不该取决于一个家庭的收入。

ex.en: Education about floods is useful only when it includes the streets children actually use.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的教育，只有包含孩子真正走的那些街时才有用。

tip: education 不可数。

senses.en: a group of musicians, or a strip

ex.en: The school band will play tonight.
ex.zh: 学校乐队今晚演出。

ex.en: A band playing in the square should keep a volume that lets people talk.
ex.zh: 在广场演奏的乐队应该把音量保持在人们仍能交谈的程度。

tip: band 也可指橡皮筋或波段，要看搭配。

senses.en: the direction where the sun rises
in or towards the east

ex.en: The sun rises in the east.
ex.zh: 太阳从东方升起。

ex.en: Towns in the east of the region share one hospital, so the road between them matters.
ex.zh: 该地区东部的城镇共用一家医院，所以它们之间的路很重要。

tip: eastern 是形容词。

senses.en: a device for taking photographs or video

ex.en: Leave the camera in the bag during the test.
ex.zh: 考试时把相机留在包里。

ex.en: A camera at the school gate can make parents feel safer, and it also records ordinary children every day.
ex.zh: 校门口的摄像头能让家长更安心，它也会每天拍下普通的孩子。

tip: camera 重音在第一音节。

senses.en: mother; British informal

ex.en: Her mum will meet the bus.
ex.zh: 她妈妈会去接公交。

ex.en: A form should accept mum, mom, or another adult name.
ex.zh: 表格应当接受 mum、mom 或其他成年人的名字。

tip: mum 是英式口语。美式 mom 已在本库。两条都保留。表里这一格是 Mom 的读音，本库用英式 espeak。

senses.en: a list of food, or a list of choices on a screen

ex.en: The menu is on the wall.
ex.zh: 菜单在墙上。

ex.en: A menu that hides nuts is not a menu a student can trust.
ex.zh: 隐瞒坚果的菜单，不是学生能信任的菜单。

tip: menu 也可指计算机菜单。表里这一行的音标是 mention，本库不用。

senses.en: to save someone from danger
an act of saving someone

ex.en: The team rescued the bags, not a person; nobody was hurt.
ex.zh: 队伍救回的是包，不是人；没有人受伤。

ex.en: Flood rescue starts with a dry room and a list of names.
ex.zh: 洪水救援从一间干房间和一份名单开始。

col: come to the rescue｜前来救援
rescue sb from｜把某人从……救出
tip: rescue 也可作名词。本条不写危险操作步骤。

senses.en: even, without bumps, or without problems
to make something smooth

ex.en: The path is smooth after the repair.
ex.zh: 修好之后小路很平。

ex.en: A smooth timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
ex.zh: 顺利的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。

tip: smooth 作动词是使光滑。表里这一行的音标是 smoking，本库不用。

senses.en: to say officially that something is not allowed
an official order that forbids something

ex.en: The school bans phones during the exam.
ex.zh: 学校禁止考试时使用手机。

ex.en: A ban on the late bus would punish the students who stay for the club.
ex.zh: 禁止晚班车会惩罚留下来参加社团的学生。

col: ban sb from doing｜禁止某人做
tip: ban 作名词是禁令。比 forbid 更正式，常用于法规。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: The girl by the window is our monitor.
ex.zh: 窗边的女孩是我们的班长。

ex.en: A girl who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work, not only hear that it is possible.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女孩，应该看到有女性在做这份工作，而不只是听说这是可能的。

tip: girl 的复数是 girls。

senses.en: a reply, or a solution
to reply

ex.en: Write the answer on the line.
ex.zh: 把答案写在横线上。

ex.en: An easy answer to traffic is another lane, but that often brings more cars.
ex.zh: 交通的简单答案是再加一条车道，但这常常带来更多汽车。

col: in answer to｜作为对……的回答
tip: the answer to a question，介词用 to，不用 of。

senses.en: a device that controls the flow of water; British
to hit lightly

ex.en: Turn off the tap.
ex.zh: 关掉水龙头。

ex.en: A dripping tap wastes more water than a poster about conservation.
ex.zh: 滴水的水龙头比一张节约用水的海报更费水。

col: turn on the tap｜打开水龙头
tip: tap 是英式。美式常用 faucet。作动词是轻拍。

senses.en: feeling that there is no hope, or wanting something very much

ex.en: She was desperate for a seat on the last bus.
ex.zh: 她极想要末班车上的一个座位。

ex.en: A desperate student still needs a person to talk to, not only a poster.
ex.zh: 绝望的学生仍然需要一个能说话的人，而不只是一张海报。

tip: desperate 形容人。本条不写伤害自己的做法。

senses.en: a row, a long mark, or a queue

ex.en: Please stand in line for the tickets.
ex.zh: 请排队买票。

ex.en: A new metro line helps the centre, but outer towns still need buses to reach the first station.
ex.zh: 新地铁线方便市中心，但外围城镇仍需要公交才能到第一站。

tip: 排队英式常用 queue，美式常用 line。online 是一个词，表示“在线”。

senses.en: a person trying to be chosen, or taking an exam

ex.en: Each candidate spoke for two minutes.
ex.zh: 每位候选人讲了两分钟。

ex.en: A candidate for class monitor should say what they will do, not only their name.
ex.zh: 班长候选人应当说自己要做什么，而不只是报名字。

tip: candidate 可指求职、选举或考试的人。英式和美式重音相同，元音略有差别。

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe

ex.en: The helmet is for your protection.
ex.zh: 头盔是用来保护你的。

ex.en: Legal protection for a river fails if nobody checks the factories along it.
ex.zh: 如果没人检查沿河工厂，对河流的法律保护就会落空。

col: under the protection of｜在……的保护下
tip: protection 通常不可数。具体的保护措施有时可用复数。

senses.en: the entrance to a room or building

ex.en: Please close the door quietly.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门。

ex.en: A shop door that opens onto a pavement full of cars is hard for a child to use.
ex.zh: 开向停满汽车的人行道的店门，孩子很难使用。

tip: answer the door 表示去开门。

senses.en: unhappy because you are alone

ex.en: He felt lonely on the first day.
ex.zh: 第一天他感到孤独。

ex.en: A lonely student still needs a seat, not only a smile.
ex.zh: 孤独的学生仍然需要一个座位，而不只是一个微笑。

tip: alone 已在本库，只表示独自。lonely 带有寂寞。

senses.en: the act of making someone known, or the beginning of a book

ex.en: The introduction explains how to use the lab.
ex.zh: 引言说明如何使用实验室。

ex.en: An introduction of a new student should include a seat, not only a name.
ex.zh: 介绍新生应当包括一个座位，而不只是一个名字。

tip: an introduction to 可指入门，也可指介绍。

senses.en: the opinion people have of someone or something

ex.en: The school has a reputation for music.
ex.zh: 这所学校以音乐闻名。

ex.en: A reputation for fairness matters more than a reputation for high scores alone.
ex.zh: 公平的名声比只有高分的名声更重要。

tip: reputation 可数也可不可数。have a reputation for doing。

senses.en: a title before a woman's surname, without saying if she is married

ex.en: Ms. Li teaches history this term.
ex.zh: 李老师这学期教历史。

ex.en: On a form, Ms. is useful when a woman does not want Mrs. or Miss.
ex.zh: 在表格上，如果女性不想用 Mrs. 或 Miss，Ms. 就很有用。

tip: Ms. 后接姓，不表明婚否。Mr. 和 Mrs. 已在本库。读音是 /mɪz/，不是两个字母分开读。

senses.en: the quality of being correct

ex.en: Accuracy matters more than speed.
ex.zh: 准确比速度重要。

ex.en: The accuracy of a bus time is a written clock, not a guess.
ex.zh: 公交时间的准确是一块写下来的钟，不是猜测。

tip: accurate 已在本库。accuracy 通常不可数。

senses.en: in or of the east

ex.en: The eastern sky was already bright.
ex.zh: 东方的天空已经亮了。

ex.en: Eastern provinces that share one river have to share the news of a flood as well.
ex.zh: 共用一条河的东部省份，也必须共享洪水的消息。

tip: eastern 是形容词。名词用 east。

senses.en: a way of doing or making something

ex.en: Each student has a different writing style.
ex.zh: 每个学生的写作风格不同。

ex.en: A building style that ignores local rain will leak in the first storm.
ex.zh: 忽视本地雨水的建筑风格，会在第一场暴风雨里漏水。

tip: lifestyle 常写作一个词。

senses.en: to turn up the corners of the mouth
an act of smiling

ex.en: She smiled at the new student.
ex.zh: 她对新同学微笑。

ex.en: A smile at the gate costs nothing and tells a visitor they are welcome.
ex.zh: 门口的微笑不花钱，也能告诉来访者他们受欢迎。

tip: smile 也可作名词。不要和 smoke（烟）混淆。

senses.en: the flavour of food, or a liking
to try food, or to have a flavour

ex.en: The soup has a sweet taste.
ex.zh: 这汤有甜味。

ex.en: Taste in music differs, so the hall should not play one song for the whole afternoon.
ex.zh: 音乐品味不同，所以礼堂不该整个下午只放一首歌。

tip: taste 作动词是品尝，也可作连系动词：taste good。

senses.en: to push yourself off the ground
an act of jumping

ex.en: Do not jump off the wall.
ex.zh: 不要从墙上往下跳。

ex.en: Prices can jump in a dry month, and the canteen needs a plan before that week.
ex.zh: 干旱的月份价格可能跳涨，食堂需要在那一周之前就有方案。

col: jump to a conclusion｜匆匆下结论
tip: jump 也可作名词。jump to a conclusion 是未经思考就下结论。

senses.en: past tense of find
to start an organisation

ex.en: We found a quiet corner in the library.
ex.zh: 我们在图书馆找到一个安静的角落。

ex.en: Archaeologists found tools that show people cooked together long before cities existed.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现的工具表明，早在城市出现之前，人们就一起做饭了。

tip: find 的过去式是 found。表示“建立”时 founded 才是过去式，不要混用。

senses.en: stored information, or the best result so far
to write down or store sound

ex.en: Keep a record of the books you borrow.
ex.zh: 把你借的书记下来。

ex.en: A temperature record means little if the sensor sits in the sun beside a car park.
ex.zh: 如果传感器放在停车场旁边的太阳下，气温记录就没什么意义。

tip: record 作名词重音常在前；作动词“记录”时重音常在后。

senses.en: a group of things tied or growing together

ex.en: She brought a bunch of keys.
ex.zh: 她带来一串钥匙。

ex.en: A bunch of notices on one board is harder to read than one clear sheet.
ex.zh: 板上的一堆通知，比一张写清楚的纸更难读。

tip: a bunch of 后可接花、钥匙，口语里也可接人，略随便。

senses.en: a part of a building, or space for something

ex.en: The music room is on the second floor.
ex.zh: 音乐教室在二楼。

ex.en: There is little room for a safe pavement if cars are allowed to park on both sides.
ex.zh: 如果允许汽车停在两边，就几乎没有空间做安全的人行道。

tip: room 表示空间时不可数：no room for。表示房间时可数。

senses.en: a person who helps

ex.en: The lab assistant checked the list.
ex.zh: 实验室助理核对了名单。

ex.en: An assistant who knows the building can help a new teacher more than a thick handbook.
ex.zh: 熟悉这栋楼的助手，比一本厚手册更能帮助新老师。

tip: assistant 也可放在职称前：assistant teacher。

senses.en: a break, or what remains
to stop activity for a while

ex.en: We had a short rest after the run.
ex.zh: 跑完后我们休息了一小会儿。

ex.en: The rest of the class waited outside while two students helped the teacher carry the maps.
ex.zh: 其余同学在外面等，两名学生帮老师搬地图。

tip: the rest of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数。

senses.en: related to education and study

ex.en: The academic year starts in September.
ex.zh: 学年九月开始。

ex.en: Academic success is easier to see than the student who keeps the lab tidy.
ex.zh: 学业成功比那个让实验室保持整洁的学生更容易被看见。

tip: academic 作名词可指大学教师。academy 是学会或学院，本批另有词条。

senses.en: to make something shine by rubbing
a substance used to polish

ex.en: Polish the notice board, then write the time.
ex.zh: 把布告栏擦亮，然后写下时间。

ex.en: Polish on a shoe does not fix a hole.
ex.zh: 鞋油补不了洞。

tip: 小写 polish 是擦亮。大写 Polish 是“波兰的”，读音不同。也可作名词“擦光剂”。

senses.en: to make unclear or mixed up
To wrongly think one person or thing is another.

ex.en: Too many choices may confuse buyers.
ex.zh: 选择太多可能让买家困惑。

ex.en: Public health messages can confuse audiences when experts use technical language without explaining its meaning.
ex.zh: 专家使用术语却不解释其含义时，公共卫生信息可能会让受众感到困惑。

col: confuse A with B｜把A与B混淆
confuse the issue｜把问题弄复杂
tip: confused形容人感到困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a person

ex.en: Every human being needs clean water.
ex.zh: 每个人都需要干净的水。

ex.en: A human being waiting for a bus in the dark is not a traffic statistic; the street should be lit.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中等公交的人不是一个交通统计数字；街道应该有灯。

tip: human being 比 human 更强调“人”这一完整说法，可数。

senses.en: a person trained to care for the sick
to care for a sick person

ex.en: The nurse is in the clinic.
ex.zh: 护士在医务室。

ex.en: A nurse at school can notice an illness before it spreads.
ex.zh: 学校的护士能在疾病传播之前发现它。

tip: nurse 作动词是护理。

senses.en: attracted to people of the same sex; in older texts, cheerful

ex.en: In that old poem, gay means cheerful.
ex.zh: 在那首旧诗里，gay 的意思是快乐的。

ex.en: A school rule is fair only if gay students are treated with the same respect as everyone else.
ex.zh: 只有当同性恋学生和其他人得到同样的尊重时，校规才算公平。

col: gay and lesbian｜男女同性恋者
tip: 现代英语里 gay 主要指同性恋。旧诗文里它还可以表示快乐，阅读时要看年代。

senses.en: a device that moves air, or an enthusiastic supporter

ex.en: The classroom needs a fan in June.
ex.zh: 六月教室需要一台风扇。

ex.en: A sports fan who travels to a match still needs a bus home after the last whistle.
ex.zh: 去看比赛的体育迷，终场哨响后仍然需要一趟回家的公交。

tip: fan 的三个常见义是扇子、风扇和爱好者。

senses.en: of the highest quality, or very typical
a book or work of the highest quality

ex.en: We read a classic story in class.
ex.zh: 我们在课上读了一篇经典故事。

ex.en: A classic mistake in the lab is to skip the label on the bottle.
ex.zh: 实验室里一个典型错误是不看瓶子上的标签。

tip: classic 是经典或典型。classical 多指古典的，如 classical music。

senses.en: to look at something for a time
a small clock worn on the wrist

ex.en: We watched the match in the hall.
ex.zh: 我们在大厅看了比赛。

ex.en: Residents watch a river rise long before an official warning reaches their phones.
ex.zh: 居民在官方警报到达手机之前很久，就看着河水上涨。

tip: watch 强调持续看；see 强调看见的结果。

senses.en: wanting to know more
Unusual or strange in a way that attracts attention.

ex.en: Children are curious about nature.
ex.zh: 孩子对自然充满好奇。

ex.en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。

col: a curious mixture｜奇特的混合物
tip: be curious about表示“对……好奇”。

senses.en: the continent south of Europe

ex.en: We read a news story from Africa.
ex.zh: 我们读了一则来自非洲的新闻。

ex.en: A drought in Africa can raise food prices in towns that never see the dry field.
ex.zh: 非洲的干旱可以提高那些从未见过旱地的城镇的食品价格。

tip: Africa 和 African 都要大写。

senses.en: on some occasions but not always

ex.en: I sometimes study in the library.
ex.zh: 我有时在图书馆学习。

ex.en: Buses that sometimes skip a stop leave students guessing whether to wait or walk.
ex.zh: 有时甩站的公交，让学生猜测该等还是该走。

tip: sometimes 位置较灵活，可放句首、句中或句末。

senses.en: a printed set of news pages

ex.en: The newspaper is in the library.
ex.zh: 报纸在图书馆。

ex.en: A school newspaper that corrects a name the next day is more useful than a perfect delay.
ex.zh: 第二天就改掉姓名的校报，比拖得很完美更有用。

tip: newspaper 可数。表里这一行的音标是 news，本库不用。

senses.en: up to a time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open till nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: Wait till the path is clear before you send the younger students home.
ex.zh: 等路通了再送低年级学生回家。

tip: till 与 until 同义。until 已在本库，两条都保留。till 更口语，句首正式文体多用 until。

senses.en: good, thin, or bright and dry
money paid as a punishment

ex.en: The weather is fine, so we can have class outside.
ex.zh: 天气很好，我们可以在外面上课。

ex.en: A fine for dropping litter works only when bins are near and the rule is explained clearly.
ex.zh: 乱扔垃圾的罚款只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且规则讲清楚时才有效。

tip: fine 作名词是“罚款”，作动词是“处以前款”。

senses.en: a school period, a word, or a length of time

ex.en: This term we have a new science teacher.
ex.zh: 这学期我们有一位新的科学老师。

ex.en: A short term of office can stop a mayor from finishing a flood plan that needs several years.
ex.zh: 很短的任期会让市长完不成一个需要数年的防汛计划。

col: in the long term｜从长远看
tip: in terms of 表示“就……而言”。

senses.en: a small vehicle for travelling on water

ex.en: The boat leaves when the class is ready.
ex.zh: 全班到齐后船就开。

ex.en: A school boat on a river needs life jackets, not only a sunny photograph.
ex.zh: 河上的学校用船需要救生衣，而不只是一张晴天的照片。

col: in the same boat｜处境相同
tip: boat 通常比 ship 小。by boat 不加冠词。

senses.en: what a word or action expresses

ex.en: What is the meaning of this sign?
ex.zh: 这个标志是什么意思？

ex.en: A poem can have more than one meaning, and a class does not have to pick a single winner.
ex.zh: 一首诗可以有不止一个意思，班级也不必选出唯一正确答案。

tip: meaning 是名词。动词“意思是”用 mean。

senses.en: a small piece of stiff paper

ex.en: Show your student card at the gate.
ex.zh: 在门口出示学生证。

ex.en: A library card should be free, or the students who need books most may never borrow them.
ex.zh: 借书证应该免费，否则最需要书的学生可能永远借不到。

tip: card 是可数名词。

senses.en: frightened

ex.en: Do not be afraid to ask.
ex.zh: 不要害怕提问。

ex.en: Students who are afraid of a wrong answer will not test the idea the lesson depends on.
ex.zh: 害怕答错的学生，不会去检验这节课所依赖的想法。

tip: afraid 只作表语。I am afraid 也可表示遗憾的委婉说法。

senses.en: to have power over something
the power to decide

ex.en: We cannot control the weather, but we can plan for rain.
ex.zh: 我们控制不了天气，但可以为下雨做准备。

ex.en: Cities that control building near rivers reduce the damage when the water rises.
ex.zh: 控制河边建设的城市，能在水位上涨时减少损失。

tip: control 的过去式仍是 control，过去分词加 -led：controlled。

senses.en: the Olympic Games

ex.en: The Olympics are on the poster, not on our timetable.
ex.zh: 奥运会在海报上，不在我们的课表上。

ex.en: Watching the Olympics does not replace a field the school can use on Tuesday.
ex.zh: 看奥运会代替不了学校周二能用的场地。

tip: the Olympics 谓语用复数。形容词 Olympic 是本批的另一词。表里没有复数这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: to begin
the beginning of something

ex.en: We start the meeting at two.
ex.zh: 我们两点开始开会。

ex.en: Cities that start rubbish sorting early avoid the higher cost of fixing mixed waste later.
ex.zh: 早点开始垃圾分类的城市，可以避免以后处理混合垃圾的更高成本。

tip: start 和 begin 后接 to do 或 doing 通常都可以。

senses.en: a place where sick people are treated

ex.en: The hospital is an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 医院坐公交要一小时。

ex.en: A hospital on the far side of a flooded road cannot help the street that needs it most.
ex.zh: 洪水那边的医院，帮不了最需要它的那条街。

tip: 英式 in hospital 表示住院，不加 the；美式常用 in the hospital。

senses.en: bad and important, or sincere

ex.en: This is a serious problem.
ex.zh: 这是一个严重的问题。

ex.en: A serious heatwave is a health event, not only a few hot days on the news.
ex.zh: 一场严重的热浪是健康事件，而不只是新闻里的几天高温。

tip: take sth seriously 表示认真对待。

senses.en: the state of being alive, or a way of living

ex.en: School life is busy but full of friends.
ex.zh: 学校生活忙碌，但有很多朋友。

ex.en: City life can be exciting, yet the noise and cost push some families back to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 城市生活可以很精彩，但噪音和花费也会把一些家庭推回小城镇。

tip: life 的复数是 lives。泛指生活时通常不可数。

senses.en: feeling physically at ease

ex.en: These chairs are comfortable for a long class.
ex.zh: 这些椅子上长课也舒服。

ex.en: A comfortable classroom still fails if the air does not move on a hot afternoon.
ex.zh: 炎热的下午如果空气不流通，舒服的教室也没用。

tip: comfortable 形容感受或使人体感舒适的事物。

senses.en: protection, or the arguments for someone in court

ex.en: The wall is a defence against the flood.
ex.zh: 这堵墙是防洪的。

ex.en: A defence of a late bus is simple: students can stay for the club and still get home.
ex.zh: 为晚班车辩护很简单：学生可以留下参加社团，并且还能回家。

tip: defence 是英式拼写，defense 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

senses.en: something built to remember people

ex.en: The memorial names the people, not only the date.
ex.zh: 纪念碑写着人的名字，而不只是日期。

ex.en: A memorial visit should leave time for silence.
ex.zh: 纪念参观应当留出沉默的时间。

tip: memorial 也可作形容词“纪念的”。

senses.en: the middle; British spelling of center

ex.en: The sports centre is near the station.
ex.zh: 体育中心在车站附近。

ex.en: A health centre in the middle of town is useless if the buses stop before it opens.
ex.zh: 如果公交在开门前就停了，镇中心的卫生中心也没用。

tip: centre 是英式拼写，center 是美式。本库两条都保留，因为考纲里都出现。

senses.en: money paid for work, often by the week

ex.en: The wage is written on the form.
ex.zh: 工资写在表格上。

ex.en: A low wage near a school pushes workers farther from the bus.
ex.zh: 学校附近的低工资，把工人推得离公交更远。

tip: wage 常用复数 wages。salary 多指月薪，本批另有词条。

senses.en: older or higher in rank

ex.en: A senior student helped the new class.
ex.zh: 一名高年级学生帮助了新班级。

ex.en: Senior teachers who stay in a village school are hard to replace.
ex.zh: 留在乡村学校的资深教师很难被替代。

tip: senior to 不用 than。

senses.en: a thin book with articles and pictures, sold regularly

ex.en: The magazine arrives at the library every month.
ex.zh: 这本杂志每月送到图书馆。

ex.en: A school magazine gives students a page, and it needs an editor who checks names.
ex.zh: 校刊给学生一个版面，也需要一位核对姓名的编辑。

tip: magazine 可数。报纸是 newspaper。

senses.en: a large town

ex.en: Our city has a new metro line.
ex.zh: 我们这座城市有一条新地铁线。

ex.en: A city that grows upward needs parks on the ground, or children will have nowhere to play.
ex.zh: 向上生长的城市需要地面上的公园，否则孩子将无处玩耍。

tip: city 的复数是 cities。in the city 表示在城里。

senses.en: to finish a school or college course

ex.en: She will graduate in June.
ex.zh: 她将在六月毕业。

ex.en: Students who graduate still need a bus on the morning of the ceremony.
ex.zh: 毕业的学生在典礼那天早上仍然需要一班车。

tip: 名词毕业生也是 graduate，读音重音常在前。动词毕业重音也常在前。

senses.en: careful study to find facts
to study something carefully

ex.en: Her research is about teenage sleep.
ex.zh: 她的研究是关于青少年睡眠的。

ex.en: Research that never leaves the lab may miss what families actually do at home.
ex.zh: 从不离开实验室的研究，可能会错过家庭在家里真正做的事。

tip: research 作研究时通常不可数。作动词直接接宾语：research a topic。

senses.en: not interesting

ex.en: The speech was boring because it named no fact.
ex.zh: 这篇讲话很乏味，因为它没有一个事实。

ex.en: A boring timetable is still better than one that hides the last bus.
ex.zh: 乏味的课表仍然好过藏起末班车的课表。

tip: boring 形容事物。bored 形容人。

senses.en: a journey for pleasure, or a short visit around a place

ex.en: The class went on a tour of the museum.
ex.zh: 全班游览了博物馆。

ex.en: A tour of a clean park does not show the street where the rubbish was moved.
ex.zh: 游览一座干净的公园，看不到垃圾被运去的那条街。

tip: tour 作动词是“游览”。

senses.en: a place where a road turns

ex.en: Take the second turning on the left.
ex.zh: 在第二个路口向左拐。

ex.en: A turning without a light is where the school should ask for a crossing.
ex.zh: 没有灯的转弯处，正是学校应当要求设斑马线的地方。

tip: turning point 是转折点。表里没有单独音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: energy sent out as waves or particles

ex.en: The textbook explains radiation as energy.
ex.zh: 课本把辐射解释为能量。

ex.en: A lesson on radiation should include the warning sign, not a method.
ex.zh: 辐射课应当包括警告标志，而不是做法。

tip: radiation 通常不可数。本条是科普词汇，不写如何制造或使用。

senses.en: to come to the end of something

ex.en: Please finish the form before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前请把表填完。

ex.en: Students who finish a long project in small steps are less likely to stay up the night before it is due.
ex.zh: 把长作业分成小步来完成的学生，不太会拖到交作业前一夜才熬通宵。

col: from start to finish｜自始至终
tip: finish 后接 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: a set of rooms for living in

ex.en: They live in a small apartment near school.
ex.zh: 他们住在学校附近的一套小公寓里。

ex.en: An apartment above a shop can be cheap and still too noisy for sleep before an exam.
ex.zh: 商店楼上的公寓可以很便宜，考试前却仍然吵得睡不着。

tip: apartment 是美式。英式常用 flat，已在本库。

senses.en: rings joined together, or a series of shops

ex.en: The gate is held by a chain.
ex.zh: 门用链子拴着。

ex.en: A chain of small shops can feed a street if one of them stays open after school.
ex.zh: 如果其中一家放学后还开着，一串小店就能养活一条街。

tip: chain 也可指连锁店。a chain of events 是一连串事件。

senses.en: a game played by two teams with a ball

ex.en: We play football after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后踢足球。

ex.en: A football field that floods every spring shows that the drains, not the players, need attention.
ex.zh: 每年春天都积水的足球场说明需要关注的是排水，不是球员。

tip: 球类运动前不加 the：play football。美式 football 常指橄榄球。

senses.en: a large dry area
to leave someone or something

ex.en: The map shows a desert in the west.
ex.zh: 地图显示西边有一片沙漠。

ex.en: A lesson about the desert should also say who lives there.
ex.zh: 关于沙漠的课也应当说谁住在那里。

tip: 名词沙漠重音在前。动词“遗弃”重音在后，读 /dɪˈzɜːt/。表里给的是动词读音，本库名词用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: in the middle of three or more

ex.en: She is the tallest among the three.
ex.zh: 她是三人中最高的。

ex.en: Trust is low among residents when a new road is planned without a public meeting.
ex.zh: 如果新路的规划没有公开会议，居民之间的信任就会很低。

col: among other things｜除了别的以外
tip: among 用于三者或更多；between 多用于两者。

senses.en: a connection, or a member of your family

ex.en: The relation between sleep and scores is not a slogan.
ex.zh: 睡眠和分数的关系不是一句口号。

ex.en: A form should leave space for a relation who is not a parent.
ex.zh: 表格应当给不是父母的亲属留出位置。

tip: 动词 relate 是本批的另一词。relation 可指关系，也可指亲戚。

senses.en: land for crops, an area of study, or a sports ground

ex.en: The football field is behind the gym.
ex.zh: 足球场在体育馆后面。

ex.en: Experts in one field may miss a river problem that farmers in the next field see every week.
ex.zh: 一个领域的专家可能会错过隔壁田里的农民每周都看见的河流问题。

tip: field 既可指田野、运动场，也可指学术领域。

senses.en: a stop for trains or buses, or a broadcasting centre

ex.en: We met at the bus station.
ex.zh: 我们在汽车站见面。

ex.en: A station without a light is a poor place for students to wait after the last lesson.
ex.zh: 没有灯的车站，是学生在最后一节课后等候的糟糕地方。

tip: station 的具体种类靠前面的词区分。

senses.en: the day after today
the day after today

ex.en: The test is tomorrow.
ex.zh: 测验在明天。

ex.en: A decision made tomorrow about housing will shape who can live near the school.
ex.zh: 明天做出的住房决定，将影响谁能住在学校附近。

tip: tomorrow 前面不加 on。

senses.en: on this day
this day

ex.en: Today we will practise the listening section.
ex.zh: 今天我们练习听力部分。

ex.en: Decisions made today about housing will decide who can live near good schools in ten years.
ex.zh: 今天做出的住房决定，将决定十年后谁能住在好学校附近。

tip: today 可作副词或名词，前面不加介词 on。

senses.en: a group of teams or organisations

ex.en: Our team is top of the school league.
ex.zh: 我们队在校联赛中排名第一。

ex.en: A league of small towns can share one hospital when none of them can pay for it alone.
ex.zh: 小城镇组成的联盟可以共用一家医院，当它们谁也单独负担不起时。

tip: League 大写时常指特定组织，如 the League。

senses.en: as a result, or in this way

ex.en: The bus was late; thus we missed the bell.
ex.zh: 公交晚了，因此我们没赶上铃。

ex.en: The river flooded the road and thus cut the village off from the county hospital.
ex.zh: 河水淹没了路，因此村子和县医院断了联系。

tip: thus 偏书面。口语里更常说 so 或 therefore。

senses.en: an aircraft

ex.en: The plane leaves at noon.
ex.zh: 飞机中午起飞。

ex.en: A town with no plane still needs a bus that meets the train.
ex.zh: 没有飞机的城镇仍然需要一辆能接上火车的公交。

tip: plane 也可指数学里的平面。by plane 不加冠词。

senses.en: from a time in the past until now
from the time when, or because

ex.en: I have lived here since 2019.
ex.zh: 我从 2019 年起住在这里。

ex.en: Since the new bridge opened, fewer students have had to take two buses to reach school.
ex.zh: 自从新桥通车，需要换乘两趟公交才能到校的学生少了。

tip: since 接时间点，for 接时间段，常与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: quiet and not excited or angry
to make someone or something calm

ex.en: Stay calm and read the notice again.
ex.zh: 保持镇静，再读一遍通知。

ex.en: A calm explanation of a late bus helps more than a loud one.
ex.zh: 对公交晚点的平静说明，比大声的说明更有帮助。

tip: calm 作动词是使平静。

senses.en: paid work, or a task

ex.en: She found a weekend job at a bookshop.
ex.zh: 她在书店找到一份周末工作。

ex.en: A first job teaches timekeeping, but it should not take the hours a student needs for sleep.
ex.zh: 第一份工作能培养守时，但不该占掉学生需要的睡眠时间。

tip: job 是可数名词，一份工作用 a job；work 表示工作通常不可数。

senses.en: a building for Christian worship

ex.en: The old church stands at the end of the street.
ex.zh: 老教堂在街的尽头。

ex.en: A church hall can become a shelter on the night a flood reaches the lower street.
ex.zh: 当洪水到达低处的街道时，教堂大厅可以变成避难所。

tip: go to church 泛指去做礼拜，常不加 the。

senses.en: a large grand house of a king, queen, or president

ex.en: The palace is open on Sunday.
ex.zh: 宫殿周日开放。

ex.en: A chapter about a palace should also say who carried the water.
ex.zh: 写宫殿的一章也应当写是谁担的水。

tip: palace 可数。the palace 常指某一座具体的宫殿。

senses.en: very clever or bright
Exceptionally intelligent or skilled.
Shining brightly or having a strong, vivid colour.

ex.en: She had a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 她有一个杰出的想法。

ex.en: Brilliant teachers can inspire students to explore difficult subjects with confidence and genuine curiosity.
ex.zh: 出色的教师能激励学生带着信心和真正的好奇心探索难学的科目。

tip: 英式口语中常用 brilliant 表示“太棒了”。

senses.en: an object for making music, or a tool for careful work

ex.en: The instrument is a piano.
ex.zh: 这件乐器是钢琴。

ex.en: An instrument in the lab should have a label.
ex.zh: 实验室里的器械应当有标签。

tip: instrument 可数。

senses.en: the process of coming to live in another country

ex.en: The museum has a room about immigration.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一个关于移民的展室。

ex.en: A school form about immigration should not shame the student who fills it in.
ex.zh: 关于移民的学校表格，不应当让填写的学生感到羞耻。

tip: immigration 通常不可数。immigrant 是移民者。

senses.en: a room where food is prepared

ex.en: The kitchen closes at two.
ex.zh: 厨房两点关门。

ex.en: A school kitchen that labels nuts protects the student who cannot see the cook.
ex.zh: 标明坚果的学校厨房，能保护看不见厨师的那名学生。

tip: kitchen 可数。厨具的总称不是 kitchen，是用具本身。

senses.en: a fast aircraft

ex.en: The jet is late.
ex.zh: 这架喷气式飞机晚点了。

ex.en: A jet on a poster does not replace the bus to the airport.
ex.zh: 海报上的飞机代替不了去机场的公交。

tip: jet 也可指喷射的一股。

senses.en: a structure that carries a road over water or a gap

ex.en: We cross the bridge on the way to school.
ex.zh: 我们上学要过那座桥。

ex.en: A bridge that cannot take a bus cuts a village off from the county hospital.
ex.zh: 不能过公交的桥，会让村子和县医院断开。

tip: bridge 也可指桥牌。作动词是“弥合”。

senses.en: to hit something hard, or to fall and break
an accident, or a sudden failure

ex.en: The bus did not crash; it only stopped.
ex.zh: 公交没有撞车，只是停了。

ex.en: News of a crash should give the place and the time, not a guess about blame.
ex.zh: 撞车新闻应当给出地点和时间，而不是猜测责任。

tip: crash 也可作名词。计算机崩溃也叫 crash。

senses.en: happening every day

ex.en: Exercise is part of her daily routine.
ex.zh: 锻炼是她每日例行的一部分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to want, or to imagine
decorative and not simple
imagination, or a liking

ex.en: I fancy a quiet seat, not a loud one.
ex.zh: 我想要一个安静的座位，不是吵的。

ex.en: Do not fancy that a poster will move the bus.
ex.zh: 不要以为一张海报就会让公交改线。

tip: fancy 作形容词是花哨的。英式口语 I fancy 表示想要。

senses.en: help and advice

ex.en: The notice gives guidance, not only a slogan.
ex.zh: 通知给出指导，而不只是一句口号。

ex.en: Guidance about the late bus should be written where parents can see it.
ex.zh: 关于晚班车的指导应当写在家长能看见的地方。

tip: guide 已在本库。guidance 通常不可数。

senses.en: the middle, or a place for an activity

ex.en: The sports center is near the station.
ex.zh: 体育中心在车站附近。

ex.en: A health center in the middle of a town is useless if buses stop before it opens.
ex.zh: 如果公交在开门前就停运，镇中心的卫生中心也没用。

tip: 英式拼写是 centre，美式是 center。意思相同。

senses.en: father; informal, often used by children

ex.en: Her daddy will meet the bus.
ex.zh: 她爸爸会去接公交。

ex.en: A form should accept daddy, dad, or another adult name.
ex.zh: 表格应当接受 daddy、dad 或其他成年人的名字。

tip: daddy 是儿童口语。dad 已在本库。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a serious disease in which cells grow without control

ex.en: The talk was about how to reduce the risk of cancer.
ex.zh: 讲座讲的是如何降低患癌风险。

ex.en: Cleaner air and earlier checks can lower the cancer risk in a neighbourhood beside a busy road.
ex.zh: 更干净的空气和更早的检查，可以降低繁忙道路旁社区的癌症风险。

tip: cancer 作病名时常不可数；某种癌症有时用 a cancer。

senses.en: a pointed end, a piece of advice, or extra money for service

ex.en: The tip of the pencil is broken.
ex.zh: 铅笔尖断了。

ex.en: A tip on the board should name the bus, not only say good luck.
ex.zh: 布告栏上的提示应当写上公交，而不只是说祝你好运。

col: give a tip｜给小费；给提示
tip: tip 作动词可以是倾斜或给小费。本库词卡上的“提示”也是这个词。

senses.en: the direction opposite south
in or towards the north

ex.en: The wind is coming from the north.
ex.zh: 风从北边来。

ex.en: Towns in the north may need longer heating seasons, which raises the cost of keeping schools warm.
ex.zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖季，这会提高学校保暖的成本。

tip: in the north of 在范围内部的北部；to the north of 在某地以北。

senses.en: expected, or owed

ex.en: The report is due on Friday.
ex.zh: 报告周五到期。

ex.en: Floods are due in part to drains built for a smaller town than the one that exists now.
ex.zh: 洪水的部分原因是排水系统按比现在更小的城镇修建。

tip: due to 后接名词，表示原因；be due to do 表示预定要做。

senses.en: a sweet substance used in food

ex.en: There is too much sugar in the drink.
ex.zh: 这杯饮料里糖太多了。

ex.en: A canteen that hides sugar in sauces makes a healthy choice harder to see.
ex.zh: 把糖藏在酱里的食堂，会让健康的选择更难看出来。

tip: sugar 作物质名词不可数。a sugar 在口语里可以指一块糖。

senses.en: scientific knowledge used in practical ways

ex.en: The lab has new technology for measuring air.
ex.zh: 实验室有测量空气的新技术。

ex.en: Technology that warns of a storm helps only people who can receive the message.
ex.zh: 风暴预警技术只帮助那些能收到信息的人。

tip: technology 作总称时常不可数。

senses.en: a way for walking, or a course

ex.en: The path to the lake is muddy.
ex.zh: 通向湖的小路很泥泞。

ex.en: A safe path to school can matter more than a faster road with no pavement.
ex.zh: 一条安全的上学小路，可能比没有人行道的更快的大路更重要。

tip: path 比 road 窄，多供人走。career path 是职业道路。

senses.en: a married man

ex.en: Her husband teaches music.
ex.zh: 她的丈夫教音乐。

ex.en: A husband on a night shift may miss the school meeting and still care about the result.
ex.zh: 上夜班的丈夫可能错过学校的会，却仍然关心结果。

tip: husband 是可数名词。

senses.en: right, without mistakes
to make something right

ex.en: Is this answer correct?
ex.zh: 这个答案正确吗？

ex.en: A correct total still needs a source, or the class cannot tell how it was made.
ex.zh: 正确的总数仍然需要来源，否则班级看不出它是怎么算出来的。

tip: correct 作动词是改正。

senses.en: a set of parts working together, or an organised method

ex.en: The school bell system was repaired yesterday.
ex.zh: 学校的铃声系统昨天修好了。

ex.en: A bus system that only serves the centre leaves outer neighbourhoods with long walks to the first stop.
ex.zh: 只服务市中心的公交系统，会让外围社区走到第一站就要很久。

tip: system 是可数名词：a transport system。

senses.en: a living creature that is not a plant

ex.en: The zoo poster shows an animal from Africa.
ex.zh: 动物园海报上是一种来自非洲的动物。

ex.en: An animal that loses its path through a town needs a bridge, not only a warning sign.
ex.zh: 在城镇里失去通道的动物需要一座桥，而不只是一块警告牌。

tip: animal 通常不包括植物。科学上有时也不包括人，日常英语里要看语境。

senses.en: to need or trust someone or something

ex.en: Do not rely on a poster for the bus time.
ex.zh: 不要靠一张海报来记公交时间。

ex.en: Families rely on the late bus when work ends after the early one.
ex.zh: 下班晚于早班车时，家庭依靠晚班车。

tip: rely on somebody or something。形容词 reliable 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: a tool for writing with ink

ex.en: The pen is on the desk.
ex.zh: 钢笔在书桌上。

ex.en: A pen that works matters more than a new cover.
ex.zh: 一支能写的笔比一个新封面更重要。

tip: pen 可数。

senses.en: to go away, or to let something stay

ex.en: We leave school at four on Fridays.
ex.zh: 周五我们四点离校。

ex.en: If young people leave a town, the shops and clinics that depend on them leave too.
ex.zh: 如果年轻人离开城镇，依靠他们的商店和诊所也会离开。

tip: leave 的过去式和过去分词是 left。leave 也可表示“使处于某种状态”：leave the door open。

senses.en: to say sorry

ex.en: You should apologize for being late.
ex.zh: 你应该为迟到道歉。

ex.en: Companies should apologize promptly for service failures and explain what steps they will take to prevent further problems.
ex.zh: 企业应及时为服务失误道歉，并说明将采取哪些措施来防止问题再次发生。

col: apologize for doing something｜为做某事道歉
tip: 向人道歉用to，为事情道歉用for；英式也写apologise。

senses.en: an opening in a wall that lets in light, or an area on a screen

ex.en: Please open the window for a minute.
ex.zh: 请把窗户打开一会儿。

ex.en: A window that does not open turns a hot classroom into a health problem.
ex.zh: 打不开的窗户会把炎热的教室变成健康问题。

tip: 电脑里的窗口也叫 window。

senses.en: to sit on and control a bicycle or horse, or to travel in a vehicle
a journey on a bike, horse or vehicle

ex.en: I ride my bike to school when it is dry.
ex.zh: 天气干燥时我骑自行车上学。

ex.en: A safe ride home matters as much as the lesson that ended at dusk.
ex.zh: 安全骑车回家，和黄昏结束的那节课一样重要。

col: give sb a ride｜让某人搭车
tip: ride 的过去式是 rode，过去分词是 ridden。

senses.en: a part of the body used for standing and walking

ex.en: Her left leg hurt after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后她的左腿疼。

ex.en: A chair with a short leg makes the whole row unsafe.
ex.zh: 一条短腿的椅子会让整排都不安全。

tip: 家具的腿也叫 leg。pull somebody leg 是开玩笑，不是拉腿。

senses.en: a machine that produces motion

ex.en: The motor of the fan is loud.
ex.zh: 风扇的马达声音很大。

ex.en: An electric motor still needs a clean source of power.
ex.zh: 电动机仍然需要清洁的电力来源。

tip: engine 已在本库，常指更大的发动机。motor 也常用于机动车。

senses.en: to make an effort, or to test something
an attempt

ex.en: Try the second method if the first one fails.
ex.zh: 如果第一种方法不行，试试第二种。

ex.en: Cities should try small bus changes before they rebuild a whole road.
ex.zh: 城市在重建整条路之前，应该先尝试小的公交调整。

tip: try to do 强调努力要做成；try doing 强调试一试某种做法。

senses.en: the science of living things

ex.en: Biology is in the lab on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 周三在实验室上生物。

ex.en: Students learn the word and the warning sign, not a method for misuse.
ex.zh: 学生学的是这个词和警告标志，不是误用的做法。

tip: biology 作学科时谓语用单数。本条不写实验步骤。

senses.en: a place where meals are sold

ex.en: The restaurant near the station is closed on Monday.
ex.zh: 车站附近的餐馆周一休息。

ex.en: A school trip to a restaurant should say what a student can order if the menu is expensive.
ex.zh: 学校去餐馆的活动应当说明，如果菜单很贵，学生可以点什么。

tip: restaurant 重音在第一音节。英式和美式元音不同，表里两种都有。

senses.en: a large vehicle that carries passengers

ex.en: The school bus leaves at seven.
ex.zh: 校车七点出发。

ex.en: A later bus helps students who stay for club, if the stop is still lit.
ex.zh: 如果车站还有灯，晚一班的公交能帮助留下参加社团的学生。

tip: by bus 不加冠词。上车用 get on the bus。
