senses.en: a male parent

ex.en: My father picks me up on Fridays.
ex.zh: 我父亲周五来接我。

ex.en: A father who works nights may never see the school play his child is in.
ex.zh: 上夜班的父亲可能永远看不到孩子参加的学校演出。

tip: father 是较正式的说法；dad 更口语。

senses.en: the part of the leg you stand on, or a unit of length

ex.en: My left foot hurts after the hike.
ex.zh: 徒步之后我的左脚疼。

ex.en: A path that is only one foot wide is not a safe route for a class walking together.
ex.zh: 只有一英尺宽的小路，不适合全班一起走。

tip: foot 的复数是 feet。on foot 表示步行，不用冠词。

senses.en: using force to hurt, or very strong

ex.en: The school rule forbids violent behaviour.
ex.zh: 校规禁止暴力行为。

ex.en: A violent storm is a reason to open the hall, not to send students into it.
ex.zh: 猛烈的风暴是开放礼堂的理由，不是把学生送进风暴里。

tip: 名词 violence 已在本库。本条不写伤害方法。

senses.en: in every part, or during the whole time

ex.en: The rule applies throughout the school.
ex.zh: 这条规则适用于全校。

ex.en: Rain throughout the night can fill a street if the drain was built for a smaller town.
ex.zh: 如果排水管按更小的城镇修建，整夜的雨就能灌满一条街。

tip: throughout 强调整段时间或全部范围。

senses.en: having a good result

ex.en: The book fair was successful.
ex.zh: 书展很成功。

ex.en: A bus line is successful when workers arrive on time, not when a photo looks full.
ex.zh: 公交线的成功是工人准时到达，不是照片看起来很挤。

tip: successful 是形容词；succeed 是动词。

senses.en: one part of a larger thing

ex.en: Cost is one component of the plan.
ex.zh: 费用是计划的一个部分。

ex.en: A component that students cannot see should still be named.
ex.zh: 学生看不见的部分仍然应当写出来。

tip: component 可数。

senses.en: an area of study, a topic, or the doer in a sentence

ex.en: History is her favourite subject.
ex.zh: 历史是她最喜欢的学科。

ex.en: The subject of a public meeting should be posted before people are asked to attend.
ex.zh: 公开会议的主题应该在请人参加之前公布。

tip: subject 作形容词是“受制的”：be subject to。

senses.en: after noon

ex.en: The club meets at 4 p.m.
ex.zh: 社团下午四点见面。

ex.en: A notice that says 4 p.m. and another that says 16:00 should mean the same bus.
ex.zh: 写着下午四点的通知和写着 16:00 的通知，应当指同一班车。

tip: p.m. 表示中午到午夜。与 pm 是同一个缩写，本库只保留 p.m.，以便和已有的 a.m. 一致。数字和 p.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: a person who acts unwisely
to trick someone

ex.en: It is unkind to call a classmate a fool.
ex.zh: 把同学叫做蠢人是不友善的。

ex.en: A fool in a story can be funny; a fool aimed at a student is not.
ex.zh: 故事里的傻瓜可以好笑；对着学生说的傻瓜则不是。

tip: fool 用在人身上会伤人。作动词是欺骗。

senses.en: the first part

ex.en: Read the beginning of the story again.
ex.zh: 把故事的开头再读一遍。

ex.en: The beginning of a heatwave is the time to open cool public rooms, not the day after people collapse.
ex.zh: 热浪开始时就该开放凉爽的公共房间，而不是等人们倒下之后。

col: at the beginning of｜在……开始时
tip: at the beginning of 后接名词。

senses.en: not clean

ex.en: Do not drink from a dirty cup.
ex.zh: 不要用脏杯子喝水。

ex.en: A dirty filter in the lab is a reason to stop, not to hurry.
ex.zh: 实验室里脏了的滤器是停下来的理由，不是赶工的理由。

tip: dirty 作动词是弄脏。

senses.en: the protection of nature or of something valuable

ex.en: Conservation of water starts with a closed tap.
ex.zh: 节约用水从关好水龙头开始。

ex.en: A conservation plan should name who waters the school garden in August.
ex.zh: 保护计划应当写明八月谁给学校园子浇水。

tip: conservation 通常不可数。

senses.en: to be right for someone or something
a set of clothes

ex.en: The early class does not suit everyone.
ex.zh: 早课并不适合每个人。

ex.en: A timetable that suits the bus also suits the students who cannot stay late.
ex.zh: 适合公交的课表，也适合不能留下来很晚的学生。

tip: suit 作名词是一套衣服。动词是适合。两种读音都常见。

senses.en: very foolish, or very enthusiastic

ex.en: It is crazy to cycle without a light at night.
ex.zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是很荒唐的。

ex.en: A crazy building boom can fill a town with flats nobody on a local wage can rent.
ex.zh: 疯狂的建设热潮会让城镇充满本地工资租不起的公寓。

tip: crazy 是口语词，正式写作可用 foolish 或 unwise。

senses.en: the sense of perceiving sound, or an official meeting to hear facts

ex.en: The test checks hearing, not only reading.
ex.zh: 这次测验检查听力，不只是阅读。

ex.en: A public hearing lets neighbours speak before a new road is drawn through their street.
ex.zh: 公开听证会让邻居在新路画过他们的街道之前发言。

tip: 动词 hear 已在本库。hearing 是名词，也可指听证会。

senses.en: two people, or a small number

ex.en: A couple of students stayed to tidy up.
ex.zh: 有几个学生留下来收拾。

ex.en: A young couple may leave a town when the only flats cost more than their wages.
ex.zh: 当仅有的公寓贵过工资时，年轻夫妇可能会离开城镇。

tip: a couple of 在口语里常表示“几个”，不一定正好两个。

senses.en: a piece of paper that allows you to travel or enter

ex.en: Keep your ticket until you leave the station.
ex.zh: 离开车站前留着票。

ex.en: A free ticket that the last bus cannot honour is not free for the student who must take a taxi.
ex.zh: 末班车用不了的免费票，对必须改乘出租车的学生并不免费。

tip: ticket 可数。交通罚单也叫 ticket。

senses.en: the process of growing

ex.en: The growth of the town has been fast.
ex.zh: 这个城镇增长得很快。

ex.en: Rapid growth along a river can bring jobs and also destroy the wetland that holds flood water.
ex.zh: 河边的快速增长能带来工作，也会毁掉蓄洪水的湿地。

tip: growth 通常不可数。

senses.en: the ability to do something well

ex.en: Checking a source is a skill.
ex.zh: 核对来源是一项技能。

ex.en: A skill that only one student can practise is not yet a class skill.
ex.zh: 只有一个学生能练的技能，还不是全班的技能。

tip: skill 可数。表里这一行的音标是 ski，本库不用。

senses.en: something that is done

ex.en: We need action, not only a poster.
ex.zh: 我们需要行动，而不只是一张海报。

ex.en: Climate action in a city includes buses and buildings, not only speeches on a special day.
ex.zh: 一座城市的气候行动包括公交和建筑，而不只是特殊日子里的演讲。

tip: take action to do 表示采取行动做某事。

senses.en: a story, often an imagined one

ex.en: The tale is about a late bus.
ex.zh: 这个故事讲的是一趟晚班车。

ex.en: A tale can be fiction, and the bus time on the wall still has to be fact.
ex.zh: 故事可以是虚构的，墙上的公交时间却必须是事实。

tip: tale 与 tail（尾巴）同音。tail 已在本库。

senses.en: the one after the first, or a unit of time
a very short time

ex.en: I sat in the second row.
ex.zh: 我坐在第二排。

ex.en: A delay of even a second at a busy junction can add up to long queues in the evening.
ex.zh: 繁忙路口哪怕一秒钟的延误，也会在傍晚累积成长队。

tip: the second 表示顺序；a second 可以表示“又一”。

senses.en: to look carefully for something
an act of searching

ex.en: Search the website for the bus times.
ex.zh: 在网站上搜索公交时刻。

ex.en: Families search for a flat they can afford near a school, and often fail.
ex.zh: 家庭寻找学校附近租得起的公寓，却常常找不到。

tip: search 可直接接地点，search for 后接寻找的对象。

senses.en: something said to make people laugh

ex.en: The joke was kind, and everyone laughed.
ex.zh: 这个玩笑很善意，大家都笑了。

ex.en: A joke about a classmate's name is not funny when that student cannot leave the room.
ex.zh: 拿同学的名字开玩笑，当那个学生没法离开房间时，就不好笑了。

tip: joke 作动词是开玩笑。make a joke 或 tell a joke 都可以。

senses.en: coming before

ex.en: Look at the previous page.
ex.zh: 看前一页。

ex.en: The previous flood should have changed the building rules, but the same land was sold again.
ex.zh: 上一次洪水本应改变建筑规则，但同一块地又被卖掉了。

tip: previous 前面常用 the。

senses.en: a person you invite, or who stays at a hotel

ex.en: The guest spoke for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 客人讲了十分钟。

ex.en: A guest speaker needs a chair, a glass of water, and a way back to the station.
ex.zh: 嘉宾需要一把椅子、一杯水和回车站的办法。

tip: guest 可数。主人是 host，已在本库。

senses.en: a person thought to be guilty

ex.en: The report does not name the suspect.
ex.zh: 报道没有写出嫌疑人的名字。

ex.en: Calling a student a suspect before the facts are written down is not fair.
ex.zh: 在事实写下来之前把学生叫做嫌疑人，是不公平的。

tip: 名词嫌疑人重音常在前。动词“怀疑”重音在后：/səˈspekt/。本条以名词为主，不写办案步骤。

senses.en: a flat surface that shows images

ex.en: The screen at the back of the lab is new.
ex.zh: 实验室后面的屏幕是新的。

ex.en: A bright screen late at night can delay sleep even when the homework on it is finished.
ex.zh: 即使屏幕上的作业已经写完，深夜亮着的屏幕仍会推迟睡眠。

tip: screen 也可指纱窗或屏风。看电影的幕布也叫 screen。

senses.en: a person you do an activity with

ex.en: My partner in the lab checked the numbers.
ex.zh: 我的实验搭档核对了数字。

ex.en: A business partner who hides costs can damage a small shop faster than a quiet week.
ex.zh: 隐瞒成本的生意伙伴，对小店的伤害可以超过一周冷清。

tip: partner 可以是合作伙伴、舞伴或配偶，要看语境。

senses.en: an object that moves around a planet, or a machine that does so

ex.en: The satellite sends the weather map.
ex.zh: 卫星发送天气图。

ex.en: A satellite picture of the flood still needs someone who can read it.
ex.zh: 洪水的卫星图片仍然需要有人能看懂。

tip: satellite 可数。

senses.en: no person

ex.en: Nobody was late today.
ex.zh: 今天没有人迟到。

ex.en: Nobody should have to wait for a bus in the dark if the town can put up one light.
ex.zh: 如果城镇能装一盏灯，就不该有人在黑暗中等公交。

tip: nobody 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: the land next to the sea

ex.en: We walked along the coast at sunset.
ex.zh: 日落时我们沿着海岸走。

ex.en: Towns on a low coast need a plan for storms before the sea wall fails.
ex.zh: 低海岸上的城镇需要在海堤失事之前就有风暴方案。

tip: coast 是较大的海岸地带。shore 更强调水边的岸。

senses.en: to go or come in

ex.en: Enter the lab only with a teacher.
ex.zh: 只有老师在场才能进入实验室。

ex.en: Students who enter a new school in the middle of the year need a map and a person, not only a form.
ex.zh: 学年中途入学的学生需要一张地图和一个人，而不只是一张表。

tip: 进入某处直接说 enter a room，一般不加 into。enter into 多用于“开始讨论”或“达成协议”。

senses.en: a careful examination

ex.en: The analysis of the water will take a week.
ex.zh: 水质分析要一周。

ex.en: An analysis of late arrivals should look at buses before it looks at character.
ex.zh: 对迟到的分析应该先看公交，再看品格。

tip: analysis 的复数是 analyses。

senses.en: the surface of a room, or a level of a building

ex.en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
ex.zh: 请把地上的纸捡起来。

ex.en: The library is on the second floor, which is hard to reach without a lift.
ex.zh: 图书馆在二楼，没有电梯很难到达。

tip: 英式 ground floor 是一层；美式 first floor 常指一层。

senses.en: land used for growing food or raising animals

ex.en: Her uncle works on a farm outside the town.
ex.zh: 她叔叔在镇外的农场干活。

ex.en: A school that visits a farm should ask who owns the land and who does the work.
ex.zh: 学校参观农场时，应当问土地是谁的、活是谁干的。

tip: farm 作动词是务农。

senses.en: not high

ex.en: The shelf is low enough for everyone to reach.
ex.zh: 架子低得每个人都够得着。

ex.en: Low pay in village schools makes it hard to keep teachers who could work in the city.
ex.zh: 乡村学校的低报酬，让那些可以去城市工作的老师很难留下来。

col: at a low level｜处于低水平
tip: low 的比较级是 lower。人的声音低用 a low voice。

senses.en: a sign, sound, or movement that sends a message

ex.en: The signal was too weak for the video.
ex.zh: 信号太弱，视频放不了。

ex.en: A green signal at the crossing matters more than a poster about safety.
ex.zh: 路口的绿灯比一张安全海报更重要。

tip: signal 作动词是发信号。

senses.en: a formal test, or a careful look

ex.en: The examination is in the hall.
ex.zh: 考试在礼堂。

ex.en: A medical examination should be explained before it starts.
ex.zh: 体检应当在开始前说明。

tip: 简称 exam 是本批的另一词。表里没有 examination 这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。本条不写检查步骤。

senses.en: a large old building built for defence

ex.en: The castle is on the hill.
ex.zh: 城堡在山上。

ex.en: A castle in a textbook should also say who carried the water.
ex.zh: 课本里的城堡也应当写是谁担的水。

tip: castle 可数。

senses.en: very bad

ex.en: The noise was awful during the drill.
ex.zh: 演习时噪音很糟。

ex.en: An awful score on one quiz is information, not a final judgement.
ex.zh: 一次小测的糟糕分数是信息，不是最终判决。

tip: awful 程度很强。awfully 在口语里也可表示“非常”。

senses.en: a picture made with paint

ex.en: The painting hangs in the hall.
ex.zh: 这幅画挂在大厅里。

ex.en: A student painting of the river can teach the town what the bank looks like after rain.
ex.zh: 学生画的河，能让城镇看见雨后的河岸。

tip: painting 作一幅画时可数。作绘画这项活动时不可数。

senses.en: written words
to send a written message by phone

ex.en: Read the text before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答之前先读课文。

ex.en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is already under water.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路还没被水淹之前到达才有帮助。

tip: text 作动词是“发短信”。

senses.en: a drawing of an area

ex.en: The map shows the bus stops.
ex.zh: 地图标出了公交站。

ex.en: A map of flood risk helps a town decide which school needs a higher floor.
ex.zh: 洪水风险地图帮助城镇决定哪所学校需要更高的楼层。

tip: map 作动词是绘制或详细安排。

senses.en: using electronic devices

ex.en: The electronic clock in the hall is wrong.
ex.zh: 大厅里的电子钟不准。

ex.en: An electronic notice still needs a paper copy when the network fails.
ex.zh: 网络断了的时候，电子通知仍然需要一份纸质副本。

tip: electronic 强调电子设备。electric 已在本库，多指用电的。

senses.en: to change place, or to cause a feeling
an action

ex.en: Please move your bag off the seat.
ex.zh: 请把包从座位上移开。

ex.en: Families move away when rents rise faster than wages, and schools then lose students.
ex.zh: 当房租涨得比工资快时，家庭会搬走，学校随后失去学生。

tip: move 可作及物或不及物。搬家用 move to a place。

senses.en: what happens because of something

ex.en: The result of the test will come out tomorrow.
ex.zh: 考试结果明天出来。

ex.en: The result of cutting night buses is that workers walk home on dark roads.
ex.zh: 削减夜班公交的结果是，工人走在没有灯的路上回家。

tip: result in 后接后果；result from 后接原因。

senses.en: to cause something to go somewhere

ex.en: Please send the form to the office.
ex.zh: 请把表格送到办公室。

ex.en: Schools that send warnings only by app miss families who have no signal at home.
ex.zh: 只用应用发送警报的学校，会漏掉家里没有信号的家庭。

tip: send 的过去式和过去分词是 sent。

senses.en: something you do regularly

ex.en: Checking the source is a habit.
ex.zh: 核对来源是一个习惯。

ex.en: A habit of writing the bus time saves the phone call.
ex.zh: 写下公交时间的习惯能省掉那通电话。

col: get into a habit｜养成习惯
tip: habit 可数。

senses.en: about, but not exactly

ex.en: The hall holds approximately 200 people.
ex.zh: 大厅大约容纳 200 人。

ex.en: Approximately right numbers are useful, and a budget still needs the exact figure.
ex.zh: 大约正确的数字有用，预算仍然需要确切的数。

tip: approximately 比 about 正式。

senses.en: stone, or a kind of popular music

ex.en: We sat on a flat rock by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们坐在湖边一块平坦的岩石上。

ex.en: A rock concert in a small square needs a volume that still lets neighbours sleep.
ex.zh: 小广场上的摇滚音乐会需要一个仍让邻居能睡觉的音量。

tip: rock 作动词是“摇动”。

senses.en: a strong elastic material, or a tool that removes pencil marks

ex.en: The rubber is on the desk.
ex.zh: 橡皮在书桌上。

ex.en: Rubber boots by the door matter when the path is wet.
ex.zh: 小路湿的时候，门边的胶靴就有用。

tip: 英式 rubber 常指橡皮。美式 eraser 更常见。材料“橡胶”通常不可数。

senses.en: to combine different things
a combination

ex.en: Do not mix those two liquids.
ex.zh: 不要把那两种液体混在一起。

ex.en: Cities that mix housing and shops keep a street alive after the offices close.
ex.zh: 把住房和商店混在一起的城市，能让街道在办公室关门后仍然有人。

tip: mix up 是搞混。a mix of 是名词短语。

senses.en: the power used to make light and machines work

ex.en: The electricity failed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨时停电了。

ex.en: Electricity from the school roof still needs someone who can repair it.
ex.zh: 学校屋顶发的电，仍然需要有人能修。

tip: electricity 不可数。electric 和 electrical 都已在或将在本库。

senses.en: something that is made or grown to be sold

ex.en: The label says where the product comes from.
ex.zh: 标签写明产品来自哪里。

ex.en: A cheap product that cannot be repaired becomes waste faster than a simple tool.
ex.zh: 无法修理的便宜产品，会比一件简单工具更快变成垃圾。

tip: product 是可数名词。

senses.en: a series of names or items

ex.en: Your name is not on the list.
ex.zh: 名单上没有你的名字。

ex.en: A waiting list for a clinic shows demand, but it does not treat the patient.
ex.zh: 诊所的等候名单显示需求，但并不治疗病人。

tip: list 作动词是“列出”。

senses.en: material of threads with spaces, or a network

ex.en: The ball went into the net.
ex.zh: 球进了网。

ex.en: A safety net under the gym equipment prevents one fall from becoming a serious injury.
ex.zh: 体操器械下的安全网，能避免一次跌落变成重伤。

tip: the Net 可指互联网，和 web 相近。本库已有 network。

senses.en: to come together, or to satisfy a need

ex.en: We will meet at the gate at seven.
ex.zh: 我们七点在门口见面。

ex.en: A bus timetable should meet the hour when school ends, not an office hour from another city.
ex.zh: 公交时刻应该配合放学的时间，而不是另一座城市的办公时间。

tip: meet 的过去式和过去分词是 met。初次相识用 meet；重逢也用 meet。

senses.en: a laboratory

ex.en: The lab closes at five.
ex.zh: 实验室五点关门。

ex.en: A lab rule that requires goggles only works if the goggles are there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定，只有护目镜真的在时才有效。

tip: lab 是 laboratory 的缩写。表里这一行的音标是 knowledge，本库不用。

senses.en: as far as you are concerned, or in person

ex.en: Personally, I prefer the early bus.
ex.zh: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢早班车。

ex.en: The head teacher personally checked the lock.
ex.zh: 校长亲自检查了锁。

tip: personal 已在本库，并提醒不要和 personnel 拼混。personally 是副词。

senses.en: to remain in a place or state

ex.en: Please stay in your seat until the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。

ex.en: Young workers stay in a town only if housing and jobs appear together.
ex.zh: 只有住房和工作同时出现，年轻工人才会留在城镇。

tip: stay 作连系动词后接形容词：stay calm。

senses.en: the passage in the neck for food and air

ex.en: Her throat hurt on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一她喉咙疼。

ex.en: A sore throat is a reason to see the clinic before the match.
ex.zh: 喉咙疼是比赛前去医务室的理由。

tip: throat 可数。

senses.en: feeling pleasure

ex.en: I am happy to help with the posters.
ex.zh: 我乐意帮忙做海报。

ex.en: A happy photo of a new park hides the families who were moved to make space for it.
ex.zh: 新公园的快乐照片，藏起了为腾地方而被搬走的家庭。

tip: happy 后接 to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: to be brave enough to do something

ex.en: She dared to ask about the fee.
ex.zh: 她敢于询问费用。

ex.en: Do not dare a classmate to do something unsafe.
ex.zh: 不要激同学去做不安全的事。

tip: How dare you 表示“你怎么敢”。本条不写冒险的做法。

senses.en: sure of yourself
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: Speak in a confident voice.
ex.zh: 用自信的声音说话。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: a mark, a school year, or a level of quality
to give a mark or a level

ex.en: She got a high grade in history.
ex.zh: 她历史成绩很高。

ex.en: A single grade should not decide whether a student may join the choir.
ex.zh: 一个分数不该决定学生能否参加合唱团。

col: in the same grade｜同一年级
tip: grade 可指分数、年级或品质等级。作动词是评分。

senses.en: to throw
the actors in a play or film

ex.en: Cast the net carefully from the bank.
ex.zh: 从岸上小心地撒网。

ex.en: The cast of the school play includes students who have never stood on a stage.
ex.zh: 校园剧的演员阵容里有从未上过台的学生。

tip: cast 的过去式和过去分词仍是 cast。作名词是“演员阵容”。

senses.en: wrong or cruel use
to use wrongly, or to treat cruelly

ex.en: Drug abuse is discussed in health class without any instructions.
ex.zh: 健康课讨论药物滥用，但不提供任何做法。

ex.en: If you see abuse, tell a teacher. You do not have to handle it alone.
ex.zh: 如果你看到虐待，告诉老师。你不必独自处理。

tip: 动词 abuse 末尾常读 /z/，名词常读 /s/。本条只作词汇，不写任何伤害别人的方法。

senses.en: things that people or animals eat

ex.en: The food in the canteen was simple but hot.
ex.zh: 食堂的食物简单但是热的。

ex.en: Wasted food in school kitchens is a loss of money and of the water used to grow it.
ex.zh: 学校厨房里浪费的食物，既是金钱的损失，也是种植它所用水的损失。

tip: food 通常不可数。一种食物可以说 a food，但较少用。

senses.en: sounds arranged in a way people enjoy

ex.en: There is music practice in the hall after school.
ex.zh: 放学后大厅里有音乐排练。

ex.en: Live music in a square can bring a neighbourhood together, but only if the volume lets people talk.
ex.zh: 广场上的现场音乐能把社区聚在一起，但前提是音量仍允许人们交谈。

tip: music 不可数，不说 a music 或 musics。

senses.en: a person trained in the law who advises and speaks in court

ex.en: The lawyer explained the form in plain words.
ex.zh: 律师用平实的话解释了表格。

ex.en: A school does not need a lawyer for every rule, but it does need one clear written policy.
ex.zh: 学校不是每条规则都需要律师，但确实需要一份写清楚的制度。

tip: lawyer 可数。法律是 law，已在本库。

senses.en: a shop, or a supply kept for later
to keep something for future use

ex.en: The store on the corner sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 拐角的商店卖笔记本。

ex.en: A village store that closes forces families to travel for food they used to buy next door.
ex.zh: 村里的商店关门后，家庭不得不为过去在隔壁就能买到的食物出远门。

tip: store 作动词是“储存”。美式 store 常指商店。

senses.en: a round part that turns

ex.en: The wheel of the cart is loose.
ex.zh: 手推车的轮子松了。

ex.en: A wheelchair needs a path, not only a poster about welcome.
ex.zh: 轮椅需要一条路，而不只是一张欢迎海报。

tip: wheel 可数。wheelchair 是轮椅。

senses.en: the money spent on something

ex.en: The expense is written on the form.
ex.zh: 费用写在表格上。

ex.en: An expense that families cannot see is not a fair price.
ex.zh: 家庭看不见的费用不是公平的价格。

col: at the expense of｜以牺牲……为代价
tip: expense 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a set of pages on the internet

ex.en: The bus times are on the school website.
ex.zh: 公交时刻在学校网站上。

ex.en: A website that hides who wrote a story makes it harder to trust the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒作者的网站，让人更难信任其中的事实。

tip: website 是一个词，也可写成 web site。

senses.en: a phone
to speak to someone by phone

ex.en: The telephone is by the office door.
ex.zh: 电话在办公室门边。

ex.en: A telephone number on the wall matters when the network fails.
ex.zh: 网络断了的时候，墙上的电话号码很重要。

tip: phone 已在本库，更常用。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

senses.en: something you ask
to express doubt about

ex.en: May I ask a question about the homework?
ex.zh: 我可以问一个关于作业的问题吗？

ex.en: The right question about a new road is who will walk it, not only how many cars it will carry.
ex.zh: 关于一条新路，正确的问题是谁会在上面走，而不只是它能载多少车。

tip: out of the question 是“不可能”；out of question 现在很少用。

senses.en: despite the fact that

ex.en: Though the lab is small, the equipment is new.
ex.zh: 虽然实验室小，设备却是新的。

ex.en: Though a city plants trees, the streets stay hot if the trees are too young to give shade.
ex.zh: 尽管一座城市种了树，如果树还小、遮不成荫，街道依然炎热。

tip: though 可放在句首或句末；although 多放在句首，一般不放句末。

senses.en: the force of pushing, or stress

ex.en: Exam pressure is common in the last month.
ex.zh: 最后一个月考试压力很常见。

ex.en: Pressure to publish quickly can make a newsroom skip the check that would catch a false photo.
ex.zh: 赶快发表的压力，会让编辑部跳过能发现假照片的核对。

tip: pressure 通常不可数。put pressure on sb 表示向某人施压。

senses.en: if, used when there are two possibilities

ex.en: I do not know whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我不知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Whether a town keeps its clinic depends on buses as well as on doctors.
ex.zh: 一个城镇能否保住诊所，既取决于医生，也取决于公交。

tip: whether 可接不定式：whether to go。if 一般不接不定式。介词后用 whether，不用 if。

senses.en: a very small town in the countryside

ex.en: Her grandparents live in a village.
ex.zh: 她的祖父母住在一个村子里。

ex.en: A village school with one teacher still has to cover every subject on the exam list.
ex.zh: 只有一位老师的乡村学校，仍然要覆盖考试清单上的每一科。

tip: village 比 town 小。乡村地区也可说 the village。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: The concert was fantastic.
ex.zh: 音乐会棒极了。

ex.en: A fantastic score for one class does not show what the school did for the others.
ex.zh: 一个班的极好成绩，说明不了学校为其他班做了什么。

tip: fantastic 已经程度很高，口语里很常见。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a movable barrier, or the entrance to a school or airport

ex.en: Meet me at the school gate.
ex.zh: 在校门口等我。

ex.en: A gate that locks before the last student leaves is not a safety plan.
ex.zh: 在最后一名学生离开之前就锁上的门，不是安全方案。

tip: gate 可数。机场登机口也叫 gate。

senses.en: AIDS, a serious illness

ex.en: The health class explains AIDS as an illness.
ex.zh: 健康课把艾滋病作为一种疾病来讲。

ex.en: A poster about AIDS should give facts, not fear.
ex.zh: 关于艾滋病的海报应当给事实，而不是恐惧。

tip: 书写常用大写 AIDS。本条是健康词汇，不写传播或治疗的做法。

senses.en: new information about events

ex.en: The news about the match spread quickly.
ex.zh: 关于比赛的消息很快传开了。

ex.en: Good news reporting explains what is known and what is still uncertain.
ex.zh: 好的新闻报道会说明哪些是已知的，哪些仍不确定。

col: a piece of news｜一则新闻
tip: news 不可数，不说 a news。一则新闻用 a piece of news。

senses.en: the name of a book or a person's rank

ex.en: Write a clear title for the poster.
ex.zh: 给海报写一个清楚的标题。

ex.en: The title of a report should say what was measured, not only what sounds impressive.
ex.zh: 报告的标题应该说明测量了什么，而不只是听起来动人。

tip: title 作动词是“给……加标题”。

senses.en: a raised flat surface, or a place to speak or build on

ex.en: The train leaves from platform two.
ex.zh: 火车从二号站台开出。

ex.en: A platform for student writing needs an editor, not only a website.
ex.zh: 学生写作的平台需要编辑，而不只是一个网站。

tip: 火车站台和演讲台、软件平台都可以用 platform。

senses.en: the act of leaving a vehicle, or space for it

ex.en: There is no parking at the gate.
ex.zh: 门口不能停车。

ex.en: Parking for the bus matters more than parking for one car.
ex.zh: 给公交的停车位比给一辆小汽车的更重要。

tip: 动词 park 已在本库。parking 通常不可数。

senses.en: to take the place of, or to put something back

ex.en: The new clock will replace the broken one.
ex.zh: 新钟将换掉坏的那一个。

ex.en: Screens do not replace a teacher who knows the student is lost.
ex.zh: 屏幕代替不了知道学生没跟上的老师。

tip: replace A with B 是用 B 替换 A。

senses.en: a unit of language

ex.en: I wrote the new word in my notebook.
ex.zh: 我把生词写在笔记本里。

ex.en: A single word in a headline can change how readers judge a whole event.
ex.zh: 标题里的一个词就能改变读者对整件事的判断。

tip: have a word with sb 是和某人说句话；have words with 是争吵。

senses.en: an area next to a building, or a unit of length

ex.en: The class meets in the yard.
ex.zh: 班级在院子里集合。

ex.en: A yard with no light is a poor place to wait for the last bus.
ex.zh: 没有灯的院子，是等末班车的糟糕地方。

tip: yard 作长度是码，约 0.91 米。美式 backyard 是后院。

senses.en: with little or no light
the absence of light

ex.en: The street is dark after eight.
ex.zh: 八点以后这条街很黑。

ex.en: A dark walk from the bus stop to the school gate is a safety problem, not a small inconvenience.
ex.zh: 从车站走到校门的一段黑路是安全问题，不是小不便。

tip: dark 也可作名词，前面常加 the。

senses.en: numbers that give information, or the study of them

ex.en: The statistics show who uses the late bus.
ex.zh: 统计数字显示谁在坐晚班车。

ex.en: Statistics without a source are just another opinion.
ex.zh: 没有来源的统计数字只是另一种意见。

tip: 作“统计学”时谓语常用单数。作“统计数字”时谓语用复数。

senses.en: ground, or the solid part of the earth
to come down onto the ground

ex.en: The school sits on flat land near the river.
ex.zh: 学校坐落在河边的平地上。

ex.en: Cheap land beside a river looks useful until the first flood shows why it was empty.
ex.zh: 河边的廉价土地看起来有用，直到第一次洪水说明它为什么曾经空着。

tip: land 作动词是“着陆”或“登陆”。

senses.en: the keeping of things until they are needed

ex.en: There is no storage for the extra chairs.
ex.zh: 没有地方存放多余的椅子。

ex.en: Cold storage for milk matters more than a new sign on the canteen door.
ex.zh: 牛奶的冷藏比食堂门上的新牌子更重要。

tip: storage 通常不可数。store 已在本库。

senses.en: how long something is

ex.en: Measure the length of the table first.
ex.zh: 先量桌子的长度。

ex.en: The length of a school day changes how much daylight children still have for sport.
ex.zh: 上课日的长度会改变孩子放学后还剩多少日光可以运动。

tip: 长度用 length。at length 是书面语，表示详尽地。

senses.en: pleased

ex.en: I am glad to see you back at school.
ex.zh: 看到你回学校我很高兴。

ex.en: Parents are glad when a late bus is explained, even if the delay itself cannot be avoided.
ex.zh: 即使晚点本身无法避免，只要有人解释，家长也会高兴一些。

tip: glad 作表语，一般不说 a glad person。

senses.en: highest in rank or greatest

ex.en: The supreme rule here is to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 这里的最高规定是锁好实验室。

ex.en: A supreme court decision can change what a textbook is allowed to say.
ex.zh: 最高法院的裁决可以改变课本被允许写的内容。

tip: supreme 程度已经最高，一般不再加 most。

senses.en: to know someone or something again, or to accept that something is true

ex.en: I did not recognize her in the hat.
ex.zh: 她戴着帽子，我没认出她。

ex.en: A city should recognize a flood risk before the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在第一条街被淹之前承认洪水风险。

tip: recognize 是美式拼写。英式常作 recognise。意思相同。

senses.en: a sudden strong surprise
to surprise and upset someone

ex.en: The result was a shock.
ex.zh: 这个结果令人震惊。

ex.en: The shock of a cancelled bus is smaller if the other route is already on the sheet.
ex.zh: 如果另一条路线已经写在纸上，公交取消带来的震惊就会小一些。

tip: shock 作动词是使震惊。electric shock 是电击，本条不写如何触电。

senses.en: probable

ex.en: Rain is likely today.
ex.zh: 今天可能下雨。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: going far down, or strong

ex.en: Do not swim where the river is deep.
ex.zh: 河水深的地方不要游泳。

ex.en: Deep floods reach streets that a shallow rain never touches.
ex.zh: 深的洪水会漫到浅雨从不到达的街道。

tip: deep 可形容水、颜色、睡眠或感情。

senses.en: a play or film that is meant to be funny

ex.en: The comedy made the hall laugh.
ex.zh: 这部喜剧让礼堂里的人笑了。

ex.en: A comedy about a flood can still name who had to leave their house.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的喜剧仍然可以写出谁不得不离开自己的家。

tip: comedy 可数。喜剧演员是 comedian。

senses.en: a person who secretly collects information for a government or company
to watch secretly

ex.en: The novel has a spy, and then it returns to school.
ex.zh: 小说里有一个间谍，然后回到学校。

ex.en: A history text can name a spy without teaching a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文可以提到间谍，同时不教做法。

col: a spy for｜为……工作的间谍
tip: spy 作动词是暗中侦察。本条只作词汇，不写做法。

senses.en: at once

ex.en: Please come to the office immediately.
ex.zh: 请立刻到办公室来。

ex.en: A leaking gas pipe should be reported immediately, not after the next lesson.
ex.zh: 煤气管道泄漏应该立刻报告，而不是等下一节课之后。

tip: immediately 是副词；immediate 是形容词。

senses.en: a short piece of writing on a subject

ex.en: The essay is due on Friday.
ex.zh: 短文周五交。

ex.en: An essay about the bus should include the return time.
ex.zh: 写公交的短文应当包括返回时间。

tip: essay 可数。

senses.en: a place where adults buy drinks; British

ex.en: The bus stops near the pub.
ex.zh: 公交停在酒吧附近。

ex.en: A pub on a map is a landmark, not an invitation.
ex.zh: 地图上的酒吧是地标，不是邀请。

tip: pub 是英式。本条只作地点词汇。

senses.en: a child

ex.en: The kid by the gate is waiting for his sister.
ex.zh: 门口的小孩在等他姐姐。

ex.en: A kid walking home in the dark needs a light on the street, not only a lecture about safety.
ex.zh: 在黑暗中走回家的小孩需要街上的灯，而不只是关于安全的说教。

tip: kid 是口语。正式写作多用 child。

senses.en: hard work
an attempt or organised activity intended to achieve a goal

ex.en: Success needs continuous effort.
ex.zh: 成功需要持续努力。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires a joint effort from consumers, manufacturers and local authorities to change everyday practices.
ex.zh: 减少家庭垃圾需要消费者、制造商和地方政府共同努力，改变日常做法。

tip: 表示精力时不可数；表示一次尝试时可数。

senses.en: to be in charge, or to succeed in doing something difficult

ex.en: She managed to catch the last bus.
ex.zh: 她设法赶上了末班车。

ex.en: Schools manage a flood better when the plan names a person, not only a building.
ex.zh: 当方案写明一个人而不只是一栋楼时，学校能更好地应对洪水。

tip: manage to do 表示做成了难事。manager 已在本库。

senses.en: a device that supplies electricity

ex.en: The battery in the clock is dead.
ex.zh: 钟里的电池没电了。

ex.en: A spare battery for the school bus radio matters on a storm day.
ex.zh: 暴风雨那天，校车无线电的备用电池很重要。

tip: battery 可数。复数 batteries。

senses.en: things for sale or transport

ex.en: The goods arrived before the shop opened.
ex.zh: 货物在商店开门前到了。

ex.en: Goods left in the rain outside a school shop are nobody's bargain.
ex.zh: 放在学校小卖部外淋雨的货物，谁买了都不划算。

tip: goods 是复数，不说 a goods。表里这一行的音标是 good，本库不用。

senses.en: a frozen sweet food

ex.en: We had ice cream after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后我们吃了冰淇淋。

ex.en: Ice cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a mess and a risk.
ex.zh: 放在太阳下的冰淇淋不是款待，是一片狼藉，也是风险。

col: a bowl of ice cream｜一碗冰淇淋
tip: cream 已在本库。ice cream 通常不可数。an ice cream 可指一份。

senses.en: in a short time

ex.en: The meeting will start soon.
ex.zh: 会议很快就要开始。

ex.en: A leaking roof will soon damage books if a school waits for a perfect budget.
ex.zh: 如果学校一直等一份完美的预算，漏雨的屋顶很快会损坏书籍。

tip: as soon as 引导时间从句，主句将来时，从句用一般现在时。

senses.en: to give a document to someone in authority

ex.en: Submit the form before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前提交表格。

ex.en: Students submit better work when the question is clear.
ex.zh: 问题清楚时，学生交上来的作业更好。

col: submit sth to｜把某物提交给
tip: submit 比 hand in 正式。

senses.en: a piece of a whole, or a role

ex.en: This chapter is the hardest part of the book.
ex.zh: 这一章是书里最难的部分。

ex.en: Parents are only one part of a child's education; streets, screens, and friends shape habits too.
ex.zh: 父母只是孩子教育的一部分；街道、屏幕和朋友也会塑造习惯。

tip: take part in 表示参加活动，不要漏掉 in。

senses.en: to use something carelessly
unwanted material, or careless use

ex.en: Do not waste paper on a second cover.
ex.zh: 不要为了再做一个封面浪费纸。

ex.en: Food waste from the canteen can feed a garden if someone sorts it the same day.
ex.zh: 如果有人当天分类，食堂的食物废料可以供给花园。

tip: waste 作名词是废物或浪费。food waste 里 waste 可以是名词。

senses.en: the leader of a country, club, or some universities

ex.en: The club president will speak first.
ex.zh: 社团主席将首先发言。

ex.en: A student president who only repeats teachers ideas will not represent the class.
ex.zh: 只重复老师想法的学生主席，代表不了班级。

tip: president 在不同机构里可以是总统、主席或大学校长。

senses.en: to promise to do something, or to do something wrong

ex.en: Please commit to locking the lab.
ex.zh: 请承诺锁上实验室。

ex.en: Do not commit the same error on the next form.
ex.zh: 不要在下一张表上再犯同样的错误。

tip: 名词 commitment 已在本库。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

senses.en: a person's own nature or identity

ex.en: The exercise asks you to describe your self in three words.
ex.zh: 这个练习请你用三个词描述自己。

ex.en: A sense of self grows when students are trusted with real tasks, not only with tests.
ex.zh: 当学生被托付真正的任务而不只是考试时，自我意识会成长。

tip: self 常构成复合词，如 self-study。复数是 selves。

senses.en: on all sides of, or about
in the surrounding area

ex.en: We walked around the lake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们绕着湖走了走。

ex.en: Shops around a school gate affect what students buy between classes, from water to sweets.
ex.zh: 校门口的商店影响着学生课间买什么，从水到糖果都是。

tip: around 表示大约时与 about 接近：around 20 students。

senses.en: sleeping

ex.en: The baby was asleep on the bus.
ex.zh: 婴儿在公交上睡着了。

ex.en: A student asleep in class may need sleep, not a punishment.
ex.zh: 课上睡着的学生可能需要的是睡眠，不是惩罚。

tip: asleep 只作表语。sleep 已在本库。

senses.en: a person who reports news

ex.en: The reporter checked the name.
ex.zh: 记者核对了名字。

ex.en: A reporter who names no source is harder to trust.
ex.zh: 不写来源的记者更难信任。

tip: report 已在本库。journalist 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: a female ruler, or the wife of a king

ex.en: The queen visited the old harbour in the story.
ex.zh: 故事里女王参观了古老的港口。

ex.en: A history chapter about a queen should also say who cooked, farmed and paid the taxes.
ex.zh: 写女王的历史章节，也应当说谁在做饭、种地和纳税。

tip: queen 可以是女性君主，也可以是国王的妻子。

senses.en: what you notice with your nose
to notice a smell, or to have one

ex.en: There is a smell of paint in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里有油漆味。

ex.en: A bad smell from the kitchen is a reason to stop lunch, not to hide it.
ex.zh: 厨房的异味是停下午饭的理由，不是把它藏起来。

tip: smell 作动词的过去式是 smelt 或 smelled。smell 可作连系动词：smell good。

senses.en: work, especially physical work; British spelling

ex.en: Harvest labour starts before sunrise.
ex.zh: 收割的劳动在日出前就开始了。

ex.en: Child labour is illegal, and a weekend school job is not the same thing.
ex.zh: 童工是非法的，周末在学校打工不是一回事。

tip: labour 是英式拼写，labor 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，意思相同。

senses.en: kind and pleasant

ex.en: The staff were friendly to the new students.
ex.zh: 工作人员对新同学很友好。

ex.en: A friendly match still needs a referee and a way home.
ex.zh: 友谊赛仍然需要裁判和回家的办法。

tip: friendly 是形容词，不是副词。友好地用 in a friendly way。friend 已在本库。

senses.en: the science of matter and energy

ex.en: Physics is the first lesson on Tuesday.
ex.zh: 周二第一节是物理。

ex.en: A physics problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
ex.zh: 一道关于公交的物理题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。

tip: physics 作学科时谓语用单数。physical 已在本库。

senses.en: measuring a lot from side to side

ex.en: The new pavement is wide enough for two people.
ex.zh: 新的人行道宽得够两个人走。

ex.en: A wide road without a crossing is still a barrier for a child.
ex.zh: 没有过街处的宽路，对孩子仍然是障碍。

tip: wide 强调横向的宽；broad 常强调幅面或抽象的广。

senses.en: something accepted as true

ex.en: Strong belief can give people hope.
ex.zh: 坚定的信念能给人希望。

ex.en: The belief that education improves social mobility influences government spending priorities in many countries.
ex.zh: 教育能促进社会流动的这一信念影响着许多国家的政府支出重点。

col: belief in someone｜对某人的信任
a widely held belief｜普遍持有的看法
contrary to popular belief｜与普遍看法相反
tip: belief in表示信任或信仰；belief that后接具体看法。

senses.en: to get ready

ex.en: Prepare the lab before the class arrives.
ex.zh: 班级到来之前把实验室准备好。

ex.en: Cities should prepare flood plans before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在雨季之前准备防汛方案，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: prepare for 后接所准备的事。prepare sth 是把某物准备好。

senses.en: to move through the air
a small flying insect

ex.en: Birds fly over the sports field.
ex.zh: 鸟飞过运动场。

ex.en: A town that wants fewer cars cannot only tell people to fly; most journeys are short.
ex.zh: 想减少汽车的城镇不能只叫人坐飞机，大多数行程都很短。

tip: fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown。航班名词 flight 已在本库。

senses.en: what you plan to do

ex.en: Her intention is to return the book.
ex.zh: 她的打算是还书。

ex.en: A good intention still needs a written time.
ex.zh: 好意仍然需要一个写下来的时间。

tip: intention 可数。

senses.en: damaged by use, or very tired

ex.en: The coat is worn at the elbows.
ex.zh: 外套的肘部磨旧了。

ex.en: A worn step should be repaired before someone falls.
ex.zh: 磨坏的台阶应当在有人摔倒之前修好。

tip: worn 是 wear 的过去分词。wear 已在本库。表里把 worm 的读音混了进来，本库不用。

senses.en: demanding that rules are obeyed

ex.en: The rule is strict about the lab door.
ex.zh: 这条规则对实验室的门很严格。

ex.en: A strict timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
ex.zh: 严格的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。

tip: strict 可形容人或规则。

senses.en: far from towns

ex.en: The village is remote, but the school is open.
ex.zh: 村子很偏远，但学校开着。

ex.en: A remote school still needs a bus, not only a website.
ex.zh: 偏远的学校仍然需要公交，而不只是一个网站。

tip: remote control 是遥控器。

senses.en: a room where people wait

ex.en: Please stay in the waiting room until your name is called.
ex.zh: 请在候诊室等到叫你的名字。

ex.en: A crowded waiting room shows that a clinic needs more staff, not only more chairs.
ex.zh: 拥挤的候诊室说明诊所需要更多工作人员，而不只是更多椅子。

col: in the waiting room｜在等候室
tip: waiting room 中间有空格。医院、车站都可以用。

senses.en: having a low temperature
low temperature, or a common illness

ex.en: It is cold in the classroom this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨教室里很冷。

ex.en: Cold classrooms in winter make it harder to learn, especially for children who walked a long way.
ex.zh: 冬天寒冷的教室让学习更难，尤其是走了很远路的孩子。

tip: cold 作名词是“寒冷”或“感冒”。

senses.en: very small grains of rock, as on a beach

ex.en: The path is covered with sand.
ex.zh: 小路上盖着沙。

ex.en: Sand in the playground drains rain better than bare soil.
ex.zh: 操场上的沙比光土更能排雨。

tip: sand 通常不可数。

senses.en: a path, a rail, or marks left behind

ex.en: She runs on the track after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后在跑道上跑。

ex.en: Keeping track of bus delays shows which routes fail students most often.
ex.zh: 记录公交延误，能显示哪些线路最常让学生失望。

tip: track 作动词是“跟踪”。

senses.en: in or of the north

ex.en: The northern wind made the field feel colder.
ex.zh: 北风让田野感觉更冷。

ex.en: Northern towns may need longer heating, which changes the winter school budget.
ex.zh: 北方城镇可能需要更长的供暖，这会改变冬季的学校预算。

tip: northern 是形容词。名词“北方”用 north。

senses.en: not liking change
a person who does not like change

ex.en: The plan is conservative and keeps the old bus.
ex.zh: 这个方案很保守，保留了旧公交。

ex.en: A conservative estimate of the cost is safer than a hopeful one.
ex.zh: 对费用的保守估计，比乐观的估计更安全。

tip: conservative 也可作名词“保守的人”。政治里的 Conservative 常大写。

senses.en: if not

ex.en: We will walk unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，否则我们走路去。

ex.en: A river will not recover unless the factories upstream stop the night waste.
ex.zh: 除非上游工厂停止夜间排污，否则河不会恢复。

tip: unless 等于 if not，本身已含否定，从句里一般不再加 not。

senses.en: very valuable

ex.en: Time before the exam is precious.
ex.zh: 考前的时间很珍贵。

ex.en: A precious seat on the late bus should go to the student who cannot stand.
ex.zh: 晚班车上珍贵的座位应当给不能站着的学生。

tip: precious 可形容时间、物品或人。用在人身上时要尊重。

senses.en: to make something, or to show it
food that is grown, especially in large amounts

ex.en: The factory produces parts for buses.
ex.zh: 这家工厂生产公交零件。

ex.en: Local farms that produce food for the school can shorten the road from field to canteen.
ex.zh: 为学校生产食物的本地农场，可以缩短从田地到食堂的路。

tip: 动词重音在后。名词 produce 指农产品，重音在前。

senses.en: having a sour sharp taste, or containing acid
a chemical substance with a sour sharp quality

ex.en: The lab labels every bottle that is acid.
ex.zh: 实验室给每一瓶酸性的东西贴标签。

ex.en: Students learn the word acid and the warning sign, not a method for making it.
ex.zh: 学生学的是 acid 这个词和警告标志，不是制造它的方法。

tip: acid 作名词是酸。本条只作课堂词汇和安全提示，不写制备或使用方法。

senses.en: material burned to produce heat or power

ex.en: The bus runs on cleaner fuel this year.
ex.zh: 今年这辆公交使用更清洁的燃料。

ex.en: Cutting fuel use in old buildings can pay for itself if the windows actually close.
ex.zh: 如果窗户真的能关上，减少旧楼的燃料消耗可以收回成本。

tip: fuel 作物质名词时常不可数。作动词是加燃料或激起。

senses.en: to keep in the hand, to organise, or to contain

ex.en: Please hold the door for the next person.
ex.zh: 请为后面的人扶住门。

ex.en: A hall that cannot hold the whole school should not be the only place for a fire drill.
ex.zh: 容纳不下全校的礼堂，不该是消防演习的唯一地点。

tip: hold 的过去式和过去分词是 held。

senses.en: the place where visitors are received, or a formal party

ex.en: The reception is by the front door.
ex.zh: 接待处在前门边。

ex.en: A reception for parents should not start after the last bus.
ex.zh: 家长招待会不应当在末班车之后才开始。

tip: reception 可数。

senses.en: a hot drink made from coffee beans

ex.en: The teachers drink coffee in the office.
ex.zh: 老师们在办公室喝咖啡。

ex.en: A night of coffee before an exam keeps students awake, and it also makes the next morning harder.
ex.zh: 考前一夜咖啡能让学生醒着，也会让第二天早上更难熬。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: coffee 作物质名词不可数。a coffee 可以指一杯咖啡。

senses.en: to some degree, not completely

ex.en: The delay was partly the storm.
ex.zh: 这次延误有一部分是因为暴风雨。

ex.en: A plan that only partly names the bus still leaves families guessing.
ex.zh: 只部分写出公交的计划，仍然让家庭在猜。

tip: partly 是副词。

senses.en: a covering for the foot

ex.en: The shoe is under the desk.
ex.zh: 鞋在书桌下面。

ex.en: A wet shoe at the gate is a reason to bring a spare pair.
ex.zh: 门口的湿鞋是再带一双的理由。

tip: 常用复数 shoes。

senses.en: from another country

ex.en: She is learning a foreign language.
ex.zh: 她在学一门外语。

ex.en: Foreign news is useful only when students also know how to check the source.
ex.zh: 只有当学生也知道如何核对来源时，外国新闻才有用。

tip: foreign 是形容词，不说 foreign country people，说 people from other countries 或 foreigners。

senses.en: the planet, or soil

ex.en: We live on the earth.
ex.zh: 我们生活在地球上。

ex.en: Healthy earth near a river can hold flood water that concrete sends straight into the street.
ex.zh: 河边健康的土壤能蓄住洪水，而混凝土会把水直接送进街道。

tip: the earth 指地球时常加 the。on earth 也可加强疑问语气。

senses.en: a bicycle

ex.en: I ride my bike when the path is dry.
ex.zh: 路干的时候我骑自行车。

ex.en: A place to lock a bike matters as much as a lesson about clean air.
ex.zh: 一个能锁自行车的地方，和一节关于清洁空气的课一样重要。

tip: bike 是 bicycle 的口语。by bike 不加冠词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the reflexive form of they

ex.en: The students organised the fair themselves.
ex.zh: 学生们自己组织了这次义卖。

ex.en: Communities can protect a river themselves, but they still need the law behind them.
ex.zh: 社区可以自己保护一条河，但他们仍然需要法律在背后支持。

tip: themselves 不能代替 they 作主语。

senses.en: small, or not much
not much

ex.en: There is little time before the bus leaves.
ex.zh: 汽车开走前时间不多了。

ex.en: A little shade on a playground can make summer sports safer for younger children.
ex.zh: 操场上一点点荫凉，就能让年幼的孩子在夏天运动时更安全。

tip: little 偏否定，表示几乎没有；a little 表示有一点。都修饰不可数名词。

senses.en: of Europe

ex.en: We read a European folk story.
ex.zh: 我们读了一个欧洲民间故事。

ex.en: European visitors bring money to a town, but they also raise rents if housing is already short.
ex.zh: 欧洲游客给城镇带来钱，但如果住房已经短缺，他们也会推高房租。

tip: European 和 Europe 都要大写。

senses.en: tasting of sugar, or pleasant
a piece of candy or a sweet dish

ex.en: This tea is too sweet for me.
ex.zh: 这茶对我来说太甜了。

ex.en: A sweet snack every afternoon can hide how much sugar a teenager drinks in a week.
ex.zh: 每天下午一块甜点，会掩盖青少年一周喝下多少糖。

tip: sweet 作名词时常指糖果，英式英语更常见。

senses.en: a feeling of hurt

ex.en: She felt a pain in her knee after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后她感到膝盖疼。

ex.en: Tooth pain that waits a month for a clinic becomes a larger problem than it was on the first day.
ex.zh: 等了一个月才看上诊所的牙痛，会比第一天更严重。

tip: pain 可数或不可数都可以。

senses.en: a long flat surface in a shop or bank

ex.en: Please pay at the counter.
ex.zh: 请在柜台付款。

ex.en: A counter that is too high hides the person who is serving a child.
ex.zh: 太高的柜台会挡住正在给孩子服务的那个人。

tip: counter 作动词是反驳。run counter to 表示与……相反。

senses.en: the early part of the day

ex.en: I review words every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨复习单词。

ex.en: A hot morning in a room without fans makes the first lesson harder than it needs to be.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的房间里炎热的早晨，会让第一节课难上加难。

tip: 泛指上午用 in the morning；具体某一天上午用 on Monday morning。

senses.en: as the representative of someone

ex.en: She spoke on behalf of the class.
ex.zh: 她代表班级发言。

ex.en: A speech on behalf of students should come after someone has asked them.
ex.zh: 代表学生的讲话，应当在有人问过他们之后。

tip: 几乎只用于 on behalf of 或 on somebody's behalf。

senses.en: a unit of distance

ex.en: The farm is two miles from school.
ex.zh: 农场离学校两英里。

ex.en: A mile of pavement matters more to a walking student than a faster road with none.
ex.zh: 对步行的学生来说，一英里人行道比没有人行道的更快的路更重要。

tip: 1 mile 约 1.6 公里。英里是 mile，米是 metre。

senses.en: not inside
outdoors or not inside

ex.en: Please wait outside the office.
ex.zh: 请在办公室外面等。

ex.en: Noise from outside a classroom can undo the quiet a teacher is trying to keep.
ex.zh: 教室外面的噪音可以毁掉老师试图保持的安静。

tip: outside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not named

ex.en: I left my bag somewhere in the hall.
ex.zh: 我把包落在大厅的某个地方了。

ex.en: Students need somewhere quiet to read when home has no spare room.
ex.zh: 家里没有空房间时，学生需要一个安静的地方读书。

tip: somewhere 是副词，前面不加 in。表里这一行的音标是 sometimes，本库不用。

senses.en: what is true

ex.en: Please tell the truth about the broken window.
ex.zh: 请说出打破窗户的真相。

ex.en: The truth about a flood includes which streets were under water, not only the official speech.
ex.zh: 洪水的真相包括哪些街被水淹了，而不只是官方的讲话。

tip: truth 通常不可数。

senses.en: the direction between north and west

ex.en: The wind is from the north-west.
ex.zh: 风从西北来。

ex.en: Villages in the north-west share one clinic, so the winter road between them must stay open.
ex.zh: 西北的村子共用一家诊所，所以它们之间的冬季道路必须保持通畅。

tip: north-west 也可写作 northwest。

senses.en: of the darkest colour
the colour black

ex.en: The black cat slept on the warm step.
ex.zh: 黑猫睡在温暖的台阶上。

ex.en: Black smoke from old buses is a daily health problem for students waiting at the stop.
ex.zh: 旧公交冒出的黑烟，是等车学生每天面对的健康问题。

tip: black 也可作名词表示黑色。

senses.en: a game, or the ball used in it

ex.en: Basketball practice is at four.
ex.zh: 篮球训练在四点。

ex.en: A basketball court that locks at dusk leaves the students who finish late outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的篮球场，把下课晚的学生留在外面。

tip: 球类运动前通常不加 the：play basketball。

senses.en: a closed path, or a complete electrical path

ex.en: The bus runs a circuit of the town.
ex.zh: 公交绕城镇跑一圈。

ex.en: The lab circuit is drawn on the board, and the switch stays off until the teacher checks it.
ex.zh: 实验室电路画在黑板上，在老师检查之前开关保持关闭。

tip: circuit 可指路线或电路。本条不写如何接通危险电路。

senses.en: the end of a route, or a computer screen and keyboard
at the end

ex.en: The bus terminal is at the end of the avenue.
ex.zh: 公交终点站在大街尽头。

ex.en: A computer terminal in the library needs a working clock.
ex.zh: 图书馆的计算机终端需要一块能走的钟。

tip: terminal 作形容词可指晚期的。表里这一行的音标是 term，本库不用。

senses.en: the body that goes round the earth

ex.en: The moon was bright on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家的路上月亮很亮。

ex.en: A town that turns off some lights can still see the moon, and the owls can hunt.
ex.zh: 关掉一部分灯的城镇仍然看得见月亮，猫头鹰也能捕猎。

tip: moon 前通常加 the。

senses.en: a large wild cat with stripes

ex.en: The tiger is in the nature book.
ex.zh: 老虎在自然课本里。

ex.en: A lesson about the tiger should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
ex.zh: 关于老虎的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。

tip: tiger 可数。

senses.en: the Christian festival on 25 December

ex.en: The shop is closed on Christmas Day.
ex.zh: 商店在圣诞节关门。

ex.en: Christmas lights can make a street feel safe at night if they do not replace the ordinary lamps.
ex.zh: 圣诞灯可以让街道在夜里感觉安全，如果它们不是用来代替普通路灯的。

tip: Christmas 要大写。

senses.en: a table for writing or working

ex.en: Leave the desk clear.
ex.zh: 把书桌收拾干净。

ex.en: A desk at home is not available to every student, which is why the library stays open.
ex.zh: 不是每个学生家里都有书桌，所以图书馆一直开着。

tip: desk 可数。

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned

ex.en: I have never seen such a clear night sky.
ex.zh: 我从没见过这么晴朗的夜空。

ex.en: Such a small tax on plastic bags can change what millions of shoppers carry home.
ex.zh: 对塑料袋征收如此小的一笔费用，就能改变数百万人拎回家的东西。

tip: such a/an + 形容词 + 可数名词单数；so + 形容词。

senses.en: to defeat, or to hit repeatedly

ex.en: Our team beat Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队打败了三班。

ex.en: You cannot beat a flood with a speech if the drains are still too small.
ex.zh: 如果排水管仍然太小，你无法用一篇讲话打败洪水。

tip: 打败某人用 beat sb；赢得比赛用 win a match。过去式是 beat，过去分词是 beaten。

senses.en: causing public disagreement

ex.en: The plan is controversial.
ex.zh: 这个计划有争议。

ex.en: A controversial fee should be written down before the meeting.
ex.zh: 有争议的费用应当在开会前写下来。

col: a controversial topic｜有争议的话题
tip: controversial 形容事物。

senses.en: an act of performing, or how well someone does

ex.en: The music performance starts at seven.
ex.zh: 音乐表演七点开始。

ex.en: A student's performance on one test should not decide the whole story of a year.
ex.zh: 学生一次考试的表现，不该决定一整年的全部故事。

tip: performance 可指演出，也可指工作或学习表现。

senses.en: to give information to someone, or to recognise a difference

ex.en: Please tell me when the meeting starts.
ex.zh: 请告诉我会议什么时候开始。

ex.en: A label should tell shoppers where food comes from, not only how attractive the packet looks.
ex.zh: 标签应该告诉购物者食物来自哪里，而不只是包装有多好看。

col: tell sb to do｜叫某人做
tip: tell 后面接人：tell sb sth。say 后面接说的内容，不直接接人。

senses.en: money paid regularly for work, often by the month

ex.en: The salary is paid on the first day.
ex.zh: 薪水在每月第一天发。

ex.en: A salary that cannot pay the rent pushes workers away from the school.
ex.zh: 付不起租金的薪水，把工人推离学校。

tip: salary 多指月薪。wage 是本批的另一词，常指周薪。

senses.en: the sound of speaking, or the right to speak

ex.en: She has a clear voice.
ex.zh: 她的声音很清楚。

ex.en: Students need a voice in decisions about the hour their school day starts.
ex.zh: 关于上学时间的决定，学生需要有发言权。

tip: voice 多指人的嗓音；sound 是任何声音。

senses.en: a general direction of change

ex.en: The trend is toward later school starts.
ex.zh: 趋势是上学时间更晚。

ex.en: A trend in the numbers is not a plan until someone writes the next step.
ex.zh: 数字里的趋势在有人写下下一步之前还不是计划。

tip: trend 可数。

senses.en: a series of lessons, or the way something develops

ex.en: I chose a history course this term.
ex.zh: 这学期我选了一门历史课。

ex.en: Of course a new course needs books, but it also needs a teacher who has time to mark them.
ex.zh: 新课程当然需要书，但也需要有时间批改的老师。

col: in the course of｜在……过程中
tip: course 表示课程；of course 是固定短语“当然”。

senses.en: a male ruler

ex.en: The story is about a king who listened to farmers.
ex.zh: 故事讲的是一位倾听农民的国王。

ex.en: Even a king in an old tale needed roads and grain, which is still true of any government.
ex.zh: 即使是旧故事里的国王也需要道路和粮食，任何政府今天仍然如此。

tip: king 是可数名词。

senses.en: the ability to learn and understand

ex.en: The quiz does not measure all of a student's intelligence.
ex.zh: 这次小测测不出一名学生的全部智力。

ex.en: Artificial intelligence can sort answers, and a teacher still has to notice who is lost.
ex.zh: 人工智能可以给答案分类，老师仍然得注意到谁没跟上。

tip: intelligence 通常不可数。表示情报时多用于机构名称。

senses.en: low land between hills or mountains

ex.en: Fog stays in the valley in the morning.
ex.zh: 早晨雾留在山谷里。

ex.en: Schools in a valley share one road, so a flood closes more than one gate.
ex.zh: 山谷里的学校共用一条路，所以一场洪水会关上不止一扇校门。

tip: valley 可数。河流经过的谷地也叫 valley。

senses.en: to make someone believe

ex.en: She tried to convince him to stay.
ex.zh: 她试图说服他留下来。

ex.en: Governments must convince residents that improved public transport offers a practical alternative to private cars.
ex.zh: 政府必须让居民相信，改善后的公共交通能够切实替代私家车出行。

col: convince someone of something｜使某人相信某事
convince someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
tip: convince sb of sth表示使某人相信某事。

senses.en: the shore beside the sea

ex.en: We walked on the beach after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我们在海滩上走了走。

ex.en: A popular beach can damage the coast if plastic from one weekend is left in the sand.
ex.zh: 如果一个周末的塑料留在沙子里，受欢迎的海滩会破坏海岸。

tip: beach 是可数名词。

senses.en: related to literature

ex.en: The literary club meets on Thursday.
ex.zh: 文学社周四见面。

ex.en: A literary text about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
ex.zh: 写洪水的文学作品可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。

tip: literature 已在本库。

senses.en: lower than

ex.en: The temperature fell below zero last night.
ex.zh: 昨夜气温降到了零度以下。

ex.en: Scores below the pass line still show effort, and they should not be the only story of a term.
ex.zh: 低于及格线的分数仍然说明有努力，而且不该成为一学期的唯一故事。

tip: below 强调低于某个水平；under 多指在某物正下方。

senses.en: great respect, or something that brings it
to show respect, or to give an award

ex.en: It was an honor to speak for the class.
ex.zh: 代表班级发言是一种荣誉。

ex.en: An honor roll that lists only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
ex.zh: 只列分数的光荣榜，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。

tip: honor 是美式拼写，英式是 honour。作动词是尊敬或授予荣誉。

senses.en: a person's social or legal position

ex.en: The form asks for your student status.
ex.zh: 表格询问你的学生身份。

ex.en: Social status should not decide who may use the public library after school.
ex.zh: 社会地位不该决定谁可以在放学后使用公共图书馆。

tip: status 通常不可数。法律地位、社会地位都可以用。

senses.en: to make something less

ex.en: The school wants to reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 学校想减少食物浪费。

ex.en: Cities can reduce traffic near schools by changing the bell, not only by adding lanes.
ex.zh: 城市可以靠调整铃声来减少学校附近的车流，而不只是加车道。

tip: reduce 后接所减少的东西。表里的美式音标不完整，美式读音用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a married woman

ex.en: His wife teaches at the primary school.
ex.zh: 他的妻子在小学教书。

ex.en: A wife who works nights still needs a safe bus home after the last shift.
ex.zh: 上夜班的妻子在最后一班结束后，仍然需要一趟安全的回家公交。

tip: wife 的复数是 wives。

senses.en: an idea of how something is

ex.en: The concept is easier with a picture.
ex.zh: 这个概念配上一张图就容易些。

ex.en: Students grasp a new concept faster when they can test it on a familiar problem.
ex.zh: 学生若能用熟悉的题目检验一个新概念，就会理解得更快。

tip: concept 比 idea 更偏学科里的概念。

senses.en: a bad habit or moral fault
next in rank

ex.en: The essay argues that waste is a public vice.
ex.zh: 文章认为浪费是一种公共恶习。

ex.en: The vice principal, not the principal, meets the bus company on Mondays.
ex.zh: 周一和公交公司见面的是副校长，不是校长。

tip: vice 作名词是恶习。放在职称前表示“副”：vice principal。两种意思不要混在一个句子里让人猜。

senses.en: to want something to happen
a feeling of wanting something good

ex.en: I hope to see you at the concert.
ex.zh: 我希望在音乐会上见到你。

ex.en: Families hope the new clinic will open before winter, when travel on icy roads is harder.
ex.zh: 家人希望新诊所在冬天前开业，因为结冰的路更难走。

col: in the hope of｜抱着……的希望
tip: hope 后接 to do 或 that 从句，不说 hope sb to do。

senses.en: a person or book that shows the way
to show someone the way

ex.en: The guide stopped at the old gate.
ex.zh: 向导在老城门前停下。

ex.en: A guide for new students works better with a map than with a speech alone.
ex.zh: 给新生的指南配上一张地图，比只有一篇讲话更有用。

tip: guide 作动词是引导。

senses.en: a hard shiny material such as iron or gold

ex.en: The gate is made of metal.
ex.zh: 这扇门是金属做的。

ex.en: Sorting metal from kitchen waste makes recycling possible and keeps the rest cleaner.
ex.zh: 把金属从厨余里分出来，回收才可能进行，其余垃圾也更干净。

tip: metal 作材料时常不可数。a metal 可指某一种金属。

senses.en: to control a vehicle, or to force something forward
a journey in a car

ex.en: My uncle drives to work.
ex.zh: 我叔叔开车上班。

ex.en: High rents drive workers out of the centre, and then the morning roads fill with cars.
ex.zh: 高房租把工人赶出市中心，然后早晨的路就挤满了汽车。

col: drive sb to｜开车送某人去
tip: drive 的过去式是 drove，过去分词是 driven。

senses.en: to ask for firmly
a strong request that someone expects to be obeyed
to insist on receiving something or require something essential

ex.en: Workers demand better pay and safety.
ex.zh: 工人们要求更好的薪酬和安全。

ex.en: Growing demand for affordable housing has encouraged local authorities to convert unused office buildings into residential accommodation.
ex.zh: 对可负担住房不断增长的需求促使地方政府将闲置办公楼改建为住宅。

tip: 要求做某事用demand to do，不用demand sb to do。

senses.en: the front of the head
to deal with a difficult situation

ex.en: She had a smile on her face.
ex.zh: 她脸上带着微笑。

ex.en: A city must face the fact that cheap housing and clean air are both necessary.
ex.zh: 一座城市必须面对这个事实：廉价住房和干净空气都是必需的。

tip: face 作动词表示面对：face a problem，不要说 face to a problem。

senses.en: modern, or living at the same time
a person living at the same time

ex.en: The gallery shows contemporary painting.
ex.zh: 画廊展出当代绘画。

ex.en: A contemporary of the old poet still needed a bus to the library.
ex.zh: 那位老诗人的同时代人，去图书馆仍然需要一班车。

tip: contemporary 作名词是同代人。

senses.en: a round deep dish

ex.en: There is a bowl of rice on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有一碗米饭。

ex.en: A cracked bowl in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
ex.zh: 食堂里裂了的碗应当当天扔掉。

tip: bowl 可数。a bowl of 后接所盛的东西。

senses.en: health and happiness, or help given by the public

ex.en: The club cares about student welfare.
ex.zh: 社团关心学生的福祉。

ex.en: Welfare that never reaches the clinic is only a word.
ex.zh: 到不了诊所的福利只是一个词。

tip: welfare 通常不可数。

senses.en: a black rock burned for heat

ex.en: The old school once burned coal.
ex.zh: 这所老学校曾经烧煤。

ex.en: A town that leaves coal behind still has to heat the classroom.
ex.zh: 不再用煤的城镇，仍然必须给教室供暖。

tip: coal 通常不可数。本条不写开采方法。

senses.en: to say something is true; to allow in
to allow someone to enter or join a place or institution

ex.en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
ex.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。

ex.en: Governments should admit when policies have failed and use reliable evidence to develop more effective alternatives.
ex.zh: 政府应承认政策失败，并依据可靠证据制定更有效的替代方案。

col: admit doing something｜承认做过某事
be admitted to hospital｜被收治入院
tip: 用admit doing，不用admit to do；过去式双写t。

senses.en: a person who teaches

ex.en: Our teacher returned the essays on Friday.
ex.zh: 老师周五发还了作文。

ex.en: A new teacher needs time to learn the names, and a class can help by sitting in the same places at first.
ex.zh: 新老师需要时间记名字，班级一开始坐在固定位置可以帮上忙。

tip: 说 a teacher of English，或 an English teacher。

senses.en: a person who sees an event, or who speaks in court
to see something happen, or to give evidence

ex.en: The witness wrote the time, not a guess.
ex.zh: 证人写下了时间，不是猜测。

ex.en: A witness at a school gate should be asked what they saw, not what they fear.
ex.zh: 校门口的目击者应当被问看见了什么，而不是害怕什么。

tip: witness 作动词是目击或作证。

senses.en: to give something that is needed

ex.en: The school provides lunch for students.
ex.zh: 学校为学生提供午餐。

ex.en: Cities should provide lights on the road home, not only seats in the classroom.
ex.zh: 城市应该在回家的路上提供照明，而不只是教室里的座位。

col: provide sb with sth｜向某人提供
provide sth for sb｜为某人提供
tip: provide 的两种搭配：provide sb with sth 或 provide sth for sb。

senses.en: to make known publicly

ex.en: The teacher will announce the exam date tomorrow.
ex.zh: 老师明天会宣布考试日期。

ex.en: Local authorities should announce major policy changes early so residents have enough time to prepare.
ex.zh: 地方政府应尽早公布重大政策调整，让居民有充足的准备时间。

tip: 用announce sth或announce that，不用announce sb sth。

senses.en: people living together under shared rules

ex.en: Schools are part of society, not separate from it.
ex.zh: 学校是社会的一部分，不是与之分开的。

ex.en: A society that measures success only by test scores will miss students who help their families after class.
ex.zh: 只用考分衡量成功的社会，会忽略那些课后帮助家人的学生。

tip: society 可数。the society 有时指某个社团。

senses.en: a way for vehicles

ex.en: The road to the museum is closed today.
ex.zh: 去博物馆的路今天封闭。

ex.en: A wider road can invite more cars unless buses and bikes are given space too.
ex.zh: 更宽的路会招来更多汽车，除非公交和自行车也有空间。

tip: road 多指车辆道路；street 多指两边有建筑的街道。

senses.en: a short form of advertisement

ex.en: The ad on the board is for the book fair.
ex.zh: 布告栏上的广告是书展的。

ex.en: An ad aimed at teenagers should say who paid for it.
ex.zh: 面向青少年的广告应当说明是谁出的钱。

tip: ad 是 advertisement 的缩写。正式写作用全称。

senses.en: one part of a situation

ex.en: Cost is only one aspect of the plan.
ex.zh: 费用只是计划的一个方面。

ex.en: The safety aspect of the late bus matters as much as the fare.
ex.zh: 晚班车的安全方面和票价一样重要。

tip: aspect 可数。

senses.en: a large room for meetings or events

ex.en: The concert is in the school hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。

ex.en: A town hall that opens in the evening gives working parents a place to hear the budget.
ex.zh: 晚上开放的市政厅，给上班的家长一个听预算说明的地方。

tip: hall 可指礼堂、门厅或市政厅，要看搭配。

senses.en: having a high temperature

ex.en: The classroom was too hot to concentrate.
ex.zh: 教室热得无法集中注意力。

ex.en: Hot nights without fans make it harder for students to sleep before an exam.
ex.zh: 没有风扇的炎热夜晚，让学生更难在考试前入睡。

tip: hot 的比较级是 hotter。

senses.en: a step, or the speed of an activity

ex.en: Walk at a steady pace.
ex.zh: 以稳定的步速走。

ex.en: The pace of the lesson should leave time for the quiet student.
ex.zh: 课的节奏应当给安静的学生留出时间。

col: at a pace of｜以……的速度
tip: pace 作动词是来回走动。

senses.en: to choose, or to take fruit or flowers

ex.en: Pick a question you can explain.
ex.zh: 选一道你能解释的题。

ex.en: Families pick a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
ex.zh: 家庭会选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。

tip: pick up sb 可以表示开车接人。

senses.en: a building where a car is kept

ex.en: The garage is behind the hall.
ex.zh: 车库在礼堂后面。

ex.en: A garage that blocks the path is not a place to leave a car.
ex.zh: 挡住小路的车库不是停车的地方。

tip: 英式 garage 有 /ˈɡærɑːʒ/ 和 /ˈɡærɪdʒ/ 两种读音。

senses.en: ideas and activities about government

ex.en: They discussed politics in the history club.
ex.zh: 他们在历史社里讨论政治。

ex.en: School politics is not only elections; it is also who gets to speak in a meeting.
ex.zh: 校园政治不只是选举，也包括谁能在会上发言。

tip: politics 作学科时谓语常用单数：Politics is interesting。

senses.en: a person who writes news

ex.en: The journalist checked the time twice.
ex.zh: 记者把时间核对了两遍。

ex.en: A journalist who names no source is harder to trust.
ex.zh: 不写来源的记者更难信任。

tip: reporter 是本批的另一词，意思相近。

senses.en: of the colour of a clear sky
the colour blue

ex.en: She wore a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件蓝色外套。

ex.en: Blue signs that nobody can read at night do not make a crossing safer.
ex.zh: 夜里没人看得清的蓝色标志，并不能让过街更安全。

tip: blue 也可作名词表示蓝色。

senses.en: on this night

ex.en: The concert is tonight.
ex.zh: 音乐会在今晚。

ex.en: A storm warning for tonight helps only families who can still receive it.
ex.zh: 今晚的风暴警报只帮助仍能收到它的家庭。

tip: tonight 前面不加介词 on。

senses.en: help given to people, or a public system

ex.en: The bus service stops at ten.
ex.zh: 公交服务十点结束。

ex.en: A health service that only works in the city centre leaves villages waiting for basic care.
ex.zh: 只在市中心运转的医疗服务，会让乡村等待基本的照料。

tip: service 表示服务时常不可数；一项具体服务有时用 a service。

senses.en: the worldwide computer network

ex.en: I checked the bus times on the Internet.
ex.zh: 我在网上查了公交时刻。

ex.en: The Internet spreads a correction slowly if the false picture was more exciting.
ex.zh: 如果假图片更刺激，互联网传播更正就会很慢。

tip: Internet 常大写，前面加 the。

senses.en: a substance used in or produced by chemistry
related to chemistry

ex.en: The chemical is labelled and locked.
ex.zh: 这种化学品贴了标签并锁好了。

ex.en: A school lab should name every chemical and still not publish a method for misuse.
ex.zh: 学校实验室应当标明每一种化学品，同时仍然不公布误用的方法。

tip: chemical 作形容词是化学的。本条不写配制或滥用方法。

senses.en: certain to, or obliged to

ex.en: The bus is bound to be full at four.
ex.zh: 四点的公交肯定是满的。

ex.en: A school is bound to publish the fee before it asks families to pay.
ex.zh: 学校在要求家庭付款之前，有义务公布费用。

tip: be bound to do 表示很可能或有义务。bound 也可作动词 bind 的过去分词，或名词“跳跃”。

senses.en: an opinion, or a decision by a court

ex.en: The judgment was written down.
ex.zh: 这个判断被写了下来。

ex.en: Judgment of a student should use more than one score.
ex.zh: 对学生的判断应当用不止一个分数。

tip: 美式拼作 judgment，英式常拼 judgement。表里词头是 judgement，读音相同。judge 已在本库。

senses.en: a set of different things, or the limits of something
to vary between limits

ex.en: The shop sells a wide range of pens.
ex.zh: 这家店卖各种各样的笔。

ex.en: A wide range of bus times helps workers whose shifts do not match a school day.
ex.zh: 多样的公交班次有助于那些班次和上学日对不上的工人。

col: in the range of｜在……范围内
tip: range from A to B 表示范围从 A 到 B。

senses.en: to be unable to find, or to be beaten

ex.en: Do not lose your student card.
ex.zh: 别弄丢学生证。

ex.en: Towns lose young workers when housing, jobs, and buses are all somewhere else.
ex.zh: 当住房、工作和公交都在别处时，城镇会失去年轻工人。

tip: lose 的过去式和过去分词是 lost。

senses.en: a light in the night sky, or a famous performer

ex.en: We could see one bright star above the hill.
ex.zh: 我们能看见山上空一颗明亮的星。

ex.en: A film star visiting a school for one hour does less than a teacher who stays all year.
ex.zh: 在学校停留一小时的电影明星，不如全年留下来的老师做得更多。

tip: star 作动词是“主演”。

senses.en: a state of ease, or kind words
to make someone feel less sad

ex.en: The chair is for comfort, not for show.
ex.zh: 这把椅子是为了舒服，不是为了好看。

ex.en: A word of comfort helps, and a seat on the bus helps more.
ex.zh: 一句安慰有用，公交上的一个座位更有用。

tip: comfortable 已在本库。comfort 作动词是安慰。

senses.en: a way of doing something, or polite behaviour

ex.en: She explained the rule in a calm manner.
ex.zh: 她用平静的方式解释了规定。

ex.en: Good manners at the gate include holding the door, not only saying hello.
ex.zh: 门口的礼貌包括扶门，而不只是说你好。

tip: manner 表示方式。manners 复数常指礼貌。

senses.en: a person who acts in plays or films

ex.en: The actor visited the drama club.
ex.zh: 这位演员来了戏剧社。

ex.en: An actor who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
ex.zh: 只念台词的演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。

tip: 现在 actor 也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

senses.en: a connection
to connect

ex.en: There is a link between sleep and attention.
ex.zh: 睡眠和注意力之间有联系。

ex.en: The bus link between the village and the clinic is as important as the clinic itself.
ex.zh: 村子和诊所之间的公交联系，和诊所本身一样重要。

tip: link 作动词是“连接”。

senses.en: the end of life

ex.en: The story ends with the death of the old tree.
ex.zh: 故事以那棵老树的死亡结束。

ex.en: Heat-related death is more common in neighbourhoods with little shade and few clinics.
ex.zh: 与高温有关的死亡，在少荫凉、少诊所的社区更常见。

tip: death 是名词；die 是动词；dead 是形容词。

senses.en: popular, especially in music

ex.en: The pop song was playing in the canteen.
ex.zh: 食堂里放着那首流行歌曲。

ex.en: Pop culture reaches students faster than a textbook, which is why the source still matters.
ex.zh: 流行文化比课本更快到达学生，所以来源仍然重要。

tip: pop 是 popular 的口语缩略，多用于音乐和艺术。作动词可表示发出砰的一声。

senses.en: a person in control, an expert, or a graduate degree
to learn something thoroughly

ex.en: She is a master of the violin.
ex.zh: 她是小提琴大师。

ex.en: Students master a word by using it, not only by seeing it once on a list.
ex.zh: 学生通过使用来掌握一个词，而不只是在词表上看一次。

col: master a skill｜掌握一项技能
tip: master 作动词是“掌握”。

senses.en: the making of beautiful or expressive things

ex.en: There is an art show in the hall.
ex.zh: 大厅里有一场艺术展。

ex.en: Public art on a dull wall can make a walk to school feel shorter and safer.
ex.zh: 单调墙上的公共艺术，能让走路上学感觉更短、更安全。

tip: art 泛指艺术时不可数。the arts 可指多种艺术。

senses.en: to draw liquid into the mouth

ex.en: The baby will suck the milk.
ex.zh: 婴儿会吮奶。

ex.en: Do not suck the juice through a dirty straw.
ex.zh: 不要用脏吸管吸果汁。

tip: suck 是普通动词。本条用进食的意思。

senses.en: an official paper or computer file

ex.en: Save the document before you close it.
ex.zh: 关闭前请保存文件。

ex.en: A document that names a child should not sit open on a public desk.
ex.zh: 写有孩子姓名的文件，不应当摊开在公共桌子上。

tip: document 也可作动词“记录”。

senses.en: to separate into pieces, or to disobey
a short rest

ex.en: Do not break the lab rules.
ex.zh: 不要违反实验室规则。

ex.en: If a pipe breaks under a school, classes stop even when the building looks fine.
ex.zh: 如果学校底下的管子破裂，即使楼看起来没事，课也会停。

tip: break 的过去式是 broke，过去分词是 broken。

senses.en: an oval object from a bird, used as food

ex.en: There is an egg in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱里有一个蛋。

ex.en: An egg left out of the fridge all morning is not a safe lunch.
ex.zh: 放在冰箱外一上午的蛋不是安全的午饭。

tip: egg 可数。

senses.en: the direction between south and east

ex.en: The wind turned to the south-east.
ex.zh: 风向转成了东南。

ex.en: Ports in the south-east depend on roads that stay open when the river rises.
ex.zh: 东南的港口依靠河水上涨时仍然通畅的道路。

tip: south-east 也可写作 southeast。

senses.en: firm and not likely to change or fall

ex.en: The table is stable.
ex.zh: 这张桌子是稳的。

ex.en: A stable bus time helps more than a new paint colour.
ex.zh: 稳定的公交时间比新的油漆颜色更有帮助。

tip: stable 作名词是马厩。本条以形容词为主。

senses.en: the act of dividing, a part of an organization, or dividing numbers

ex.en: The younger division of the club meets on Monday.
ex.zh: 社团的低年级小组周一见面。

ex.en: Fair division of practice time matters when one team shares a single court.
ex.zh: 当两支队共用一块场地时，公平分配练习时间就很重要。

tip: 除法是 division。公司或机构的部门也用 division。

senses.en: how good something is

ex.en: The quality of the recording is poor.
ex.zh: 这段录音的质量很差。

ex.en: Air quality outside a school matters as much as the quality of the books inside.
ex.zh: 学校外面的空气质量和里面的书的质量一样重要。

tip: quality 表示质量时常不可数。

senses.en: costing nothing, or not busy, or not controlled

ex.en: Are you free after class today?
ex.zh: 你今天课后有空吗？

ex.en: Free entry to museums matters most to families who would not pay for a ticket.
ex.zh: 博物馆免费入场，对那些本来不会买票的家庭最为重要。

tip: free 表示免费或有空；freely 才是副词“自由地”。

senses.en: something that happens, or a race in a sports meeting

ex.en: The sports event starts at nine.
ex.zh: 体育项目九点开始。

ex.en: A public event in the square should leave a path so people can still reach the clinic.
ex.zh: 广场上的公共活动应该留出一条路，让人们仍能到达诊所。

col: in the event of｜如果发生
tip: event 是可数名词。

senses.en: a large farm bird, or its meat

ex.en: The picture shows a turkey, not a chicken.
ex.zh: 图上是火鸡，不是鸡。

ex.en: Turkey the country and turkey the bird are different words; only the country is capitalised.
ex.zh: 国家 Turkey 和火鸡 turkey 是不同的词；只有国名大写。

tip: 本条指鸟。国名是 Turkey，要大写，不在这一词条里展开。

senses.en: used to contrast with what was just said

ex.en: The plan is costly. However, it may save water.
ex.zh: 这个计划花费很大。然而，它也许能节水。

ex.en: The museum is free. However, families who live an hour away still pay for the bus.
ex.zh: 博物馆是免费的。然而，住在一小时车程外的家庭仍然要付公交费。

tip: however 是副词，前后常用句号或分号；but 是连词，连接两个分句。

senses.en: a building where important objects are kept and shown

ex.en: The class visits the museum on Thursday.
ex.zh: 班级周四去博物馆。

ex.en: A free museum still fails if the bus stops an hour before it opens.
ex.zh: 如果公交在开馆前一小时就停了，免费的博物馆仍然去不成。

tip: museum 重音在第二音节。

senses.en: a place that sells goods
to buy things in shops

ex.en: The shop on the corner sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 拐角的商店卖笔记本。

ex.en: A small shop near a school can feed a street, but only if the rent stays possible.
ex.zh: 学校附近的小店能养活一条街，但前提是租金仍然付得起。

tip: shop 作动词是买东西。英式常用 shop，美式常用 store。

senses.en: Saturday and Sunday

ex.en: I review words at the weekend.
ex.zh: 我在周末复习单词。

ex.en: A clinic that closes every weekend leaves Friday-night injuries waiting until Monday.
ex.zh: 每个周末都关门的诊所，会让周五夜里的伤等到星期一。

tip: 英式常用 at the weekend；美式常用 on the weekend。

senses.en: following what is usual

ex.en: The conventional time is eight.
ex.zh: 常规时间是八点。

ex.en: A conventional answer is not always the fair one.
ex.zh: 常规答案不总是公平的那个。

tip: conventional 与方便的 convenient 不是同一个词。

senses.en: here now, or existing at this time
a gift, or the time now
to show or give formally

ex.en: All the students were present.
ex.zh: 所有学生都到了。

ex.en: The present bus timetable ignores the hour when the factory shift ends.
ex.zh: 目前的公交时刻表忽略了工厂换班结束的时间。

tip: present 作名词“礼物”或动词“呈现”时重音在第二音节。

senses.en: of Asia
a person from Asia

ex.en: The map shows Asian rivers in blue.
ex.zh: 地图上亚洲的河流用蓝色标出。

ex.en: An Asian writer on the list gives the class a voice one textbook chapter may miss.
ex.zh: 书单上的亚洲作家能给班级一个课本里某一章可能错过的声音。

tip: Asian 作形容词和名词都要大写。

senses.en: the form of something
to give something a form

ex.en: Draw the shape before you add colour.
ex.zh: 上色之前先画形状。

ex.en: The shape of the school day shapes how tired students are at four.
ex.zh: 上学日的安排会决定学生四点钟有多累。

col: out of shape｜变形；状态不好
tip: shape 作动词是塑造。in good shape 可指身体或事物状态好。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anybody can borrow the map.
ex.zh: 任何人都可以借这张地图。

ex.en: Anybody who misses the bus should know the office number before the gate closes.
ex.zh: 误了公交的任何人，应当在关门前知道办公室电话。

tip: anybody 与 anyone 同义，anyone 已在本库。疑问句和否定句里更常见。作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: a female parent

ex.en: My mother works at the hospital.
ex.zh: 我母亲在医院工作。

ex.en: A mother on a night shift needs the school to understand why her child sometimes arrives tired.
ex.zh: 上夜班的母亲需要学校理解她的孩子为什么有时疲惫地到校。

tip: mother 较正式；mum 或 mom 更口语。

senses.en: money paid to use a room or thing
to pay to use something, or to let someone use it

ex.en: The rent is due on the first day.
ex.zh: 租金在每月第一天到期。

ex.en: High rent near a school pushes workers farther from the bus they need.
ex.zh: 学校附近的高租金，把工人推得离他们需要的公交更远。

tip: rent 作动词是租用或出租。英式 let 也表示出租。

senses.en: needing rest

ex.en: I am too tired to revise tonight.
ex.zh: 我今晚累得没法复习。

ex.en: Tired drivers on the school route are a reason to shorten shifts.
ex.zh: 校车路线上疲劳的司机，是缩短班次的理由。

tip: tired 形容人。tiring 形容事物令人疲劳。be tired of 是厌倦，不是身体累。表里的中文把轮胎混了进来，释义按疲倦来写。

senses.en: a rate out of each hundred

ex.en: A high percentage of students walk.
ex.zh: 很高比例的学生步行。

ex.en: A percentage without the total number can hide how many students are left out.
ex.zh: 没有总数的百分比，会藏起有多少学生被落下。

tip: percent 已在本库。percentage 前常用 a。

senses.en: having done something wrong, or feeling that you have

ex.en: The court did not find him guilty.
ex.zh: 法庭没有认定他有罪。

ex.en: Feeling guilty about a low score is not the same as a plan to improve.
ex.zh: 为低分内疚，不等于有了改进的计划。

tip: be guilty of 后接罪名或过错。innocent 已在本库。

senses.en: to take part in a game, or to perform music
a piece of writing for the theatre, or a game

ex.en: We play basketball after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后打篮球。

ex.en: Children who play outside learn to judge risk in a way that a screen cannot teach.
ex.zh: 在户外玩耍的孩子会学习判断风险，这是屏幕教不会的。

tip: 球类前不加 the：play football；乐器前加 the：play the violin。

senses.en: to send goods to another country
a product sent to another country

ex.en: The town exports tea.
ex.zh: 这座城镇出口茶叶。

ex.en: An export figure without a source is not a report.
ex.zh: 没有来源的出口数字不是报告。

tip: 名词“出口”重音常在前，动词重音在后。表里是动词读音。

senses.en: to use force, or to try hard to stop something
a struggle

ex.en: We should not fight in the corridor.
ex.zh: 我们不该在走廊里打架。

ex.en: Communities fight flooding with drains and trees, not only with photos after the water has gone.
ex.zh: 社区用排水和树木对抗洪水，而不只是在水退后拍照。

tip: fight 的过去式和过去分词是 fought。

senses.en: a small area of water, often for swimming

ex.en: The pool is closed on Monday.
ex.zh: 泳池周一关闭。

ex.en: A public pool that opens after school gives students a place to swim without a private club.
ex.zh: 放学后开放的公共泳池，让学生不用私人俱乐部也能游泳。

tip: pool 也可指共用的一笔资源：a pool of bikes。作动词是合伙共用。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: We had a wonderful time at the concert.
ex.zh: 音乐会上我们玩得很开心。

ex.en: A wonderful score on one test is not a full picture of a difficult term.
ex.zh: 一次测验的好成绩，不是艰难一学期的全貌。

col: a wonderful time｜一段美好时光
tip: wonderful 已经表示程度很高，一般不必再加 very。

senses.en: to take air in and out

ex.en: It is hard to breathe in heavy smoke.
ex.zh: 浓烟中很难呼吸。

ex.en: People living near busy roads often breathe polluted air, which can increase their risk of respiratory illness.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路附近的人经常吸入受污染的空气，这可能增加他们患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: breathe fresh air｜呼吸新鲜空气
tip: breathe是动词，末音/ð/；breath是名词，末音/θ/。

senses.en: of the colour of snow
the colour white

ex.en: Write your name on the white card.
ex.zh: 把名字写在白色卡片上。

ex.en: White roofs can reflect summer heat and make classrooms easier to cool.
ex.zh: 白色屋顶能反射夏日热量，让教室更容易降温。

tip: white 也可作名词，表示白色。

senses.en: big in size or amount

ex.en: We need a large table for the maps.
ex.zh: 我们需要一张大桌子放地图。

ex.en: A large school on the edge of town forces many children into long bus rides.
ex.zh: 城边的大学校会迫使许多孩子长时间乘公交。

tip: large 比 big 更正式，常修饰数量和面积。

senses.en: sixty minutes

ex.en: The talk lasted one hour.
ex.zh: 讲座持续了一个小时。

ex.en: An extra hour on the bus each day takes time away from sleep and homework.
ex.zh: 每天在公交上多一个小时，会占去睡眠和作业的时间。

col: an hour's walk｜步行一小时的路程
tip: hour 前的 an 不省：an hour。

senses.en: containing as much as possible, or complete

ex.en: The bus was full, so we waited for the next one.
ex.zh: 公交车满了，所以我们等下一辆。

ex.en: A diary full of small observations can later explain how a neighbourhood changed year by year.
ex.zh: 记满细小观察的日记，日后可以解释一个社区如何逐年变化。

tip: be full of 表示充满；fill 是动词“装满”。

senses.en: drinks such as beer and wine, or the substance in them

ex.en: The school does not serve alcohol.
ex.zh: 学校不提供酒。

ex.en: Health class can name alcohol as a risk without telling anyone how to obtain it.
ex.zh: 健康课可以把酒说成一种风险，同时不告诉任何人如何得到它。

tip: alcohol 通常不可数。beer 和 wine 已在本库。本条不写饮酒方法。

senses.en: medical care, or the way someone is treated

ex.en: The treatment for the cough was simple.
ex.zh: 咳嗽的治疗很简单。

ex.en: Equal treatment in a classroom means the quiet student is heard as well as the loud one.
ex.zh: 课堂上的平等对待，意味着安静的学生和大声的学生一样被听到。

tip: treatment 可指医疗，也可指待人的方式。

senses.en: the continent east of the Atlantic

ex.en: She read a story set in Europe.
ex.zh: 她读了一个以欧洲为背景的故事。

ex.en: Visitors from Europe bring money to a town, but housing for local workers still has to come first.
ex.zh: 来自欧洲的游客给城镇带来钱，但本地工人的住房仍然必须优先。

tip: Europe 和 European 都要大写。

senses.en: to take place

ex.en: What happened after the bell?
ex.zh: 铃响之后发生了什么？

ex.en: Floods happen more often when drains were built for a smaller town.
ex.zh: 当排水系统按更小的城镇修建时，洪水会更常发生。

col: happen to sb｜发生在某人身上
tip: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态。某事发生在某人身上用 happen to sb。

senses.en: the work of building

ex.en: Construction of the bridge will take a year.
ex.zh: 建桥要一年。

ex.en: Construction beside a school should keep a safe path open for children every morning.
ex.zh: 学校旁边的建设应该每天早晨为孩子留一条安全的路。

tip: construction 作“建设”时常不可数。

senses.en: connected with what is being discussed

ex.en: Please keep the comment relevant.
ex.zh: 请让评论和话题相关。

ex.en: A relevant example from the town teaches more than a distant one the class cannot picture.
ex.zh: 来自本镇的相关例子，比班级想象不出的远例子教得更多。

tip: relevant to something。反义是 irrelevant。

senses.en: unpleasant to look at

ex.en: The crack is ugly, and it is also unsafe.
ex.zh: 这条裂缝难看，而且也不安全。

ex.en: Calling a person ugly is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 说一个人难看，不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: ugly 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人，写作时要避免。

senses.en: truthful
Expressing what you really think or feel.

ex.en: Be honest about your mistakes.
ex.zh: 对自己的错误要诚实。

ex.en: Honest communication between teachers and parents can help schools address students' difficulties before they become serious.
ex.zh: 教师与家长之间坦诚的沟通能帮助学校在学生的问题变得严重之前加以解决。

tip: h不发音，因此说an honest person。

senses.en: a good result

ex.en: The book fair was a success.
ex.zh: 书展很成功。

ex.en: Success for a bus line is not a full photo; it is whether workers arrive on time.
ex.zh: 一条公交线的成功不是一张挤满的照片，而是工人是否准时到达。

tip: success 作“成功”时常不可数；一次成功的事可用 a success。

senses.en: a figure, or a quantity

ex.en: Write your seat number in the corner.
ex.zh: 把座位号写在角落里。

ex.en: The number of cars has grown faster than the number of safe places for children to cross.
ex.zh: 汽车数量的增长，快过儿童安全过街地点的增长。

tip: a number of 作主语时谓语常用复数；the number of 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: to take pleasure in

ex.en: I enjoy reading by the window.
ex.zh: 我喜欢靠窗阅读。

ex.en: People enjoy a riverside path more when the water does not smell of waste.
ex.zh: 当水没有废物的气味时，人们更喜欢河边的小路。

tip: enjoy 后接 doing，不接 to do。

senses.en: a person who is hurt by someone or something

ex.en: The report does not name the victim.
ex.zh: 报道没有写出受害者的名字。

ex.en: A victim of a flood needs a dry room before a speech about courage.
ex.zh: 洪水的受害者需要一间干的房间，这比一篇关于勇气的讲话更先。

col: fall victim to｜成为……的受害者
tip: victim 可数。不要把受害者写成有过错的一方。

senses.en: to harm
Harm something or make it less effective.

ex.en: Floods can damage houses and roads.
ex.zh: 洪水会毁坏房屋和道路。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can damage fragile ecosystems and reduce the quality of life for local residents.
ex.zh: 不受控制的旅游活动可能破坏脆弱的生态系统，并降低当地居民的生活质量。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
tip: 损害用不可数damage；damages指法律赔偿金。

senses.en: a length of time, a full stop, or a lesson

ex.en: We have a free period on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 我们周三有一节空课。

ex.en: A dry period of only one month can empty a village tank if nobody measured the water.
ex.zh: 如果没人计量用水，仅仅一个月的干旱也能抽干村里的水箱。

tip: 美式英语里 period 也指句号。

senses.en: a flat piece of paper, or a covering for a bed

ex.en: Write both times on one sheet.
ex.zh: 把两个时间写在同一张纸上。

ex.en: A clean sheet on the clinic bed matters as much as the notice.
ex.zh: 诊所床上的干净床单和通知一样重要。

tip: a sheet of paper 是一张纸。

senses.en: to take someone to a police station by law
an act of arresting

ex.en: The novel says the officer did not arrest the child.
ex.zh: 小说写警官没有逮捕那个孩子。

ex.en: News of an arrest should give the charge and the date, not a guess.
ex.zh: 逮捕的新闻应当给出罪名和日期，而不是猜测。

tip: arrest 也可作名词。本条只作法律词汇，不写执法步骤。

senses.en: full of energy, or changing

ex.en: The club is dynamic, and it still writes the time.
ex.zh: 社团很有活力，并且仍然把时间写下来。

ex.en: A dynamic plan that changes every hour needs one person to update the notice.
ex.zh: 每小时都在变的计划，需要一个人去更新通知。

tip: dynamic 也可作名词，表示动力或相互作用。

senses.en: thankful

ex.en: I am grateful for your help.
ex.zh: 我感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Many students are grateful for scholarships that allow them to continue their education despite financial difficulties.
ex.zh: 许多学生感谢奖学金让他们即使经济困难也能继续学业。

tip: be grateful to某人 for某事；注意不是greatful。

senses.en: next to, or together with

ex.en: The path runs alongside the river.
ex.zh: 小路沿着河走。
