ex.en: A clinic alongside the school saves the hour a bus would take.
ex.zh: 学校旁边的诊所省下乘公交要花的那一小时。

tip: alongside 也可作副词。

senses.en: to be in a flat position, or to be in a place
a statement that is not true
to say something that is not true

ex.en: Lie down if you feel dizzy.
ex.zh: 如果头晕就躺下。

ex.en: The village lies beyond the hill, so the clinic bus has to leave before dark.
ex.zh: 村子在山的那一边，所以去诊所的班车必须在天黑前出发。

tip: 躺的过去式是 lay，过去分词是 lain。说谎的过去式和过去分词是 lied。不要和及物动词 lay（放置）混淆。

senses.en: a tall narrow building or part of a building

ex.en: The clock tower is visible from the gate.
ex.zh: 从门口能看见钟楼。

ex.en: A tower without a light does not help the student who arrives after dark.
ex.zh: 没有灯的塔帮不了天黑后才到的学生。

tip: tower 可数。

senses.en: a person who creates art

ex.en: The artist talked about the poster design.
ex.zh: 艺术家谈了海报设计。

ex.en: An artist in residence can help a school see its own walls as more than empty space.
ex.zh: 驻校艺术家能帮助学校看到，墙壁不只是空白。

tip: artist 不限于画家，也包括其他艺术创作者。

senses.en: very unwise

ex.en: It is stupid to cycle at night without a light.
ex.zh: 夜里骑车不带灯是愚蠢的。

ex.en: Calling a question stupid stops the student who most needs to ask it.
ex.zh: 把一个问题说成愚蠢，会阻止最需要提问的学生。

tip: stupid 语气很重，容易伤人。课堂上更适合说 unclear 或 I do not understand。

senses.en: at any time

ex.en: Have you ever visited the city museum?
ex.zh: 你去过市博物馆吗？

ex.en: If a river has ever flooded the same street twice, planners should stop building basements there.
ex.zh: 如果一条河曾两次淹没同一条街，规划者就不该再在那里建地下室。

tip: ever 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句里的“曾经”多用 once。

senses.en: the feeling of being happy

ex.en: The concert brought happiness to the hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会给礼堂带来了愉快。

ex.en: Happiness at a win should still leave room to thank the team.
ex.zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置去谢谢队伍。

tip: happiness 通常不可数。happy 已在本库。

senses.en: to get better after an illness or a loss

ex.en: She recovered after three days at home.
ex.zh: 她在家三天后恢复了。

ex.en: A student who is recovering still needs the notes from class.
ex.zh: 正在恢复的学生仍然需要课堂笔记。

tip: recover 也可指找回失物。

senses.en: to become less, or to refuse politely
a decrease

ex.en: The number of late buses did not decline.
ex.zh: 晚班车的数量没有下降。

ex.en: She declined the prize and asked for books for the library instead.
ex.zh: 她谢绝了奖品，改为给图书馆要书。

tip: decline 比 refuse 更客气。也可作名词。

senses.en: a person travelling in a vehicle

ex.en: The passenger waited for the late bus.
ex.zh: 乘客在等晚班车。

ex.en: A passenger who cannot stand needs a seat, not only a slogan.
ex.zh: 不能站着的乘客需要一个座位，而不只是一句口号。

tip: passenger 可数。

senses.en: a piece of writing, a thing, or a/an/the

ex.en: I read an article about school buses.
ex.zh: 我读了一篇关于校车的文章。

ex.en: An article without a named source is hard to trust, however smooth the sentences are.
ex.zh: 没有署名来源的文章很难信任，无论句子多么流畅。

tip: article 也可指语法里的冠词 a、an、the。

senses.en: to be on one's feet, or to bear

ex.en: Please stand in line.
ex.zh: 请排队站好。

ex.en: A small shop cannot stand a year of road works that stop customers reaching the door.
ex.zh: 一家小店受不了一整年让顾客到不了门口的道路施工。

tip: stand 的过去式和过去分词是 stood。

senses.en: one part in every hundred

ex.en: About twenty percent of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 大约百分之二十的学生步行上学。

ex.en: A ten percent rise in rent can push a family farther from the school they chose.
ex.zh: 房租上涨百分之十，就能把一个家庭推得离他们选择的学校更远。

tip: percent 常与数字连用。英式也写作 per cent。

senses.en: a custom that has existed for a long time

ex.en: The dance is a school tradition.
ex.zh: 这个舞蹈是学校的传统。

ex.en: A tradition can change when the market no longer sells the old grain.
ex.zh: 当市场不再卖那种老谷物时，传统也可以变。

tip: 形容词 traditional 已在本库。

senses.en: in place of something else

ex.en: We walked instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们没有坐公交，而是走路。

ex.en: Planting trees instead of only widening roads can cool a street and slow the rain.
ex.zh: 种树而不是只拓宽道路，可以给街道降温，并减缓雨水。

tip: instead 可放句首或句末；instead of 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: of the Atlantic Ocean

ex.en: The map colours the Atlantic in blue.
ex.zh: 地图把大西洋涂成蓝色。

ex.en: A lesson about the Atlantic should name the coasts, not only the water.
ex.zh: 关于大西洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。

tip: Atlantic 作海洋名要大写。

senses.en: used for obligation or a strong guess

ex.en: You must wear glasses in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里你必须戴眼镜。

ex.en: A public promise must be followed by a date and a person responsible, or it is only a sentence.
ex.zh: 一项公开承诺必须跟上日期和负责人，否则就只是一句话。

tip: must not 表示禁止；不必是 don't have to 或 needn't。

senses.en: the space above the earth

ex.en: The sky cleared after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后天晴了。

ex.en: A dark sky at noon is a reason to send the team indoors, not to wait for rain on the pitch.
ex.zh: 正午的阴天是让队伍进室内的理由，而不是在场上等雨。

tip: sky 通常用 the sky。文学里可用 skies。

senses.en: a person who owns something

ex.en: The owner of the shop knows every student.
ex.zh: 店主认识每一个学生。

ex.en: The owner of a rented room and the student who lives there may want different repairs.
ex.zh: 出租房的主人和住在里面的学生，想修的东西可能不一样。

tip: owner 是人。所有权是 ownership。

senses.en: physical power, or a good quality

ex.en: Reading is her strength in English.
ex.zh: 阅读是她英语上的强项。

ex.en: The strength of a team is not the fastest runner if nobody passes the ball.
ex.zh: 如果没人传球，队伍的力量就不是跑得最快的那个人。

tip: strength 是 strong 的名词。优点常用复数 strengths。

senses.en: a drop of salty water from the eye

ex.en: A tear ran down her face, and then she asked for help.
ex.zh: 一滴眼泪从她脸上落下，然后她求了助。

ex.en: Do not tear the notice off the board before the class has read it.
ex.zh: 在班级读完之前，不要把通知从板上撕下来。

tip: 名词眼泪读 /tɪə/。动词“撕”读 /teə/。两个意思都常用。

senses.en: a country's military ships and the people who work on them

ex.en: The museum has a room about the navy.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一个关于海军的展室。

ex.en: A chapter on the navy should also say who built the ships.
ex.zh: 写海军的一章也应当说是谁造的船。

tip: navy 前常用 the。navy blue 是藏青色。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: short in time or words
To give someone essential information or instructions.
Instructions explaining what a task should achieve.

ex.en: Give a brief summary.
ex.zh: 做个简短总结。

ex.en: Teachers should brief students on safety procedures before allowing them to conduct experiments independently.
ex.zh: 教师应先向学生介绍安全操作规程，再允许他们独立进行实验。

col: brief someone on｜向某人介绍……的情况
a design brief｜设计任务说明
tip: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

senses.en: extra money or an extra good thing

ex.en: The shorter walk is a bonus, not the reason.
ex.zh: 路程变短是额外的好处，不是理由。

ex.en: A bonus for the canteen staff should not come from cutting the students' meal.
ex.zh: 给食堂职工的奖金，不应当来自削减学生的那一餐。

tip: bonus 可数。

senses.en: not fast
to become slower or make something slower

ex.en: The slow bus still gets us there before class.
ex.zh: 这趟慢车仍能在上课前把我们送到。

ex.en: A slow reader may understand a poem more deeply than a classmate who only finishes first.
ex.zh: 读得慢的人，可能比只求最先读完的同学更懂一首诗。

tip: slow 作动词是使变慢。表里这一行的音标是 sleep，本库不用。

senses.en: a long thin piece of wood or metal

ex.en: The pole by the gate holds the light.
ex.zh: 门口的杆子撑着灯。

ex.en: A loose pole at the crossing should be reported the same day.
ex.zh: 路口松动的杆子应当当天报告。

tip: pole 也可指地极，如 the North Pole。

senses.en: the only one of its kind

ex.en: Each student has a unique way of taking notes.
ex.zh: 每个学生记笔记的方式都不一样。

ex.en: A unique old tree in the schoolyard cannot be replaced by ten young ones in a plan.
ex.zh: 校园里一棵独一无二的老树，不能用规划里的十棵小树代替。

tip: unique 已经表示“唯一”，一般不再用 very 修饰。

senses.en: a box or bag that has been wrapped

ex.en: The package arrived at the office.
ex.zh: 包裹到了办公室。

ex.en: A package for a student should not be opened on a public desk.
ex.zh: 给学生的包裹不应当在公共桌子上拆开。

tip: package 也可指一套方案。pack 是本批的动词。

senses.en: at the end, after some time

ex.en: We eventually found the key in the lab coat.
ex.zh: 我们终于在实验服里找到了钥匙。

ex.en: A town that plants trees eventually feels the shade, but the first class of students may not.
ex.zh: 种树的城镇最终会享受到树荫，但第一届学生可能等不到。

tip: eventually 强调经过一段时间之后，不表示“可能”。

senses.en: a mistake, or responsibility for something bad

ex.en: The fault was in the timetable, not in the class.
ex.zh: 错在课表，不在这个班。

ex.en: Finding fault with a student is easier than fixing the broken step.
ex.zh: 挑学生的错，比修好破台阶容易。

tip: It is my fault 表示是我的错。fault 也可指地质断层。

senses.en: each one in a group, seen as a whole

ex.en: Every student has a chance to speak.
ex.zh: 每个学生都有发言的机会。

ex.en: Every extra degree of summer heat makes it harder to keep classrooms comfortable without more energy.
ex.zh: 夏天每升高一度，都让教室在不增加能耗的情况下更难保持舒适。

tip: every 后接单数名词；every day 是短语，everyday 是形容词“日常的”。

senses.en: a short group of words

ex.en: The phrase is on the board.
ex.zh: 这个短语写在黑板上。

ex.en: A phrase in an ad can hide the fee if nobody asks what it means.
ex.zh: 广告里的一个说法，如果没人追问，就能把费用藏起来。

tip: phrase 可数。

senses.en: to some degree, or completely

ex.en: The room is quite quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后房间相当安静。

ex.en: A cycle lane that is quite short still helps if it crosses the most dangerous junction.
ex.zh: 一段相当短的自行车道，如果穿过最危险的路口，仍然有帮助。

tip: quite a + 形容词 + 名词：quite a long walk。不说 a quite long walk。

senses.en: unhappy or worried
to make someone unhappy, or to knock something over

ex.en: He was upset about the broken window.
ex.zh: 他对打碎的窗户感到心烦。

ex.en: An upset parent needs a clear time, not only a closed office.
ex.zh: 心烦的家长需要一个明确的时间，而不只是一间关着的办公室。

tip: upset 作动词是使心烦或弄翻，过去式仍是 upset。形容词和动词重音常在后。

senses.en: with little noise

ex.en: The library is quiet after four.
ex.zh: 四点以后图书馆很安静。

ex.en: A quiet street is not safe if the crossing has no light.
ex.zh: 如果路口没有灯，安静的街道也不安全。

tip: quiet 也可作动词“使安静”，名词“安静”。

senses.en: to put something with something else

ex.en: Add your name at the bottom.
ex.zh: 在底部加上你的名字。

ex.en: Cities that add lanes without adding buses often add cars as well.
ex.zh: 只加车道不加公交的城市，往往也增加了汽车。

tip: add A to B 表示把 A 加到 B 上。

senses.en: something that is known to be true

ex.en: In fact, the library opens at eight.
ex.zh: 事实上，图书馆八点开门。

ex.en: A fact about air pollution should be separated from an opinion about who is to blame.
ex.zh: 关于空气污染的事实，应该和谁该受责备的看法分开。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: fact 是可数名词。the fact that 后接从句。

senses.en: the direction between north and east

ex.en: The wind came from the north-east.
ex.zh: 风从东北来。

ex.en: Schools in the north-east may need longer heating, which raises the winter cost.
ex.zh: 东北的学校可能需要更长的供暖，这会提高冬天的费用。

tip: north-east 也可写作 northeast。

senses.en: pleasant or kind

ex.en: It was nice of you to wait for me.
ex.zh: 你等我，真是太好了。

ex.en: A nice park on a map is not enough if the path to it is dark and unsafe at night.
ex.zh: 地图上一个好看的公园不够，如果去那里的路夜里又黑又不安全。

tip: It is nice of sb to do 表扬某人的善意。

senses.en: official permission, or a good opinion

ex.en: The trip needs approval from the office.
ex.zh: 这次出行需要办公室批准。

ex.en: Approval that arrives after the bus has left helps nobody.
ex.zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的批准，谁也帮不了。

tip: approval 通常不可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: words that say someone did well
to say that someone did well

ex.en: Praise for the quiet student was public.
ex.zh: 对那位安静学生的赞扬是公开的。

ex.en: Praise that names only scores misses the student who kept the library open.
ex.zh: 只提分数的赞扬，会漏掉那个让图书馆一直开着的学生。

tip: praise 作动词是表扬。通常不可数。

senses.en: a feeling of happiness, or something that causes it

ex.en: It was a pleasure to meet the class.
ex.zh: 见到这个班是一件愉快的事。

ex.en: Pleasure in a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
ex.zh: 胜利的愉快仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢那个传球的人。

tip: It is a pleasure 是客套。表里这一行的音标是 pleased，本库不用。

senses.en: a small bag sewn into clothes

ex.en: The key is in my pocket.
ex.zh: 钥匙在我口袋里。

ex.en: A pocket dictionary helps on the bus, and it does not replace the library.
ex.zh: 袖珍词典在公交上有用，它代替不了图书馆。

tip: pocket 作形容词可指袖珍的。

senses.en: soon

ex.en: The bus will leave shortly.
ex.zh: 公交马上就要开了。

ex.en: Shortly after the rain, the same two classrooms flood.
ex.zh: 雨后不久，同样的两间教室进水。

tip: shortly 是副词。short 是形容词。

senses.en: the coloured part of a plant

ex.en: The flower by the gate is open.
ex.zh: 门口的花开了。

ex.en: A flower on the desk does not replace watering the school garden.
ex.zh: 桌上的一朵花代替不了给学校园子浇水。

tip: flower 可数。

senses.en: complete, or including everything
the whole amount
to add up to

ex.en: The total cost is eighty yuan.
ex.zh: 总费用是八十元。

ex.en: A total ban on cars near schools works only if buses can carry the same children.
ex.zh: 学校附近全面禁车，只有在公交能运送同样的孩子时才行得通。

tip: total 作动词是“合计”。

senses.en: a member of an army

ex.en: The museum shows a soldier's letter from 1940.
ex.zh: 博物馆展示一封 1940 年的士兵来信。

ex.en: A history of soldiers should also say who grew the food they ate.
ex.zh: 士兵的历史也应当写是谁种了他们吃的粮食。

tip: soldier 可数。本条不写作战方法。

senses.en: to show, or to throw back light

ex.en: The mirror reflects the clock.
ex.zh: 镜子映出钟。

ex.en: The timetable should reflect the last bus, not an old hope.
ex.zh: 课表应当反映末班车，而不是一个旧的希望。

tip: reflect on 表示思考。

senses.en: forward movement or improvement

ex.en: She has made progress in listening.
ex.zh: 她的听力有进步。

ex.en: Real progress in a weak subject is often slower than a single high mark suggests.
ex.zh: 薄弱科目上的真正进步，往往比一次高分所显示的更慢。

tip: progress 作名词不可数，不说 a progress。动词重音常在后。

senses.en: approved by an authority
a person with a public position

ex.en: Wait for the official notice before you change the date.
ex.zh: 改日期之前请等官方通知。

ex.en: An official report that hides bad numbers does not help a town prepare for the next flood.
ex.zh: 隐瞒糟糕数字的官方报告，帮不了一个城镇为下一次洪水做准备。

tip: official 作名词是“官员”。

senses.en: of Africa
a person from Africa

ex.en: The map shows African rivers in blue.
ex.zh: 地图上非洲的河用蓝色标出。

ex.en: An African writer on the reading list gives the class a voice that a single textbook chapter may miss.
ex.zh: 阅读清单上的非洲作家，能给班级一个课本里一章可能错过的声音。

tip: African 作形容词和名词都要大写。名词指非洲人。

senses.en: before Christ, used with years

ex.en: The map marks the year 200 BC.
ex.zh: 地图标着公元前 200 年。

ex.en: A timeline that says 200 BC should also say how we know.
ex.zh: 写着公元前 200 年的时间线，也应当说明我们是怎么知道的。

tip: BC 表示公元前，放在年份后面。与 pc 不是同一个缩写。

senses.en: having a big effect or value

ex.en: It is important to write the date on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写日期很重要。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is more important to a growing town than another bright shopping sign.
ex.zh: 对一个发展中的城镇来说，干净的饮用水比又一块闪亮的商店招牌更重要。

tip: It is important for sb to do，不要漏掉 for 或 to。

senses.en: a room or building where art is shown

ex.en: The gallery is free on Sunday.
ex.zh: 画廊周日免费。

ex.en: A gallery that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
ex.zh: 在末班车之前就关门的画廊，其实已经选定了它的观众。

tip: gallery 也可指楼座。

senses.en: very unpleasant

ex.en: The smell from the bin was disgusting.
ex.zh: 桶里的气味令人厌恶。

ex.en: Calling a person disgusting is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 说一个人令人厌恶，不是班级该保留的笑话。

col: a disgusting smell｜令人厌恶的气味
tip: disgusting 可以形容事物。用在人身上会伤人。

senses.en: an oily substance in food and in the body
having a lot of flesh or oil

ex.en: This soup has less fat than the fried dish.
ex.zh: 这汤比那道油炸菜脂肪少。

ex.en: Health class should talk about fat in food without mocking how a classmate looks.
ex.zh: 健康课应当讨论食物里的脂肪，而不是嘲笑同学的样子。

tip: fat 作形容词是“胖的；肥的”。描述人时要注意礼貌。

senses.en: to walk with regular steps, often in a group
a walk by a group, or the third month when capitalised

ex.en: The band will march onto the field.
ex.zh: 乐队将列队走上场地。

ex.en: People march when a decision about their street is made without asking them.
ex.zh: 当关于他们街道的决定没有询问他们就做出时，人们会游行。

tip: March 大写是三月；march 小写是行进。不要在句子里混用大小写。

senses.en: related to the spirit or to religion

ex.en: The song had a spiritual meaning for some students.
ex.zh: 这首歌对一些学生有精神上的意义。

ex.en: A school can discuss spiritual life without choosing one faith for everyone.
ex.zh: 学校可以讨论精神生活，而不为每个人选定一种信仰。

tip: spirit 已在本库。spiritual 不是“含酒精的”，那是 spirits 的另一个意思，本条不用。

senses.en: the act of selling

ex.en: The book sale is on Friday.
ex.zh: 书展义卖在周五。

ex.en: The sale of public land beside a school should not ignore the playground it replaces.
ex.zh: 出售学校旁边的公共土地，不该忽略它取代的操场。

tip: for sale 是待售；on sale 常指降价。

senses.en: at any time, or every time

ex.en: Come whenever you are free.
ex.zh: 你什么时候有空就来。

ex.en: Whenever the river rises, the same two classrooms flood first.
ex.zh: 每当河水上涨，同样的两间教室最先进水。

tip: whenever 引导时间从句。口语里也可表示“究竟什么时候”。

senses.en: to keep something for a particular person or purpose
a supply kept back, or a protected area

ex.en: Please reserve two seats on the bus.
ex.zh: 请在公交上订两个座位。

ex.en: A library that can reserve a book for a student who lives far away is doing its job.
ex.zh: 能为住得远的学生留一本书的图书馆，是在做它的工作。

tip: reserve 作名词是储备或保护区。预订的名词常用 reservation。

senses.en: the last part

ex.en: The ending of the story surprised us.
ex.zh: 故事的结局让我们吃惊。

ex.en: A happy ending in a film about a flood can hide the work that comes after the water leaves.
ex.zh: 洪水电影里的快乐结局，可能掩盖水退之后还要做的工作。

tip: ending 是名词。动词结束用 end。

senses.en: to agree with and help, or to provide what is needed
help or approval

ex.en: Our class supports the book-sharing plan.
ex.zh: 我们班支持图书共享计划。

ex.en: Parents cannot support a long school day if the buses stop before the last lesson ends.
ex.zh: 如果公交车在最后一节课结束前就停运，父母就无法支持过长的在校时间。

col: support sb in｜在某方面支持
tip: support 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: a building where people live

ex.en: Their house is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在邮局旁边。

ex.en: A house built on cheap wetland may cost less at first and much more after the first flood.
ex.zh: 建在廉价湿地上的房子，起初可能更便宜，第一次洪水之后却贵得多。

tip: house 是建筑物；home 是家的感觉或所在。

senses.en: an idea or feeling about something

ex.en: The first impression was the broken clock.
ex.zh: 第一印象是那块坏钟。

ex.en: An impression is not a measurement.
ex.zh: 印象不是测量。

tip: impression 可数。

senses.en: a polite word for a woman

ex.en: The lady at the desk helped us.
ex.zh: 柜台的女士帮助了我们。

ex.en: A lady who works the night shift still needs a safe way home.
ex.zh: 上夜班的女士仍然需要一条安全的回家路。

col: ladies and gentlemen｜女士们先生们
tip: lady 的复数是 ladies。正式场合可用，但 woman 更中性。

senses.en: a large musical instrument with keys

ex.en: The piano is in the hall.
ex.zh: 钢琴在礼堂里。

ex.en: A piano that nobody may touch teaches less than ten minutes of practice.
ex.zh: 谁也不许碰的钢琴，比十分钟练习教得少。

tip: play the piano 要加 the。

senses.en: a game played by two teams kicking a ball; American name

ex.en: Soccer practice is at four.
ex.zh: 足球训练在四点。

ex.en: In this atlas, soccer is the same game many students call football.
ex.zh: 在本库里，soccer 就是许多学生称为 football 的那场运动。

tip: 英式足球在美国常叫 soccer。football 已在本库。play soccer 不加 the。

senses.en: to decide after thinking; to end

ex.en: We can conclude that practice helps.
ex.zh: 我们可以得出结论：练习有帮助。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to have an influence on
to cause someone to feel a strong emotion

ex.en: Noise can affect your ability to sleep.
ex.zh: 噪音会影响你的睡眠能力。

ex.en: Rising food prices disproportionately affect poorer households, which spend a larger share of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品价格上涨对较贫困家庭的影响尤为严重，因为必需品支出占其收入的比例更大。

col: deeply affect someone｜深深触动某人
tip: 表示“影响”时affect是动词，effect通常是名词。

senses.en: to make a bell sound, or to call by phone
a sound of a bell, or a circle of metal

ex.en: The bell will ring in two minutes.
ex.zh: 铃将在两分钟后响。

ex.en: Please ring the office if the bus has not left by four.
ex.zh: 如果公交四点还没走，请给办公室打电话。

col: ring sb up｜给某人打电话
give sb a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: ring 的过去式是 rang，过去分词是 rung。作名词还可指戒指或环形物。

senses.en: a place where people buy and sell

ex.en: We buy fruit at the morning market.
ex.zh: 我们在早市买水果。

ex.en: A local market keeps money in the town, while a distant supermarket sends it away.
ex.zh: 本地市场把钱留在镇上，而远处的超市把钱送走。

tip: market 作动词是“推销”。

senses.en: something that helps you
A useful or positive feature of something.

ex.en: Speaking two languages is an advantage.
ex.zh: 会说两种语言是一种优势。

ex.en: One major advantage of public transport is its ability to reduce traffic congestion in urban areas.
ex.zh: 公共交通的一大好处是能够缓解城市地区的交通拥堵。

col: have an advantage over｜比……有优势
tip: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

senses.en: the cloud produced by something burning
to produce smoke, or to breathe in smoke from a cigarette

ex.en: Smoke from the lab set off the alarm.
ex.zh: 实验室的烟触发了警报。

ex.en: The school rule says students must not smoke, and it also says where adults may stand.
ex.zh: 校规写明学生不得吸烟，也写明成年人可以站在哪里。

tip: smoke 作动词是冒烟或吸烟。表里这一行的音标是 smile，本库不用。

senses.en: a group of things of the same type

ex.en: Put the books in the right category.
ex.zh: 把书放进正确的类别。

ex.en: A category called other often hides the students the form forgot.
ex.zh: 名为“其他”的类别，常常藏着表格忘掉的学生。

col: fall into a category｜属于一类
tip: category 可数。复数 categories。

senses.en: a raised area of land, smaller than a mountain

ex.en: The path goes over a low hill.
ex.zh: 这条小路翻过一座矮山。

ex.en: Houses on a steep hill need a plan for rain before the path becomes a stream.
ex.zh: 陡坡上的房子需要在小路变成溪流之前就有下雨的方案。

tip: hill 比 mountain 小。山脚用 at the foot of the hill。

senses.en: to ride a bicycle
a series that repeats, or a bicycle

ex.en: I cycle to school when it is dry.
ex.zh: 天气干的时候我骑自行车上学。

ex.en: A safe place to cycle matters as much as a lesson about the environment.
ex.zh: 一个能安全骑车的地方，和一节关于环境的课一样重要。

tip: cycle 作名词可以是自行车，也可以是循环。

senses.en: after the expected time
after the right time

ex.en: I was late because the bus did not come.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为公交没来。

ex.en: Late buses leave students waiting in the dark, which is a safety problem as well as a delay.
ex.zh: 晚点的公交让学生在黑暗中等待，这既是延误，也是安全问题。

tip: late 可作形容词或副词。lately 是“最近”，不是“迟到地”。

senses.en: the main city, a large letter, or money for business
of a large letter, or of money

ex.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
ex.zh: 北京是中国的首都。

ex.en: Write the capital letter at the start of the sentence, and check the name of the city.
ex.zh: 句首要写大写字母，并核对城市的名字。

tip: capital 的三个常见义是首都、大写和资本，要看搭配。

senses.en: something heavy that is carried
to put a load onto something

ex.en: The load was too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这批货一个人搬太重。

ex.en: A lighter load of homework before a match does not lower the standard of the term.
ex.zh: 比赛前少一点作业，并不会降低整个学期的标准。

tip: load 作动词是装载。workload 是工作量。

senses.en: how old someone is, or a period of history

ex.en: What is the age of the oldest student in the club?
ex.zh: 社团里年龄最大的学生几岁？

ex.en: In an age of cheap photos, it is harder to know which picture shows a real event.
ex.zh: 在照片便宜的时代，更难知道哪张照片展示的是真事。

tip: at the age of 后接数字。同龄用 of the same age。

senses.en: a sweet baked food

ex.en: The cake is for the class, not for one person.
ex.zh: 蛋糕是给全班的，不是给一个人的。

ex.en: A cake at a school fair should list nuts on the label.
ex.zh: 学校义卖上的蛋糕应当在标签上写明坚果。

col: a piece of cake｜一块蛋糕；很容易的事
tip: a piece of cake 也可比喻很容易。cake 作一块时可数。

senses.en: a picture made with a camera
to take a photograph

ex.en: The photograph is on the wall.
ex.zh: 照片在墙上。

ex.en: A photograph of a student should not be posted without permission.
ex.zh: 学生的照片不应当未经允许发布。

tip: photographer 是本批的另一词。photograph 作动词是拍照。

senses.en: careful thought

ex.en: Cost is one consideration.
ex.zh: 费用是考虑因素之一。

ex.en: Consideration for the night worker belongs in the bus plan.
ex.zh: 对夜班工人的考虑应当写进公交计划。

tip: 动词 consider 已在本库。

senses.en: something that can be heard
to seem when heard
in good condition, or sensible

ex.en: I heard a sound in the hall.
ex.zh: 我听见大厅里有声音。

ex.en: The sound of night traffic keeps students awake even when the classroom itself is quiet.
ex.zh: 夜间交通的声音会让学生睡不着，即使教室本身很安静。

tip: sound 作连系动词后接形容词：sound good，不接 well 表示“听起来好”（身体好除外）。

senses.en: a unit of weight

ex.en: The truck carried a ton of rice.
ex.zh: 卡车运了一吨米。

ex.en: A ton on a poster is not a measurement until someone writes the method.
ex.zh: 海报上的“一吨”在有人写下方法之前还不是测量。

tip: a ton of 口语里也可表示大量。表里这一行的音标是 tomorrow，本库不用。

senses.en: a wish to know more, or an advantage
to make someone want to know more

ex.en: She has an interest in local history.
ex.zh: 她对本地历史有兴趣。

ex.en: A company interest in cheap land is not the same as a town interest in clean water.
ex.zh: 公司对廉价土地的利益，不等于城镇对干净水的利益。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: to ask for money; to accuse
An amount of money requested for goods or services.
Put electrical energy into a battery or device.

ex.en: Hotels often charge extra for breakfast.
ex.zh: 酒店常对早餐额外收费。

ex.en: Museums that charge admission fees should offer discounts to ensure that students can still access cultural resources.
ex.zh: 收取门票的博物馆应提供优惠，以确保学生仍能享用文化资源。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

senses.en: no longer alive

ex.en: The plant is dead because nobody watered it.
ex.zh: 这棵植物死了，因为没人浇水。

ex.en: A river that looks dead in summer may recover if factories stop pouring waste at night.
ex.zh: 夏天看起来死气沉沉的河，如果工厂停止夜里排污，仍可能恢复。

tip: dead 是形容词；die 是动词；death 是名词。

senses.en: to have a particular meaning, or to intend
not generous, or unkind

ex.en: What does this word mean in the passage?
ex.zh: 这个词在文章里是什么意思？

ex.en: A low score does not mean a student cannot learn; it may mean the test ignored what they can do.
ex.zh: 低分并不意味着学生学不会；它可能意味着考试忽略了他们会做的事。

tip: mean to do 是打算；mean doing 是意味着。

senses.en: images during sleep, or a strong hope

ex.en: Her dream is to study medicine.
ex.zh: 她的梦想是学医。

ex.en: A school that only praises high scores can make a quieter dream look less serious than it is.
ex.zh: 只夸奖高分的学校，会让一个较安静的梦想显得不够重要。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream 作动词是“做梦”或“梦想”，后常接 of doing。

senses.en: the smallest unit of a living thing, or a small room

ex.en: We drew a plant cell in biology.
ex.zh: 我们在生物课上画了植物细胞。

ex.en: A biology lesson on the cell is clearer when students can compare it with a room in a building.
ex.zh: 如果学生能把细胞和楼里的一个房间相比，这一课会更清楚。

tip: cell 在生物课是细胞，在监狱语境是单人牢房。手机是 cell phone。

senses.en: happening at even times, or usual

ex.en: She takes a regular bus at seven.
ex.zh: 她七点坐固定的一班公交。

ex.en: Regular sleep helps attention more than one long night of revision.
ex.zh: 规律的睡眠比考前熬一个长夜更有助于注意力。

tip: regular 的副词是 regularly。

senses.en: of the Pacific Ocean

ex.en: The map colours the Pacific in blue.
ex.zh: 地图把太平洋涂成蓝色。

ex.en: A lesson about the Pacific should name the coasts, not only the water.
ex.zh: 关于太平洋的课应当写到海岸，而不只是水。

tip: Pacific 作海洋名要大写。作形容词“和平的”时可以小写，本条用考纲里的太平洋义。

senses.en: to make something not closed, or to start a business
not closed, or public

ex.en: Open the window if the room feels hot.
ex.zh: 如果房间闷，就把窗户打开。

ex.en: Shops that open late help workers who cannot buy food before their shift ends.
ex.zh: 营业到很晚的商店，帮助那些下班前买不到食物的工人。

tip: open 作形容词是“开着的”；be open 表示状态，不要说 be opened 表示日常开着。

senses.en: in or to another country

ex.en: Her uncle works abroad.
ex.zh: 她叔叔在国外工作。

ex.en: News from abroad should still name the source.
ex.zh: 来自国外的新闻仍然应当写明来源。

tip: abroad 是副词，前面不加 in。

senses.en: in or of the south

ex.en: The southern gate is closer to the bus stop.
ex.zh: 南门离公交站更近。

ex.en: Southern cities face long summers, so school timetables may start earlier in the day.
ex.zh: 南方城市夏天很长，所以课程表可能把课排得更早。

tip: southern 是形容词。名词用 south。

senses.en: to get something wanted or useful
something gained

ex.en: She hopes to gain experience in the library.
ex.zh: 她希望在图书馆获得经验。

ex.en: A city can gain parks and still lose old trees if the plan only counts new ones.
ex.zh: 如果方案只计算新种的树，一座城市可以新增公园，同时失去老树。

tip: gain 强调经过努力得到。也可作名词“收益”。

senses.en: matching the facts

ex.en: Is it true that the museum is free today?
ex.zh: 博物馆今天免费，这是真的吗？

ex.en: A story can sound true and still leave out the people who were harmed.
ex.zh: 一个故事可以听起来真实，却仍然漏掉受到伤害的人。

tip: come true 的主语是梦想或预言，不用被动。true 强调符合事实。

senses.en: a system or a set for watching broadcasts

ex.en: They watched the match on television.
ex.zh: 他们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: Television can show a distant classroom, and it still cannot ask the student a question.
ex.zh: 电视可以展示一间遥远的教室，它仍然不能向学生提问。

tip: television 是全称，TV 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 telegraph，本库不用。

senses.en: an alcoholic drink made from grain

ex.en: The school fair does not sell beer.
ex.zh: 学校义卖不卖啤酒。

ex.en: A town festival that offers beer should also offer a clear rule for students under age.
ex.zh: 提供啤酒的城镇节日，也应当给未成年学生一条清楚的规定。

col: a glass of beer｜一杯啤酒
tip: beer 作种类时可数：a beer。学校场景里它是成人饮料，不是给学生的奖品。

senses.en: to be present at, or to look after

ex.en: All students attend the morning meeting.
ex.zh: 所有学生参加晨会。

ex.en: Students who cannot attend still need the notes the same day.
ex.zh: 不能出席的学生，当天仍然需要笔记。

tip: attend 后直接接活动，不加 to 表示出席。attend to 才是处理或照料。

senses.en: related to the skills of a particular subject

ex.en: The manual is too technical for the first week.
ex.zh: 这份说明书对第一周来说太技术化了。

ex.en: A technical fault in the exam system should not be recorded as a student mistake.
ex.zh: 考试系统的技术故障不应当记成学生的错误。

tip: technical 是形容词。名词技术常用 technology 或 technique。

senses.en: a strong feeling of being angry

ex.en: His anger did not fix the clock.
ex.zh: 他的愤怒没有修好钟。

ex.en: Anger at a late bus is fair, and a written time is more useful.
ex.zh: 对晚点公交的愤怒是合理的，写下来的时间更有用。

tip: angry 已在本库。anger 是名词，通常不可数。

senses.en: the act of sharing information

ex.en: Clear communication saved the trip.
ex.zh: 清楚的沟通救了这次出行。

ex.en: Communication between the school and the bus company should not depend on one phone.
ex.zh: 学校和公交公司之间的沟通不应当只靠一部电话。

tip: communication 通常不可数。a communication 可指一封正式函件。

senses.en: a feeling that worry has gone, or help for people in trouble

ex.en: It was a relief when the bus arrived.
ex.zh: 公交到了，大家松了一口气。

ex.en: Flood relief should include a dry room, not only a speech.
ex.zh: 洪水救济应当包括一间干的房间，而不只是一篇讲话。

col: to one relief｜令某人欣慰的是
tip: relief 通常不可数。a relief 表示一件令人宽慰的事。

senses.en: the state of being dark

ex.en: The path was in darkness.
ex.zh: 小路笼罩在黑暗里。

ex.en: Darkness at the crossing is a reason to add a light.
ex.zh: 路口的黑暗是加一盏灯的理由。

tip: dark 已在本库。darkness 通常不可数。

senses.en: an agreement, or an amount
to handle, or to do business

ex.en: We made a deal to share the cleaning.
ex.zh: 我们说好轮流打扫。

ex.en: A great deal of plastic leaves a school every day if the canteen still uses single-use boxes.
ex.zh: 如果食堂仍用一次性盒子，学校每天都会送出大量塑料。

tip: a great deal of 后接不可数名词。deal with 表示处理。

senses.en: a sudden bright light, or a very short time

ex.en: A flash of light crossed the yard.
ex.zh: 一道闪光穿过院子。

ex.en: In a flash the notice was wrong, and the class had already left.
ex.zh: 转眼通知就错了，班级却已经走了。

tip: flash 作动词是闪光。新闻里的 flash 也可指快讯。

senses.en: a way of doing something

ex.en: The bus is our only means of getting to the museum.
ex.zh: 公交是我们去博物馆的唯一办法。

ex.en: A means of checking news matters when a false photo can travel faster than a correction.
ex.zh: 当一张假照片比更正传得更快时，核对新闻的方法就很重要。

tip: means 单复数同形。a means 是一种方法，谓语用单数。

senses.en: sweet food made with sugar; especially American

ex.en: The candy is mostly sugar.
ex.zh: 这糖果主要是糖。

ex.en: Candy that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的糖果应当在标签上写明。

tip: candy 是美式。英式常用 sweet，已在本库。作物质名词通常不可数。

senses.en: the act of going in, or one item in a list

ex.en: Entry is free for students.
ex.zh: 学生免费入场。

ex.en: The last entry in the log should say who locked the lab.
ex.zh: 记录的最后一条应当写明谁锁了实验室。

tip: 动词进入是 enter，已在本库。entry 也可指参赛作品或词典的词条。

senses.en: for everyone, or known to people in general
people in general

ex.en: The public library is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆周日开放。

ex.en: Public money should be easy to trace, from the tax office to the classroom it is meant to support.
ex.zh: 公共资金应该易于追踪，从税务部门一直到它本应支持的教室。

tip: the public 表示公众，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: American spelling of grey
the colour gray

ex.en: The sky is gray this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。

ex.en: A gray area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
ex.zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。

tip: gray 是美式，grey 是英式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留。

senses.en: studying again, or a report judging something
to study again, or to judge

ex.en: We did a review of last week's words.
ex.zh: 我们复习了上周的单词。

ex.en: A review of a new road should include the people who walk it, not only the engineers.
ex.zh: 对新路的评议应该包括走这条路的人，而不只是工程师。

tip: review 作动词是“复习”或“评论”。

senses.en: a main public road

ex.en: The highway does not pass the school.
ex.zh: 这条公路不经过学校。

ex.en: A highway without a crossing is a wall for the student who walks.
ex.zh: 没有斑马线的公路，对步行的学生来说是一堵墙。

tip: highway 可数。information highway 比喻信息通道。

senses.en: soldiers as a group

ex.en: The history text mentions troops only as part of the war.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到部队，只是把它当作战争的一部分。

ex.en: News about troops should name the place and the date, not invent a method.
ex.zh: 关于部队的新闻应当写地点和日期，而不是编造方法。

tip: troops 是复数。单数一名士兵不用 troop 来指人，troop 常指一队。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: to need, or to demand

ex.en: The form requires a parent signature.
ex.zh: 这张表需要家长签字。

ex.en: A lab rule that requires goggles protects eyes, and it only works if the goggles are actually there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的实验室规定能保护眼睛，但前提是护目镜真的在那儿。

col: require sb to do｜要求某人做
tip: require 后接名词或 sb to do。不说 require to do。

senses.en: a large business company

ex.en: The corporation funds the school library.
ex.zh: 这家公司资助学校图书馆。

ex.en: A corporation that uses the school name in an ad should say so on the poster.
ex.zh: 在广告里使用校名的公司，应当在海报上写明。

tip: corporation 比 firm 更常指大公司。可数。

senses.en: a penalty for doing something wrong

ex.en: The punishment was extra work, not shame.
ex.zh: 惩罚是额外的作业，不是羞辱。

ex.en: A punishment that names a student in public teaches fear more than the rule.
ex.zh: 当众点名的惩罚，教给人的是害怕多于规则。

tip: punishment 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a way of thinking or feeling

ex.en: A positive attitude helps in hard times.
ex.zh: 积极态度有助于渡过难关。

ex.en: Schools can encourage a positive attitude towards learning by giving students constructive feedback rather than constant criticism.
ex.zh: 学校可以给予学生建设性的反馈，而非不断批评，以培养积极的学习态度。

tip: 对某事的态度常用attitude to或towards。

senses.en: to be likely to, or to look after

ex.en: Prices tend to rise in a dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的月份价格往往会上涨。

ex.en: Nurses tend the clinic, and the school still needs a number on the wall.
ex.zh: 护士照料医务室，学校仍然需要把电话写在墙上。

tip: tend to do 表示倾向。照料用 tend somebody 或 tend to somebody。

senses.en: 12 o'clock at night

ex.en: The bus does not run after midnight.
ex.zh: 午夜之后这路公交不开。

ex.en: A club that ends at midnight still needs a way home.
ex.zh: 午夜才结束的社团仍然需要回家的办法。

tip: night 已在本库。at midnight 不加 the。

senses.en: a place for drinks, or a long piece

ex.en: There is a bar of soap by the sink.
ex.zh: 水槽边有一条肥皂。

ex.en: A snack bar at the school gate shapes what students eat more than a poster does.
ex.zh: 校门口的小吃店对学生吃什么的影响，大于一张海报。

tip: bar 的意思靠搭配区分：酒吧、条状物或栏杆。

senses.en: the act of choosing, or what is chosen

ex.en: You have a choice of two questions.
ex.zh: 你可以在两道题里选。

ex.en: A real choice of school exists only when a family can reach it by bus or on foot.
ex.zh: 只有当家庭能乘公交或步行到达时，择校才是真正的选择。

tip: choice 是名词；choose 是动词。

senses.en: to come back, or to give something back
the act of coming back

ex.en: Please return the book by Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前还书。

ex.en: Young people return to a town when there is work, not only when they miss their family.
ex.zh: 年轻人回到城镇是因为有工作，而不只是因为想念家人。

tip: return 本身含“回”，不要说 return back。

senses.en: any person

ex.en: Anyone can borrow books with a library card.
ex.zh: 任何人有借书证都可以借书。

ex.en: Anyone planning a new road should ask the people who will walk beside it every day.
ex.zh: 任何计划修新路的人，都应该问问每天要在路边走的人。

tip: anyone 作主语时谓语用单数。疑问句和否定句比 someone 更常见。

senses.en: in a correct or suitable way

ex.en: Close the window properly.
ex.zh: 把窗户关严。

ex.en: A notice is useful only if the time is written properly.
ex.zh: 只有时间写对了，通知才有用。

tip: 形容词 proper 已在本库。properly 是它的副词。

senses.en: very pleasing to see or hear

ex.en: The lake looks beautiful in the morning.
ex.zh: 湖在早晨看起来很美。

ex.en: A beautiful old street can still be unsafe if cars park across the pavement.
ex.zh: 一条美丽的老街，如果汽车停满人行道，仍然可能不安全。

tip: beautiful 可形容人、景色或声音。

senses.en: a name that identifies a product

ex.en: The brand on the bag is not a reason to buy it.
ex.zh: 包上的品牌不是购买的理由。

ex.en: A famous brand can raise the price of a simple pencil far above its cost.
ex.zh: 名牌可以把一支普通铅笔的价格抬到成本之上很多。

tip: brand 是商业品牌。作动词可以是“打上烙印”。

senses.en: to rest and become less anxious

ex.en: Relax for ten minutes, then check the map.
ex.zh: 放松十分钟，然后核对地图。

ex.en: A room where students can relax still needs a clock.
ex.zh: 学生能放松的房间仍然需要一块钟。

tip: relax 可及物也可不及物。

senses.en: a feeling of shock, or an unexpected event
to make someone feel surprise

ex.en: The result was a surprise to the whole class.
ex.zh: 这个结果让全班都感到意外。

ex.en: A pleasant surprise still needs a plan if it changes the bus home.
ex.zh: 如果一件惊喜会改变回家的公交，它仍然需要安排。

col: to one surprise｜令某人吃惊的是
tip: surprised 形容人，surprising 形容事物。

senses.en: a situation, a legal matter, or a container

ex.en: In this case, we should ask the teacher.
ex.zh: 在这种情况下，我们应该问老师。

ex.en: In the case of a city flood, the first question is which roads still lead to the hospital.
ex.zh: 如果城市内涝，第一个问题是哪些路仍然通向医院。

tip: in case 后接句子，表示以防万一；in case of 后接名词。

senses.en: the warmest season

ex.en: The sports meet is in early summer.
ex.zh: 运动会在初夏举行。

ex.en: A hotter summer makes classrooms without fans harder places to learn.
ex.zh: 更热的夏天让没有风扇的教室更难学习。

tip: 季节前常用 in，不加 the：in summer。

senses.en: a number of people or things together

ex.en: Our group will present first.
ex.zh: 我们组第一个展示。

ex.en: A small group of volunteers can keep a community library open when the town budget is thin.
ex.zh: 当城镇预算紧张时，一小群志愿者也能维持社区图书馆开放。

tip: a group of 加复数名词时，谓语可随强调整体或成员而变化。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group

ex.en: She is a member of the science club.
ex.zh: 她是科学社团的成员。

ex.en: Every member of a team should know who will speak if the plan fails.
ex.zh: 团队的每个成员都应该知道，如果计划失败由谁来说明。

tip: member 后常用 of，不用 in。

senses.en: an idea that explains facts

ex.en: The theory is simple, but the test is not.
ex.zh: 理论很简单，但实验并不简单。

ex.en: A theory about climate is useful only when students can see the measurements behind it.
ex.zh: 关于气候的理论，只有当学生能看到背后的测量数据时才有用。

tip: in theory 常和 in practice 对照。表里这一行的音标其实是 theoretical，本库改用 espeak。

senses.en: the soft part in the mouth used for tasting and speaking

ex.en: The doctor asked her to show her tongue.
ex.zh: 医生让她伸出舌头。

ex.en: A sharp tongue in a meeting teaches fear, not the bus time.
ex.zh: 会上尖刻的话教给人的是害怕，不是公交时间。

tip: mother tongue 是母语。a sharp tongue 比喻说话刻薄。

senses.en: an animal that lives in water
to try to catch fish

ex.en: The fish in this lake are protected.
ex.zh: 这个湖里的鱼受保护。

ex.en: If a river has no fish, the birds that feed on them leave the town as well.
ex.zh: 如果河里没有鱼，以鱼为食的鸟也会离开这座城镇。

tip: fish 单复数同形。表示一条鱼可用 a fish。

senses.en: a female child

ex.en: Her daughter studies at this school.
ex.zh: 她的女儿在这所学校上学。

ex.en: A daughter who wants to study engineering should see women doing that work.
ex.zh: 想学工程的女儿，应该看到有女性在做这份工作。

tip: daughter 的复数是 daughters。

senses.en: ready to attack or to push hard

ex.en: Aggressive talk does not fix the clock.
ex.zh: 强势的话修不好钟。

ex.en: An aggressive ad for a drink should not hang in the canteen.
ex.zh: 强推饮料的广告不应当挂在食堂。

tip: aggressive 可以形容人或做法。不要用来嘲笑同学。

senses.en: during the time that, or whereas
a period of time

ex.en: I listened to the recording while I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 我洗碗时听了录音。

ex.en: Some cities invest in stadiums while their oldest school buildings still leak in the rain.
ex.zh: 一些城市投资体育场，而它们最老的校舍下雨时仍在漏水。

tip: while 可表示对比，相当于“而”；一段时间用 for a while。

senses.en: a place where children are educated

ex.en: Our school has a new science lab.
ex.zh: 我们学校有一间新的科学实验室。

ex.en: A school that stays open in the evening can give working parents a safe place for their children.
ex.zh: 晚上仍然开放的学校，可以为上班的父母提供一个孩子的安全去处。

tip: go to school 泛指上学，school 前通常不加 the。

senses.en: to move or act quickly
a sudden quick movement, or haste

ex.en: Do not rush onto a full bus.
ex.zh: 不要冲向满员的公交。

ex.en: Students who rush a lab step spill more than they save.
ex.zh: 赶实验步骤的学生洒出来的比省下的多。

tip: rush hour 是交通高峰。

senses.en: to lift, to increase, or to care for a child

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: Towns that raise bus fares should also say how students on free meals will travel.
ex.zh: 提高公交票价的城镇，也应当说明吃免费餐的学生怎么出行。

tip: raise 是及物动词。不及物的“上升”用 rise，已在本库。

senses.en: to put, arrange, or establish
a group of things that belong together

ex.en: Please set the chairs in a circle.
ex.zh: 请把椅子摆成一圈。

ex.en: If a school sets homework without time to sleep, the extra pages may lower the next day's attention.
ex.zh: 如果学校布置的作业挤掉了睡眠，多出来的页数可能会降低第二天的注意力。

tip: set 的过去式和过去分词都是 set。a set of 后接复数名词。

senses.en: to give food

ex.en: Who will feed the cat during the holiday?
ex.zh: 假期谁来喂猫？

ex.en: A canteen that can feed every student still needs a quiet table for those who eat slowly.
ex.zh: 能让每个学生吃上饭的食堂，仍然需要一张给吃得慢的人的安静桌子。

tip: feed 的过去式和过去分词是 fed。feed on 表示以……为食。

senses.en: school lessons in sport and exercise

ex.en: Physical education is on Tuesday afternoon.
ex.zh: 体育课在周二下午。

ex.en: Physical education needs a safe yard, not only a mark on the report.
ex.zh: 体育需要一个安全的场地，而不只是成绩单上的一个分数。

tip: 常缩写为 PE。形容词 physical 已在本库，本条保留全称，因为考纲里单独出现。

senses.en: clear and exact

ex.en: Please give a specific example.
ex.zh: 请给一个具体的例子。

ex.en: A specific date for opening the clinic matters more than a general promise.
ex.zh: 诊所开业的具体日期，比笼统的承诺更重要。

tip: specific 强调明确；special 强调特别。

senses.en: to feel sorry about something
a feeling of being sorry

ex.en: I regret the delay.
ex.zh: 我对这次延误感到遗憾。

ex.en: The town will regret a plan that ignores the last bus.
ex.zh: 忽视末班车的计划，城镇以后会后悔。

tip: regret doing 是后悔做过。regret to say 是遗憾地告诉你。也可作名词。

senses.en: at all times

ex.en: She always checks her answers twice.
ex.zh: 她总是把答案检查两遍。

ex.en: Towns that always build on the cheapest land may later discover that the ground floods.
ex.zh: 总在最便宜的土地上建设的城镇，日后可能会发现那块地会积水。

tip: always 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: the sky, or a place of complete happiness in some religions

ex.en: The poem looks up at heaven.
ex.zh: 这首诗望向天空。

ex.en: Good heavens is an old phrase of surprise, not a fact about the sky.
ex.zh: Good heavens 是表示惊讶的旧说法，不是关于天空的事实。

tip: heaven 在宗教里常指天堂。文学里也可指天空。

senses.en: past events, or the study of them

ex.en: We have a history test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有历史测验。

ex.en: Local history is easier to care about when students can visit the street the textbook describes.
ex.zh: 当学生能去教科书描写的那条街时，本地历史就更容易让人在意。

tip: history 作学科不可数。historical 是“历史的”；historic 常指有历史意义的。

senses.en: not including

ex.en: Everyone was present except Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都到了。

ex.en: The museum is free except on the one day when a special show raises the price.
ex.zh: 除了特别展览涨价的那一天，博物馆都是免费的。

tip: except 表示排除；besides 表示除此之外还有。

senses.en: not firmly fixed, or not tight

ex.en: The lock is loose.
ex.zh: 锁松了。

ex.en: A loose wheel on the cart is a reason to stop before the hill.
ex.zh: 手推车轮子松了，是在上坡前停下来的理由。

tip: 不要和 lose（丢失）混淆。tight 已在本库。

senses.en: newly made or picked, or clean and new

ex.en: The canteen has fresh fruit on Monday.
ex.zh: 食堂周一有新鲜水果。

ex.en: Fresh air in a classroom depends on windows that actually open, not only on a poster.
ex.zh: 教室里的新鲜空气取决于窗户真的能开，而不只是一张海报。

tip: fresh water 是淡水，不是“刚接的水”这一个意思。

senses.en: a workers' organisation, or a joining together

ex.en: The union asked for safer night buses.
ex.zh: 工会要求更安全的夜班公交。

ex.en: A union of small shops can buy together and keep a market alive.
ex.zh: 小店的联合可以一起进货，并让市场继续活着。

tip: the European Union 是欧洲联盟。

senses.en: to clean with water
an act of washing

ex.en: Wash your hands before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前洗手。

ex.en: A place to wash near the canteen prevents more illness than a poster.
ex.zh: 食堂附近一个能洗手的地方，比一张海报更能减少疾病。

tip: wash 作名词是洗。表里这一行的音标是 warning，本库不用。

senses.en: a ceremony for a person who has died

ex.en: The class sent a letter after the funeral.
ex.zh: 葬礼之后班级送了一封信。

ex.en: A school should leave time for a funeral without asking the student to explain it in public.
ex.zh: 学校应当为葬礼留出时间，而不要求学生当众解释。

tip: funeral 可数。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: a team game played with an oval ball

ex.en: Rugby practice is on the field.
ex.zh: 橄榄球训练在场上。

ex.en: Rugby needs a safe surface, not only a poster of a cup.
ex.zh: 橄榄球需要安全的场地，而不只是一张奖杯海报。

tip: play rugby 不加 the。

senses.en: great honour and praise

ex.en: The glory belongs to the whole team.
ex.zh: 光荣属于整支队伍。

ex.en: Glory on a poster does not name who locked the door.
ex.zh: 海报上的光荣不会写出是谁锁的门。

tip: glory 通常不可数。

senses.en: without being affected by something

ex.en: The bus left regardless of the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下雨，公交还是开了。

ex.en: Every student may use the library regardless of the score.
ex.zh: 不论分数，每个学生都可以用图书馆。

tip: 固定搭配 regardless of。表里把它标成形容词，本库按副词用。

senses.en: whether a person is male or female

ex.en: The form asks for your name and sex.
ex.zh: 表格要填写姓名和性别。

ex.en: A school sports rule based only on sex can be unfair if it ignores what each student can actually do.
ex.zh: 只按性别制定的学校体育规则，如果忽略每个学生实际能做什么，就可能不公平。

tip: sex 在考纲里主要作“性别”，填写表格时用。

senses.en: a very small cause of disease, or a harmful computer program

ex.en: The clinic explained the virus without a scare.
ex.zh: 医务室解释了这种病毒，没有制造恐慌。

ex.en: A computer virus is a reason to keep a paper copy of the class list.
ex.zh: 计算机病毒是给班级名单留一份纸质副本的理由。

tip: virus 可数。本条不写如何制造或传播病毒。

senses.en: simple, or easy to see
a large area of flat land

ex.en: The notice is in plain words.
ex.zh: 通知用的是明白的话。

ex.en: A plain meal that students can afford is better than a picture of a feast.
ex.zh: 学生买得起的普通一餐，好过一张盛宴的图片。

tip: plain 作名词是平原。

senses.en: of the Roman Catholic Church
a member of the Roman Catholic Church

ex.en: The old church in the story is Catholic.
ex.zh: 故事里的老教堂是天主教的。

ex.en: A history class can explain a Catholic festival without telling students to join it.
ex.zh: 历史课可以讲解一个天主教节日，而不要求学生加入。

tip: Catholic 作宗教名要大写。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a result
To bring about a change or result.

ex.en: Sleep has a strong effect on mood.
ex.zh: 睡眠对情绪有强烈影响。

ex.en: Higher parking charges may have little effect on traffic unless reliable public transport is also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有可靠的公共交通，提高停车费对交通状况的影响可能很小。

col: have an effect on｜对……有影响
tip: effect常作名词；affect常作动词，意为影响。

senses.en: a senior university teacher

ex.en: The professor answered questions after the talk.
ex.zh: 教授在讲座后回答了问题。

ex.en: A visiting professor can show students how research looks outside their own textbook.
ex.zh: 客座教授能让学生看到研究在自己课本之外是什么样。

tip: professor 是大学里的高级职称，中学老师一般称 teacher。

senses.en: holding one's attention

ex.en: The talk was interesting.
ex.zh: 讲座很有趣。

ex.en: An interesting museum is still out of reach if the bus fare is too high.
ex.zh: 如果公交票价太高，有趣的博物馆仍然到不了。

tip: interesting 修饰事物；interested 修饰人。

senses.en: very great, or very far in one direction

ex.en: The extreme heat closed the afternoon sport.
ex.zh: 极端高温让下午的体育停了。

ex.en: Extreme views in a debate still have to answer the same question: what happens to the bus?
ex.zh: 辩论里的极端观点，仍然必须回答同一个问题：公交怎么办？

tip: extreme 作名词可指极端。go to extremes 是走极端。

senses.en: a grain, or the food made from it

ex.en: There is rice in the bowl.
ex.zh: 碗里有米饭。

ex.en: Rice left out all morning is not a safe lunch.
ex.zh: 放了一上午的米饭不是安全的午饭。

col: a bowl of rice｜一碗米饭
tip: rice 通常不可数。不说 a rice。

senses.en: help
to help

ex.en: The clinic keeps a first-aid box by the door.
ex.zh: 医务室在门边放着急救箱。

ex.en: Food aid after a flood helps for a week; repairing the road helps for years.
ex.zh: 洪水后的食品援助能帮上一周，修路则能帮上很多年。

tip: aid 作动词是帮助，比 help 正式。

senses.en: a part of a place, or the size of a surface

ex.en: This area of the library is for quiet study.
ex.zh: 图书馆这一区是安静学习用的。

ex.en: Industrial areas beside rivers need stricter rules, because waste travels farther than the factory gate.
ex.zh: 河边的工业区需要更严的规定，因为废物会流到比厂门更远的地方。

tip: area 可指地区或面积，面积不可数时仍说 an area of。

senses.en: to become better or make something better

ex.en: Reading aloud can improve your pronunciation.
ex.zh: 朗读能改进你的发音。

ex.en: Towns improve a bus line by counting who is left at the stop, not only who is already on board.
ex.zh: 城镇改进公交线路，要数还留在车站的人，而不只是已经上车的人。

tip: improve 可及物也可不及物：improve English；English improves。

senses.en: a piece of writing in verse

ex.en: The poem is on the wall.
ex.zh: 这首诗在墙上。

ex.en: A poem about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
ex.zh: 写洪水的诗可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。

tip: poem 可数。

senses.en: firm and hard, or reliable
a substance that is not a liquid or a gas

ex.en: Ice is solid water.
ex.zh: 冰是固态的水。

ex.en: A solid plan names who locks the door, not only what the poster says.
ex.zh: 扎实的计划会写明谁锁门，而不只是海报上的话。

tip: solid 作名词是固体。

senses.en: a soft white material from a plant
made of cotton

ex.en: The shirt is cotton.
ex.zh: 这件衬衫是棉的。

ex.en: Cotton dries faster than a coat left in a pile.
ex.zh: 棉布比堆着的外套干得快。

tip: cotton 作材料通常不可数。也可作形容词。

senses.en: to ask formally; to use
To use something practically, or be relevant to a situation
To spread a substance onto a surface

ex.en: She will apply for a scholarship.
ex.zh: 她将申请奖学金。

ex.en: Universities should encourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds to apply for scholarships that cover tuition and living expenses.
ex.zh: 大学应鼓励家庭条件困难的学生申请涵盖学费和生活费的奖学金。

col: apply for a job｜申请工作
apply to a university｜向大学提出申请
tip: apply for接申请事项；apply to接机构或适用对象。

senses.en: not dirty
to make something not dirty

ex.en: The lab must be clean before we leave.
ex.zh: 离开前实验室必须干净。

ex.en: Clean drinking water is a public duty, not a luxury for one neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 干净的饮用水是公共责任，不是一个社区的奢侈。

tip: clean 作动词是“打扫”。

senses.en: to cut with the teeth, or to sting
a small mouthful, or a wound from a bite

ex.en: The dog did not bite.
ex.zh: 狗没有咬人。

ex.en: A bite from an insect is a reason to see the clinic.
ex.zh: 被虫子叮了是去医务室的理由。

tip: 过去式 bit，过去分词 bitten。本条不写如何伤害。

senses.en: happening at once
prepared very quickly, usually by adding hot water
an extremely short period of time

ex.en: She got an instant reply.
ex.zh: 她得到了立即回复。

ex.en: Digital platforms provide instant access to educational resources, although reliable internet connections remain essential.
ex.zh: 数字平台让人们即时获取教育资源，但稳定的网络连接仍然必不可少。

tip: instant作形容词表示即时的；in an instant表示转眼间。

senses.en: a final decision or end
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: The conclusion of the report is clear.
ex.zh: 报告的结论很清楚。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: trade, a company, or a matter to deal with

ex.en: Her aunt runs a small business near the station.
ex.zh: 她阿姨在车站附近做小生意。

ex.en: A business that ignores its waste may save money this year and lose the trust of the town next year.
ex.zh: 忽视废弃物的企业今年也许省了钱，明年却可能失去城镇的信任。

col: none of one's business｜不关某人的事
tip: business 表示生意时可不可数；表示一家企业时可数。

senses.en: the way people or things are connected

ex.en: The relationship between the two clubs is friendly.
ex.zh: 两个社团的关系很友好。

ex.en: The relationship between rent and bus fares decides whether a worker can live near a job.
ex.zh: 房租和公交费之间的关系，决定工人能否住在工作附近。

tip: relationship 比 relation 更常指人与人的关系。

senses.en: extremely large

ex.en: The map shows a vast forest.
ex.zh: 地图上是一片广阔的森林。

ex.en: A vast budget that never names the roof is still a leak.
ex.zh: 从不写屋顶的庞大预算，漏的仍然是雨。

tip: vast 比 big 更强调范围大。

senses.en: added to

ex.en: Two plus three is five.
ex.zh: 二加三等于五。

ex.en: A low fare plus a late bus is still a poor service for students.
ex.zh: 低票价加上晚点的公交，对学生来说仍是糟糕的服务。

tip: plus 可作介词或名词。A plus B。

senses.en: a kind of music with a strong rhythm

ex.en: Jazz is on the radio at noon.
ex.zh: 中午电台放爵士乐。

ex.en: A jazz concert that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开始的爵士音乐会，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: jazz 通常不可数。

senses.en: to put things into a bag or box
a bag, or a group

ex.en: Pack your bag the night before the trip.
ex.zh: 出行前一晚把包打好。

ex.en: Students who pack only what the list says leave room for a coat.
ex.zh: 只按清单打包的学生，还能给外套留出地方。

tip: pack 作名词是包，或一群。a pack of 后可接物或动物。

senses.en: very bad weather with wind and rain

ex.en: The storm started after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后暴风雨开始了。

ex.en: A storm plan should say who calls parents if the buses stop.
ex.zh: 风暴方案应当写明公交停运时谁给家长打电话。

tip: storm 可数。a storm of protest 比喻一阵抗议。

senses.en: what a person or thing is called
to give a name, or to say a name

ex.en: Please write your name in capital letters.
ex.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

ex.en: A place can lose its old name when new maps care more about roads than about the people who named it.
ex.zh: 当新地图更在意道路而不是命名的人时，一个地方可能失去旧名。

tip: name 作动词是“命名”：name the baby。

senses.en: a place where aircraft land and take off

ex.en: The airport bus leaves every half hour.
ex.zh: 机场大巴每半小时一班。

ex.en: An airport far from the city helps flights, and it also makes the last bus home matter.
ex.zh: 远离城区的机场方便航班，也让末班回家的车变得重要。

tip: airport 是一个词，不要拆开写。

senses.en: a part of the coast where the land curves in

ex.en: The town sits on a quiet bay.
ex.zh: 小镇坐落在一个安静的海湾边。

ex.en: A bay that looks calm can still be a poor place for a school boat on a windy day.
ex.zh: 看起来平静的海湾，在有风的日子仍可能不适合学校的小船。

tip: bay 是海湾，比 gulf 小。

senses.en: many times

ex.en: I often review new words on the bus.
ex.zh: 我经常在公交上复习生词。

ex.en: Streets that often flood need a better drain, not only a warning after the rain starts.
ex.zh: 经常积水的街道需要更好的排水，而不只是雨开始后的警报。

tip: often 放在实义动词前、be 动词后。

senses.en: a person who supports communism
related to communism

ex.en: The history chapter uses the word communist.
ex.zh: 历史课用了 communist 这个词。

ex.en: Students can read the word communist without being told what to believe.
ex.zh: 学生可以读到这个词，同时不被要求信什么。

tip: 也可作形容词。本条是历史词汇，不是要求学生表态。

senses.en: a country with an elected head, not a king

ex.en: The text compares a republic with a kingdom.
ex.zh: 课文把共和国和王国作了比较。

ex.en: A republic still has to decide who may vote and who may go to school.
ex.zh: 共和国仍然必须决定谁可以投票、谁可以上学。

col: the People's Republic of China｜中华人民共和国
tip: republic 可数。People's Republic 要大写。

senses.en: a curved piece of metal for hanging things

ex.en: Hang the coat on the hook.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在钩子上。

ex.en: A hook by the door keeps wet coats off the floor.
ex.zh: 门边的钩子让湿外套不堆在地上。

tip: hook 作动词是钩住。

senses.en: not smooth, or not exact

ex.en: The path is rough after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后小路很粗糙。

ex.en: A rough estimate is useful, and the budget still needs the exact figure.
ex.zh: 粗略估计有用，预算仍然需要确切数字。

tip: rough 也可表示风浪大或粗暴。粗暴义不要用来形容同学。

senses.en: at the same time

ex.en: The bus was late; meanwhile the class waited.
ex.zh: 公交晚了，与此同时班级在等。

ex.en: Meanwhile the clinic stayed open, which mattered more than the speech.
ex.zh: 与此同时诊所还开着，这比那篇讲话更重要。

tip: meanwhile 是副词，可放在句首。也可作名词，较少用。

senses.en: a person who leads a meeting or an organization

ex.en: The chairman asked each class to speak once.
ex.zh: 主席请每个班发言一次。

ex.en: A chairman who keeps the clock also keeps the last speaker from being pushed out.
ex.zh: 守时的主席也能避免最后一位发言人被挤掉。

tip: 复数是 chairmen。现在也常用 chair 或 chairperson 表示同一职务。

senses.en: the unit of money in the US and some other countries

ex.en: The book costs ten dollars.
ex.zh: 这本书十美元。

ex.en: A dollar sign on a school poster should not be the only way a family learns the real cost.
ex.zh: 学校海报上的美元符号，不应当是家庭得知真实费用的唯一方式。

tip: 符号是 $。100 cents 等于 1 dollar。cent 已在本库。

senses.en: a place where people live, or an agreement

ex.en: The old settlement is now a town.
ex.zh: 旧定居点现在是一座城镇。

ex.en: A settlement of the bus argument should be written down.
ex.zh: 公交争论的解决办法应当写下来。

tip: settlement 可指村落，也可指协议。

senses.en: a purpose or goal
to intend or try to achieve something
to point something towards a particular target

ex.en: Our aim is to finish on time.
ex.zh: 我们的目标是按时完成。

ex.en: The programme aims to reduce youth unemployment by providing practical training and opportunities to gain workplace experience.
ex.zh: 该项目旨在通过提供实践培训和获取职场经验的机会，降低青年失业率。

col: aim to do something｜力求做某事
with the aim of｜以……为目的
aim at a target｜瞄准目标
tip: aim to do表打算做；aim at doing表力求实现。

senses.en: not thick, or not having much fat

ex.en: The ice is too thin to walk on.
ex.zh: 冰太薄，不能在上面走。

ex.en: A thin coat in this wind is a reason to open the lost-property box.
ex.zh: 这种风里一件薄外套，是打开失物箱的理由。

tip: 说人瘦时要注意礼貌。thin 也可作动词“变薄”。

senses.en: British spelling of realize

ex.en: She realised the clock was wrong.
ex.zh: 她意识到钟是错的。

ex.en: Cities realise a bus plan only after they write the time.
ex.zh: 城市在写下时间之后，公交计划才算实现。

tip: realise 是英式，realize 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: the people who work for an organisation

ex.en: The staff meeting is at four.
ex.zh: 职员会议在四点。

ex.en: Hospital staff on the night shift need a bus after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班的医院职工需要一趟在常规班次停运之后的公交。

tip: staff 是集体名词，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: a very young child

ex.en: The baby slept through the whole meeting.
ex.zh: 婴儿在整个会议期间都睡着。

ex.en: A baby clinic once a month is not enough for a village that is two hours from the hospital.
ex.zh: 对离医院两小时的村子来说，每月一次的婴儿诊所是不够的。

tip: baby 的复数是 babies。

senses.en: to produce words or pictures on paper
letters produced by printing, or a mark

ex.en: Print the notice before the network fails.
ex.zh: 在网络断掉之前把通知打印出来。

ex.en: A school that can print one page for a student without a phone is still fair.
ex.zh: 能为没有手机的学生打印一页的学校，仍然是公平的。

tip: print 也可作名词“印刷品”。

senses.en: large and impressive, or important

ex.en: The grand hall can hold the whole school.
ex.zh: 这个宏伟的大厅能容纳全校。

ex.en: A grand opening means little if the new library still has no books for the lower grades.
ex.zh: 如果新图书馆仍然没有适合低年级的书，盛大的开幕就意义不大。

tip: grand 也可放在称呼里，如 grandfather。

senses.en: the right to do something, given by someone

ex.en: You need permission to use the lab.
ex.zh: 使用实验室需要许可。

ex.en: Permission to leave early should be written, so the gate and the parent agree.
ex.zh: 提前离开的许可应当写下来，这样门口和家长才一致。

tip: permission 通常不可数。

senses.en: the clear liquid we drink
to pour water on plants

ex.en: Please bring your own water to the sports meet.
ex.zh: 运动会请自带水。

ex.en: When a city wastes water in dry months, farms downstream have less for the next planting season.
ex.zh: 城市在干旱月份浪费水，下游农场下一季可种的水就更少。

tip: water 通常不可数，不说 a water。

senses.en: an organized store of information on a computer

ex.en: The database lists every bus time.
ex.zh: 数据库列出每一班车的时间。

ex.en: A database without a paper copy fails when the network fails.
ex.zh: 没有纸质副本的数据库，在断网时就会失效。

tip: data 已在本库。

senses.en: one of two equal parts
equal to one of two parts

ex.en: Half of the class walks to school.
ex.zh: 班上一半的人步行上学。

ex.en: Cutting a journey by half still leaves some students on the bus for more than an hour.
ex.zh: 把路程缩短一半，仍有一些学生要在公交上坐一个多小时。

tip: half of 加复数名词时谓语常用复数；half an hour 中间有 an。

senses.en: American spelling of colour

ex.en: What color is your bag?
ex.zh: 你的包是什么颜色？

ex.en: The color of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe to touch.
ex.zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否可以安全触碰。

tip: color 是美式拼写；英式是 colour。考纲里两种都可能出现。

senses.en: ill, or about to vomit

ex.en: He stayed home because he felt sick.
ex.zh: 他觉得不舒服，所以待在家里。

ex.en: A sick child sent to school can pass an illness through a whole class by noon.
ex.zh: 带病上学的孩子，到中午就可能把病传给全班。

tip: be sick of 表示厌烦，不是生病。英式 feel sick 常指恶心。

senses.en: to experience something bad

ex.en: The village suffered from the flood.
ex.zh: 这个村子遭受了洪水。

ex.en: Students should not suffer in silence when the bus stops coming.
ex.zh: 公交不再来时，学生不应当默默忍受。

tip: 名词 suffering 已在本库。suffer from 后接疾病或困难。

senses.en: a thin piece of metal, or a cable

ex.en: Do not touch the loose wire.
ex.zh: 不要碰松了的电线。

ex.en: A loose wire in the lab is a reason to switch the power off and call an adult.
ex.zh: 实验室里松了的电线，是关掉电源并叫成年人的理由。

col: a piece of wire｜一根金属丝
tip: 本条只作安全词汇。不写如何接线。

senses.en: a person who hunts, or who searches

ex.en: The history text mentions a hunter, not a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到猎人，不是方法。

ex.en: A job hunter needs a clear form more than a long speech.
ex.zh: 找工作的人需要一张清楚的表，而不是一篇长讲话。

tip: 动词 hunt 已在本库。本条不写狩猎操作。

senses.en: a tool with a blade for cutting

ex.en: The knife stays in the kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 刀留在厨房抽屉里。

ex.en: A knife in a school kitchen is a tool for food, and it is locked when the cook leaves.
ex.zh: 学校厨房里的刀是做饭的工具，厨师离开时要锁上。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
tip: 复数是 knives。本条不写如何伤人。

senses.en: able to harm you

ex.en: The icy steps are dangerous.
ex.zh: 结冰的台阶很危险。

ex.en: A dangerous crossing near a school is a planning problem, not only a warning to children.
ex.zh: 学校附近危险的路口是规划问题，而不只是对孩子的一句警告。

tip: dangerous 形容事物。处于危险中的人用 in danger。

senses.en: not bent or curved
directly

ex.en: Draw a straight line under the title.
ex.zh: 在标题下画一条直线。

ex.en: A straight road through a wetland may be faster for cars and worse for the water.
ex.zh: 穿过湿地的直路对汽车可能更快，对水却更糟。

tip: straight 可作形容词或副词，不要写成 straightly。

senses.en: to move forward, or to help something develop
progress, or money paid before the work

ex.en: The line will advance when the gate opens.
ex.zh: 门开后队伍会向前走。

ex.en: Science can advance and still leave a village without clean water.
ex.zh: 科学可以进步，村子却仍然可能没有干净的水。

tip: in advance 表示事先。advance 作名词是进展或预付。

senses.en: the state of being free from control

ex.en: The country marks independence in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月纪念独立。

ex.en: Independence in study means a student can start without waiting to be told every step.
ex.zh: 学习上的独立，是指学生不必每一步都被吩咐也能开始。

tip: 形容词 independent 已在本库。Independence Day 要大写。

senses.en: buying and selling, or a kind of work
to buy and sell

ex.en: The town lives by trade with the city.
ex.zh: 这个城镇靠与城市的贸易过活。

ex.en: Fair trade in food means the farmer, not only the shop, receives a living wage.
ex.zh: 公平的食品贸易意味着农民而不只是商店获得足以生活的工资。

tip: trade 作动词是“交易”。

senses.en: belonging to the place where you were born
a person born in a place

ex.en: She is a native speaker of the local dialect.
ex.zh: 她的母语是当地方言。

ex.en: Native plants along the path need less water than a lawn that must stay green.
ex.zh: 路边的本地植物比必须保持翠绿的草坪更省水。

tip: native 作名词是本地人。用在人身上时要注意礼貌，不要带轻视。

senses.en: a piece of information sent to someone

ex.en: I left a message on her desk.
ex.zh: 我在她桌上留了口信。

ex.en: A text message about a storm helps only if it arrives before the road is under water.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的短信只有在路被水淹之前到达才有帮助。

tip: message 是可数名词。

senses.en: the salt water covering much of the earth

ex.en: We could smell the sea from the hill.
ex.zh: 我们在山上能闻到海的气味。

ex.en: Plastic that reaches the sea started as packaging someone dropped in a town.
ex.zh: 进入大海的塑料，起初是有人在城镇里丢掉的包装。

tip: by sea 表示经海路，不加 the。go to the sea 常指去海边。

senses.en: a building where people are kept as a legal punishment

ex.en: The history text describes the old prison.
ex.zh: 历史课文描述了那座旧监狱。

ex.en: A town that builds a prison still has to decide what happens to a person on the day they leave.
ex.zh: 建造监狱的城镇，仍要决定一个人出狱那天会发生什么。

tip: in prison 表示服刑，通常不加 the。

senses.en: a play in which most of the words are sung

ex.en: The opera starts at seven.
ex.zh: 歌剧七点开始。

ex.en: An opera that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开演的歌剧，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: opera 可数。

senses.en: having many parts
A group of buildings used for related activities.

ex.en: The problem is more complex than it looks.
ex.zh: 问题比看上去更复杂。

ex.en: Urban poverty is a complex issue that requires cooperation between governments, businesses and local communities.
ex.zh: 城市贫困是一个复杂问题，需要政府、企业和当地社区共同合作。

tip: 作形容词指复杂；作名词可指综合建筑群。

senses.en: a common food made from flour

ex.en: There is bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 厨房里有面包。

ex.en: Bread left out all day is not a safe breakfast.
ex.zh: 放了一整天的面包不是安全的早饭。

col: a piece of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread 通常不可数。不说 a bread。

senses.en: how hot or cold something is

ex.en: The temperature in the lab is too high.
ex.zh: 实验室温度太高。

ex.en: A city that records temperature near schools can see which classrooms need shade.
ex.zh: 记录学校附近温度的城市，能看出哪些教室需要遮阴。

tip: temperature 可数。have a temperature 常指发烧。

senses.en: a person or group that hates or fights another

ex.en: The story has no simple enemy.
ex.zh: 这个故事里没有一个简单的敌人。

ex.en: Treating a rival school as an enemy teaches the wrong lesson before a friendly match.
ex.zh: 在友谊赛前把对手学校当成敌人，教给学生的是错误的一课。

tip: enemy 可数。the enemy 作军队时谓语可用单数或复数。

senses.en: in the space or time separating two things

ex.en: The lab is between the library and the hall.
ex.zh: 实验室在图书馆和大厅之间。

ex.en: The difference between knowing a word and using it shows up when students write under time pressure.
ex.zh: 认识一个词和会用一个词的差别，会在学生限时写作时显现出来。

tip: between 多用于两者；among 用于三者或更多。

senses.en: at or to a great distance
distant

ex.en: The station is not far from our school.
ex.zh: 车站离我们学校不远。

ex.en: Families who live far from a hospital wait longer when a child is suddenly ill.
ex.zh: 住得离医院远的家庭，孩子突然生病时要等更久。

tip: far 的比较级是 farther 或 further；further 还可表示“进一步的”。

senses.en: a well-known statement, or something said

ex.en: There is an old saying about practice.
ex.zh: 有一句关于练习的老话。

ex.en: A saying about saving water means little unless the school itself fixes a leaking tap.
ex.zh: 如果学校自己不修漏水的水龙头，一句关于节水的谚语就没什么意义。

tip: saying 也可是 say 的 -ing 形式。作名词“谚语”是可数的。

senses.en: the main idea, a dot, or a score
to show direction with a finger

ex.en: The point of the story is to check your sources.
ex.zh: 这个故事的要点是要核对来源。

ex.en: There is little point in collecting data if nobody is responsible for acting on it.
ex.zh: 如果没有人负责根据数据采取行动，收集数据就没什么意义。

tip: point 作动词是“指”：point at / point to。There is no point in doing 表示做某事没有意义。

senses.en: a business, or the state of being with someone

ex.en: Her mother works for a bus company.
ex.zh: 她母亲在一家公交公司工作。

ex.en: A company that moves its factory should also say what will happen to the workers who stay behind.
ex.zh: 搬迁工厂的公司，也应该说明留下来的工人会怎样。

tip: company 表示陪伴时不可数：for company。表示公司时可数。

senses.en: not one, or not any

ex.en: None of the answers is correct.
ex.zh: 这些答案没有一个是对的。

ex.en: None of the night buses reach the village, so the clinic might as well be closed after dark.
ex.zh: 夜班公交没有一趟到村子，所以诊所天黑后等于关了。

tip: none of 加复数时谓语可用单数或复数；强调“一个也没有”时常用单数。

senses.en: a very large sea

ex.en: The river ends in the ocean.
ex.zh: 这条河最终流入海洋。

ex.en: Plastic that leaves a school bin can reach the ocean if nobody stops it on the way.
ex.zh: 如果沿途没人拦住，离开学校垃圾桶的塑料可以一直到海洋。

tip: ocean 比 sea 大。the ocean 常指海洋整体。

senses.en: a seat that swings, or a swinging movement
to move backwards and forwards

ex.en: The swing in the yard is for the younger class.
ex.zh: 院子里的秋千是给低年级的。

ex.en: A swing with a loose chain should be closed the same day.
ex.zh: 链子松了的秋千应当当天停用。

tip: swing 作动词是摆动，过去式是 swung。

senses.en: a room with a bath or toilet

ex.en: The bathroom on this floor is closed.
ex.zh: 这层的卫生间关了。

ex.en: A bathroom that students can reach matters more than a new poster about health.
ex.zh: 学生能够到的卫生间，比一张关于健康的新海报更重要。

tip: 美式 bathroom 常指卫生间。英式有时只指有浴缸的房间。

senses.en: to appear to be

ex.en: The question seems easy at first.
ex.zh: 这道题起初似乎很容易。

ex.en: A street can seem safe in daylight and still be dark for the walk home at night.
ex.zh: 一条街在白天可以看起来安全，夜里回家时仍然很黑。

tip: seem 后接形容词、to do 或 that 从句。

senses.en: related to the nucleus of an atom

ex.en: The chapter explains nuclear energy in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话解释核能。

ex.en: A town that discusses nuclear power should also publish the emergency plan.
ex.zh: 讨论核电的城镇，也应当公布应急方案。

tip: nuclear family 指父母和子女组成的家庭，不是核能。本条不提供任何制造或使用危险材料的方法。

senses.en: about science, or done in a careful tested way

ex.en: The scientific report includes the measurements.
ex.zh: 这份科学报告包含测量数据。

ex.en: A scientific claim about sleep should show how the numbers were collected.
ex.zh: 关于睡眠的科学主张应当说明数字是怎么收集的。

tip: scientific 是形容词。名词科学是 science，已在本库。

senses.en: an official rule

ex.en: The regulation is on the lab door.
ex.zh: 规章写在实验室门上。

ex.en: A regulation that students can hardly read is not one they can follow.
ex.zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规章，不是他们能遵守的规章。

tip: regulation 可数。

senses.en: the act of getting ready

ex.en: Preparation for the exam includes sleep.
ex.zh: 备考包括睡眠。

ex.en: Preparation that never names the return bus will fail the trip.
ex.zh: 从不写回程公交的准备会让这次出行失败。

tip: 动词 prepare 已在本库。preparation 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a warning signal, or a clock that wakes you
to make someone afraid

ex.en: The alarm rang at seven.
ex.zh: 闹钟七点响了。

ex.en: An alarm that nobody can hear is not a fire plan.
ex.zh: 没人听得见的警报不是消防方案。

tip: alarm 作动词是使惊恐。本条不写如何制造危险。

senses.en: an official paper that proves something

ex.en: The certificate is in the office.
ex.zh: 证书在办公室。

ex.en: A certificate that families cannot read should also have plain words.
ex.zh: 家庭读不懂的证书，也应当配上明白的话。

tip: certificate 可数。

senses.en: in spite of that, or in any case

ex.en: It was raining, but we walked anyway.
ex.zh: 当时在下雨，但我们还是走了。

ex.en: The poster looks fine. Anyway, the real question is whether the bus arrives.
ex.zh: 海报看起来不错。无论如何，真正的问题是公交是否到达。

tip: anyway 多用于口语，常放在句首或句末。

senses.en: related to electricity

ex.en: The electrical fault closed the lab.
ex.zh: 电气故障让实验室关了门。

ex.en: An electrical repair needs an adult, not a student with a loose wire.
ex.zh: 电气维修需要成年人，而不是拿着松脱电线的学生。

tip: 电动设备多用 electric；电气系统多用 electrical。本条不写如何修电路。

senses.en: clothes in general

ex.en: Wet clothing dries slowly in this room.
ex.zh: 湿衣服在这个房间里干得很慢。

ex.en: Spare clothing at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first set.
ex.zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一套衣服时，学校里的备用衣服就有用。

col: an item of clothing｜一件衣服
tip: clothing 是总称，不可数。一件用 an item of clothing。clothes 已在本库，是复数。

senses.en: words that make something clear
a reason given for why something happened

ex.en: Her explanation helped us understand.
ex.zh: 她的解释帮助我们理解。

ex.en: One possible explanation for declining car ownership is the growing availability of reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 汽车拥有率下降的一个可能原因，是可靠的公共交通越来越普及。

tip: explanation of多说明内容，for多解释原因。

senses.en: how high something is

ex.en: The height of the shelf is on the label.
ex.zh: 架子的高度写在标签上。

ex.en: The height of a flood mark tells the next class what the last storm did.
ex.zh: 洪水痕迹的高度告诉下一届学生上次风暴做了什么。

col: at the height of｜在……的顶点
tip: 形容词 high 已在本库。问身高用 How tall，不用 How high 指人时要小心；身高也常用 height。

senses.en: sad because something was not as good as hoped

ex.en: She was disappointed with the score, not with the effort.
ex.zh: 她对分数失望，不是对努力失望。

ex.en: Parents are disappointed when the bus time changes and nobody writes it down.
ex.zh: 公交时间变了却没人写下来时，家长会失望。

tip: disappointed 形容人。disappointing 形容事物。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: whole

ex.en: The entire class passed the test.
ex.zh: 整个班级都通过了考试。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: almost

ex.en: It is nearly eight.
ex.zh: 快八点了。

ex.en: A clinic that is nearly an hour away is too far for a child who cannot breathe well.
ex.zh: 将近一小时路程的诊所，对呼吸困难的孩子来说太远了。

tip: nearly 和 almost 常可互换；almost 更能修饰 no 和 never。

senses.en: to move to music
a set of movements, or a social event

ex.en: They dance in the hall on Fridays.
ex.zh: 他们周五在大厅跳舞。

ex.en: A school dance can bring a class together if the cost does not keep some students out.
ex.zh: 如果费用不把一些学生挡在外面，学校舞会可以把一个班聚在一起。

tip: dance 也可作名词“舞蹈”。

senses.en: liked more than others

ex.en: Blue is her favorite colour.
ex.zh: 蓝色是她最喜欢的颜色。

ex.en: A student's favorite reading place may be a shared table, not a quiet room of their own.
ex.zh: 学生最喜欢的阅读地点可能是一张共用的桌子，而不是自己的安静房间。

tip: favorite 是美式拼写；英式是 favourite。意思相同。

senses.en: further than, or outside the range of

ex.en: The village is beyond the hill.
ex.zh: 村子在山的那一边。

ex.en: The cost of dirty air goes beyond the hospital bill and into lost days at school.
ex.zh: 脏空气的代价超出医院账单，还包括在学校损失的天数。

tip: beyond 是介词，后接名词。

senses.en: a hot drink made from leaves

ex.en: The teachers drink tea in the office.
ex.zh: 老师们在办公室喝茶。

ex.en: Afternoon tea in some families is a meal, not only a cup.
ex.zh: 在有些家庭，下午茶是一餐，而不只是一杯饮料。

tip: tea 作物质名词不可数。a tea 可以指一杯茶。

senses.en: to become different, or to replace
a difference, or coins returned

ex.en: We changed the time of the meeting.
ex.zh: 我们改了开会时间。

ex.en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。

tip: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: to try to win against others
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Many teams compete for the prize.
ex.zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

senses.en: fair and sensible

ex.en: The price is reasonable.
ex.zh: 价格公道。

ex.en: A reasonable timetable leaves time to eat, not only time to score.
ex.zh: 合理的课表留出吃饭的时间，而不只是得分的时间。

tip: reasonable 来自 reason。It is reasonable to do。

senses.en: a period of one hundred years

ex.en: The bridge was built in the last century.
ex.zh: 这座桥建于上个世纪。

ex.en: A town that grew in one century can lose its river in a single decade of careless building.
ex.zh: 一个世纪里成长起来的城镇，可能在十年粗心的建设中失去它的河。

tip: in the twentieth century 表示在二十世纪。

senses.en: prepared

ex.en: Are you ready for the listening test?
ex.zh: 听力测试你准备好了吗？

ex.en: A town is not ready for a flood if the only high road is already full of parked cars.
ex.zh: 如果唯一的高路已经停满车，一个城镇就还没有为洪水做好准备。

col: be ready to do｜准备好做
tip: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to do 后接动词。

senses.en: a complete change in government or in a way of doing something

ex.en: The chapter describes the revolution in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话描述那场革命。

ex.en: A revolution in bus routes still needs a map the next morning.
ex.zh: 公交线路的大变革，第二天早上仍然需要一张地图。

tip: revolution 可数。也可指旋转一周。

senses.en: the points in a game or test
to get a point or a mark

ex.en: The final score was two to one.
ex.zh: 最终比分是二比一。

ex.en: A low score on a listening test may show noise in the room, not only a weak ear.
ex.zh: 听力测验分数低，可能说明房间吵，而不只是耳朵不行。

tip: score 作动词是得分。比分的说法是 two to one。

senses.en: not needing others' control
not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: She became more independent at college.
ex.zh: 她上大学后更独立了。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

senses.en: on

ex.en: The decision depends upon the bus timetable.
ex.zh: 这个决定取决于公交时刻表。

ex.en: Once upon a time is a story opening, but real towns still depend upon roads and water.
ex.zh: Once upon a time 是故事的开头，但真实的城镇仍然依靠道路和水。

tip: upon 比 on 更正式，意思常常相同。

senses.en: to stay, or to be left

ex.en: Please remain in your seats until the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。

ex.en: The questions that remain after a lesson are often the ones worth writing down.
ex.zh: 一节课结束后仍留下的问题，往往值得写下来。

col: it remains to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip: remain 是连系动词，后接形容词：remain calm。不能说 remain to do 表示“仍然要做”时要小心，剩下要做的常用 it remains to do。

senses.en: a thought or plan

ex.en: That is a good idea for the poster.
ex.zh: 对海报来说那是个好主意。

ex.en: An idea for a new park fails if nobody asks who will water the trees after the opening day.
ex.zh: 如果没人问开放日之后谁来给树浇水，建新公园的想法就会失败。

tip: idea 是可数名词：an idea。

senses.en: one side of a sheet in a book

ex.en: The answer is on page twelve.
ex.zh: 答案在第十二页。

ex.en: A torn page in a shared textbook matters when the school cannot buy a new copy.
ex.zh: 当学校买不起新书时，共用课本上撕掉的一页就很要紧。

tip: page 前用 on：on page 5。

senses.en: to make a picture, or to pull

ex.en: Draw the map before you write the paragraph.
ex.zh: 写段落之前先把地图画出来。

ex.en: Cities draw young workers when housing and night buses exist, not only when the posters are bright.
ex.zh: 当住房和夜班公交都存在时，城市才会吸引年轻工人，而不只是海报鲜亮的时候。

tip: draw 的过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn。draw 也可表示吸引。

senses.en: to do something, or to perform
something done, or a law

ex.en: We must act before the river rises again.
ex.zh: 我们必须在河水再次上涨前行动。

ex.en: Schools that act on student suggestions show that those suggestions were not only a form to fill.
ex.zh: 根据学生建议采取行动的学校，表明那些建议不只是一张要填的表。

tip: act 强调行动；action 是名词。

senses.en: one of the four parts of the year, or a sports period

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

ex.en: A long dry season can empty village wells before the next rain arrives.
ex.zh: 漫长的旱季会在下一场雨到来前抽干村里的水井。

tip: 季节前常用 in：in summer。

senses.en: towards a lower place

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，把书打开。

ex.en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
ex.zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。

tip: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

senses.en: to give an answer without being sure
an answer given without proof

ex.en: Can you guess the last word?
ex.zh: 你能猜出最后一个词吗？

ex.en: Planners should not guess where floods reach when residents can show them the marks on the wall.
ex.zh: 当居民能指出墙上的水痕时，规划者不该猜测洪水淹到哪里。

tip: guess 后可直接接从句。

senses.en: to speak to a god, or to hope strongly

ex.en: Some students pray before the meal.
ex.zh: 有些学生饭前祈祷。

ex.en: A school can leave time to pray without making it a rule for everyone.
ex.zh: 学校可以留出祈祷的时间，而不把它变成每个人的规定。

tip: 名词 prayer 是本批的另一词。本条不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a conversation, or the words spoken in a story

ex.en: The dialogue is on page two.
ex.zh: 对话在第二页。

ex.en: A dialogue about the bus should include the quiet student.
ex.zh: 关于公交的对话应当包括那位安静的学生。

tip: dialogue 是英式。美式常拼 dialog，目前本库是 dialogue。

senses.en: a plant smaller than a tree

ex.en: The bush by the gate needs cutting.
ex.zh: 门口的灌木该修剪了。

ex.en: A bush that hides the crossing sign is not decoration; move it.
ex.zh: 挡住路口标志的灌木不是装饰，把它移开。

tip: bush 可数。the bush 在有的国家指荒野。

senses.en: happening quickly and unexpectedly

ex.en: The sudden rain closed the match.
ex.zh: 突然的雨让比赛停了。

ex.en: A sudden change in the bus time should be written the same hour.
ex.zh: 公交时间的突然改变，应当在同一小时写出来。

tip: suddenly 是副词。

senses.en: a piece of equipment that does work

ex.en: This machine copies the notice for every class.
ex.zh: 这台机器给每个班复印通知。

ex.en: A washing machine saves time, but a school still has to teach students how to share one.
ex.zh: 洗衣机能省时间，但学校仍要教学生如何共用一台。

tip: machine 是可数名词。统称机器设备常用 machinery，不可数。

senses.en: having the power or skill to do something

ex.en: She is able to explain the diagram clearly.
ex.zh: 她能把这张图讲清楚。

ex.en: Students are more able to concentrate when the classroom is quiet and the air is fresh.
ex.zh: 当教室安静、空气新鲜时，学生更能集中注意力。

tip: can 多指一般能力；be able to 可用于各种时态，并强调做成。

senses.en: the way something is arranged
to arrange in a format

ex.en: Keep the same format for every notice.
ex.zh: 每则通知用同一格式。

ex.en: A clear format names the time before the welcome.
ex.zh: 清楚的格式先写时间，再写欢迎。

tip: format 作动词是编排，计算机里也可指格式化。本条不写破坏数据的操作。

senses.en: the center of attention
the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Keep your focus on the task.
ex.zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

senses.en: of the colour of blood
the colour red

ex.en: The red bag on the chair is mine.
ex.zh: 椅子上的红包是我的。

ex.en: Red warnings on a river app help only if people who live nearby can actually receive them.
ex.zh: 河流应用上的红色警报只有在附近居民真能收到时才有用。

tip: red 也可作名词表示红色。

senses.en: goodbye

ex.en: She said bye at the gate.
ex.zh: 她在门口说了再见。

ex.en: A bye on the phone is not a record of the bus time.
ex.zh: 电话里一声再见不是公交时间的记录。

tip: bye 是 goodbye 的口语。

senses.en: the main meal of the day

ex.en: Dinner is at six in our hall.
ex.zh: 我们食堂六点开晚饭。

ex.en: A free dinner at school can matter more than a speech about healthy food.
ex.zh: 学校的一顿免费晚餐，可能比一场关于健康饮食的演讲更重要。

tip: dinner 在不同地方可以指午餐或晚餐，都是一天的正餐。

senses.en: the act of arriving

ex.en: The arrival of the bus was late.
ex.zh: 公交到达晚了。

ex.en: The arrival time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
ex.zh: 到达时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。

tip: 动词 arrive 是本批的另一词。arrival 通常不可数，一次到达可以说 an arrival。

senses.en: personal computer

ex.en: The lab has one PC for two students.
ex.zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。

ex.en: A PC at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
ex.zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。

col: a school PC｜学校的个人电脑
tip: PC 与 p.c. 是同一个缩写，本库只保留 PC。personal computer 已在本库。

senses.en: to carry something towards the speaker

ex.en: Please bring your student card tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天带学生证。

ex.en: New jobs bring people to a town only if there is also a place for them to live.
ex.zh: 只有同时有地方住，新工作才会把人带到一个城镇。
