tip: bring 是带来（朝说话人）；take 是带走。过去式是 brought。

senses.en: of several different kinds

ex.en: The library has various maps of the town.
ex.zh: 图书馆有各种各样的城镇地图。

ex.en: Various reasons, from rent to bus times, push young workers out of a small town.
ex.zh: 从房租到公交时间，各种各样的原因把年轻工人推出小镇。

tip: various 后接复数名词。

senses.en: why something happens

ex.en: The reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的原因是下雨。

ex.en: The reason a street floods is often an old drain, not only a heavy cloud.
ex.zh: 街道积水的原因常常是旧排水管，而不只是厚云。

tip: the reason 后用 why 或 that，不要再用 because 重复原因。

senses.en: material made from animal skin

ex.en: The bag is leather.
ex.zh: 这个包是皮的。

ex.en: Leather shoes still need a dry place after the rain.
ex.zh: 皮鞋在雨后仍然需要一个干的地方。

tip: leather 作材料通常不可数。

senses.en: the largest continent

ex.en: Asia appears on the first map in the book.
ex.zh: 亚洲出现在书里的第一张地图上。

ex.en: A chapter about Asia should not treat the whole continent as one climate.
ex.zh: 写亚洲的一章不应当把整块大陆当成同一种气候。

tip: Asia 要大写。形容词 Asian 已在本库。

senses.en: British spelling of color
to add colour

ex.en: What colour is the new notice?
ex.zh: 新通知是什么颜色？

ex.en: The colour of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe.
ex.zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否安全。

tip: colour 是英式，color 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都有，搜索只匹配词头。

senses.en: the organ of sight

ex.en: She has brown eyes.
ex.zh: 她有棕色的眼睛。

ex.en: Too little light in a classroom tires the eye before the lesson is over.
ex.zh: 教室光线太暗，课还没结束眼睛就累了。

tip: eye 的复数是 eyes。

senses.en: happening often
Visit a particular place regularly

ex.en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
ex.zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: the time from noon until evening

ex.en: The match is on Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 比赛在周五下午。

ex.en: A hot afternoon in a room with shut windows is a health problem, not a character test.
ex.zh: 窗户关着的炎热下午是健康问题，不是对性格的考验。

tip: 泛指下午用 in the afternoon。具体某一天用 on Friday afternoon。

senses.en: a shirt with short sleeves and no collar

ex.en: He wore a clean T-shirt to the photo.
ex.zh: 他穿着干净的 T 恤去拍照。

ex.en: A T-shirt rule that costs too much keeps some students out of the team photo.
ex.zh: 花费过高的 T 恤规定，会让一些学生进不了集体照。

col: a cotton T-shirt｜棉 T 恤
tip: T-shirt 也可写成 tee shirt。shirt 是本批的另一词，通常有领。

senses.en: mathematics; American short form

ex.en: Math is the first lesson on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一第一节是数学。

ex.en: A math problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
ex.zh: 一道关于公交的数学题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。

tip: math 是美式简称。英式常用 maths。本库用考纲里的 math。学科前通常不加 the，但可以说 the math lesson。

senses.en: a large vehicle for carrying goods

ex.en: The truck blocked the school gate.
ex.zh: 卡车堵住了校门。

ex.en: A truck route that avoids the gate is safer than a sign that says slow.
ex.zh: 避开校门的卡车路线，比一块写着慢行的牌子更安全。

tip: truck 是美式。英式常用 lorry。

senses.en: happening a short time ago

ex.en: A recent photo shows the new bridge.
ex.zh: 一张近照展示了新桥。

ex.en: Recent floods should change where the town allows new houses, not only this year's repairs.
ex.zh: 最近的洪水应该改变城镇允许建新房的位置，而不只是今年的修补。

tip: recent 是形容词；recently 是副词。

senses.en: the last part of something
to finish

ex.en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
ex.zh: 请把名字写在页尾。

ex.en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
ex.zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。

tip: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

senses.en: a contract that pays if something bad happens

ex.en: Health insurance helped the family pay the bill.
ex.zh: 健康保险帮助这个家庭付了账单。

ex.en: Insurance does not replace a clinic that is close enough to reach at night.
ex.zh: 保险替代不了一家夜里能够到达的诊所。

tip: insurance 通常不可数。

senses.en: easily affected, or understanding feelings

ex.en: The topic is sensitive, so the names stay off the board.
ex.zh: 这个话题很敏感，所以名字不写在板上。

ex.en: A sensitive teacher notices who has no coat before the speech about weather.
ex.zh: 体贴的老师在关于天气的讲话之前，就会注意到谁没有外套。

tip: sensitive 可指容易受影响，也可指善解人意。不要和 sensible（明智的）混淆。

senses.en: very pleasant to taste

ex.en: The soup was delicious.
ex.zh: 这汤很好喝。

ex.en: Delicious food that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的美食应当在标签上写明。

tip: delicious 形容食物。

senses.en: to make something full, or to write information

ex.en: Fill the form before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前把表填好。

ex.en: Bottles that fill the recycling bin by noon show the canteen what it sells.
ex.zh: 中午就把回收桶装满的瓶子，告诉食堂它在卖什么。

tip: 填表英式常用 fill in，美式常用 fill out。

senses.en: unable to see, or not based on reason

ex.en: The sign is in large print for students who are not fully blind but cannot read small type.
ex.zh: 牌子用大字，给那些并非全盲但看不清小字的学生。

ex.en: A blind rule that ignores the last bus will fail the students who need it.
ex.zh: 无视末班车的盲目规定，会让需要它的学生吃亏。

col: turn a blind eye｜视而不见
tip: 说视力时要尊重对方。blind 也可比喻盲目。用 the blind 指一类人时要谨慎。

senses.en: a building where goods are made

ex.en: The factory is outside the town.
ex.zh: 工厂在镇外。

ex.en: A factory near a school should publish what it releases into the air.
ex.zh: 学校附近的工厂应当公布它排到空气里的东西。

tip: factory 可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: to want something that may not be real
a desire

ex.en: I wish you a good journey.
ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

ex.en: Residents wish the clinic were closer, but wishes do not move a building.
ex.zh: 居民希望诊所更近，但愿望搬不走一座楼。

tip: wish 后接虚拟语气，表示与事实相反；hope 后接真实的希望。

senses.en: relaxed, or not formal

ex.en: The meeting is casual, but the time is fixed.
ex.zh: 见面很随意，但时间是定好的。

ex.en: Casual clothes still need a name on the lost-property form.
ex.zh: 便装在失物表格上仍然需要一个名字。

tip: casual 也可表示偶然的。

senses.en: tables, chairs, and similar objects

ex.en: The furniture is old but safe.
ex.zh: 家具旧，但是安全。

ex.en: Furniture that blocks the exit is not a design.
ex.zh: 挡住出口的家具不是设计。

col: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip: furniture 不可数。一件用 a piece of furniture。

senses.en: a flower with a sweet smell and thorns

ex.en: She put a rose on the teacher's desk.
ex.zh: 她在老师桌上放了一朵玫瑰。

ex.en: A rose in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
ex.zh: 学校花园里的玫瑰在八月需要浇水，而那时大多数学生不在。

tip: rose 也是 rise（上升）的过去式。作花名时是名词。

senses.en: a small disc on clothes, or a control you press
to fasten with buttons

ex.en: The button on the coat is loose.
ex.zh: 外套上的扣子松了。

ex.en: A button that calls the office should be where a student can reach it.
ex.zh: 呼叫办公室的按钮应当装在学生够得着的地方。

tip: button 作动词是扣上。

senses.en: to begin to be

ex.en: The room will become quiet when the talk starts.
ex.zh: 讲座开始时房间会安静下来。

ex.en: A neighbourhood can become unsafe for walking if shops close and the street lights fail.
ex.zh: 如果商店关门、路灯不亮，一个社区会变得不适合步行。

tip: become 后接形容词或名词，不加 to be。过去分词仍是 become。

senses.en: land with water all around it

ex.en: We read a story about a small island.
ex.zh: 我们读了一个关于小岛的故事。

ex.en: An island school depends on the boat timetable as much as on its teachers.
ex.zh: 岛上的学校对船的时刻表的依赖，不亚于对老师的依赖。

tip: island 前的元音用 an：an island。

senses.en: the thick part of milk

ex.en: The cake has too much cream.
ex.zh: 这蛋糕奶油太多。

ex.en: Cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a risk.
ex.zh: 放在太阳下的奶油不是款待，是风险。

tip: cream 通常不可数。ice cream 是冰淇淋。

senses.en: chance, especially good chance

ex.en: Good luck on the oral test tomorrow.
ex.zh: 祝你明天口语考试好运。

ex.en: Luck may open a door, but a student still has to walk through it with preparation.
ex.zh: 运气也许能打开一扇门，但学生仍要靠准备自己走进去。

col: a stroke of luck｜一次走运
tip: luck 不可数。祝愿用 Good luck，不要说 a good luck。

senses.en: the earth, or a particular area of activity

ex.en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
ex.zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。

ex.en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
ex.zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。

tip: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

senses.en: anxious

ex.en: Parents were worried about the late bus.
ex.zh: 家长担心晚到的公交。

ex.en: A worried note from a student is information, not a nuisance.
ex.zh: 学生写来的担心是信息，不是麻烦。

tip: worried 形容人。worry 已在本库。worrying 形容令人担心的事物。

senses.en: the legal end of a marriage
to legally end a marriage

ex.en: The form does not ask about divorce in public.
ex.zh: 表格不在公开场合询问离婚。

ex.en: A school should not shame a student because of a divorce at home.
ex.zh: 学校不应当因为家里的离婚而让学生感到羞耻。

tip: divorce 作动词是离婚。说话时要尊重家庭。

senses.en: a senior priest in some Christian churches

ex.en: The history text mentions a bishop, not a rule for today.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到一位主教，不是今天的规定。

ex.en: A visit to a church can name the bishop and still not tell students what to believe.
ex.zh: 参观教堂可以提到主教，同时仍然不告诉学生该信什么。

tip: bishop 是称谓。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: to act as if something is true when it is not

ex.en: Do not pretend the late bus arrived.
ex.zh: 不要假装晚班车已经到了。

ex.en: A student should not have to pretend that a broken step is safe.
ex.zh: 不应当让学生假装坏台阶是安全的。

tip: 表里这一行的音标是 pressure，本库不用。

senses.en: to take liquid into the mouth
a liquid for drinking

ex.en: Drink some water before the run.
ex.zh: 跑步前喝点水。

ex.en: Towns that drink from the same river have to agree on what factories may pour into it.
ex.zh: 共用一条河取水的城镇，必须约定工厂可以向河里排什么。

tip: drink 的过去式是 drank，过去分词是 drunk。

senses.en: a group with a purpose, or the act of arranging

ex.en: The organization collected books for the village school.
ex.zh: 这个组织为乡村学校收集了书。

ex.en: Good organization of a fire drill matters more than a long speech about safety.
ex.zh: 消防演习的良好组织，比关于安全的长篇讲话更重要。

tip: organization 是美式拼写；英式常用 organisation。

senses.en: not true or not real

ex.en: The rumour was false.
ex.zh: 那则谣言是假的。

ex.en: A false alarm still needs a check, or the next real one will be ignored.
ex.zh: 假警报仍然需要核查，否则下一次真的会被忽视。

tip: false 是形容词。名词错误用 mistake 或 error。

senses.en: not usual

ex.en: An empty bus at four is unusual.
ex.zh: 四点的空公交不寻常。

ex.en: An unusual result in the lab is a reason to measure again.
ex.zh: 实验室里不寻常的结果，是再测一次的理由。

tip: usual 已在本库。unusual 是反义。

senses.en: of the colour between black and white; British spelling
the colour grey

ex.en: The sky is grey this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。

ex.en: A grey area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
ex.zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。

tip: grey 是英式，gray 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

senses.en: fine dry powder

ex.en: Dust covered the map.
ex.zh: 地图上满是灰尘。

ex.en: Dust in the lab is a reason to cover the bottles.
ex.zh: 实验室里的灰尘是把瓶子盖上的理由。

col: a cloud of dust｜一片尘土
tip: dust 通常不可数。作动词是掸灰。

senses.en: the business of providing holidays

ex.en: Tourism brings money, and also crowds.
ex.zh: 旅游业带来钱，也带来人群。

ex.en: Tourism that closes the local bus for visitors is not a gift to the town.
ex.zh: 为游客停掉本地公交的旅游业，不是给城镇的礼物。

tip: tourism 通常不可数。

senses.en: an act of travelling from one place to another

ex.en: The journey takes two hours by bus.
ex.zh: 这段路程乘公交要两小时。

ex.en: A journey to a museum teaches more when the return time is written on the same sheet.
ex.zh: 如果回程时间写在同一张纸上，去博物馆的旅程会更有收获。

tip: journey 常比 trip 更长或更正式。动词旅行用 travel。

senses.en: very silly or unreasonable

ex.en: The rumour is ridiculous.
ex.zh: 这则谣言很荒谬。

ex.en: It is ridiculous to blame a student for a bus the town cancelled.
ex.zh: 因为城镇取消的公交去责备学生，是荒谬的。

tip: ridiculous 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学的外表。

senses.en: to gain knowledge or skill

ex.en: We learn new words by using them.
ex.zh: 我们通过使用来学会生词。

ex.en: Children learn road safety by walking with an adult, not only by reading a poster.
ex.zh: 孩子通过和成年人一起走路来学习交通安全，而不只是读海报。

tip: learn 强调学会；study 强调学习的过程。

senses.en: protection, or the argument for someone

ex.en: The town's defense against floods is still a low wall.
ex.zh: 城镇的防洪仍然只是一堵矮墙。

ex.en: A strong defense of a plan should include the people who disagree with it.
ex.zh: 对一个计划的有力辩护，应该包括不同意它的人。

tip: defense 是美式拼写；英式是 defence。

senses.en: wide

ex.en: The path is broad enough for two people.
ex.zh: 这条路宽得能过两个人。

ex.en: A broad rule that says nothing clear is harder to follow than a short one.
ex.zh: 一条宽泛却什么也没说清的规定，比一条短的更难遵守。

tip: broad 与 wide 相近。broad 更常用于比喻：a broad range。

senses.en: to take something from a person or place by force

ex.en: The novel says the shop was robbed, and then it stops.
ex.zh: 小说写商店被抢，然后就停住了。

ex.en: News of a robbery should give the place and the date, not a method.
ex.zh: 抢劫新闻应当给出地点和日期，而不是方法。

tip: rob 的宾语是人或地方，不是被抢走的东西。steal 的宾语才是东西。本条不写作案方法。

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in or towards the south

ex.en: The library is to the south of the stadium.
ex.zh: 图书馆在体育馆南边。

ex.en: Towns in the south may face longer summers, which changes when schools can hold sports outdoors.
ex.zh: 南方的城镇可能面临更长的夏天，这会改变学校何时能在户外运动。

tip: in the south of 表示在某范围的南部；to the south of 表示在某地以南。

senses.en: to speak or act for someone, or to be a sign of something

ex.en: She will represent the class at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她将在会上代表班级。

ex.en: One photo does not represent every family that uses the school.
ex.zh: 一张照片代表不了使用这所学校的每一个家庭。

tip: 名词 representative 是本批的另一词，指代表或典型的。

senses.en: of great weight, or severe

ex.en: The box is too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重。

ex.en: Heavy rain on a street with small drains becomes a flood within an hour.
ex.zh: 排水管很小的街道上的大雨，会在一小时内变成洪水。

tip: heavy 的比较级是 heavier。

senses.en: to be real

ex.en: The problem still exists after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后问题仍然存在。

ex.en: A rule that exists only on paper does not protect the student who needs it.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的规定，保护不了需要它的学生。

tip: exist 是不及物动词，没有被动式。there exist 是较正式的 there be。

senses.en: fairly, or preferably

ex.en: The question is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题相当难。

ex.en: Many students would rather walk than take a bus that arrives after the gate has closed.
ex.zh: 许多学生宁愿走路，也不愿坐一辆校门关上后才到的公交。

tip: would rather do than do 表示宁愿……而不愿。rather than 后常接不带 to 的动词。

senses.en: a friendly informal talk
to talk in a friendly way

ex.en: We had a chat after class.
ex.zh: 课后我们聊了聊。

ex.en: A chat in the hallway is not a record; write the decision down.
ex.zh: 走廊里的聊天不是记录，把决定写下来。

tip: chat 作动词同义。比 discussion 随意。

senses.en: to speak or write about something briefly
a short remark

ex.en: She did not mention the test date.
ex.zh: 她没有提到考试日期。

ex.en: Reports that mention a river but not the villages along it miss half the story.
ex.zh: 只提到河、不提沿岸村子的报道，漏掉了一半内容。

col: mention sth to sb｜向某人提到
tip: mention 后直接接内容，不说 mention about。

senses.en: to cause pain, or to feel pain

ex.en: My knee hurts after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后我的膝盖疼。

ex.en: Words can hurt, and a false story about a classmate can last longer than the speaker expects.
ex.zh: 话能伤人，关于同学的假故事可能比说话的人预计的更长久。

tip: hurt 的过去式和过去分词仍是 hurt。

senses.en: a narrow line of light

ex.en: A ray of sun reached the back row.
ex.zh: 一束阳光照到了后排。

ex.en: One ray of light in a stairwell can stop a fall that a speech about safety will not.
ex.zh: 楼梯间的一束光能防止摔倒，而一篇关于安全的讲话做不到。

tip: a ray of hope 表示一线希望。

senses.en: concerned with real use, not only ideas

ex.en: The plan is practical: it names the bus.
ex.zh: 这个计划是实际的：它写了公交。

ex.en: Practical help is a seat and a time, not only a kind sentence.
ex.zh: 实际的帮助是一个座位和一个时间，而不只是一句善意的话。

tip: practice 已在本库。practical 是形容词。

senses.en: to move by turning over and over
something rolled, a small loaf, or a list

ex.en: The ball rolled under the desk.
ex.zh: 球滚到了桌子底下。

ex.en: Teachers roll a new plan out slowly when the old timetable still has to finish the term.
ex.zh: 旧课表还要撑完这个学期时，老师会慢慢推出新方案。

tip: roll 作名词可以是小圆面包、名册或卷。

senses.en: one of four equal parts, or fifteen minutes

ex.en: It is a quarter past eight.
ex.zh: 现在是八点一刻。

ex.en: A quarter of the class walking is still a crowd if the pavement is one person wide.
ex.zh: 如果人行道只有一个人宽，即使只有四分之一的班级步行，也仍是拥挤。

tip: 一刻钟是 fifteen minutes，口语常用 a quarter。美式 quarter 也可指 25 美分。

senses.en: a piece of work to be done

ex.en: The first task is to count the chairs.
ex.zh: 第一项任务是数椅子。

ex.en: A task without a name on it becomes everybody's job and nobody's job.
ex.zh: 没有写上名字的任务，会变成每个人的事，也变成没有人的事。

tip: task 可数。比 work 更具体。

senses.en: a wash under falling water, or a short fall of rain

ex.en: There is a shower on the second floor.
ex.zh: 二楼有淋浴。

ex.en: A shower of rain at the gate is a reason to open the hall, not to cancel the bus.
ex.zh: 门口的一阵雨是开放礼堂的理由，不是取消公交。

tip: 淋浴和阵雨是同一个词。

senses.en: a room where scientific tests are done

ex.en: The laboratory closes at five.
ex.zh: 实验室五点关门。

ex.en: A laboratory rule that requires goggles only works if the goggles are there.
ex.zh: 要求戴护目镜的规定，只有护目镜真的在时才有效。

tip: lab 已在本库，是简称。表里没有 laboratory 这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。本条不写实验步骤。

senses.en: belonging to me
a place where minerals are dug

ex.en: This bag is mine.
ex.zh: 这个包是我的。

ex.en: A river is not mine or yours alone; the town downstream drinks from it too.
ex.zh: 一条河不是我的或你一个人的；下游的城镇也从中取水。

col: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip: 名词性物主代词 mine 后面不再加名词。mine 作名词是“矿”。

senses.en: if not, or in a different way

ex.en: Hurry up; otherwise we will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 快点，否则我们会错过公交。

ex.en: Write the source down; otherwise a later reader cannot tell a fact from a guess.
ex.zh: 把来源写下来，否则后来的读者分不清事实和猜测。

tip: otherwise 可单独作“否则”。和 or 连用时不要再堆一个 else。

senses.en: a tall plant with a trunk and branches

ex.en: The old tree by the gate gives shade.
ex.zh: 门口的老树提供树荫。

ex.en: One tree in a schoolyard does not cool a city, but a row of them can change a street.
ex.zh: 校园里的一棵树凉不了一座城，但一排树可以改变一条街。

tip: tree 可数。木头作为材料用 wood，不是 tree。

senses.en: to make something by putting parts together

ex.en: They plan to build a bridge over the river.
ex.zh: 他们计划在河上建一座桥。

ex.en: Towns that build only roads forget that children also need a pavement.
ex.zh: 只修路的城镇忘了孩子也需要人行道。

tip: build 的过去式和过去分词是 built。

senses.en: the head of a government

ex.en: The premier visited the new library.
ex.zh: 总理参观了新图书馆。

ex.en: A speech by the premier does not replace the bus the town was promised.
ex.zh: 总理的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。

tip: premier 与 prime minister 相近。作形容词是首要的，较少用。

senses.en: to give someone confidence or hope

ex.en: Teachers encourage students to ask.
ex.zh: 老师鼓励学生提问。

ex.en: Cities encourage walking when the path is lit, not only when the poster says so.
ex.zh: 当小路有灯而不只是海报这么说时，城市才是在鼓励步行。

col: encourage sb to do｜鼓励某人做
tip: encourage somebody to do。

senses.en: knowing about something

ex.en: Be aware of the risks.
ex.zh: 要意识到风险。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: happening once a year

ex.en: The annual sports meet is in May.
ex.zh: 一年一度的运动会在五月。

ex.en: An annual check of the school roof costs less than the damage after one storm.
ex.zh: 每年检查一次校舍屋顶，比一场暴风雨之后的损坏更省。

tip: annual 是形容词；annually 是副词。

senses.en: a sign that stands for something

ex.en: The symbol on the door means the clinic.
ex.zh: 门上的符号表示医务室。

ex.en: A symbol without words fails the parent who does not know it.
ex.zh: 没有文字的符号会让不认识它的家长看不懂。

tip: symbol 可数。

senses.en: to choose
chosen as the best

ex.en: Select one route before you print the notice.
ex.zh: 打印通知前先选定一条路线。

ex.en: A school should not select only the already confident students for the lab.
ex.zh: 学校不应当只挑选已经自信的学生进实验室。

col: select sb to do｜挑选某人做
tip: select 比 choose 更正式。也可作形容词“精选的”。

senses.en: a relationship or a join

ex.en: The internet connection failed during the quiz.
ex.zh: 测验时网络连接断了。

ex.en: The connection between sleep and memory is a reason to protect the hour before bed.
ex.zh: 睡眠和记忆的联系，是保护睡前那一小时的理由。

tip: connection 可指具体的连接，也可指抽象联系。

senses.en: a set of clothes worn by members of a group
the same in all cases

ex.en: The uniform is blue.
ex.zh: 制服是蓝色的。

ex.en: A uniform rule should say what a family does if they cannot buy one.
ex.zh: 校服规定应当写明买不起时家庭怎么办。

tip: uniform 作形容词是一致的。

senses.en: to join together
A farm machine that harvests grain and separates the seeds.

ex.en: Good teachers combine hard work with creativity.
ex.zh: 好老师把努力与创造力结合起来。

ex.en: Cities can combine improved public transport with safer cycling routes to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市可以将公共交通改善与更安全的骑行路线建设相结合，减少对私家车的依赖。

col: combine A with B｜把A与B结合
combine theory and practice｜理论与实践相结合
tip: 动词重音在后；收割机名词读/ˈkɒmbaɪn/。

senses.en: something you can choose instead
that can be used instead

ex.en: Walking is an alternative to the crowded bus.
ex.zh: 步行是拥挤公交之外的一种选择。

ex.en: An alternative date for the exam helps students who are ill on the first day.
ex.zh: 考试的备用日期能帮助第一天生病的学生。

tip: alternative 作形容词是“可供替代的”。后接 to，不接 of。

senses.en: to copy data from a larger system onto your device
a file you have copied onto your device

ex.en: Download the form before Friday.
ex.zh: 周五前把表格下载下来。

ex.en: Students who cannot download a large file at home need a copy at school.
ex.zh: 在家下载不了大文件的学生，需要学校里有一份副本。

tip: download 也可作名词。反义常是 upload。

senses.en: an adult male, or humans in general

ex.en: A man from the bookshop helped us find the map.
ex.zh: 书店里的一位男士帮我们找到了那张地图。

ex.en: For most of history, man changed the land slowly; the last century has been different.
ex.zh: 在历史上的大部分时间里，人类改变土地的速度很慢；上一个世纪则不同。

tip: man 泛指人类时较少用于新的正式写作，更常见的是 humans 或 people。

senses.en: the reflexive form of it

ex.en: The door closed by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己关上了。

ex.en: A warning system that fails itself is worse than no system, because people trust it.
ex.zh: 自己失灵的警报系统比没有系统更糟，因为人们信任它。

tip: itself 指事物或动物，不指人。

senses.en: before the usual time
before the expected time

ex.en: I caught the early bus.
ex.zh: 我赶上了早班车。

ex.en: Early support in reading costs less than trying to repair years of failure later.
ex.zh: 早期的阅读帮助，比日后修补多年的失败更省。

tip: early 既可作形容词也可作副词：arrive early。

senses.en: the ability to remember, or something remembered

ex.en: The song brings back a memory of primary school.
ex.zh: 这首歌唤起一段小学的回忆。

ex.en: Public memory of a flood fades unless the photos stay in the library.
ex.zh: 除非照片留在图书馆，否则公众对一场洪水的记忆会消退。

tip: memory 表示记性时多不可数；表示一段回忆时可数。电脑内存也叫 memory。

senses.en: a computer set of instructions, a show, or a plan

ex.en: The program helps students check new words.
ex.zh: 这个程序帮助学生检查生词。

ex.en: A training program for village teachers fails if it requires them to leave their classes for a month.
ex.zh: 如果乡村教师培训计划要求他们离开课堂一个月，这个计划就会失败。

tip: 英式拼写 programme 常指节目或计划；计算机程序英美都常用 program。

senses.en: a plan of how money will be spent
to plan how to spend money

ex.en: The club budget cannot pay for two trips.
ex.zh: 社团预算付不起两次出行。

ex.en: A school budget that forgets heating discovers the mistake in the first cold week.
ex.zh: 忘了供暖的学校预算，会在第一个寒冷的星期发现错误。

tip: budget 作动词是编制预算。

senses.en: for each

ex.en: The room costs twenty yuan per hour.
ex.zh: 这间房间每小时二十元。

ex.en: Cities that measure water use per person can see which habits waste the most.
ex.zh: 按每人用水量统计的城市，能看出哪些习惯最浪费。

tip: per 多用于书面；口语里常用 a 或 every，如 twenty yuan an hour。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they change

ex.en: Chemistry is in the lab on Wednesday.
ex.zh: 周三在实验室上化学。

ex.en: Students learn the word and the warning sign, not a method for misuse.
ex.zh: 学生学的是这个词和警告标志，不是误用的方法。

tip: chemistry 作学科时谓语用单数。chemical 已在本库。本条不写实验配方。

senses.en: a dry substance in the form of very small grains

ex.en: The powder on the shelf is labelled.
ex.zh: 架子上的粉末贴了标签。

ex.en: A powder without a label in the lab should not be used.
ex.zh: 实验室里没有标签的粉末不应当使用。

tip: powder 作物质名词通常不可数。本条指贴了标签的粉末，不写配方或用途。

senses.en: liked more than others; British spelling
a person or thing you like best

ex.en: This is her favourite seat by the window.
ex.zh: 这是她最喜欢的靠窗座位。

ex.en: A favourite book in the library should have more than one copy.
ex.zh: 图书馆里最受欢迎的书，应当不止一本。

tip: favourite 是英式，favorite 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都出现，搜索也只匹配词头。

senses.en: to fix something at the top so the lower part is free

ex.en: Hang the map where everyone can see it.
ex.zh: 把地图挂在大家都能看见的地方。

ex.en: Wet coats that hang in the hallway dry faster than coats left in a pile.
ex.zh: 挂在走廊里的湿外套，比堆成一堆的干得快。

tip: 悬挂的过去式和过去分词是 hung。绞死的过去式是 hanged，本库不展开这个意思。

senses.en: more than usual, or in particular

ex.en: The library is busy, especially before exams.
ex.zh: 图书馆很忙，尤其是考试前。

ex.en: Night buses matter especially for workers who finish after the regular service has stopped.
ex.zh: 夜班公交对那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人尤其重要。

tip: especially 强调“尤其”；specially 强调“专门地”。

senses.en: a piece of metal given as a prize

ex.en: The medal is for the whole team.
ex.zh: 这块奖牌是给整队的。

ex.en: A medal in a cabinet teaches less than the practice that won it.
ex.zh: 柜子里的奖牌比赢得它的那次练习教得少。

tip: medal 可数。

senses.en: a fully grown person

ex.en: An adult must sign the trip form.
ex.zh: 出行表必须由成年人签字。

ex.en: Evening classes give adults a second chance without asking them to leave work.
ex.zh: 夜校给成年人第二次机会，又不必让他们辞去工作。

tip: adult 也可作形容词“成年的”。

senses.en: to show that something is true

ex.en: The experiment did not prove the idea.
ex.zh: 实验没有证明这个想法。

ex.en: One story cannot prove that a whole teaching method works for every school.
ex.zh: 一个故事证明不了一种教学法在每所学校都有效。

tip: 过去式 proved，过去分词 proved 或 proven。prove 后可接形容词：prove useful。

senses.en: a hole, a start, or a job that is free

ex.en: The opening of the clinic is next month.
ex.zh: 诊所下月开业。

ex.en: An opening for a village teacher stays empty if the housing is an hour from the school.
ex.zh: 如果住房离学校一小时，乡村教师的空缺就会一直空着。

tip: opening 是可数名词。

senses.en: the condition of the body or mind

ex.en: Sleep is part of health, not a reward after study.
ex.zh: 睡眠是健康的一部分，不是学完之后的奖赏。

ex.en: Poor air quality is a public health problem, not only a matter of personal choice.
ex.zh: 糟糕的空气质量是公共健康问题，不只是个人选择。

tip: health 不可数。healthy 是形容词。

senses.en: a device that shows the time

ex.en: The clock in the hall is five minutes fast.
ex.zh: 大厅的钟快了五分钟。

ex.en: A working clock tells you whether you are late; a poster does not.
ex.zh: 能走的钟告诉你是否迟到；海报不会。

tip: clock 通常挂在墙上或放在桌上。戴在手上的是 watch。

senses.en: a message sent by computer
to send an e-mail

ex.en: Send the form by e-mail.
ex.zh: 用电子邮件把表发来。

ex.en: An e-mail to the whole school should say who wrote it and how to reply.
ex.zh: 发给全校的电子邮件应当写明是谁写的、如何回复。

tip: e-mail 与 email 同义。mail 已在本库，范围更广，也包括纸质邮件。

senses.en: a person who does something for pleasure, not as a job
done for pleasure, not as a job

ex.en: The amateur asked the photographer before taking a picture.
ex.zh: 这位业余爱好者拍照前问过摄影师。

ex.en: An amateur concert still needs a bus home.
ex.zh: 业余音乐会仍然需要回家的公交。

col: an amateur of｜……的业余爱好者
tip: amateur 也可作形容词。

senses.en: able to be moved

ex.en: The clinic uses a mobile screen in the hallway.
ex.zh: 诊所在走廊里用一块可移动的屏。

ex.en: A mobile phone in class is useful for a timetable and harmful when it replaces the lesson.
ex.zh: 课堂上的手机对查看课表有用，如果它取代了课本身就有害。

tip: mobile phone 是手机。美式也说 cell phone。形容词 mobile 表示可移动。

senses.en: facts about something

ex.en: The website gives information about bus times.
ex.zh: 网站提供公交时刻的信息。

ex.en: Personal information collected by a school app should not be sold to other companies.
ex.zh: 学校应用收集的个人信息，不该卖给其他公司。

col: a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: information 不可数，不说 an information。

senses.en: something that happens, especially something unusual

ex.en: The incident was written in the log.
ex.zh: 这件事写进了记录。

ex.en: An incident at the gate should name the time, not a guess about who started it.
ex.zh: 门口的事件应当写明时间，而不是猜测谁先动手。

tip: incident 可数。比 accident 更中性，不一定是事故。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: We had a super time at the fair.
ex.zh: 我们在义卖上玩得非常开心。

ex.en: A super stadium does not help a town whose school roof still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座超级体育场帮不了校舍屋顶仍在漏雨的城镇。

tip: super 多用于口语。supermarket 是“超市”。

senses.en: to take in; to hold one's attention

ex.en: Plants absorb water through their roots.
ex.zh: 植物通过根部吸收水分。

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: to be connected, or to tell

ex.en: The chart relates sleep to scores.
ex.zh: 图表把睡眠和分数联系起来。

ex.en: Relate the bus story, then give the source.
ex.zh: 讲公交的事，然后给出来源。

tip: 名词 relation 是本批的另一词。relate to something。

senses.en: against the law

ex.en: It is illegal to drive through the playground.
ex.zh: 开车穿过操场是违法的。

ex.en: An illegal dump behind the school is a town problem, not only a bad smell.
ex.zh: 学校后面的非法倾倒是城镇的问题，而不只是一股臭味。

tip: illegal 是形容词。名词是 illegality，不常用。

senses.en: said aloud, not written

ex.en: Spoken English is practised in pairs.
ex.zh: 英语口语两人一组练习。

ex.en: A spoken warning at the gate helps the student who cannot read the sign.
ex.zh: 门口的口头警告能帮助看不懂牌子的学生。

tip: speak 的过去分词是 spoken。动词 speak 已在本库。

senses.en: a social gathering, or a political group

ex.en: Our class will have a party on Friday evening.
ex.zh: 我们班周五晚上有聚会。

ex.en: A political party that never meets voters outside election season soon loses their trust.
ex.zh: 只在选举季见选民的政党，很快会失去他们的信任。

tip: party 表示聚会或党派，看语境区分。

senses.en: an occasion when you eat, or the food itself

ex.en: Breakfast is the first meal.
ex.zh: 早饭是第一餐。

ex.en: A hot meal at school can matter more than a speech about diet.
ex.zh: 学校的一顿热饭，可能比一篇关于饮食的讲话更重要。

tip: meal 可数。breakfast、lunch 是具体的餐。

senses.en: the relationship between friends

ex.en: Their friendship began in the library.
ex.zh: 他们的友谊从图书馆开始。

ex.en: Friendship across two classes still needs a seat on the same bus.
ex.zh: 两个班之间的友谊，仍然需要同一班车上的座位。

tip: friend 已在本库。friendship 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a seat for one person

ex.en: Please put the chair back.
ex.zh: 请把椅子放回去。

ex.en: A chair with arms helps some students stand, and it takes more space in a crowded room.
ex.zh: 有扶手的椅子能帮助一些学生站起来，在拥挤的房间里也更占地方。

tip: chair 也可指会议主席。chairman 已在本库。

senses.en: the quality of being hot
to make something hot

ex.en: The heat in the lab made everyone thirsty.
ex.zh: 实验室里的高温让每个人都口渴。

ex.en: Cities store heat in roads and roofs, so a park can be cooler than the street beside it.
ex.zh: 城市把热存在路面和屋顶里，所以公园可以比旁边的街道凉快。

tip: heat 作名词通常不可数。作动词是加热。

senses.en: how someone looks; the act of showing up
an occasion when someone or something becomes visible or present

ex.en: First appearance can be misleading.
ex.zh: 第一印象可能具有误导性。

ex.en: Employers should assess candidates on their skills and experience rather than judging them by their appearance.
ex.zh: 雇主应根据应聘者的技能和经验进行评估，而不是以貌取人。

col: improve the appearance of｜改善……的外观
tip: 外貌与露面都可用appearance；露面常用make an appearance。

senses.en: the centre
in the centre

ex.en: Stand in the middle of the line.
ex.zh: 站在队伍中间。

ex.en: Shops in the middle of a town keep daily life there when a mall opens on the edge.
ex.zh: 当商场开在城边时，镇中心的商店仍维持着那里的日常生活。

tip: middle 作形容词是“中间的”：middle school。

senses.en: fairly cold, or calm

ex.en: The room is cool in the morning.
ex.zh: 房间早晨很凉快。

ex.en: Cool shade from old trees can matter as much as an air conditioner a school cannot afford.
ex.zh: 老树的凉荫，可以和学校买不起的空调一样重要。

tip: cool 比 cold 程度轻。口语里也可表示“酷”。

senses.en: the leader of a team or a ship

ex.en: She is captain of the school basketball team.
ex.zh: 她是校篮球队队长。

ex.en: A captain who listens before the match can stop a small argument from becoming a lost game.
ex.zh: 开赛前肯听人说话的队长，能避免小争执变成一场输掉的比赛。

tip: captain 也可指海军上校或机长，要看语境。

senses.en: a person or team that wins

ex.en: The winner of the race is in Class 2.
ex.zh: 赛跑的获胜者在二班。

ex.en: Naming only one winner can hide a class project that several students built together.
ex.zh: 只点出一个获胜者，可能掩盖几个学生一起完成的课堂项目。

tip: winner 是人。奖品用 prize 或 award。

senses.en: a large region of a country

ex.en: The province shares one exam timetable.
ex.zh: 这个省共用一份考试时间表。

ex.en: Two provinces that share a river have to share the news of a flood.
ex.zh: 共用一条河的两个省，也必须共享洪水的消息。

tip: province 可数。

senses.en: not difficult

ex.en: The first question is easy.
ex.zh: 第一题很容易。

ex.en: It is easy to blame students for being late when the bus itself never arrives on time.
ex.zh: 当公交本身从不准时，责备学生迟到是容易的。

tip: It is easy for sb to do。

senses.en: suitable, or real and correct

ex.en: Please use the proper bin for paper.
ex.zh: 请把纸放进对应的桶。

ex.en: A proper lunch is more than a packet eaten while walking to the next class.
ex.zh: 一顿像样的午饭不只是走向下一节课时吃掉的一包东西。

tip: proper 放在名词前。properly 是副词。

senses.en: an object, fact, or action

ex.en: The first thing I do is open the windows.
ex.zh: 我做的第一件事是开窗。

ex.en: The hardest thing about changing a habit is not the first day but the quiet week that follows.
ex.zh: 改变一个习惯最难的不是第一天，而是之后安静的那一周。

tip: thing 很宽泛；写作里能用更具体的名词时尽量换掉。

senses.en: the feeling of being afraid
to be afraid of

ex.en: Her fear of the dark road is reasonable.
ex.zh: 她对那条黑路的害怕是合理的。

ex.en: Fear of a late bus should lead a town to change the timetable, not to blame the student.
ex.zh: 对晚点公交的担忧应该促使城镇改时刻表，而不是责备学生。

tip: fear 作动词是“害怕”：fear that。

senses.en: to like one thing more than another

ex.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
ex.zh: 我喜欢茶胜过咖啡。

ex.en: Students who prefer a quiet seat should not have to arrive first to get one.
ex.zh: 更喜欢安静座位的学生，不应当必须最先到才能得到。

col: prefer A to B｜喜欢 A 胜过 B
tip: prefer A to B，不用 than。prefer to do rather than do 也可以。

senses.en: lasting for a long time or forever

ex.en: The mark on the wall is not permanent.
ex.zh: 墙上的痕迹不是永久的。

ex.en: A permanent bus stop is more useful than a promise that changes every term.
ex.zh: 一个固定的公交站，比每个学期都变的承诺更有用。

tip: permanent 的反义是 temporary。

senses.en: a person who receives guests, or who presents a show
to organize an event or receive guests

ex.en: Our host showed us where to sit.
ex.zh: 主人带我们找到座位。

ex.en: A host city for a school games meeting needs beds as well as a stadium.
ex.zh: 承办校际运动会的城市需要床位，而不只是一座体育场。

tip: host 作动词是主办或招待。a host of 表示许多。

senses.en: extra, or available
to give time, or to not harm

ex.en: There is a spare key in the office.
ex.zh: 办公室有一把备用钥匙。

ex.en: A spare coat at school matters when the rain soaks the first one.
ex.zh: 雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用外套就有用。

tip: spare 作动词是抽出（时间）或使免于。

senses.en: the quality of being beautiful

ex.en: The beauty of the lake is in the morning light.
ex.zh: 湖的美在晨光里。

ex.en: A city can protect the beauty of an old street and still make the pavement safe.
ex.zh: 一座城市可以保护老街的美，同时把人行道修安全。

tip: beauty 通常不可数。a beauty 可指美丽的人或物，要看语境。

senses.en: the opening in the face used for eating and speaking

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough.
ex.zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴。

ex.en: The mouth of the river is where the town's waste becomes the sea's problem.
ex.zh: 河口是城镇的废物变成海洋问题的地方。

tip: mouth 可指嘴，也可指河口或容器口。

senses.en: not far away

ex.en: There is a nearby shop that sells notebooks.
ex.zh: 附近有一家卖笔记本的店。

ex.en: A nearby clinic is useful only if it is open after school.
ex.zh: 附近的诊所只有在放学后还开着时才有用。

tip: nearby 也可作副词，放在动词后：live nearby。

senses.en: the main support or reason
The arrangement or frequency according to which something happens.

ex.en: Trust is the basis of friendship.
ex.zh: 信任是友谊的基础。

ex.en: Reliable evidence should provide the basis for government decisions about public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 可靠的证据应成为政府作出公共卫生和环境保护决策的依据。

col: form the basis of｜构成……的基础
tip: 复数为bases；on a daily basis意为每天。

senses.en: to spend time learning
the activity of studying

ex.en: I study English for twenty minutes a day.
ex.zh: 我每天学二十分钟英语。

ex.en: Students study better in a room that is quiet than in one filled with traffic noise.
ex.zh: 学生在安静的房间里比在充满交通噪音的房间里学得更好。

tip: study 强调系统学习；learn 强调学会。

senses.en: the money or effort needed
to have a price

ex.en: The cost of the trip is fifty yuan.
ex.zh: 这次出行的费用是五十元。

ex.en: The cost of dirty air does not appear on a shop receipt, but it appears in hospital visits.
ex.zh: 脏空气的代价不会出现在购物小票上，但会出现在医院就诊里。

col: at the cost of｜以……为代价
tip: cost 作动词的过去式仍是 cost。sth costs sb money。

senses.en: any thing at all

ex.en: Is there anything I can do to help?
ex.zh: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

ex.en: If a report hides anything important, the public cannot judge whether a project deserves support.
ex.zh: 如果一份报告隐瞒了重要内容，公众就无法判断一个项目是否值得支持。

tip: anything 常用于疑问句和否定句；肯定句中的“某事”用 something。

senses.en: a hot sausage in a long piece of bread

ex.en: He bought a hot dog after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后他买了一个热狗。

ex.en: A hot dog at a school fair is a small sale, and the queue still needs a clear price.
ex.zh: 学校义卖上的热狗是小买卖，队伍前面仍然需要标明清价格。

tip: hot dog 是食物，不是狗。两个词都要写。

senses.en: a sweet brown food

ex.en: The chocolate is for the whole class.
ex.zh: 巧克力是给全班的。

ex.en: Chocolate that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的巧克力应当在标签上写明。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一条巧克力
tip: chocolate 作物质名词通常不可数。

senses.en: how big something is

ex.en: What size are these shoes?
ex.zh: 这双鞋是多大尺码？

ex.en: The size of a class changes what one teacher can notice during a lesson.
ex.zh: 班级的大小会改变一位老师在课上能注意到什么。

tip: size 前常用 what 提问尺码。

senses.en: of whom or of which

ex.en: Whose bag is this?
ex.zh: 这是谁的包？

ex.en: A town whose only clinic closes will send every night emergency onto a dark road.
ex.zh: 唯一诊所关闭的城镇，会把每个夜间急诊都送到一条黑暗的路上。

tip: whose 可指人也可指物，用来表示所属。

senses.en: the ability to see, or something you see

ex.en: The test checks sight, not only reading.
ex.zh: 这次检查的是视力，不只是阅读。

ex.en: The sight of a late bus is a relief only if it still stops here.
ex.zh: 看见晚班车令人宽慰，前提是它仍然在这里停。

tip: in sight 表示看得见。表里这一行的音标是 sigh，本库不用。

senses.en: not large

ex.en: We need a small room for the group discussion.
ex.zh: 小组讨论我们需要一间小房间。

ex.en: A small change in bus times can decide whether a student arrives before the first lesson.
ex.zh: 公交时间的一个小改动，就能决定学生是否赶得上第一节课。

tip: small 强调尺寸不大；little 常带感情色彩。

senses.en: a person who speaks for a group
typical of a group

ex.en: Each class sent one representative.
ex.zh: 每个班派了一名代表。

ex.en: A representative who never asks the class is only a name on a list.
ex.zh: 从不询问班级的代表，只是名单上的一个名字。

tip: represent 是本批的动词。representative 作形容词是有代表性的。

senses.en: physical games and exercise

ex.en: Sport is part of the timetable on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五的课表里有体育。

ex.en: School sport should include students who are not trying to win a cup.
ex.zh: 学校体育应当包括那些并不想去夺杯的学生。

tip: sport 作总称时常不可数。具体项目可用 a sport。英式运动会常用 sports。

senses.en: an examination

ex.en: The exam is on Friday.
ex.zh: 考试在周五。

ex.en: An exam room needs a clock that works.
ex.zh: 考场需要一块能走的钟。

tip: exam 是 examination 的缩写，examination 是本批的另一词。表里这一行的音标是整个 examination，本库不用。

senses.en: the organ of thought

ex.en: Sleep helps the brain keep new words.
ex.zh: 睡眠帮助大脑记住生词。

ex.en: A tired brain makes careless mistakes, which is why a late bus is also a learning problem.
ex.zh: 疲惫的大脑会犯粗心错误，所以晚点的公交也是学习问题。

tip: brain 是可数名词。

senses.en: damage or injury
to hurt

ex.en: The smoke did no lasting harm.
ex.zh: 这烟没有造成持久的伤害。

ex.en: Harm from a rumour can last longer than the speaker expects.
ex.zh: 谣言造成的伤害可能比说话的人预计的更久。

col: there is no harm in｜……没有坏处
tip: harm 作动词是伤害。通常不可数。

senses.en: a round object used in games, or a formal dance

ex.en: The ball went over the fence.
ex.zh: 球飞过了篱笆。

ex.en: A lost ball is a small cost; a playground with no space to play is a larger one.
ex.zh: 丢一个球是小代价；没有地方玩的操场是更大的代价。

tip: ball 表示球是可数名词。

senses.en: to say you will certainly do something
a statement that you will do something

ex.en: I promise to return the book on Monday.
ex.zh: 我保证周一还书。

ex.en: A city should not promise a new library until it has named the building and the staff.
ex.zh: 在确定房子和人员之前，城市不应当承诺一座新图书馆。

tip: promise 后接 to do 或 that。名词也是 promise。

senses.en: not changing, or in agreement

ex.en: The two notices are not consistent.
ex.zh: 两则通知不一致。

ex.en: A consistent bus time is more useful than a new colour on the sign.
ex.zh: 稳定的公交时间比牌子上的新颜色更有用。

tip: consistent with something。

senses.en: special, or one certain thing

ex.en: Is there a particular bus you take?
ex.zh: 你坐某一路特定的公交吗？

ex.en: A particular street may flood every year while the official map still calls the area safe.
ex.zh: 某一条街可能每年都积水，而官方地图仍称该地区安全。

tip: particular 强调某一个；special 强调与众不同。

senses.en: to search carefully, or to chase wild animals
a search, or the chasing of animals

ex.en: We hunted for the key for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 我们找了十分钟钥匙。

ex.en: The history text mentions a hunt only as a custom, not as a method.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到狩猎，只把它当作一种习俗，而不是方法。

tip: hunt for 是寻找。狩猎义本条不写操作。

senses.en: a subject or situation
to be important

ex.en: This is a serious matter.
ex.zh: 这是一件严肃的事。

ex.en: Housing is not a private matter when high rents push workers far from the jobs a city needs.
ex.zh: 当高房租把工人推离城市需要的工作时，住房就不是私事。

col: as a matter of fact｜事实上
tip: matter 作动词是“要紧”：It matters。no matter 后接 who、what、how。

senses.en: an organization that provides a service

ex.en: The travel agency changed our train tickets.
ex.zh: 旅行社改了我们的火车票。

ex.en: A housing agency that hides fees makes it harder for young workers to compare real costs.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的房屋中介，会让年轻工人更难比较真实成本。

tip: agency 是机构，agent 是里面办事的人或代理人。

senses.en: to guide, or to cause a result
a leading position, or a soft metal

ex.en: The monitor will lead us to the hall.
ex.zh: 班长会带我们去大厅。

ex.en: Poor bus links can lead families to buy cars they can hardly afford.
ex.zh: 糟糕的公交连接会促使家庭去买他们几乎负担不起的汽车。

tip: lead 的过去式和过去分词是 led，不是 leaded。作名词“铅”或“领先”时读音不同。

senses.en: an organised group, or a connection

ex.en: The parents' association paid for the new books.
ex.zh: 家长协会付了新书的钱。

ex.en: The association between night noise and poor sleep is clear in streets beside a main road.
ex.zh: 夜间噪音和睡眠差之间的联系，在主干道旁的街道上很清楚。

tip: association 可指组织，也可指事物之间的关联。

senses.en: to start

ex.en: The meeting will begin at eight.
ex.zh: 会议八点开始。

ex.en: Cities should begin flood practice before the rainy season, not after the first street is under water.
ex.zh: 城市应当在雨季之前开始防汛演练，而不是等第一条街被淹之后。

tip: begin 的过去式是 began，过去分词是 begun。to begin with 表示首先。

senses.en: to pay no attention to

ex.en: Do not ignore the broken step.
ex.zh: 不要忽视坏掉的台阶。

ex.en: Cities that ignore the last bus will hear about it from parents.
ex.zh: 忽视末班车的城市，会从家长那里听到这件事。

tip: ignore 后直接接宾语，不说 ignore about。

senses.en: as much or as many as needed

ex.en: There is enough paper for everyone.
ex.zh: 纸够每个人用。

ex.en: It is not enough to build a cycle lane if it ends at the busiest crossing without a light.
ex.zh: 如果自行车道在最繁忙的路口没有信号灯就中断，仅仅修建它是不够的。

tip: enough 放在形容词和副词后面：old enough；放在名词前面：enough time。

senses.en: only

ex.en: The notice merely says the time.
ex.zh: 通知仅仅写了时间。

ex.en: A poster that merely says welcome does not name the bus.
ex.zh: 只写欢迎的海报没有写出公交。

tip: merely 放在所限制的词前。比 only 更正式。

senses.en: a person who designs or builds machines or structures

ex.en: An engineer checked the roof.
ex.zh: 一位工程师检查了屋顶。

ex.en: The engineer who designs the crossing should walk it at the hour students leave.
ex.zh: 设计路口的工程师应当在学生离校的那个钟点走一遍。

tip: engine 已在本库。engineer 是设计或修建的人。

senses.en: a group of students, a lesson, or a social group

ex.en: Our class meets in Room 12.
ex.zh: 我们班在 12 室上课。

ex.en: A class of forty is hard to teach well if one teacher has no assistant.
ex.zh: 如果一位老师没有助手，四十人的班很难教好。

tip: class 表示课堂时 in class 不加 the。

senses.en: a part in a play, or a function

ex.en: She played the role of the teacher in the play.
ex.zh: 她在剧里扮演老师。

ex.en: Buses play a role in school life that a wider road cannot replace.
ex.zh: 公交在学校生活中的作用，是更宽的马路替代不了的。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
tip: play a role in 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to continue to live or exist

ex.en: The plant survived the frost.
ex.zh: 这棵植物在霜冻后活了下来。

ex.en: A small shop survives when the rent stays possible, not only when the poster is bright.
ex.zh: 小店能留下来，是因为租金仍然付得起，而不只是因为海报鲜亮。

tip: survive 可及物：survive a flood。也可不及物。

senses.en: not many

ex.en: Few students finished the last question.
ex.zh: 很少有学生做完最后一题。

ex.en: A few trees on a hot street help, but they cannot replace a park.
ex.zh: 炎热街道上的几棵树有帮助，但替代不了一座公园。

tip: few 偏否定，几乎没有；a few 表示有一些。都用于可数名词。

senses.en: a state in which weight or importance is equal
to keep something steady, or to weigh options

ex.en: Try to keep a balance between study and sleep.
ex.zh: 尽量在学习和睡眠之间保持平衡。

ex.en: A city budget is a balance between a new road and the clinic that already needs repairs.
ex.zh: 城市预算是在新路和已经需要维修的诊所之间做平衡。

tip: balance 作动词是权衡或使平衡。

senses.en: a nation, or land outside towns

ex.en: Students from five countries joined the online class.
ex.zh: 来自五个国家的学生参加了网课。

ex.en: People leave the country for the city when schools and clinics there are too far apart.
ex.zh: 当乡村的学校和诊所彼此离得太远时，人们会离开乡村去城市。

tip: country 表示国家时可数；the country 常指乡村。

senses.en: to know the meaning of something

ex.en: I understand the question now.
ex.zh: 我现在明白这道题了。

ex.en: Planners understand a neighbourhood better when they walk it at the hour children leave school.
ex.zh: 规划者如果在孩子放学的时刻走过一个社区，会理解得更好。

tip: understand 的过去式仍是 understand，不是 understanded。

senses.en: a title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr. Li starts the lesson at eight.
ex.zh: 李老师八点开始上课。

ex.en: A letter that begins with the wrong title, such as Mr. for a woman, can undo an otherwise polite request.
ex.zh: 一封信如果称谓用错，比如对女性用 Mr.，再礼貌的请求也会被削弱。

tip: Mr. 后接姓，不接名。书写时通常作 Mr.。

senses.en: the act of leaving

ex.en: The departure is at four.
ex.zh: 出发时间是四点。

ex.en: The departure time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
ex.zh: 出发时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。

tip: 名词 arrival 已在本库。departure 可数。

senses.en: pleasing, or able to draw interest

ex.en: The poster is attractive, but the time is wrong.
ex.zh: 海报好看，但时间写错了。

ex.en: An attractive fare is useless if the last bus does not stop here.
ex.zh: 如果末班车不在这里停，好看的票价也没用。

tip: attract 已在本库。attractive 不要只用在外貌上。

senses.en: morally good, or belonging to a high social rank
a person of high social rank

ex.en: A noble aim still needs a written time.
ex.zh: 高尚的目标仍然需要一个写下来的时间。

ex.en: The history text uses noble for a rank, not for a compliment.
ex.zh: 历史课文里的 noble 是一种等级，不是一句夸奖。

tip: noble 作名词是贵族。

senses.en: safety, or the people who guard a place

ex.en: The school improved security at the gate.
ex.zh: 学校加强了校门的安保。

ex.en: Food security means a town can still eat when one road is closed by a flood.
ex.zh: 粮食安全意味着一条路被洪水封闭时，城镇仍然吃得上饭。

tip: security 通常不可数。

senses.en: unfair treatment of a person or group

ex.en: Discrimination by race is not a school rule.
ex.zh: 按种族歧视不是校规。

ex.en: A form should not be a tool for discrimination.
ex.zh: 表格不应当成为歧视的工具。

tip: discrimination 通常不可数。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: shared customs and arts
activities involving art, music, literature and other creative work
cells or microorganisms grown under controlled conditions

ex.en: Food is part of local culture.
ex.zh: 食物是当地文化的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
ex.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

tip: 泛指文化通常不可数；不同文化可用cultures。

senses.en: an opinion, or what can be seen
to look at, or to consider

ex.en: What is your view on the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你对新课表有什么看法？

ex.en: A fine view of the river does not show whether the water is safe to drink.
ex.zh: 好看的河景并不能说明水是否可以安全饮用。

tip: view 作动词是“观看”或“视为”。

senses.en: to stop living

ex.en: The flowers die if nobody waters them.
ex.zh: 如果没人浇水，花就会死。

ex.en: Fish die in a river long before the colour of the water warns the town.
ex.zh: 鱼会在水色警告城镇之前很久就死在河里。

tip: die 是不及物动词，不能说 die sb。过去式是 died。

senses.en: to win against someone
a loss

ex.en: The team did not defeat anyone; the match was cancelled.
ex.zh: 队伍没有击败任何人，比赛取消了。

ex.en: A defeat on the field should not decide who may use the library.
ex.zh: 场上的失败不应当决定谁可以使用图书馆。

tip: defeat 作名词是失败。比 fail 更常用于比赛或战争。

senses.en: a photograph, a kick or throw at a goal, or an injection

ex.en: She took a shot of the old bridge.
ex.zh: 她给那座旧桥拍了一张照片。

ex.en: A last-minute shot can win a match, but a team still needs a plan for the whole game.
ex.zh: 最后一秒的投篮可以赢得比赛，但球队仍需要整场比赛的计划。

tip: shot 也是 shoot 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: a reason you give to explain a fault
to forgive

ex.en: Tiredness is not an excuse for a locked fire door.
ex.zh: 疲劳不是锁上防火门的借口。

ex.en: Please excuse the delay; the bus was late and the notice said so.
ex.zh: 请原谅这次耽误；公交晚了，通知里也写了。

tip: 名词借口常读 /ɪkˈskjuːs/，动词原谅常读 /ɪkˈskjuːz/。表里给的是动词读音。

senses.en: not thin, or not flowing easily

ex.en: The coat is thick enough for this wind.
ex.zh: 这件外套够厚，能挡这种风。

ex.en: Thick smoke in a hallway is a reason to leave, not to look for a bag.
ex.zh: 走廊里的浓烟是离开的理由，不是找包的理由。

tip: thick 可形容物体、液体或烟雾。

senses.en: acceptable

ex.en: Is it okay if I borrow your ruler?
ex.zh: 我借你的尺子可以吗？

ex.en: An okay-looking timetable still fails students if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 看起来没问题的时刻表，如果末班车在放学前离开，仍然会让学生失望。

tip: okay 与 O.K. 是同一个词。本库只保留 okay。正式写作可用 all right。

senses.en: a disease or a period of being ill

ex.en: The illness kept her at home for three days.
ex.zh: 这场病让她在家待了三天。

ex.en: An illness reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 早报告的病比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。

tip: ill 已在本库。illness 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: younger or lower in rank
Intended for younger people or involving them
A younger person, or a student below the final year

ex.en: He is a junior member of the team.
ex.zh: 他是队里的初级成员。

ex.en: Companies should provide junior employees with structured training and regular opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues.
ex.zh: 公司应为初级员工提供系统培训，并定期安排他们向经验丰富的同事学习。

tip: 职位或年龄比较用junior to，不用junior than。

senses.en: in a true way, or sincerely

ex.en: I am truly sorry for the delay.
ex.zh: 这次耽误我真的很抱歉。

ex.en: A programme is truly open only when students without a laptop can still take part.
ex.zh: 只有没有笔记本电脑的学生也能参加时，一个项目才真正开放。

tip: 信末 Yours truly 是客套结尾。truly 强调真实，不只是程度很高。

senses.en: a flat dish, or a flat piece

ex.en: Put the plate in the sink.
ex.zh: 把盘子放进水槽。

ex.en: A cracked plate in the canteen should be thrown away the same day.
ex.zh: 食堂里裂了的盘子应当当天扔掉。

tip: plate 也可指金属板或车牌。

senses.en: with each other

ex.en: We cleaned the classroom together.
ex.zh: 我们一起打扫了教室。

ex.en: Neighbours who cook together waste less food than families who each buy too much.
ex.zh: 一起做饭的邻居，比各自买得太多的家庭浪费的食物更少。

tip: together 是副词，不单独作动词。

senses.en: the process of making things, or the amount made

ex.en: Food production fell after the dry month.
ex.zh: 干旱的一个月之后，食品产量下降了。

ex.en: Higher production of plastic does not help if the town has nowhere to put the waste.
ex.zh: 如果城镇没有地方放置废物，更高的塑料产量也没有帮助。

tip: production 通常不可数。

senses.en: a place, a job, or an opinion

ex.en: Write your position in the team on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上写你在队里的位置。

ex.en: A city's position on housing decides who can live near work and who must travel for hours.
ex.zh: 一座城市在住房上的立场，决定谁能住在工作附近，谁必须赶几小时的路。

tip: in a position to do 表示有条件做某事。

senses.en: something you own, or the state of owning it

ex.en: The bag is her possession.
ex.zh: 这个包是她的东西。

ex.en: A list of possessions helps a lost bag return.
ex.zh: 一份物品清单能帮助遗失的包回到主人手里。

tip: possessions 复数常指财物。

senses.en: not in any place

ex.en: The key was nowhere in the lab.
ex.zh: 钥匙在实验室里哪儿都没有。

ex.en: A plan that leads nowhere should be rewritten before the trip.
ex.zh: 哪儿也到不了的计划，应当在出行前改写。

tip: nowhere 已含否定。放在句首时句子常倒装。

senses.en: of the colour of earth or coffee
the colour brown

ex.en: He carried a brown bag.
ex.zh: 他拿着一个棕色的包。

ex.en: Brown flood water in a street is a warning, not a picture to share without context.
ex.zh: 街上的棕色洪水是警报，不是可以不说明背景就转发的照片。

tip: brown 也可作名词表示棕色。

senses.en: of the Olympic Games

ex.en: The Olympic story is on the wall.
ex.zh: 奥林匹克的故事在墙上。

ex.en: An Olympic poster does not replace a field the school can actually use.
ex.zh: 一张奥林匹克海报代替不了学校真正能用的场地。

col: the Olympic Games｜奥林匹克运动会
tip: Olympic 要大写。Olympics 是本批的另一词，指奥运会。

senses.en: to use money or time

ex.en: I spend twenty minutes on new words.
ex.zh: 我花二十分钟学生词。

ex.en: Families spend a larger share of their income on food when prices rise.
ex.zh: 物价上涨时，家庭把收入中更大的一份花在食物上。

tip: spend 的主语是人。It takes time 的主语是事物。过去式是 spent。

senses.en: a repeated design, or a regular way something happens

ex.en: The pattern on the cloth is simple.
ex.zh: 布上的图案很简单。

ex.en: A pattern of late buses is a fact, not one unlucky day.
ex.zh: 公交一再晚点是一个事实，不是倒霉的一天。

tip: pattern 可数。作动词是仿造。

senses.en: a substance that flows, like water
in the form of a liquid

ex.en: Do not mix the two liquids.
ex.zh: 不要把这两种液体混在一起。

ex.en: A liquid without a label in the lab should not be used.
ex.zh: 实验室里没有标签的液体不应当使用。

tip: liquid 也可作形容词。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

senses.en: the season between summer and winter; British

ex.en: School starts in autumn.
ex.zh: 学校在秋天开学。

ex.en: An autumn storm still needs the ordinary plan: who calls parents.
ex.zh: 一场秋日暴风雨仍然需要普通的方案：谁给家长打电话。

tip: autumn 是英式。美式秋季常用 fall。本库已有 fall，含义更多。

senses.en: to make it easier for someone to do something
the act of helping

ex.en: Could you help me move this desk?
ex.zh: 你能帮我搬这张桌子吗？

ex.en: Older students can help younger ones settle in, which also builds leadership in the older group.
ex.zh: 高年级学生可以帮助新生适应，这也能培养他们的领导能力。

col: help sb with｜在某方面帮助
with the help of｜在……帮助下
tip: help sb (to) do 中的 to 可以省略。

senses.en: a series of musical notes
to adjust a musical instrument

ex.en: The tune is simple.
ex.zh: 这个曲调很简单。

ex.en: A tune without words still needs a time if the concert has a bus.
ex.zh: 如果音乐会要坐公交，没有歌词的曲子仍然需要一个时间。

tip: tune 作动词是调音。

senses.en: the one belonging to you

ex.en: This seat is yours if you want it.
ex.zh: 如果你要，这个座位是你的。

ex.en: Yours sincerely is a safe ending when you know the name but not the person well.
ex.zh: 知道对方姓名但并不熟时，Yours sincerely 是稳妥的信末用语。

tip: 名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。your 是限定词，本库未单列。

senses.en: tall, or great in amount or level

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs near good schools can shut out the families those schools were meant to serve.
ex.zh: 好学校附近的高房价，可能把学校本应服务的家庭挡在外面。

tip: 人的个子用 tall；山、价格、水平用 high。

senses.en: a person who does office work or keeps records

ex.en: The club secretary wrote the minutes.
ex.zh: 社团秘书写了会议记录。

ex.en: A school secretary often knows which families cannot be reached by phone.
ex.zh: 学校秘书常常知道哪些家庭用电话联系不上。

tip: secretary 的复数是 secretaries。

senses.en: to a position on

ex.en: The cat jumped onto the desk.
ex.zh: 猫跳到了书桌上。

ex.en: A ramp onto the platform lets a student with a wheelchair board the same train.
ex.zh: 通向站台的坡道，让坐轮椅的学生能上同一列火车。

tip: onto 强调移动到表面之上。已经在上面用 on。

senses.en: the small part from which a plant grows

ex.en: The seed is in the soil.
ex.zh: 种子在土里。

ex.en: A seed in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
ex.zh: 学校园子里的种子在八月需要水，而那时大多数学生不在。

col: a seed of｜一粒种子；……的萌芽
tip: seed 可数。

senses.en: a date remembered each year

ex.en: The school anniversary is in October.
ex.zh: 校庆在十月。

ex.en: An anniversary speech should name who keeps the building open, not only who founded it.
ex.zh: 周年讲话应当点出是谁让这栋楼一直开着，而不只是谁创办了它。

tip: anniversary 可数。

senses.en: something given to a winner

ex.en: The prize was a book, not money.
ex.zh: 奖品是一本书，不是钱。

ex.en: A prize for attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
ex.zh: 出勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。

tip: prize 是奖品。award 已在本库，更常指正式授予的奖。

senses.en: how fast something moves

ex.en: The car was travelling at a high speed.
ex.zh: 汽车在高速行驶。

ex.en: Lower speed near a school protects children more than a wider road does.
ex.zh: 学校附近降低速度，比把路修得更宽更能保护孩子。

col: at a speed of｜以……的速度
tip: speed 作动词是“加速”，过去式可以是 sped。

senses.en: a formal public event

ex.en: The ceremony starts at ten.
ex.zh: 典礼十点开始。

ex.en: A ceremony still needs a seat for the parent who comes from work.
ex.zh: 典礼仍然要给下班赶来的家长留一个座位。

tip: ceremony 可数。

senses.en: the usual level or mean
A value calculated by dividing a total by the item count.
Have a particular amount as the usual or calculated middle value.

ex.en: His scores are above the average.
ex.zh: 他的分数高于平均水平。

ex.en: Average household spending on energy may fall as better insulation reduces the need for heating.
ex.zh: 随着更好的隔热措施减少供暖需求，家庭能源支出的平均水平可能下降。

tip: on average表示“平均而言”，不用in average。

senses.en: to put something where it cannot be seen, or to go where you cannot be seen

ex.en: Do not hide the broken step behind a sign.
ex.zh: 不要用一块牌子把坏台阶遮住。

ex.en: Students who hide a worry until the exam give the school no time to help.
ex.zh: 把担心藏到考试的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的时间。

col: hide sth from sb｜对某人隐瞒
tip: hide 的过去式是 hid，过去分词是 hidden。

senses.en: a sound, especially a loud or unpleasant one

ex.en: The noise from the road enters the classroom.
ex.zh: 路上的噪声进了教室。

ex.en: Noise at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
ex.zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的噪声就是设计问题。

tip: noise 可数也可不可数。a noise 是一阵声音。

senses.en: a thin piece of wood
to attach, or to continue with

ex.en: The dog brought back a stick.
ex.zh: 狗把一根棍子叼了回来。

ex.en: A walking stick at the school gate is a tool, not something to joke about.
ex.zh: 校门口的拐杖是工具，不是拿来开玩笑的东西。

tip: 动词 stick 的过去式和过去分词是 stuck。stick to 表示坚持。

senses.en: to decide which one you want

ex.en: Choose a question you can explain.
ex.zh: 选一道你能解释的题。

ex.en: Families choose a school they can reach, not only the one with the highest scores.
ex.zh: 家庭选择他们能够到达的学校，而不只是分数最高的那所。

tip: choose 的过去式是 chose，过去分词是 chosen。

senses.en: to remove something written or stored

ex.en: Delete the old time before you write the new one.
ex.zh: 写下新时间之前，先删掉旧时间。

ex.en: Do not delete the only copy of the class list.
ex.zh: 不要删掉班级名单的唯一副本。

tip: delete 比 remove 更常用于文字和文件。

senses.en: in addition to
in addition

ex.en: Besides English, she studies history.
ex.zh: 除了英语，她还学历史。

ex.en: Besides the fare, the later bus matters because students can stay for the club.
ex.zh: 除了票价，晚班车重要是因为学生可以留下参加社团。

tip: besides 表示包括在内的“还有”。except 是排除。作副词是“而且”。

senses.en: a film

ex.en: We saw a movie about a small town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于小镇的电影。

ex.en: A movie can show a problem, but the town still has to decide what to do on Monday.
ex.zh: 电影可以展示一个问题，但城镇仍要决定星期一做什么。

col: go to the movies｜去看电影
tip: movie 是美式常用词；英式更常说 film。

senses.en: a machine that moves liquid or air
to move liquid or air with a pump

ex.en: The pump is off.
ex.zh: 泵关着。

ex.en: A pump that fails in August leaves the garden dry.
ex.zh: 八月坏掉的泵会让园子变干。

tip: pump 作动词是用泵抽。本条不写危险操作。

senses.en: happening often, or shared

ex.en: Colds are common in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天感冒很常见。

ex.en: A common timetable for buses and schools would stop students waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 公交和学校共用的时刻表，能避免学生在黑暗中等候。

tip: common 强调经常发生或共有；ordinary 强调平凡、不特别。

senses.en: to divide into parts

ex.en: Split the class into two groups.
ex.zh: 把班级分成两组。

ex.en: Cities that split one bus into two short routes can help students who live past the old stop.
ex.zh: 把一路公交拆成两条短线的城市，能帮助住在旧站以外的学生。

tip: split 的过去式和过去分词仍是 split。

senses.en: to think that something is true

ex.en: I believe we can finish the project tonight.
ex.zh: 我相信我们今晚能做完这个项目。

ex.en: Students should not believe a chart until they know who collected the numbers and why.
ex.zh: 学生在弄清数字是谁收集的、为什么收集之前，不该轻信一张图表。

col: believe it or not｜信不信由你
tip: believe 后接 that 从句或 sb；believe in 表示信任或信仰。

senses.en: a railway vehicle
to teach a skill

ex.en: The train leaves at seven.
ex.zh: 火车七点开。

ex.en: A late train can make a student miss the first lesson even when the school itself starts on time.
ex.zh: 晚点的火车会让学生错过第一节课，即使学校本身准时开始。

tip: train 作动词是“训练”。

senses.en: thin material for writing, or a newspaper

ex.en: Write your name on the paper.
ex.zh: 把名字写在纸上。

ex.en: A paper exam in a hot room measures heat as well as knowledge.
ex.zh: 炎热房间里的纸笔考试，测量的不只是知识，还有热。

tip: paper 表示纸张时不可数。a paper 可以是一份报纸或一篇论文。

senses.en: facing, or completely different
a person or thing that is completely different
across from

ex.en: The shop is opposite the school.
ex.zh: 商店在学校对面。

ex.en: The opposite choice, a later bus, helps the students who stay for sport.
ex.zh: 相反的选择，也就是晚一班车，能帮助留下来运动的学生。

tip: opposite 作介词也可表示在对面。名词是“相反的事物”。

senses.en: large in size or importance

ex.en: We need a bigger table for the group work.
ex.zh: 小组活动我们需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: A big sports event can fill hotels while leaving ordinary residents with higher rents.
ex.zh: 一场大型体育赛事可以住满酒店，同时让普通居民面对更高的房租。

tip: big 多用于口语；large 更中性，great 强调程度或情感。

senses.en: not able

ex.en: She was unable to attend the first class.
ex.zh: 她没能上第一节课。

ex.en: A student unable to climb the stairs still needs a way into the lab.
ex.zh: 上不了楼梯的学生，仍然需要一条进实验室的路。

tip: unable 后接 to do。able 已在本库。表里这一行的音标不对，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the part of the body at the end of the arm
to pass something to someone

ex.en: Please raise your hand before you speak.
ex.zh: 发言前请举手。

ex.en: A helping hand from an older student can matter more than another printed worksheet.
ex.zh: 高年级学生伸来的一只援手，可能比又一张打印的练习纸更重要。

tip: hand in 是上交。hand 作动词是“递”。

senses.en: a period of ten years

ex.en: The school is a decade old.
ex.zh: 这所学校有十年了。

ex.en: A decade of the same broken step is a choice, not an accident.
ex.zh: 同一个坏台阶过了十年，是一种选择，不是意外。

tip: decade 可数。

senses.en: of the sex that can produce young
a female person or animal

ex.en: The form has a box for male or female.
ex.zh: 表格上有男或女的一栏。

ex.en: A female engineer visiting the class shows a possible job, not only a word in a textbook.
ex.zh: 一位女工程师来到班上，展示的是一种可能的工作，而不只是课本里的一个词。

tip: female 可作形容词或名词。填写表格时表示性别。

senses.en: farming

ex.en: Agriculture still feeds the town.
ex.zh: 农业仍然养活这座城镇。

ex.en: A lesson on agriculture should name who does the work.
ex.zh: 农业课应当写出是谁在干活。

tip: 形容词 agricultural 是本批的另一词。agriculture 通常不可数。

senses.en: a large amount, or ordinary people as a group

ex.en: A mass of leaves blocked the drain.
ex.zh: 一大堆叶子堵住了排水口。

ex.en: The masses use the early bus, so a fare rise hits them before it hits anyone with a car.
ex.zh: 普通大众坐早班车，所以票价上涨先打击他们，而不是有车的人。

tip: a mass of 后可接可数或不可数名词。the masses 指广大民众。

senses.en: of the colour of a lemon or the sun
the colour yellow

ex.en: The yellow bus is ours.
ex.zh: 那辆黄色的车是我们的。

ex.en: Yellow lines on the road mean more when students know why they are there.
ex.zh: 当学生知道黄线为什么在那里时，路上的黄线才更有意义。

tip: yellow 也可作名词“黄色”。

senses.en: to form a picture in the mind

ex.en: Imagine a street where children can walk safely.
ex.zh: 想象一条孩子可以安全走路的街。

ex.en: It is hard to imagine a later school start unless the buses change too.
ex.zh: 除非公交也改时间，否则很难想象推迟上学。

tip: imagine 后接名词、doing 或 that 从句。

senses.en: a set of papers or computer data about one subject

ex.en: Please save the file before you close it.
ex.zh: 关闭前请保存文件。

ex.en: A paper file and a computer file of the same student should not disagree.
ex.zh: 同一名学生的纸质档案和电脑档案不应当互相矛盾。

tip: file 也可作动词“把……归档”。计算机里的文档也叫 file。

senses.en: having a lot of money, or full of something

ex.en: The soil here is rich and good for vegetables.
ex.zh: 这里的土壤肥沃，适合种菜。

ex.en: A rich city can still have neighbourhoods where children share one small room.
ex.zh: 富裕的城市里，仍可能有孩子合住一间小屋的社区。

tip: the rich 表示一类人。rich in 后接所富含的东西。

senses.en: the power to change someone or something
to change how someone thinks or acts

ex.en: His teacher had a strong influence on him.
ex.zh: 老师对他影响很大。

ex.en: Peer influence can push a student toward a club or away from one.
ex.zh: 同伴的影响可以把学生推向一个社团，也可以把他们推开。

col: have an influence on｜对……有影响
under the influence of｜在……影响下
tip: influence 后接 on。作动词时直接接宾语：influence somebody。

senses.en: what something is made of, or information for a piece of work

ex.en: The bag is made of recycled material.
ex.zh: 这个包是用回收材料做的。

ex.en: Teaching material about floods should include the streets children actually use.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的教材应该包括孩子真正走的那些街。

tip: material 作“材料”时可数或不可数。作形容词是“物质的”。

senses.en: a student with a class duty, or a screen

ex.en: The monitor locked the lab.
ex.zh: 班长锁了实验室。

ex.en: A monitor on the wall does not replace a person who knows the students.
ex.zh: 墙上的监视器代替不了认识学生的人。

tip: monitor 也可作动词“监视”。班长是中国课堂里的常用义。

senses.en: an idea that someone offers

ex.en: The suggestion is on the board.
ex.zh: 建议写在黑板上。

ex.en: A suggestion about the bus should include the return time.
ex.zh: 关于公交的建议应当包括返回时间。

tip: 动词 suggest 已在本库。suggestion 可数。

senses.en: the child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: Her cousin will share the book.
ex.zh: 她的表姐会和她合用这本书。

ex.en: A form that says cousin should still leave space for another name.
ex.zh: 写着表亲的表格，仍然应当给另一个名字留出位置。

tip: cousin 可指表兄弟或表姐妹，不标明性别。

senses.en: the reflexive form of we

ex.en: We cleaned the lab ourselves.
ex.zh: 实验室是我们自己打扫的。

ex.en: We cannot blame the timetable if we wrote it ourselves and left out the last bus.
ex.zh: 如果课表是我们自己写的，又漏了末班车，就不能怪课表。

tip: ourselves 是反身代词。by ourselves 表示独自。

senses.en: to say you will give or do something
a proposal to give or pay

ex.en: The library offers a quiet room after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆放学后提供一间安静的房间。

ex.en: Towns that offer night buses help workers who finish after the regular service stops.
ex.zh: 提供夜班公交的城镇，帮助那些在常规班次停运后才下班的工人。

tip: offer 后可接 to do 或双宾语。

senses.en: to have one's home, or to be alive
happening now, or alive

ex.en: We live near the old market.
ex.zh: 我们住在旧市场附近。

ex.en: People who live beside a busy road pay a health cost that does not appear on the rent receipt.
ex.zh: 住在繁忙道路旁的人承担着健康代价，而这不会出现在房租收据上。

tip: live 作动词读 /lɪv/；作形容词“现场的”读 /laɪv/。

senses.en: fitting closely, or firmly fixed

ex.en: The lid is too tight.
ex.zh: 盖子太紧了。

ex.en: A tight budget can still buy the lock if the lab door does not close.
ex.zh: 如果实验室的门关不上，紧的预算也仍然应当先买锁。

tip: tight 可形容衣服、时间或预算。

senses.en: a type
to arrange into groups

ex.en: What sort of book do you want?
ex.zh: 你想要哪一种书？

ex.en: The sort of food sold at the gate shapes what students eat between lessons.
ex.zh: 门口卖的食物种类，影响着学生课间吃什么。

tip: sort 作动词是“分类”。

senses.en: a planned piece of work

ex.en: Our project is about the river behind the school.
ex.zh: 我们的课题是关于学校后面的河。

ex.en: A project that never asks local people can solve the wrong problem.
ex.zh: 从不询问当地人的项目，可能会解决一个错误的问题。

tip: project 作名词重音常在前；作动词“投射、预计”时重音常在后。

senses.en: kindness shown when you could punish

ex.en: The story ends with mercy, not with shame.
ex.zh: 故事以怜悯结束，不是以羞辱结束。

ex.en: Mercy for a late form is fair when the bus never came.
ex.zh: 公交根本没来时，原谅迟交的表格是公平的。

tip: mercy 通常不可数。

senses.en: a woman who acts in plays or films

ex.en: The actress visited the drama club.
ex.zh: 这位女演员来了戏剧社。

ex.en: An actress who only reads the lines still needs the crew that built the set.
ex.zh: 只念台词的女演员，仍然需要搭景的那组人。

tip: actor 已在本库，现在也可泛指演员。actress 专指女演员。

senses.en: liked by many people

ex.en: The reading club is popular this term.
ex.zh: 读书社团这学期很受欢迎。

ex.en: A popular beach can damage the very coast people come to see.
ex.zh: 受欢迎的海滩可能破坏人们前来观看的那片海岸。

tip: popular 后接 with 表示受某类人欢迎。

senses.en: to repair, or to decide

ex.en: Can you fix the clock in the hall?
ex.zh: 你能修大厅里的钟吗？

ex.en: Cities should fix the crossing before they fix the paint on the school wall.
ex.zh: 城市应当先修好路口，再去刷学校墙上的漆。

tip: fix 在美式口语里常指修理。确定日期也用 fix。

senses.en: a room for art, music, or broadcasting

ex.en: The art studio is on the top floor.
ex.zh: 美术工作室在顶楼。

ex.en: A studio with one door still needs a window that opens.
ex.zh: 只有一扇门的工作室，仍然需要一扇能开的窗。

tip: studio 可数。复数是 studios。

senses.en: done in a short time

ex.en: We had a quick review before the test.
ex.zh: 测验前我们快速复习了一下。

ex.en: A quick warning is useless if the path to higher ground is not marked.
ex.zh: 如果通往高地的路没有标出，快速的警报也没有用。

tip: quick 的副词是 quickly。fast 本身可作副词。

senses.en: from one side to the other
from one side to the other

ex.en: There is a bookshop across the street.
ex.zh: 街对面有一家书店。

ex.en: A bridge across the river can cut a student's journey from an hour to ten minutes.
ex.zh: 河上的一座桥可以把学生的路程从一小时缩短到十分钟。

tip: across 强调从表面一边到另一边；through 强调从内部穿过。

senses.en: mail, a job, or a pole
to send by mail, or to put up a notice

ex.en: I will send the form by post.
ex.zh: 我会把表格寄出。

ex.en: A post in a village school is hard to fill if the teacher must travel two hours each way.
ex.zh: 如果老师每天要单程走两小时，乡村学校的岗位就很难有人来。

tip: post 作动词是“邮寄”或“张贴”。美式邮件多用 mail。

senses.en: a container of soft material

ex.en: My bag is under the desk.
ex.zh: 我的包在桌子下面。

ex.en: A clear bag rule at the gate should still leave room for a student's medicine.
ex.zh: 门口的透明包规定，仍应当给学生的药留出位置。

tip: bag 可数。a bag of 后接所装的东西。

senses.en: a stick used in some ball games, or a flying animal

ex.en: The bat is in the sports room.
ex.zh: 球棒在体育室。

ex.en: A bat in the school roof is a reason to call an adult, not to chase it.
ex.zh: 屋顶上的蝙蝠是叫成年人的理由，不是去追它。

tip: 球棒和蝙蝠是同一个词。本条不写如何伤害动物。

senses.en: British spelling of organization

ex.en: The organisation runs the late bus.
ex.zh: 这个组织运营晚班车。

ex.en: An organisation that hides its fees is harder for families to trust.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的组织更难让家庭信任。

tip: organisation 是英式，organization 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: money paid for a service

ex.en: The fee is on the notice.
ex.zh: 费用写在通知上。

ex.en: A fee that is not written down is not a choice a family can make.
ex.zh: 没写下来的费用，不是家庭能够作出的选择。

tip: fee 可数。学费常用复数 fees。

senses.en: to be the right size or kind
healthy, or suitable

ex.en: These shoes do not fit.
ex.zh: 这双鞋不合脚。

ex.en: A school timetable should fit the buses, or students will arrive after the lesson has started.
ex.zh: 课表应该配合公交，否则学生会在课开始后才到。

tip: fit 作形容词是“健康的”或“适合的”。过去式可以是 fitted。

senses.en: usual and expected

ex.en: It is normal to feel nervous before a test.
ex.zh: 考试前紧张是正常的。

ex.en: A normal school day becomes unsafe when the road outside has no pavement.
ex.zh: 当外面的路没有人行道时，普通的上学日会变得不安全。

tip: normal 是形容词；normally 是副词。

senses.en: a game played with a racket and a ball

ex.en: Tennis practice is at four.
ex.zh: 网球训练在四点。

ex.en: A tennis court that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的网球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。

tip: play tennis 不加 the。

senses.en: a person who takes photographs

ex.en: The photographer asked before taking the picture.
ex.zh: 摄影师拍照前先问过。

ex.en: A photographer at a school event should not post a face without permission.
ex.zh: 学校活动的摄影师不应当未经允许发布人脸。

tip: 名词 photograph 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: to think about carefully
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: Please consider my advice before deciding.
ex.zh: 做决定前请考虑我的建议。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: trust in paying later, a school unit, or praise

ex.en: She got extra credit for the project.
ex.zh: 她因这个课题得到了额外学分。

ex.en: Credit for a cleaner river belongs to the people who stopped the waste, not only to the speech.
ex.zh: 把河变干净的功劳属于制止排污的人，而不只属于那篇讲话。

tip: credit 的几个义要靠搭配区分。

senses.en: connected with a god, or treated with great respect

ex.en: The visit included a sacred place for those who wanted it.
ex.zh: 参观包括一处圣地，给想去的人。

ex.en: A school can explain a sacred object without telling every student to believe.
ex.zh: 学校可以讲解一件圣物，而不要求每个学生去信。

tip: 表里的中文写成了 scared（害怕）。音标是 sacred，本库按“神圣的”写。本条不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a cover for the face
to hide something

ex.en: The mask is by the clinic door.
ex.zh: 口罩在医务室门边。

ex.en: A mask in a health lesson is a tool, and the lesson should say when to change it.
ex.zh: 健康课里的口罩是工具，课上应当说明何时更换。

tip: mask 作动词是掩饰。本条不写如何伤害。

senses.en: to succeed, hand over, or go by
a permit, or a successful result

ex.en: I hope to pass the listening test.
ex.zh: 我希望通过听力测验。

ex.en: Students who pass a crowded junction every morning need a light, not only a higher test score.
ex.zh: 每天早晨经过拥挤路口的学生需要一盏灯，而不只是更高的考分。

tip: pass 的过去式是 passed。past 是介词或名词，不要拼混。

senses.en: belonging to a king or queen

ex.en: The royal garden is open on Sunday.
ex.zh: 皇家花园周日开放。

ex.en: A royal visit fills the news, while the town's ordinary market still has to open on Monday.
ex.zh: 王室来访会占满新闻，而镇上的普通集市周一仍然得开。

tip: royal 是形容词。国王或女王用 king、queen。

senses.en: a sweet food made by bees

ex.en: There is honey in the tea.
ex.zh: 茶里有蜂蜜。

ex.en: Honey that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的蜂蜜应当在标签上写明。

col: a spoon of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
tip: honey 通常不可数。表里这一行的音标是 honest，本库不用。

senses.en: usual weather of a place
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: The climate here is warm and wet.
ex.zh: 这里的气候温暖潮湿。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: a senior official who represents a country abroad

ex.en: The ambassador visited the school.
ex.zh: 大使参观了学校。

ex.en: A speech by an ambassador does not replace the bus the town was promised.
ex.zh: 大使的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。

tip: ambassador 可数。

senses.en: a small animal often kept as a pet

ex.en: The cat sleeps in the sunny window.
ex.zh: 猫睡在有阳光的窗台上。

ex.en: A school rule about the office cat should say who feeds it on holiday.
ex.zh: 关于办公室那只猫的规定，应当写明假期谁喂它。

tip: cat 可数。雄猫是 tomcat，小猫是 kitten。

senses.en: a location, or a position

ex.en: This is a good place to wait for the bus.
ex.zh: 这是等公交的好地方。

ex.en: Every child needs a place to study that is safe, even if that place is a shared table.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都需要一个安全的学习地方，哪怕那只是一张共用的桌子。

tip: take place 表示发生，没有被动语态。

senses.en: a piece of clothing, or clothes in general
to put clothes on

ex.en: She wore a blue dress to the concert.
ex.zh: 她穿着蓝裙子去听音乐会。

ex.en: A dress code that costs too much keeps some students out of the photo.
ex.zh: 花费过高的着装要求，会让一些学生进不了合影。

tip: dress 作动词是穿衣。给某人穿上用 dress sb。

senses.en: to travel through a place to learn about it, or to examine an idea

ex.en: Explore the map before the trip.
ex.zh: 出行前先研究地图。

ex.en: Students explore a question better when the source is named.
ex.zh: 写明来源时，学生能更好地探究一个问题。

col: explore a place｜探索一个地方
tip: explore 不用于“探索危险操作”。

senses.en: a small animal, or a device that moves a pointer

ex.en: The mouse is beside the keyboard.
ex.zh: 鼠标在键盘旁边。

ex.en: A mouse in the lab cupboard is a reason to close the food, not a joke.
ex.zh: 实验室柜子里的老鼠是把食物收起来的理由，不是笑话。

tip: 复数是 mice。动物和鼠标是同一个词。

senses.en: a show, or a plan of events; British spelling

ex.en: The programme starts at seven.
ex.zh: 节目七点开始。

ex.en: A reading programme fails if the books never reach the classroom.
ex.zh: 如果书从来到不了教室，阅读计划就会失败。

tip: programme 是英式，常指节目或计划。计算机程序英美都常用 program，已在本库。两条都保留。

senses.en: a road vehicle with an engine

ex.en: My uncle drives a small car to work.
ex.zh: 我叔叔开一辆小汽车上班。

ex.en: Fewer car trips to school would clear the air on the narrow street outside the gate.
ex.zh: 减少开车上学的次数，能改善校门外窄街上的空气。

tip: by car 不加冠词。

senses.en: the first meal of the day

ex.en: Breakfast is at seven in the hall.
ex.zh: 早饭七点在食堂。

ex.en: A student who skips breakfast often loses the first lesson, not only the meal.
ex.zh: 不吃早饭的学生常常丢掉的是第一节课，而不只是那一餐。

tip: breakfast 前通常不用 a。have breakfast 不加 the。

senses.en: help

ex.en: The office offers assistance with the form.
ex.zh: 办公室帮助填写表格。

ex.en: Financial assistance for the trip should be quiet, so no student is named in public.
ex.zh: 出行的经济帮助应当安静地进行，这样就不会在公开场合点学生的名。

col: come to one's assistance｜来帮助某人
tip: assistance 通常不可数。assistant 已在本库。

senses.en: stories that are imagined, not fact

ex.en: The library keeps fiction on the left.
ex.zh: 图书馆把小说放在左边。

ex.en: Fiction about a flood can start a discussion, and the bus time still has to be fact.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的小说可以开启讨论，公交时间却必须是事实。

tip: fiction 通常不可数。a work of fiction 是一部虚构作品。

senses.en: to write or say the letters of a word

ex.en: Spell your name on the form.
ex.zh: 在表格上拼写你的名字。

ex.en: Students who can spell the stop can also find it on the map.
ex.zh: 能拼出站名的学生，也能在地图上找到它。

col: spell out｜逐字母拼出；讲清楚
tip: spell 的过去式是 spelt 或 spelled。表里这一行的音标是 speed，本库不用。

senses.en: a flat piece of wood, or a group that directs an organisation

ex.en: The teacher wrote the date on the board.
ex.zh: 老师把日期写在黑板上。

ex.en: A school board that never visits classrooms may not see why a class of forty is hard to teach.
ex.zh: 从不进教室的校董会，可能看不到四十人的班为什么难教。

tip: board 作动词是“上船、上车”。

senses.en: to stop and hold, to be in time, or to get an illness

ex.en: Catch the ball with both hands.
ex.zh: 用双手接球。

ex.en: Students who catch the early bus avoid the crowd that builds up outside the gate.
ex.zh: 赶上早班车的学生，可以避开校门口越聚越多的人。

tip: catch 的过去式和过去分词是 caught。catch up with 表示追上。

senses.en: a person who speaks, or a device for sound

ex.en: The speaker asked for questions.
ex.zh: 演讲者请大家提问。

ex.en: A speaker at the back of the hall helps the student who cannot move forward.
ex.zh: 大厅后面的扬声器能帮助不能往前走的学生。

tip: 动词 speak 已在本库。speaker 也可指说某种语言的人。

senses.en: a plan of action by a government or organisation

ex.en: The new policy limits cars near the school.
ex.zh: 新政策限制学校附近的汽车。

ex.en: A housing policy that ignores bus routes pushes workers farther from their jobs.
ex.zh: 忽视公交线路的住房政策，会把工人推得离工作更远。

tip: policy 是可数名词：a policy。politics 是“政治”。

senses.en: a position in an organization or a list

ex.en: She rose to the rank of monitor.
ex.zh: 她升到了班长这个职位。

ex.en: Rank in a class should not decide who may use the library.
ex.zh: 班里的名次不应当决定谁可以用图书馆。

tip: rank 作动词是排列或位列。

senses.en: to feel deep affection, or to like very much
a strong feeling of affection

ex.en: I love the smell of the library in the morning.
ex.zh: 我喜欢早晨图书馆的气味。

ex.en: People who love a place are often the first to notice when its river or dialect is disappearing.
ex.zh: 热爱一个地方的人，往往最先注意到它的河流或方言正在消失。

tip: love 后可接 doing 或 to do，口语里 doing 更常见。

senses.en: a place, or a small mark

ex.en: This spot by the window is good for reading.
ex.zh: 窗边这个位置适合读书。

ex.en: A quiet spot in a noisy city can matter as much as a large park that is hard to reach.
ex.zh: 喧闹城市里一个安静的角落，可能和一座难以到达的大公园一样重要。

tip: spot 作动词是“发现”或“弄上污点”。

senses.en: used to say what is right or expected

ex.en: You ought to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 你应该锁上实验室。

ex.en: A city ought to write the bus time before it asks families to trust the plan.
ex.zh: 城市在要求家庭信任计划之前，应该先写下公交时间。

tip: ought 后接 to。否定是 ought not to。没有过去式变化。

senses.en: a change meant to improve a system
to improve a system by changing it

ex.en: The reform of the bus route is on the notice.
ex.zh: 公交线路的改革写在通知上。

ex.en: A reform that ignores the last bus will look modern and still fail.
ex.zh: 不考虑末班车的改革看起来现代，仍然会失败。

tip: reform 作动词是改革。

senses.en: to let someone see, or to prove
a public performance or display

ex.en: Show me your ticket, please.
ex.zh: 请出示你的票。

ex.en: The data show that night markets bring noise as well as income to the streets around them.
ex.zh: 数据表明，夜市给周围街道带来收入的同时，也带来噪音。

tip: show sb sth 双宾语；过去分词是 shown。

senses.en: higher than, or more than
in a higher place

ex.en: The clock is above the door.
ex.zh: 钟在门的上方。

ex.en: Temperatures above forty degrees make outdoor sports unsafe for younger students.
ex.zh: 超过四十度的气温会让低龄学生的户外运动不安全。

tip: above 强调位置更高，不一定垂直；over 常有“正上方”或“越过”的意思。

senses.en: ready to face danger or difficulty

ex.en: She was brave enough to report the broken step.
ex.zh: 她有勇气报告那级坏台阶。

ex.en: A brave reply still needs a fact, not only a loud voice.
ex.zh: 勇敢的回答仍然需要事实，而不只是大嗓门。

tip: brave 也可作动词“勇敢面对”。

senses.en: the fact of owning something

ex.en: Ownership of the lab books is the school.
ex.zh: 这些实验书的所有权属于学校。

ex.en: Clear ownership of a lost bag helps it return.
ex.zh: 遗失包的所有权写清楚，它才容易回到主人手里。

tip: owner 已在本库。ownership 通常不可数。

senses.en: a public performance of music

ex.en: The concert is in the hall on Friday.
ex.zh: 音乐会周五在礼堂。

ex.en: A free concert still needs a seat for the parent who comes straight from work.
ex.zh: 免费音乐会仍然要给刚下班赶来的家长留一个座位。

col: go to a concert｜去听音乐会
tip: concert 可数。in concert 也可表示一致行动。

senses.en: to produce tears, or to shout
a shout or a period of crying

ex.en: The child did not cry; he asked for help.
ex.zh: 孩子没有哭，他求了助。

ex.en: A cry for help in a crowded hall needs a person, not only a camera.
ex.zh: 拥挤大厅里的呼救需要一个人，而不只是一台摄像机。

tip: cry 作名词是哭声或呼喊。

senses.en: to get something by paying money

ex.en: I will buy a notebook after class.
ex.zh: 课后我去买一本笔记本。

ex.en: Families buy less fresh food when the nearest market is an hour away by bus.
ex.zh: 当最近的市场要坐一小时公交时，家庭会少买新鲜食物。

tip: buy 的过去式和过去分词是 bought。

senses.en: the outside limit of something

ex.en: Stand back from the edge of the platform.
ex.zh: 站在站台边缘后面。

ex.en: Houses on the edge of town are the first to lose the bus when a route is cut.
ex.zh: 城镇边缘的房子，在线路被削减时最先失去公交。

tip: on edge 表示紧张。at the edge 是在边上。

senses.en: not long, or not tall

ex.en: It is a short walk from here to the gate.
ex.zh: 从这里到门口走路不远。

ex.en: Short breaks between lessons help attention more than one long break at the end of the day.
ex.zh: 课间的短休息比一天结束时一次长休息更有助于注意力。

tip: short 可指时间、长度或身材。shortly 是“不久”，不是“短地”。

senses.en: a group of words that expresses a complete idea
