to state a punishment in court

ex.en: Write one sentence to explain the chart.
ex.zh: 写一句话解释这张图。

ex.en: A long sentence that hides the number is less honest than a short one.
ex.zh: 把数字藏起来的长句，不如短句诚实。

tip: sentence 也可指判决。本条以语法义为主，法律义在第二个义项。

senses.en: by way of

ex.en: We came via the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们经由旧桥过来。

ex.en: News via a phone app is fast, but a named source is still necessary.
ex.zh: 通过手机应用传来的新闻很快，但署名的来源仍然必要。

tip: via 是介词，后接名词，多用于书面。

senses.en: to have clothes or glasses on the body

ex.en: Wear glasses in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里戴眼镜。

ex.en: Students wear the same uniform, but their journeys to school are not the same length.
ex.zh: 学生穿同样的校服，但他们上学的路程并不一样长。

tip: wear 表示穿着的状态；put on 表示穿上的动作。过去式是 wore。

senses.en: money, or the management of money

ex.en: The club has no finance for a second trip.
ex.zh: 社团没有再出行一次的经费。

ex.en: School finance should be public enough for parents to see where the lunch money goes.
ex.zh: 学校财务应当公开到家长能看见午餐钱去了哪里。

tip: finance 作动词是提供资金。形容词是 financial。

senses.en: gradual change over time

ex.en: The chapter explains evolution in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话解释进化。

ex.en: The evolution of the bus route is written on one sheet.
ex.zh: 公交线路的演变写在一张纸上。

tip: evolution 通常不可数。

senses.en: a bar, or the railway

ex.en: Hold the rail on the stairs.
ex.zh: 在楼梯上抓住栏杆。

ex.en: Travel by rail fails if the station has no late train.
ex.zh: 如果车站没有晚班火车，乘铁路出行就会失败。

tip: railway 已在本库。by rail 不加冠词。

senses.en: a spoken or written account
to give an account of

ex.en: Please hand in the lab report tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天交实验报告。

ex.en: A news report should show what is certain and what is still only a claim.
ex.zh: 新闻报道应该标明哪些是确定的，哪些仍只是说法。

tip: report 作动词是“报告”或“举报”：report sth to sb。

senses.en: a place where people cross a road

ex.en: The crossing needs a light.
ex.zh: 这个人行横道需要一盏灯。

ex.en: A crossing without a light pushes students into the road.
ex.zh: 没有灯的人行横道把学生挤到路上。

tip: 动词 cross 已在本库。crossing 是名词。

senses.en: to put over, include, or report
the outside of a book, or a lid

ex.en: The map covers the whole town.
ex.zh: 这张地图覆盖整个城镇。

ex.en: News that covers only the city centre misses the villages where the flood starts.
ex.zh: 只报道市中心的新闻，会漏掉洪水开始的那些村子。

tip: cover 作名词是“封面”或“覆盖物”。

senses.en: a game played with a bat and a ball

ex.en: Baseball practice is after school.
ex.zh: 棒球训练在放学后。

ex.en: A baseball field that locks at dusk leaves the late class outside.
ex.zh: 黄昏就锁上的棒球场，把下课晚的班级留在外面。

tip: 球类前通常不加 the：play baseball。

senses.en: bravery

ex.en: It takes courage to speak in public.
ex.zh: 公开演讲需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.en: to deal with a situation
the part you hold

ex.en: She can handle the tickets for the trip.
ex.zh: 她能处理这次出行的票。

ex.en: Teachers handle a sudden illness better when the clinic number is on the wall.
ex.zh: 当医务室电话写在墙上时，老师能更好地处理突发疾病。

tip: handle 作名词是“把手”。作动词是处理或用手操作。

senses.en: in all places

ex.en: There were books everywhere after the fair.
ex.zh: 书展之后到处都是书。

ex.en: Signs that appear everywhere and say nothing clear do not help a new student.
ex.zh: 到处都是却什么也没说清的牌子，帮不了新生。

tip: everywhere 是副词，前面不加 in。

senses.en: the act of giving one thing and receiving another
to give something and receive something else

ex.en: The language exchange meets on Thursday.
ex.zh: 语言交流活动周四举行。

ex.en: A fair exchange of ideas needs time for the quieter student to answer.
ex.zh: 公平的思想交流需要时间，让较安静的学生也能回答。

col: in exchange for｜作为对……的交换
tip: exchange 作动词时，说 exchange A for B。

senses.en: money in coins or notes

ex.en: I paid in cash.
ex.zh: 我用现金付了款。

ex.en: A market that only takes cash still serves people who have no bank card.
ex.zh: 只收现金的市场，仍然服务没有银行卡的人。

tip: cash 不可数。

senses.en: a kind act; American spelling of favour
to support or prefer

ex.en: Could you do me a favor and hold the door?
ex.zh: 请帮个忙，扶一下门好吗？

ex.en: A favor that must be repaid in public is not a favor.
ex.zh: 必须当众偿还的忙，就不是帮忙。

col: do sb a favor｜帮某人一个忙
tip: favor 是美式，favour 是英式。它不是 favourite。favourite 是“最喜爱的”，美式 favorite 已在本库。

senses.en: a gas that people need to live

ex.en: The textbook names oxygen as a gas.
ex.zh: 课本把氧气作为一种气体来讲。

ex.en: A lesson on oxygen should stay with the word and the warning, not a method.
ex.zh: 氧气课应当停在这个词和警告上，而不是做法。

tip: oxygen 通常不可数。本条是科普词汇，不写实验步骤。

senses.en: a wild animal like a large dog

ex.en: The story has a wolf, not a pet.
ex.zh: 故事里有一只狼，不是宠物。

ex.en: A lesson about the wolf should say where it can live, not how to harm it.
ex.zh: 关于狼的课应当说它能住在哪里，而不是如何伤害它。

tip: 复数是 wolves。

senses.en: without a plan or pattern

ex.en: The names were chosen at random.
ex.zh: 名字是随机抽的。

ex.en: A random check of the lab list finds the bottle that nobody labelled.
ex.zh: 随机检查实验室清单，能发现没人贴标签的那瓶。

tip: at random 表示任意地、随机地。

senses.en: to go to see a person or place
an act of visiting

ex.en: We will visit the museum on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五去参观博物馆。

ex.en: Leaders who visit a flooded street themselves ask better questions than those who only read a report.
ex.zh: 亲自走访积水街道的负责人，比只读报告的人问出更好的问题。

tip: visit 可作动词或名词：a visit to。

senses.en: something given for good work
to give something for good work

ex.en: The reward is a book, not a speech.
ex.zh: 奖赏是一本书，不是一篇讲话。

ex.en: A reward that only the confident students can reach is not yet fair.
ex.zh: 只有自信的学生够得着的奖赏还不算公平。

tip: reward 作动词是奖赏。

senses.zh: 全体船员；一组工作人员
senses.en: a group of people working together on a ship, plane, or task

ex.en: The crew checked the doors before the trip.
ex.zh: 出发前工作人员检查了门。

ex.en: A film crew in the playground should not block the way to the clinic.
ex.zh: 操场上的摄制组不应当堵住去医务室的路。

tip: crew 是集体名词。谓语可用单数或复数。

senses.en: to protect from attack
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: Soldiers defend the city from danger.
ex.zh: 士兵们保卫城市免受危险。

ex.en: Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.
ex.zh: 政府应捍卫公民权利，同时确保公共安全措施公平且适度。

col: defend a decision｜为某项决定辩护
tip: defend ... against/from ...表示保护……免受……。

senses.en: the part of the body where the arm joins

ex.en: She carried the bag on one shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把包扛在一个肩上。

ex.en: Pain in the shoulder after a long exam is a reason to stand up.
ex.zh: 长时间考试后肩膀疼，是站起来的理由。

tip: 路肩也叫 shoulder。

senses.en: people watching or listening
People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped after the show.
ex.zh: 演出结束后观众鼓掌。

ex.en: Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.
ex.zh: 网络平台使博物馆能够接触更广泛的受众，包括无法亲自参观馆藏的人。

col: reach a wider audience｜触达更广泛的受众
tip: 观众多用large audience，不用many audiences。

senses.en: every person

ex.en: Everyone in our class has a reading partner.
ex.zh: 我们班每个人都有阅读伙伴。

ex.en: A park that looks open to everyone may still be hard to reach for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 一座看起来对所有人开放的公园，对使用轮椅的人仍可能很难到达。

tip: everyone 作主语时谓语用单数。

senses.en: not correct

ex.en: I put the wrong date on the form.
ex.zh: 我在表格上写错了日期。

ex.en: It is wrong to judge a school only by one test if many students arrive already behind.
ex.zh: 如果许多学生入学时已经落后，只用一次考试评价学校是不对的。

tip: wrong 作副词较少；做错事常用 do wrong 或副词 wrongly。

senses.en: a sudden dangerous situation

ex.en: The number for an emergency is on the wall.
ex.zh: 紧急电话写在墙上。

ex.en: An emergency plan that nobody has practised is only a piece of paper.
ex.zh: 没人演练过的应急方案只是一张纸。

col: in an emergency｜在紧急情况下
tip: emergency 可数。in case of emergency 是常见告示。

senses.en: to pull something along the ground

ex.en: Drag the chair; do not lift it alone.
ex.zh: 把椅子拖过去，不要一个人抬。

ex.en: Do not drag a bag across the wet lab floor.
ex.zh: 不要在湿的实验室地板上拖包。

tip: drag 是普通动词。本条用搬东西的意思。

senses.en: the physical world, or a person's character

ex.en: We walked in nature after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在大自然里走了走。

ex.en: Protecting nature along a river also protects the drinking water of the next town.
ex.zh: 保护河边的自然，也保护下一个城镇的饮用水。

tip: nature 通常不可数。

senses.en: something difficult that needs to be dealt with

ex.en: The main problem is the noise from the road.
ex.zh: 主要问题是路上的噪音。

ex.en: A traffic problem will not disappear if a city only widens the same road again.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市只是再次拓宽同一条路，交通问题不会消失。

tip: problem 是可数名词。question 是提出的问题；problem 是需要解决的困难。

senses.en: the brother of a parent, or the husband of a parent's sister

ex.en: Her uncle will meet the bus.
ex.zh: 她的叔叔会去接公交。

ex.en: A form that says uncle should also leave space for another adult.
ex.zh: 写着叔叔的表格，也应当给另一位成年人留出位置。

tip: uncle 可数。具体是叔、伯、舅还是姑父，要看家庭。

senses.en: to answer
an answer

ex.en: Please reply to the e-mail today.
ex.zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。

ex.en: A reply that arrives after the bus has left is too late.
ex.zh: 公交已经开走之后才到的答复太晚了。

col: in reply to｜作为对……的答复
tip: reply to something。名词也是 reply。

senses.en: a thick liquid used for fuel or cooking

ex.en: The bus uses less oil after the new route.
ex.zh: 新线路之后这辆公交更省油。

ex.en: Dependence on oil makes a town's bus fares rise whenever the world price jumps.
ex.zh: 对石油的依赖会让城镇的公交票价在世界油价跳跃时上涨。

tip: oil 通常不可数。

senses.en: not to succeed, or not to pass a test

ex.en: She did not fail the test.
ex.zh: 她测验没有不及格。

ex.en: A plan can fail and still teach the class what to change next time.
ex.zh: 一个计划可以失败，同时仍然教会班级下次改什么。

tip: fail 后可接考试：fail the exam。未能做某事用 fail to do。名词 failure 已在本库。

senses.en: a digital versatile disc

ex.en: The DVD of the concert is in the library.
ex.zh: 音乐会的影碟在图书馆。

ex.en: A DVD still helps when the network cannot play the film.
ex.zh: 网络放不了这部影片时，影碟仍然有用。

tip: DVD 是 digital versatile disc 的缩写。书写常用大写。

senses.en: a short part of a text, or a way through

ex.en: Read the passage, then name the source.
ex.zh: 读这段文字，然后写出来源。

ex.en: A passage to the clinic should not be blocked by furniture.
ex.zh: 去医务室的通道不应当被家具挡住。

tip: 阅读理解里的 passage 是文章节选。

senses.en: a metal piece for a lock, or the most important thing
most important

ex.en: I left my key in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在教室了。

ex.en: The key to a later school start is a bus timetable that changes with it.
ex.zh: 推迟上学时间的关键，是一份随之改变的公交时刻表。

tip: the key to 后接名词或 doing，介词是 to。

senses.en: to say words, or to talk a language

ex.en: She can speak English and Chinese.
ex.zh: 她会说英语和中文。

ex.en: Leaders who speak only to cameras miss the questions people ask at the bus stop.
ex.zh: 只对镜头说话的负责人，听不到人们在车站提出的问题。

tip: 说某种语言用 speak，不说 say English。

senses.en: to offer a price
an offer of a price

ex.en: The firm will bid for the roof repair.
ex.zh: 这家公司将投标修屋顶。

ex.en: A bid that hides the fee is not a bid the school should accept.
ex.zh: 隐瞒费用的投标，不是学校该接受的投标。

tip: bid 作名词是出价。告别也有 bid somebody goodbye，本条以出价为主。

senses.en: to make someone known, or to bring something in

ex.en: Please introduce the new student.
ex.zh: 请介绍这位新同学。

ex.en: Cities introduce a new bus only after they write the time.
ex.zh: 城市在写下时间之后才推出新公交。

col: introduce sb to｜把某人介绍给
tip: 名词 introduction 已在本库。introduce A to B。

senses.en: a violent act, or a sudden illness
to try to hurt or criticise

ex.en: The article is an attack on the new plan, not a description of it.
ex.zh: 这篇文章是对新计划的抨击，不是对它的描述。

ex.en: A heart attack far from a clinic is more dangerous than the same illness near one.
ex.zh: 远离诊所的心脏病发作，比在诊所附近更危险。

tip: attack 作动词直接接宾语，不加 to。

senses.en: to send out air, or to be moved by the wind

ex.en: The wind can blow the door shut.
ex.zh: 风能把门吹上。

ex.en: If the wind blows the sign down, the crossing is still there and still needs a light.
ex.zh: 如果风把牌子吹倒，路口还在，仍然需要一盏灯。

tip: blow 的过去式是 blew，过去分词是 blown。blow up 表示爆炸时，本库不写方法。

senses.en: not able to happen or be done

ex.en: It is impossible to finish this in one minute.
ex.zh: 一分钟内完成这件事是不可能的。

ex.en: A timetable that looks impossible on paper may still work if two classes share a room.
ex.zh: 纸上看起来不可能的课表，如果两个班共用一间教室，仍可能行得通。

tip: 说 It is impossible to do，不说 somebody is impossible to do。

senses.en: a wild plant growing where it is not wanted
to remove weeds

ex.en: The weed is by the path.
ex.zh: 杂草在路边。

ex.en: A weed in the school garden is easier to pull when the soil is wet.
ex.zh: 土湿的时候，学校园子里的杂草更好拔。

tip: weed 可数。作动词是除草。本条不写药剂。

senses.en: in front, or in the future

ex.en: The museum is just ahead.
ex.zh: 博物馆就在前面。

ex.en: Planning ahead for a flood is cheaper than repairing the same street every year.
ex.zh: 提前为洪水做计划，比每年修补同一条街更省。

tip: ahead 是副词，不直接接宾语；要接宾语用 ahead of。

senses.en: to free someone or something from a problem

ex.en: We need to get rid of the broken chairs.
ex.zh: 我们需要处理掉坏椅子。

ex.en: A town cannot get rid of a flood by painting the wall.
ex.zh: 一座城镇不能靠刷墙来摆脱洪水。

tip: 最常见的搭配是 get rid of。rid 的过去式和过去分词是 rid。

senses.en: to look at and understand written words

ex.en: I read the notice twice to be sure.
ex.zh: 我把通知读了两遍以确认。

ex.en: Children who read with an adult at home often arrive at school ready to enjoy longer books.
ex.zh: 在家有成年人和他们一起阅读的孩子，上学时往往已经准备好享受更长的书。

tip: read 的过去式和过去分词与原形拼写相同，但读作 /red/。

senses.en: to turn round quickly
a fast turn

ex.en: The wheel began to spin.
ex.zh: 轮子开始旋转。

ex.en: Do not spin the chair in a crowded lab.
ex.zh: 不要在拥挤的实验室里转动椅子。

tip: spin 的过去式和过去分词是 spun。

senses.en: to become aware of something
a written announcement, or attention

ex.en: Did you notice the new timetable?
ex.zh: 你注意到新课表了吗？

ex.en: Teachers notice when a usually loud student becomes quiet for several days.
ex.zh: 一个平时很闹的学生连续几天变安静时，老师会注意到。

tip: notice 后可接名词或 that 从句。布告栏上的那张纸也叫 notice。

senses.en: very likely

ex.en: She will probably arrive before eight.
ex.zh: 她大概会在八点前到。

ex.en: A town will probably lose young workers if the only jobs are in a city two hours away.
ex.zh: 如果仅有的工作在两小时外的城市，城镇很可能会失去年轻工人。

tip: probably 是副词；形容词是 probable。

senses.en: used to stress that something is true

ex.en: The lab is small indeed, but it is clean.
ex.zh: 实验室确实小，但很干净。

ex.en: The path is longer, and it is indeed safer when the main road is icy.
ex.zh: 这条路更长，主路结冰时它确实更安全。

tip: indeed 用来加强已经说过的话，多放在形容词或句末。

senses.en: the system or act of carrying people or goods
to carry people or goods

ex.en: Public transport stops at the gate.
ex.zh: 公共交通在门口停。

ex.en: Transport for a school trip fails if the return time is not written down.
ex.zh: 如果没有写下返回时间，学校出行的交通就会出问题。

tip: 英式名词常重读在前，动词重读在后。美式拼写是 transportation，名词更常见。

senses.en: to work out a number

ex.en: Can you calculate the total cost?
ex.zh: 你能算出总费用吗？

meta.pipelineNote: IPA/topic pending; not in Word Atlas overlap

senses.en: an exam, or a trial
to check something

ex.en: We have a short test on Friday.
ex.zh: 我们周五有一次小测。

ex.en: A listening test taken in a noisy hall does not measure what students can hear in a quiet room.
ex.zh: 在嘈杂大厅里进行的听力测试，测不出学生在安静房间里能听见什么。

tip: test 作动词是“测试”。

senses.en: a title used before a married woman's surname

ex.en: Mrs. Chen teaches Class 3 this term.
ex.zh: 陈老师这学期教三班。

ex.en: On an official form, Mrs. shows a title, and it should match the name the family actually uses.
ex.zh: 在正式表格上，Mrs. 是称谓，应当和家里实际使用的姓名一致。

tip: Mrs. 后接姓，用于已婚女性。Mr. 已在本库单独列出。

senses.en: air taken into or sent out of the lungs

ex.en: Take a breath before you answer.
ex.zh: 回答前先吸一口气。

ex.en: Bad air in a closed room takes the breath out of a long class.
ex.zh: 关着的房间里空气不好，会让一节长课喘不过气。

col: out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: 动词是 breathe，已在本库，末尾有 e。名词 breath 没有 e。

senses.en: to succeed in dealing with a problem

ex.en: We can overcome the delay if the time is written.
ex.zh: 如果时间写下来，我们就能克服这次延误。

ex.en: Students overcome a hard text better when the source is named.
ex.zh: 写明来源时，学生更能读懂一篇难的课文。

tip: 过去式和过去分词是 overcame、overcome。

senses.en: to fall, or to let something fall
a small amount of liquid, or a fall

ex.en: Do not drop litter in the corridor.
ex.zh: 不要在走廊里丢垃圾。

ex.en: If bus fares drop, more students can reach the school they were offered.
ex.zh: 如果公交票价下降，更多学生能到达录取他们的学校。

tip: drop 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: a condition, or a country or region
to say or write something clearly

ex.en: The classroom was in a tidy state after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后教室很整洁。

ex.en: A state that invests in rural schools narrows the gap between villages and big cities.
ex.zh: 投资乡村学校的国家，会缩小乡村与大城市之间的差距。

col: in a state of｜处于……状态
tip: the United States 中的 state 是州；泛指国家时也可作 state。

senses.en: to help someone remember

ex.en: Remind me to lock the door.
ex.zh: 提醒我锁门。

ex.en: A sign can remind students of the bus, and a person still has to update it.
ex.zh: 牌子能提醒学生公交，仍然得有人去更新它。

col: remind sb to do｜提醒某人做
tip: remind somebody to do。不要和 remember 混淆：remember 是自己记得。

senses.en: to help something develop, to raise in rank, or to advertise

ex.en: The club promotes reading, not only scores.
ex.zh: 社团促进的是阅读，而不只是分数。

ex.en: A company may promote a drink at school only if the label is honest.
ex.zh: 公司只有在标签诚实时，才可以在学校推销一种饮料。

col: promote sb to｜提拔某人担任
tip: promote 可指促进、晋升或推销。名词是 promotion。

senses.en: the number 0

ex.en: The temperature fell to zero.
ex.zh: 气温降到了零度。

ex.en: A score of zero should start a conversation, not end a student.
ex.zh: 零分应当打开一次谈话，而不是结束一个学生。

tip: zero 也可作名词。美式有时用 zero 表示没有，英式常用 nought 或 nil。

senses.en: of the body, or of physics

ex.en: Physical exercise is part of the school day.
ex.zh: 体育锻炼是上学日的一部分。

ex.en: Physical distance from a clinic becomes dangerous at night, when taxis are scarce.
ex.zh: 夜里出租车稀少时，离诊所的实际距离会变得危险。

tip: physical 可指身体或物理。physics 是学科“物理”。

senses.en: one more time

ex.en: Please read the sentence again, more slowly.
ex.zh: 请再读一遍这个句子，慢一点。

ex.en: If the same street floods again, the town should stop calling it bad luck and fix the drains.
ex.zh: 如果同一条街再次积水，城镇就不该再称之为运气不好，而应修排水系统。

tip: again 不与 repeat 叠用；repeat 本身已有“再做一次”的意思。

senses.en: a tube that carries liquid or gas

ex.en: The pipe is leaking.
ex.zh: 管子在漏。

ex.en: A leaking pipe under the hall is a reason to call an adult.
ex.zh: 礼堂下面漏水的管子是叫成年人的理由。

tip: pipe 也可指烟斗。本条以管子为主，不写如何使用。

senses.en: to use or have something with others
a part of something

ex.en: We share one microscope in the lab.
ex.zh: 实验室里我们共用一台显微镜。

ex.en: Neighbours who share tools spend less and throw fewer things away.
ex.zh: 共用工具的邻居花得更少，扔掉的东西也更少。

col: share sth with sb｜与某人分享
tip: share 可作及物动词，后面直接接宾语。

senses.en: a greeting

ex.en: Hello, is this the school office?
ex.zh: 喂，是学校办公室吗？

ex.en: A hello at the gate costs nothing and tells a new student they are in the right place.
ex.zh: 门口一声你好不花钱，也能告诉新生他们没走错。

tip: hello 用于见面或打电话。写信开头不用 hello 代替 Dear。

senses.en: related to medicine or treatment

ex.en: She hopes to do medical work in a village.
ex.zh: 她希望在乡村做医疗工作。

ex.en: Medical care that exists only in the city leaves village families travelling for hours.
ex.zh: 只存在于城市的医疗，会让乡村家庭赶几小时的路。

tip: medical 是形容词；medicine 是名词“药”或“医学”。

senses.en: a person who prepares text for publication

ex.en: The editor checked every name.
ex.zh: 编辑核对了每一个名字。

ex.en: A school editor who fixes a wrong score before printing saves a week of apology.
ex.zh: 在付印前改掉错误分数的校刊编辑，能省下一周的道歉。

tip: edition 是版本，已在本库。editor 是做这件事的人。

senses.en: a time when something happens later than planned
to make something later

ex.en: The delay was twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 延误了二十分钟。

ex.en: A delay should be written on the notice before parents leave work.
ex.zh: 延误应当在家长下班之前写到通知上。

tip: delay 作动词是推迟。

senses.en: the freedom to do what you want, within the law

ex.en: The text discusses liberty and also the bus.
ex.zh: 课文讨论自由，也讨论公交。

ex.en: Liberty to speak still has a limit: no one may threaten a classmate.
ex.zh: 说话的自由仍有界限：谁也不能威胁同学。

tip: freedom 已在本库，更常用。liberty 更正式。

senses.en: to rest on a chair or the ground

ex.en: Please sit near the window if you need light.
ex.zh: 如果你需要光线，请坐在靠窗的地方。

ex.en: Students who sit in the same seat all term may never meet the classmates behind them.
ex.zh: 整个学期都坐同一座位的学生，可能始终认识不到身后的同学。

tip: sit 的过去式和过去分词都是 sat。坐下常用 sit down。

senses.en: a feeling of pleasure in what you or others have done

ex.en: She spoke with pride about the class garden.
ex.zh: 她自豪地谈起班级的园子。

ex.en: Pride in a score should still name who watered the garden.
ex.zh: 为分数自豪时，仍然应当说出是谁给园子浇的水。

tip: 形容词 proud 已在本库。take pride in doing。

senses.en: to go from one side to the other
a mark or a place where things meet
angry

ex.en: Cross the road at the lights.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯处过马路。

ex.en: Children cross a busy road more safely when the light gives them enough time.
ex.zh: 当信号灯给足时间时，孩子过繁忙的马路会更安全。

tip: cross 是动词；across 是介词。

senses.en: a soft hat, or a cover

ex.en: He left his cap on the chair.
ex.zh: 他把帽子落在椅子上了。

ex.en: A bottle cap that is loose in the lab is a reason to stop.
ex.zh: 实验室里松了的瓶盖是停下来的理由。

tip: cap 多指无檐或只有前面有檐的帽子。hat 通常更有边，本批另有词条。

senses.en: a sudden serious event causing harm
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: An earthquake is a natural disaster.
ex.zh: 地震是一种自然灾害。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: a period in a process, or a platform for performers

ex.en: We are at the first stage of the project.
ex.zh: 我们处在项目的第一阶段。

ex.en: The stage of a plan that nobody checks is often the one that fails in the rain.
ex.zh: 计划中没人检查的那个阶段，往往是在雨里失败的阶段。

tip: stage 作动词是“上演”。

senses.en: a place to sit
to give someone a place to sit, or to have room for

ex.en: Is this seat free?
ex.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

ex.en: A reserved seat on the bus matters for a student who cannot stand the whole way.
ex.zh: 公交上的预留座位，对不能全程站着的学生很重要。

tip: seat 作动词是“使就座”，如 seat 30 people。

senses.en: towards the front

ex.en: Please step forward when your name is called.
ex.zh: 叫到你的名字时请向前走。

ex.en: Looking forward without asking residents can put a new road through the only playground.
ex.zh: 不询问居民就向前规划，可能会让新路穿过唯一的操场。

tip: look forward to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: a small container for drinks, or a prize

ex.en: There is a cup of tea on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上有一杯茶。

ex.en: Winning a cup brings a town one happy evening, not a clinic or a bus.
ex.zh: 赢得奖杯给城镇带来一个快乐的晚上，而不是诊所或公交。

tip: a cup of 后接不可数名词。

senses.en: a promise, or the time you give to something

ex.en: The club needs a commitment to lock the door.
ex.zh: 社团需要有人承诺锁门。

ex.en: A commitment to the late bus should be written, not only spoken.
ex.zh: 对晚班车的承诺应当写下来，而不只是说一说。

tip: commitment 可数也可不可数。

senses.en: a moving picture, or thin material for cameras
to record moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short film about the town.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于这个城镇的短片。

ex.en: A film about a flood can move people, but it does not repair the broken drain.
ex.zh: 一部关于洪水的电影可以打动人，但修不好破损的排水管。

tip: 英式常用 film，美式常用 movie。

senses.en: a dirty or untidy state

ex.en: The lab was a mess after the experiment.
ex.zh: 实验之后实验室一片凌乱。

ex.en: A mess in the hallway is a safety problem if bags block the door.
ex.zh: 如果包堵住了门，走廊里的凌乱就是安全问题。

tip: mess 可数。make a mess of 表示把……搞糟。

senses.en: a standard, height, or rank

ex.en: Her reading level has improved this term.
ex.zh: 她的阅读水平这学期提高了。

ex.en: Noise levels beside a main road can be high enough to disturb an open classroom window.
ex.zh: 主干道旁的噪音水平可以高到打扰开着窗的教室。

col: at a high level｜在高水平
tip: level 作形容词是“平坦的”。

senses.en: later, after an event

ex.en: We cleaned the lab afterwards.
ex.zh: 后来我们打扫了实验室。

ex.en: Afterwards the notice was corrected, but the class had already left.
ex.zh: 后来通知改了，班级却已经走了。

tip: afterwards 是副词。美式也作 afterward。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: the United States, or the American continents

ex.en: She hopes to visit America after university.
ex.zh: 她希望大学毕业后去美国看看。

ex.en: News from America reaches a classroom in minutes, but students still need to ask who wrote it.
ex.zh: 来自美国的新闻几分钟就能进课堂，但学生仍要问是谁写的。

tip: 国家名 America 前通常不加 the；the United States 要加 the。

senses.en: a smaller road off a main one

ex.en: We took a side road to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 我们走了一条支路以避开车流。

ex.en: A side road without a pavement still forces children into the same space as cars.
ex.zh: 没有人行道的支路，仍然把孩子推进和汽车相同的空间。

tip: side road 是主路旁边的小路，不要和 roadside（路边）混用。

senses.en: with nothing inside
to remove everything from something

ex.en: The bottle was empty.
ex.zh: 瓶子是空的。

ex.en: An empty seat on the late bus is useless if the stop has no light.
ex.zh: 如果车站没有灯，晚班车上的空座也没用。

tip: empty 作动词是倒空。

senses.en: to connect in the mind, or to spend time with
a partner or colleague

ex.en: Students associate the bell with the end of class.
ex.zh: 学生把铃声和下课联系在一起。

ex.en: Do not associate one late bus with every driver.
ex.zh: 不要把一趟晚班车和每一位司机联系在一起。

col: associate A with B｜把 A 与 B 联系起来
tip: association 已在本库。associate 作名词是同事，重音常在后。

senses.en: in addition, or different

ex.en: Would anyone else like to speak?
ex.zh: 还有别人想发言吗？

ex.en: If the bus is full, students have little else to do but wait in the rain.
ex.zh: 如果公交满了，学生几乎只能在雨里等。

tip: else 放在疑问词或不定代词后面：what else、someone else。

senses.en: to get money or respect by work

ex.en: She earns her bus fare at the weekend.
ex.zh: 她周末挣公交费。

ex.en: A city earns trust when the flood plan is practised, not only printed.
ex.zh: 当防汛方案被演练而不只是被印刷时，城市才赢得信任。

tip: earn 后接钱、生活或尊重。

senses.en: an unusual and exciting experience

ex.en: The trip was an adventure, and everyone came back.
ex.zh: 这次出行是一次奇遇，而且每个人都回来了。

ex.en: An adventure on the river still needs life jackets.
ex.zh: 河上的冒险仍然需要救生衣。

tip: adventure 可数。

senses.en: a strip worn around the waist, or a region

ex.en: The belt on the bag is loose.
ex.zh: 包上的带子松了。

ex.en: A green belt around the town keeps a path for walking.
ex.zh: 城镇周围的绿化带留出一条步行的路。

tip: seat belt 是安全带。

senses.en: a hard building material
definite and real, not only an idea

ex.en: The path is concrete, not soil.
ex.zh: 这条路是混凝土的，不是土的。

ex.en: A concrete plan names who locks the door.
ex.zh: 一个具体的计划会写明谁锁门。

tip: concrete 作形容词是具体的，和抽象相对。

senses.en: the highest part or rank
highest in position or degree

ex.en: My name is at the top of the list.
ex.zh: 我的名字在名单最上面。

ex.en: Standing at the top of a test list does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 站在成绩榜顶端，并不能说明一个学生能否与他人合作。

tip: top 作形容词表示“顶级的”：top speed。

senses.en: a formal meeting of questions
to ask someone questions in a formal meeting

ex.en: She has an interview at the library on Friday.
ex.zh: 她周五在图书馆有一场面试。

ex.en: An interview that only rewards confidence can miss a quiet student who knows the work.
ex.zh: 只奖励自信的面试，可能错过一个懂业务但安静的学生。

tip: interview 可作名词或动词。采访和面试是同一个词。

senses.en: almost the same

ex.en: The two maps are similar, but not the same.
ex.zh: 两张地图相似，但并不相同。

ex.en: Similar test scores can hide very different chances to study at home.
ex.zh: 相似的考分可能掩盖在家学习机会的巨大差别。

tip: similar to 后接比较对象，不用 with。

senses.en: all of something

ex.en: I spent the whole morning in the lab.
ex.zh: 我整个上午都在实验室。

ex.en: Protecting a whole river means caring for farms and factories, not only the city section.
ex.zh: 保护整条河意味着要管农场和工厂，而不只是城区那一段。

tip: whole 前面通常有 the 或物主代词：the whole day。

senses.en: an idea or the act of thinking
past form of think

ex.en: That is a thoughtful question.
ex.zh: 那是一个有想法的问题。

ex.en: A single thoughtless comment online can follow a student longer than the mistake that caused it.
ex.zh: 网上一句欠考虑的话，可能比引发它的那个错误跟随学生更久。

tip: thought 也是 think 的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: to respect or look up to someone
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire her courage in difficult times.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她在困难时期的勇气。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: a state or requirement
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: The road is in poor condition.
ex.zh: 这条路状况很差。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: of a colour between red and blue
the colour purple

ex.en: The jacket is purple.
ex.zh: 夹克是紫色的。

ex.en: A purple poster is not a plan if the words are too small.
ex.zh: 如果字太小，紫色海报也不是方案。

tip: purple 也可作名词。

senses.en: a container for liquids, usually glass or plastic

ex.en: Please return the bottle to the bin.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子放回桶里。

ex.en: A labelled bottle in the lab is safer than a faster experiment.
ex.zh: 实验室里贴了标签的瓶子，比做得更快的实验更安全。

tip: bottle 可数。作动词是把……装瓶。

senses.en: not joined, or different
to divide or keep apart

ex.en: Keep the broken glass in a separate box.
ex.zh: 把碎玻璃放在单独的盒子里。

ex.en: Separate queues for the bus stop a crowd from pushing the smallest students aside.
ex.zh: 分开排队能避免人群把最小的学生挤到一边。

tip: 形容词常读 /ˈsepərət/，动词“分开”常读 /ˈsepəreɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with anything else

ex.en: The lab uses pure water.
ex.zh: 实验室用纯净水。

ex.en: Pure luck does not explain a result that the same class can repeat.
ex.zh: 同一个班能重复的结果，不能只用纯运气解释。

tip: purely 表示完全地、仅仅。pure 不要和 poor 混淆。

senses.en: how heavy something is

ex.en: The bag is light in weight.
ex.zh: 这个包重量很轻。

ex.en: The weight of a full schoolbag is a daily load, especially for younger children on a long walk.
ex.zh: 装满的书包的重量是每天的负担，尤其对走远路的年幼孩子。

tip: weight 是名词；weigh 是动词“称重”。

senses.en: to hit, to attack suddenly, or to stop work in protest

ex.en: The bell will strike at eight.
ex.zh: 钟将在八点敲响。

ex.en: When bus drivers strike, the school needs a written way for students to get home.
ex.zh: 公交司机罢工时，学校需要一份书面办法让学生回家。

tip: strike 的过去式和过去分词一般是 struck。罢工用 go on strike。本条不写任何伤害方法。

senses.en: to take something that is not yours

ex.en: He did not steal the book; it was a loan.
ex.zh: 他没有偷书，那是借的。

ex.en: A school should not call a hungry child a thief for taking bread.
ex.zh: 学校不应当因为一个饥饿的孩子拿了面包就把他叫做小偷。

tip: steal 的过去式是 stole，过去分词是 stolen。本条不写偷窃方法。

senses.en: to move around, or to become
a chance to do something, or a change of direction

ex.en: Turn left at the bookshop.
ex.zh: 在书店处向左转。

ex.en: Parks can turn a hot street into a place where people are willing to walk.
ex.zh: 公园能把一条炎热的街道变成人们愿意步行的地方。

tip: turn 加形容词表示变化：turn green。开灯用 turn on，不是 open the light。

senses.en: one part or one item

ex.en: May I have a piece of paper?
ex.zh: 我可以要一张纸吗？

ex.en: A piece of false news can travel farther than the correction that follows it.
ex.zh: 一条假消息可以比随后的更正传得更远。

tip: 不可数名词要说数量时常用 a piece of。

senses.en: what a person thinks

ex.en: In my opinion, the second answer is better.
ex.zh: 在我看来，第二个答案更好。

ex.en: Public opinion changes when people see the flooded street, not only the plan.
ex.zh: 当人们看到积水的街道而不只是方案时，舆论会改变。

tip: opinion 是可数名词。

senses.en: of a pale red colour
a pale red colour

ex.en: The pink notice is the new one.
ex.zh: 粉红色的通知是新的。

ex.en: Pink paper does not make a wrong time correct.
ex.zh: 粉纸不能把写错的时间变成对的。

tip: pink 也可作名词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a period of teaching, or something learned from experience

ex.en: The next lesson is history.
ex.zh: 下一节是历史。

ex.en: The lesson of the late bus is to write the return time on the same sheet.
ex.zh: 晚班车的教训是把返回时间写在同一张纸上。

col: a lesson in｜一节……课；一个教训
teach sb a lesson｜给某人一个教训
tip: lesson 可数。teach somebody a lesson 有时语气是教训某人。

senses.en: on the outside

ex.en: The outer door is locked.
ex.zh: 外面那扇门锁了。

ex.en: The outer wall needs a light at the crossing.
ex.zh: 外墙在路口需要一盏灯。

tip: outer 只作定语，放在名词前。

senses.en: allowed by law
Allowed by the law

ex.en: Is this action legal?
ex.zh: 这个行为合法吗？

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: a piece of land for flowers or vegetables

ex.en: The class grows tomatoes in the garden.
ex.zh: 班级在园子里种西红柿。

ex.en: A school garden teaches seasons only if someone is there to water it in August.
ex.zh: 学校的园子只有在八月仍有人浇水时，才能教给学生季节。

tip: garden 可指花园、菜园或果园。

senses.en: a person receiving medical care
able to wait without getting angry

ex.en: The patient waited in the school clinic.
ex.zh: 病人在校医务室等候。

ex.en: A patient teacher gives a second explanation without making the class feel small.
ex.zh: 有耐心的老师会再讲一遍，而不让全班觉得难堪。

tip: patient 作名词是病人，作形容词是耐心的。

senses.en: a machine that can do tasks by itself

ex.en: The robot in the lab is switched off.
ex.zh: 实验室里的机器人关着。

ex.en: A robot that answers the phone is not a person who can change the bus time.
ex.zh: 接电话的机器人不是一个能改公交时间的人。

tip: robot 可数。

senses.en: complete disorder

ex.en: The hall was chaos when the bell failed.
ex.zh: 铃坏了的时候礼堂一片混乱。

ex.en: Chaos at the gate is what you get when nobody writes the bus time.
ex.zh: 没人写公交时间时，门口就会乱。

tip: chaos 通常不可数。

senses.en: a person who leads

ex.en: The team leader explained the plan.
ex.zh: 队长解释了计划。

ex.en: A good leader asks who will be harmed before a new road is approved.
ex.zh: 好的领导者在批准新路之前会问谁将受到伤害。

tip: leader 是人；leadership 是领导能力。

senses.en: happy about something

ex.en: The teacher was pleased with the map.
ex.zh: 老师对这张地图感到高兴。

ex.en: Parents are pleased when a late bus is explained.
ex.zh: 晚班车得到解释时，家长会高兴。

tip: pleased 形容人。pleasing 形容事物。pleasure 已在本库。

senses.en: the point where something begins

ex.en: The origin of the word is on the last line.
ex.zh: 这个词的来源在最后一行。

ex.en: The origin of a flood is not only the rain; it is also the blocked drain.
ex.zh: 洪水的起因不只是雨，也包括堵住的排水口。

tip: origin 可数。original 是形容词“原来的；独创的”。

senses.en: most important

ex.en: The main entrance is on the left.
ex.zh: 正门在左边。

ex.en: The main reason for late arrivals is the bus, not a lack of interest in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 迟到的主要原因是公交，不是对第一节课缺乏兴趣。

tip: main 没有比较级。mainly 是副词“主要地”。

senses.en: a white substance used to flavour food

ex.en: There is too much salt in the soup.
ex.zh: 这汤盐太多了。

ex.en: Salt on an icy step helps, and it also damages the plants beside it.
ex.zh: 结冰台阶上的盐有帮助，也会伤害旁边的植物。

tip: salt 通常不可数。take something with a pinch of salt 表示不完全相信。

senses.en: more than two but not many

ex.en: Several students stayed to tidy the lab.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来收拾实验室。

ex.en: Several small parks can serve a neighbourhood better than one large park that is hard to reach.
ex.zh: 几个小公园服务一个社区，可能好过一座很难到达的大公园。

tip: several 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: something valuable that you give up
to give something up

ex.en: Sleep should not be the sacrifice before an exam.
ex.zh: 考前不应当牺牲睡眠。

ex.en: A sacrifice of one lunch break can keep the library open.
ex.zh: 牺牲一次午休，可以让图书馆继续开着。

tip: sacrifice 作动词是牺牲。本条不写伤害自己或他人的做法。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when

ex.en: The shop is open until nine.
ex.zh: 商店营业到九点。

ex.en: A library that stays open until the last bus can serve students who cannot study at home.
ex.zh: 开到末班车的图书馆，可以服务那些无法在家学习的学生。

tip: until 可作介词或连词。not...until 表示直到……才。

senses.en: with no sound, or not speaking

ex.en: The hall was silent after the question.
ex.zh: 问题之后礼堂一片寂静。

ex.en: A silent student is not the same as a student who agrees.
ex.zh: 沉默的学生不等于同意的学生。

tip: 名词 silence 已在本库。silent 是形容词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: every one separately

ex.en: Each student has a different seat number.
ex.zh: 每个学生的座位号都不一样。

ex.en: Each small shop that closes on a high street takes away a place where neighbours used to talk.
ex.zh: 商业街上每关掉一家小店，就少了一个邻居们曾经聊天的地方。

tip: each of 加复数名词时，谓语常用单数。

senses.en: a person who buys goods or services

ex.en: The customer asked for a receipt.
ex.zh: 顾客要了收据。

ex.en: A school shop should treat a student as a customer and still say no to a harmful product.
ex.zh: 学校小卖部应当把学生当顾客，同时仍然拒绝有害的商品。

tip: customer 可数。买东西的人。client 更常指服务的委托人。

senses.zh: 以某种方式；不知怎么地
senses.en: in a way that is not known

ex.en: We somehow caught the last bus.
ex.zh: 我们不知怎么赶上了末班车。

ex.en: A plan that says somehow is not a plan; write the step.
ex.zh: 只说“想办法”的方案不是方案，把步骤写出来。

tip: somehow 是副词。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: an emotion or a physical sense

ex.en: I had a feeling that the answer was wrong.
ex.zh: 我有一种感觉，这个答案是错的。

ex.en: A feeling of safety on the walk home depends on lights, not only on a low crime number.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全感取决于灯光，而不只是一个很低的犯罪数字。

tip: feeling 是可数名词。

senses.en: ordinary, happening each day

ex.en: These are everyday words, not exam tricks.
ex.zh: 这些是日常用词，不是考试陷阱。

ex.en: Everyday help, such as holding a door, matters as much as a speech.
ex.zh: 扶门这样的日常帮助，和一篇讲话一样重要。

tip: everyday 是一个词，作形容词。every day 分开写是“每天”。表里这一行的音标是 everybody，本库不用。

senses.en: to bring things together

ex.en: Collect the forms before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前把表收齐。

ex.en: Cities collect the same plastic for years and still need a bin that is emptied.
ex.zh: 城市多年收集同一种塑料，仍然需要一个会被清空的桶。

tip: collection 已在本库。

senses.en: a power that seems impossible, or a wonderful quality
having a mysterious or wonderful power

ex.en: The story uses magic to solve the problem.
ex.zh: 这个故事用魔法解决问题。

ex.en: There is no magic timetable that gives every child a quiet desk at home.
ex.zh: 没有一种神奇课表能让每个孩子家里都有一张安静的书桌。

col: as if by magic｜像变魔术一样
tip: magic 也可作形容词：a magic trick。

senses.en: a person's mood or courage, or a non-physical being

ex.en: The team spirit was better after the talk.
ex.zh: 谈话之后团队精神更好了。

ex.en: School spirit is real when students help a classmate, not only when they shout at a match.
ex.zh: 当学生帮助同学，而不只是在比赛中呐喊时，学校精神才是真的。

tip: spirit 表示精神时常不可数。in high spirits 表示兴高采烈。

senses.en: a plan, or the way things are organized

ex.en: The arrangement is on the sheet.
ex.zh: 安排写在这张纸上。

ex.en: An arrangement for the late bus should name who locks the gate.
ex.zh: 晚班车的安排应当写明谁锁门。

tip: 动词 arrange 已在本库。

senses.en: a subject of speech or writing

ex.en: The topic of the essay is water.
ex.zh: 作文题目是水。

ex.en: A topic that ignores the bus will not interest the students who miss it.
ex.zh: 无视公交的题目，不会让那些赶不上车的学生感兴趣。

tip: topic 可数。

senses.en: very unpleasant or frightening

ex.en: The smell from the bin was horrible.
ex.zh: 桶里的气味很糟。

ex.en: A horrible score on one quiz is information, not the end of a student.
ex.zh: 一次小测的糟糕分数是信息，不是一个学生的终点。

tip: horrible 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学。

senses.en: a particular way of doing something

ex.en: The technique is explained on the board.
ex.zh: 技巧写在黑板上。

ex.en: A technique for checking a source is more useful than a longer essay with none.
ex.zh: 核对来源的方法，比一篇更长却没有来源的文章更有用。

tip: technique 可数。technical 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 technical，本库不用。

senses.en: a large amount of money or resources

ex.en: The town wealth is not only its shops.
ex.zh: 这座城镇的财富不只是它的商店。

ex.en: Wealth that never reaches the clinic is not shared.
ex.zh: 到不了诊所的财富，就不是被分享的。

tip: wealth 通常不可数。a wealth of 表示大量。

senses.en: more than usual

ex.en: I need extra time to check the answers.
ex.zh: 我需要额外的时间检查答案。

ex.en: Extra lanes do not cut traffic if they only invite more cars.
ex.zh: 如果额外的车道只是招来更多汽车，它们并不能减少交通。

tip: extra 可作形容词或名词。

senses.en: to put something down

ex.en: Lay the map on the desk.
ex.zh: 把地图放在桌上。

ex.en: Workers lay a new path before the rainy season, not after the first flood.
ex.zh: 工人在雨季之前铺新路，而不是等第一次洪水之后。

tip: lay 是及物动词，过去式和过去分词是 laid。lie（躺）的过去式才是 lay。lie 已在本库。

senses.en: to think of someone or something in a particular way
respect, or good wishes

ex.en: We regard the library as a public room.
ex.zh: 我们把图书馆看作公共房间。

ex.en: Do not regard a low score as the whole student.
ex.zh: 不要把一个低分看成整个学生。

tip: regard 作名词常用复数 regards，表示问候。

senses.en: a wash in a bathtub, or the tub itself

ex.en: The bath is at the end of the hall.
ex.zh: 浴缸在走廊尽头。

ex.en: A hot bath is not a plan for a school; a working shower is.
ex.zh: 热水澡不是学校的方案；能用的淋浴才是。

tip: 英式 have a bath 是盆浴。美式更常说 take a bath。bathroom 已在本库。

senses.en: unhappy

ex.en: She felt sad after the team lost.
ex.zh: 队伍输了之后她很难过。

ex.en: A sad ending in a film can still teach a class how a choice affects other people.
ex.zh: 电影里悲伤的结局，仍然可以教一个班：一个选择如何影响别人。

tip: sad 的名词是 sadness。不要说 a sad。

senses.en: in opposition to, or touching

ex.en: Our team will play against Class Three.
ex.zh: 我们队将和三班比赛。

ex.en: Laws against litter only work when bins are near and people see that the rules apply to everyone.
ex.zh: 禁止乱扔垃圾的法律，只有在附近有垃圾桶、而且人人都受约束时才有效。

tip: against 是介词，后面接名词、代词或 doing。

senses.en: a very short time

ex.en: Wait a moment, please.
ex.zh: 请稍等。

ex.en: The moment a rumour is shared, it is harder to replace it with a correction.
ex.zh: 谣言一经转发，就更难用更正来替换它。

tip: the moment 可引导时间从句，相当于 as soon as。

senses.en: strength, control, or electricity
to supply energy to a machine

ex.en: The storm cut the power for two hours.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致停电两小时。

ex.en: The power to change a bus route should sit with people who actually ride it, not only with planners.
ex.zh: 更改公交线路的权力，应该掌握在真正乘坐它的人手里，而不只是规划者。

tip: power 表示电力时不可数。作动词是“驱动”或“供电”。

senses.en: to get something

ex.en: You can obtain the form at the office.
ex.zh: 你可以在办公室拿到表格。

ex.en: Students obtain a seat on the late bus by arriving, not by a poster.
ex.zh: 学生得到晚班车的座位是靠来到，不是靠一张海报。

tip: obtain 比 get 正式。

senses.en: extremely good

ex.en: Her map was outstanding.
ex.zh: 她的地图非常出色。

ex.en: An outstanding score does not replace the student who kept the lab tidy.
ex.zh: 出色的分数代替不了那个让实验室保持整洁的学生。

tip: outstanding 也可表示未支付的：outstanding fees。

senses.en: related to race

ex.en: Racial equality is the principle on the form.
ex.zh: 种族平等是表格上的原则。

ex.en: A racial joke is not a joke the class should keep.
ex.zh: 种族笑话不是班级该保留的笑话。

tip: race 已在本库。说话时要尊重。

senses.en: a large container, or a military vehicle

ex.en: The water tank is on the roof.
ex.zh: 水箱在屋顶上。

ex.en: A history photo of a tank should stay a photo, not a set of instructions.
ex.zh: 历史照片里的坦克应当只是照片，而不是一套说明。

tip: tank 可指容器或坦克。本条不写军事操作。

senses.en: of the west

ex.en: We compared a western folk story with a Chinese one.
ex.zh: 我们把一个西方民间故事和中国故事做了比较。

ex.en: Western visitors may admire an old street and still miss the rents that local families pay.
ex.zh: 西方游客可能欣赏一条老街，却仍然看不到本地家庭支付的房租。

tip: western 是形容词，通常不大写，除非是专名的一部分。

senses.en: an area with a particular use or feature

ex.en: This street is a quiet zone.
ex.zh: 这条街是安静区域。

ex.en: A school zone with a lower speed limit only works if drivers can see the sign.
ex.zh: 学校区域的低速限制只有在司机看得见标志时才有效。

tip: zone 强调按用途或特征划分的区域。表里这一行的音标是 zoo，本库不用。

senses.en: a strong metal, or a tool for smoothing clothes
to smooth clothes with an iron

ex.en: The gate is iron and heavy.
ex.zh: 这扇门是铁的，很重。

ex.en: An iron in a dormitory needs a clear rule, or a small burn becomes a fire.
ex.zh: 宿舍里的熨斗需要明确规定，否则一小块烫痕会变成火灾。

tip: iron 作动词是熨烫。化学符号相关的“铁”不可数。

senses.en: a group effort for change, or the act of moving

ex.en: The movement to save the river started at school.
ex.zh: 拯救这条河的运动从学校开始。

ex.en: Free movement to a clinic matters when the only road floods.
ex.zh: 当唯一的路积水时，能自由前往诊所就很重要。

tip: movement 可指社会运动，也可指动作。

senses.en: separated by distance or into pieces

ex.en: The two labs are only a corridor apart.
ex.zh: 两间实验室只隔一条走廊。

ex.en: Apart from the price, the later bus is the one that working students can actually catch.
ex.zh: 除了价格，晚一班的公交才是打工的学生真正赶得上的。

tip: apart from 表示除……之外。tell apart 表示区分。

senses.en: to one side

ex.en: She stepped aside to let the class pass.
ex.zh: 她站到一边让班级过去。

ex.en: Set aside ten minutes, or the notice will be written in a hurry.
ex.zh: 留出十分钟，否则通知会写得很匆忙。

tip: aside from 与 besides 相近。put aside 是把东西放到一边。

senses.en: a person with special skill
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: Ask an expert for advice.
ex.zh: 向专家征求建议。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: something given, or a natural ability

ex.en: The book was a gift from her uncle.
ex.zh: 这本书是她叔叔送的礼物。

ex.en: A gift for music still needs practice if the student wants a place in the band.
ex.zh: 如果学生想在乐队里有位置，音乐天赋仍然需要练习。

tip: gift 可指礼物，也可指天赋。a gift for doing 表示有做某事的天分。

senses.en: a special event for a happy occasion

ex.en: The celebration is on Friday.
ex.zh: 庆祝活动在周五。

ex.en: A celebration that starts after the last bus has already chosen who can come.
ex.zh: 在末班车之后才开始的庆祝，其实已经选定了谁能来。

tip: 动词 celebrate 已在本库。

senses.en: one more, or a different one

ex.en: May I ask another question?
ex.zh: 我可以再问一个问题吗？

ex.en: Another heatwave will test whether the city's new shelters are more than a promise on paper.
ex.zh: 又一轮热浪将检验这座城市的新避暑点是否不只是纸上的承诺。

tip: another 后接单数名词；“另外两个”可以说 another two days。

senses.en: a structure with a roof and walls

ex.en: The new building has a lift.
ex.zh: 新楼有电梯。

ex.en: An empty building in the town centre is a wasted chance to house a clinic or a library.
ex.zh: 镇中心的空楼是浪费，本可以用来做诊所或图书馆。

tip: building 是名词；build 是动词，过去式 built。

senses.en: possibly

ex.en: Perhaps we can finish before lunch.
ex.zh: 也许我们能在午饭前做完。

ex.en: Perhaps a later school start would help, but only if the buses change too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改才行。

tip: perhaps 比 maybe 稍正式，意思接近。

senses.en: a drawing that shows information

ex.en: The chart shows the bus times.
ex.zh: 图表显示公交时间。

ex.en: A chart without a source is only a picture.
ex.zh: 没有来源的图表只是一张图。

tip: chart 可数。也可作动词“绘制”。

senses.en: a natural ability

ex.en: She has a talent for drawing maps.
ex.zh: 她有画地图的天赋。

ex.en: A talent for music still needs a room and an instrument the student can borrow.
ex.zh: 音乐天赋仍然需要一间房和一件学生能借到的乐器。

tip: talent 可数也可不可数。have a talent for doing。

senses.en: to work for someone, or to give food

ex.en: They serve lunch from eleven to one.
ex.zh: 他们十一点到一点供应午餐。

ex.en: Libraries that serve small towns often share one librarian among several buildings.
ex.zh: 服务小城镇的图书馆，常常是几栋楼共用一位馆员。

tip: serve 后直接接人或食物。It serves you right 表示活该，语气重。

senses.en: millimetre

ex.en: The line is 5 mm wide.
ex.zh: 这条线宽 5 毫米。

ex.en: A map that uses mm without a scale still leaves the reader guessing.
ex.zh: 不用比例尺却用毫米的地图，仍然让读者猜。

tip: mm 是 millimetre 的缩写。数字和 mm 之间通常留空格。

senses.en: a person who knows a lot about one subject

ex.en: The specialist checked the clock.
ex.zh: 专家检查了钟。

ex.en: A specialist who names no source is harder to trust.
ex.zh: 不写来源的专家更难信任。

tip: special 已在本库。

senses.en: knowledge from careful study and experiment

ex.en: Science class is in the lab today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课在实验室。

ex.en: Science can measure dirty air, but a city still has to decide what to do about it.
ex.zh: 科学可以测量脏空气，但城市仍要决定对此做什么。

tip: science 作学科通常不可数。

senses.en: to press a mouse or a button
a short sound or one press

ex.en: Click the title to open the article.
ex.zh: 点击标题打开文章。

ex.en: A design that needs three clicks to find the nurse's number wastes time in a real emergency.
ex.zh: 要点击三次才能找到校医电话的设计，会在真正的紧急情况里浪费时间。

tip: click 也可作名词，指咔哒声或一次点击。

senses.en: soft white frozen water
to fall as snow

ex.en: Snow closed the path for a day.
ex.zh: 雪把小路封了一天。

ex.en: A town that plans for snow keeps the school open when the main road is still white.
ex.zh: 为雪做准备的城镇，在大路还是白的时候也能让学校开门。

tip: snow 作名词通常不可数。作动词：It snows。

senses.en: to fail to remember

ex.en: Do not forget to write the date.
ex.zh: 别忘了写日期。

ex.en: Towns forget a flood until the same street fills again.
ex.zh: 城镇会忘记洪水，直到同一条街再次积水。

tip: forget to do 是忘了要做；forget doing 是忘了做过。

senses.en: level, without bumps
a set of rooms for living in, on one floor

ex.en: The pitch is flat and dry.
ex.zh: 场地又平又干。

ex.en: A flat battery in the school bus is a morning problem, not a surprise at the gate.
ex.zh: 校车电池没电是早晨就要处理的问题，不该到门口才发现。

tip: 英式 flat 作名词是公寓，美式常用 apartment。

senses.en: the smallest amount or degree
the smallest in amount

ex.en: This is the least difficult of the three questions.
ex.zh: 这是三道题里最不难的。

ex.en: The least expensive food is not always the one that keeps students awake through the afternoon.
ex.zh: 最便宜的食物不一定能让学生整个下午保持清醒。

tip: at least 表示至少；not in the least 表示一点也不。

senses.en: a prize given for achievement
to give a prize or a sum officially

ex.en: She won an award for the science poster.
ex.zh: 她的科学海报得了奖。

ex.en: An award for perfect attendance can hide the student who was ill and still caught up.
ex.zh: 全勤奖可能掩盖那个生过病却仍然补上进度的学生。

col: award sb sth｜授予某人某物
tip: award 作动词是“授予”。不要和 reward（酬谢）搞混。

senses.en: belonging to a whole country

ex.en: The national museum is free on Wednesdays.
ex.zh: 国家博物馆周三免费。

ex.en: A national exam should not ignore students whose schools lack labs and libraries.
ex.zh: 一场全国性考试不该忽略那些学校缺少实验室和图书馆的学生。

tip: national 是形容词；国家用 nation 或 country。

senses.en: not ordinary

ex.en: Today is a special day for our school.
ex.zh: 今天对我们学校是特别的一天。

ex.en: A special bus for students works only if it arrives before the first lesson, not after.
ex.zh: 学生专车只有在第一节课前到达才有用，而不是课后。

tip: specially 强调专门地；especially 强调尤其。

senses.en: of a city

ex.en: Urban schools share one crowded bus stop.
ex.zh: 城市学校共用一个拥挤的公交站。

ex.en: Urban growth that ignores the river will meet the water in the streets.
ex.zh: 不顾河流的城市扩张，会在街上遇见那河水。

tip: urban 的反义是 rural。不要和 suburb（郊区）混淆。

senses.en: without war or violence, or calm

ex.en: The hall was peaceful after the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响之后礼堂很平静。

ex.en: A peaceful protest still needs a clear request.
ex.zh: 和平的诉求仍然需要一个清楚的要求。

tip: peace 已在本库。

senses.en: a living thing that grows in soil or water
to put seeds or trees in the ground

ex.en: Each class looks after one plant in the hallway.
ex.zh: 每个班在走廊里照料一盆植物。

ex.en: Cities that plant trees along school roads give children shade on the walk home.
ex.zh: 在上学的路边种树的城市，让孩子放学路上有树荫。

tip: plant 作动词是种植。power plant 是发电厂，不是植物。

senses.en: to arrive at, or to touch by stretching
the distance one can stretch

ex.en: We reached the museum before it closed.
ex.zh: 我们在闭馆前到达了博物馆。

ex.en: A warning that does not reach homes without a phone signal arrives too late.
ex.zh: 到不了没有手机信号的家庭的警报，来得太晚。

tip: reach 是及物动词，后面直接接地点，不加 to。

senses.en: to invite someone to compete or try hard
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: This puzzle will challenge your mind.
ex.zh: 这道谜题会挑战你的思维。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: newspapers, television, and the internet as a group

ex.en: Social media spread the news within an hour.
ex.zh: 社交媒体在一小时内传播了这条消息。

ex.en: The media can help a town prepare for a flood, or they can only arrive to film the damage.
ex.zh: 媒体可以帮助一个城镇为洪水做准备，也可以只在事后前来拍摄损失。

tip: media 是 medium 的复数，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: the flesh of animals used as food

ex.en: Some students do not eat meat.
ex.zh: 有些学生不吃肉。

ex.en: A menu that hides meat in the sauce is not a choice for those students.
ex.zh: 把肉藏在酱里的菜单，对那些学生来说不是选择。

tip: meat 通常不可数。鱼有时不叫 meat。

senses.en: the part of the body between the head and the shoulders

ex.en: She wore a scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 她脖子上围着围巾。

ex.en: Pain in the neck after a long exam is a reason to stand up, not to ignore it.
ex.zh: 长时间考试后脖子疼，是站起来的理由，不是置之不理。

tip: a pain in the neck 也可比喻讨厌的人或事，语气不礼貌。

senses.en: a soft piece of paper, or a group of cells

ex.en: Take a tissue for the lab.
ex.zh: 带一张纸巾去实验室。

ex.en: The word tissue in a health lesson means body tissue, not only paper.
ex.zh: 健康课里的 tissue 指身体组织，而不只是纸。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾常用复数 tissues。本条不写实验步骤。

senses.en: something said or written clearly

ex.en: The school made a short statement.
ex.zh: 学校发表了一则简短声明。

ex.en: A public statement about a flood should say which roads are closed.
ex.zh: 关于洪水的公开声明应该说明哪些路封闭了。

tip: statement 是可数名词。

senses.en: a common green plant, or a lawn

ex.en: The grass is wet.
ex.zh: 草地是湿的。

ex.en: Grass along the path needs less water than a lawn that must stay perfect.
ex.zh: 路边的草比必须保持完美的草坪更省水。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
tip: grass 通常不可数。

senses.en: to help someone learn

ex.en: She will teach us the song.
ex.zh: 她将教我们这首歌。

ex.en: Schools teach more than the exam list when they show how to check a source.
ex.zh: 当学校展示如何核对来源时，它们教的就不只是考试清单。

tip: teach 的过去式和过去分词是 taught。teacher 已在本库。表里这一行的音标是 tea，本库不用。

senses.en: to hold and move something

ex.en: Can you carry this box to the lab?
ex.zh: 你能把这个箱子搬到实验室吗？

ex.en: Buses that cannot carry wheelchairs leave some students outside the trip they helped to plan.
ex.zh: 不能运送轮椅的公交，会把一些学生留在他们参与策划的出行之外。

tip: carry 强调随身带着走。搬重物也可用 carry。

senses.en: the threads that grow on the head

ex.en: Tie your hair back in the lab.
ex.zh: 在实验室里把头发扎起来。

ex.en: Hair colour tells you nothing about whether a student can solve the problem.
ex.zh: 头发的颜色说明不了一个学生能否解出这道题。

tip: hair 通常不可数。一根头发用 a hair。

senses.en: of the colour of grass
the colour green

ex.en: The green bike is mine.
ex.zh: 那辆绿色自行车是我的。

ex.en: Green space near a school gives children somewhere to play that is not a car park.
ex.zh: 学校附近的绿地给孩子一个玩耍的地方，而不是停车场。

tip: green 也可表示环保的：green energy。

senses.en: to name, phone, or shout to someone
a phone conversation or a shout

ex.en: We call our teacher Mr. Chen.
ex.zh: 我们称呼老师为陈老师。

ex.en: Parents who call the school only after a problem appears miss the chance to help earlier.
ex.zh: 只在问题出现后才给学校打电话的家长，错过了更早帮忙的机会。

col: give sb a call｜给某人打电话
tip: call sb sth 表示把某人称作……，中间不加 as。

senses.en: a food made from milk

ex.en: The sandwich has cheese in it.
ex.zh: 三明治里有奶酪。

ex.en: Cheese left out of the fridge is a small thing that can close a canteen for a day.
ex.zh: 没放进冰箱的奶酪是小事，却可以让食堂停一天。

col: a piece of cheese｜一块奶酪
tip: cheese 作物质名词通常不可数。a cheese 可指一种或一块。

senses.en: the smallest amount allowed or possible
the smallest that is allowed

ex.en: The minimum age for the trip is twelve.
ex.zh: 这次出行的最低年龄是十二岁。

ex.en: A minimum of sleep is not a luxury if the first lesson starts at seven.
ex.zh: 如果第一节课七点开始，最低限度的睡眠就不是奢侈。

tip: minimum 也可作形容词：the minimum score。反义是 maximum。

senses.en: a metal container for cooking

ex.en: The pan is still hot.
ex.zh: 平底锅还烫。

ex.en: A pan without a cover in the canteen spills more than it saves.
ex.zh: 食堂里没有盖的锅洒出来的比省下的多。

tip: pan 可数。

senses.en: measuring a great length or time
to want something very much

ex.en: It was a long walk from the station.
ex.zh: 从车站走过来要很久。

ex.en: A long commute can take away the evening hours that students need for sleep and reading.
ex.zh: 漫长的通勤会占去学生需要用于睡觉和阅读的晚上时间。

tip: how long 询问时间或长度。long 作动词是“渴望”。

senses.en: a movement of the foot, or one stage of a process
to move the foot

ex.en: The first step is to read the question.
ex.zh: 第一步是读题。

ex.en: The next step after a flood warning is a lit path to higher ground, not only a message.
ex.zh: 洪水警报之后的下一步是一条有灯的通往高地的路，而不只是一条信息。

tip: step 作动词是“迈步”。

senses.en: a part of a bird or plane used for flying

ex.en: The bird hurt one wing.
ex.zh: 这只鸟伤了一只翅膀。

ex.en: The east wing of the school is colder because that wall faces the wind.
ex.zh: 教学楼东翼更冷，因为那面墙迎着风。

tip: 建筑的侧翼也叫 wing。

senses.en: an occasion when people come together

ex.en: The meeting starts at two.
ex.zh: 会议两点开始。

ex.en: A public meeting about a new road should happen before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 关于新路的公开会议应该在机器到来之前举行。

tip: meeting 是可数名词。

senses.en: twice as much, or made of two parts
to become twice as much

ex.en: We need a double check of the names.
ex.zh: 我们需要把名字再核对一遍。

ex.en: A double fare after dark makes the night bus too costly for the workers who need it most.
ex.zh: 天黑后的双倍票价，让最需要夜班公交的工人负担不起。

tip: double 作动词是“加倍”。

senses.en: a human-made waterway

ex.en: The path follows the canal.
ex.zh: 这条路沿着运河走。

ex.en: A canal without a rail is not a safe walk to school.
ex.zh: 没有栏杆的运河不是安全的上学路。

tip: canal 可数。

senses.en: a place for money, or the side of a river

ex.en: The bank is next to the post office.
ex.zh: 银行在邮局旁边。

ex.en: Houses on the bank of a river are cheap until the water reaches the door.
ex.zh: 河边的房子在水漫到门口之前显得便宜。

tip: bank 的两个常见义是银行和岸，要看搭配。

senses.en: animals and plants living in natural conditions

ex.en: The park protects wildlife.
ex.zh: 这个公园保护野生动物。

ex.en: Wildlife near a school needs a path that is not a road.
ex.zh: 学校附近的野生动物需要一条不是马路的小路。

tip: wildlife 通常不可数。

senses.en: the front of the body between the neck and the stomach, or a large box

ex.en: The pain is in his chest, so call the clinic.
ex.zh: 他胸口疼，所以去叫医务室。

ex.en: A chest of old maps can teach a town where the river used to run.
ex.zh: 一箱旧地图能告诉一座城镇河曾经从哪里流过。

tip: 胸口和箱子是同一个词，要看语境。胸口疼应当告诉成年人或医务室。

senses.en: one of two children born at the same time

ex.en: Her twin sits in the next class.
ex.zh: 她的双胞胎兄弟姐妹坐在隔壁班。

ex.en: A form should leave space for a twin, not assume one child.
ex.zh: 表格应当给双胞胎留出位置，而不假定只有一个孩子。

tip: twin 可数。表里这一行的音标是 twist，本库不用。

senses.en: almost not

ex.en: I can hardly hear the bell from here.
ex.zh: 我在这里几乎听不见铃。

ex.en: A rule that students can hardly read is not a rule they can follow.
ex.zh: 学生几乎读不懂的规定，不是他们能遵守的规定。

tip: hardly 已含否定，不要再加 not。它放在实义动词前、助动词后。不要和 hard（努力地）混淆。

senses.en: from one side to the other, or by means of

ex.en: We walked through the market on the way home.
ex.zh: 我们回家时穿过了市场。

ex.en: Students learn more through explaining an idea than through reading the same note again.
ex.zh: 学生通过讲解一个想法学到的，往往多于把同一条笔记再读一遍。

tip: through 强调从内部穿过；across 强调从表面一边到另一边。

senses.en: the state of being safe

ex.en: Road safety is part of the first lesson.
ex.zh: 交通安全是第一课的一部分。

ex.en: Safety on the walk home depends on lights and pavements, not only on advice.
ex.zh: 回家路上的安全取决于灯和人行道，而不只是劝告。

tip: safety 是名词，不可数。

senses.en: a senior member of a government

ex.en: The education minister visited the school.
ex.zh: 教育部长参观了这所学校。

ex.en: A minister who never rides the bus may not see why the last service matters.
ex.zh: 从不坐公交的部长，可能看不到为什么末班车重要。

tip: minister 也可指牧师，考纲里更常见的是政府部长。

senses.en: the activity of using one's mind

ex.en: Critical thinking is part of the history course.
ex.zh: 批判性思考是历史课的一部分。

ex.en: Quick thinking on social media is not the same as careful thinking about a source.
ex.zh: 社交媒体上的快速思考，不等于对来源的仔细思考。

tip: thinking 是 think 的 -ing，也可作名词。

senses.en: legally acceptable, or based on good reason

ex.en: The ticket is valid until Friday.
ex.zh: 这张票周五前有效。

ex.en: A valid reason for a late bus is a written fault, not a guess.
ex.zh: 晚班车的合理理由是写下来的故障，不是猜测。

tip: valid 可指证件有效，也可指理由站得住。

senses.en: an idea for what to do
to decide what to do

ex.en: Our plan is to finish the poster today.
ex.zh: 我们的计划是今天完成海报。

ex.en: A flood plan that exists only on paper will fail the first night the river rises.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的防汛计划，会在河水上涨的第一个夜里失败。

tip: plan 作动词后接 to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: difficulty or worry
to make someone worried or to disturb them

ex.en: We had trouble finding the right room.
ex.zh: 我们费了劲才找到那间教室。

ex.en: Asking for help early can keep a small trouble from becoming a missed exam.
ex.zh: 早点求助，可以避免一个小麻烦变成一场错过的考试。

col: have trouble doing｜做某事有困难
tip: have trouble doing 不说 have trouble to do。

senses.en: a public show of objects

ex.en: The exhibition is free on Sunday.
ex.zh: 展览周日免费。

ex.en: An exhibition that closes before the last bus has already chosen its visitors.
ex.zh: 在末班车之前就关门的展览，其实已经选定了观众。

tip: exhibition 可数。

senses.en: a problem
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: She overcame great difficulty to succeed.
ex.zh: 她克服巨大困难获得成功。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: the gas from boiling water
to cook with steam, or to give off steam

ex.en: Steam rose from the pot.
ex.zh: 蒸汽从锅里升起。

ex.en: Steam in a closed kitchen is a reason to open a window.
ex.zh: 关着的厨房里的蒸汽，是打开窗户的理由。

tip: steam 通常不可数。作动词是蒸或冒热气。

senses.en: not in danger

ex.en: Is the bridge safe after the rain?
ex.zh: 雨后这座桥安全吗？

ex.en: A street is not safe for children if cars park on the only pavement.
ex.zh: 如果汽车停在唯一的人行道上，这条街对孩子就不安全。

tip: safe 是形容词；safety 是名词。

senses.en: causing laughter, or strange

ex.en: The story was funny, and we still learned the word.
ex.zh: 故事很滑稽，我们仍然学会了那个词。

ex.en: It is funny that a town boasts of a new mall while its oldest school still leaks.
ex.zh: 一座城镇吹嘘新商场，而最老的学校仍在漏雨，这很奇怪。

tip: funny 是“滑稽的”或“奇怪的”；fun 是名词“乐趣”。

senses.en: the way someone acts; British spelling

ex.en: The behaviour in the hall was calm.
ex.zh: 礼堂里的行为很平静。

ex.en: Fair rules look at behaviour, not at who arrived in a quiet car.
ex.zh: 公平的规定看行为，而不是看谁坐着安静的车来的。

tip: behaviour 是英式，behavior 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留。通常不可数。

senses.en: happening most often

ex.en: She took the usual bus.
ex.zh: 她坐了平时那班车。

ex.en: The usual route fails on the day the bridge closes, so the notice must say the other way.
ex.zh: 桥关闭的那天平时的路线走不通，所以通知必须写出另一条路。

tip: as usual 表示和往常一样。usually 是副词。

senses.en: a planned way of doing something

ex.en: This method makes the experiment clearer.
ex.zh: 这个方法让实验更清楚。

ex.en: A teaching method that works in a small class may fail when forty students share one room.
ex.zh: 小班有效的教学方法，在四十个学生共用一间教室时可能失败。

tip: method 后接 of doing 或 for doing。

senses.en: to give money for something
money received for work

ex.en: I paid for the tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在网上付了票钱。

ex.en: Families who pay a large share of their income for rent have less left for books and clinics.
ex.zh: 把收入的很大一部分用来付房租的家庭，留给书和看病的钱就更少。

tip: pay 的过去式和过去分词是 paid。人作主语：sb pays for sth。

senses.en: an open public place in a town
having four equal sides, or multiplied by itself

ex.en: We met in the square outside the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆外的广场见面。

ex.en: A town square that bans bikes may feel tidy and still be harder for students to reach.
ex.zh: 禁止自行车的城镇广场也许看起来整齐，学生却更难到达。

tip: square 作形容词是方形的，也可指数学上的平方。

senses.en: having lived long, or not new

ex.en: This is an old map, but the river is the same.
ex.zh: 这是一张旧地图，但那条河还是一样的。

ex.en: Old buildings can teach a city what to keep when everything else is being rebuilt.
ex.zh: 当其他一切都在重建时，老建筑可以告诉一座城市该保留什么。

tip: 表示年龄用数字加 years old。兄姐用 elder 或 older 都可以。

senses.en: the lowest part

ex.en: The key is at the bottom of the bag.
ex.zh: 钥匙在包的底部。

ex.en: Notes at the bottom of a chart often explain the number that the headline left out.
ex.zh: 图表底部的注释，常常解释标题没写的那个数字。

tip: bottom 是最下面。from the bottom of one's heart 表示衷心。

senses.en: something done wrongly
to be wrong about something

ex.en: I made a mistake in the date.
ex.zh: 我把日期写错了。

ex.en: A mistake in the bus time should be corrected before parents leave work to meet it.
ex.zh: 公交时间的错误应当在家长下班来接之前改掉。

tip: by mistake 表示无意中做错。过去式 mistook，过去分词 mistaken。

senses.en: to say or do again

ex.en: Please repeat the time.
ex.zh: 请把时间再说一遍。

ex.en: Teachers repeat a warning when the first one was on a poster nobody could see.
ex.zh: 当第一次警告写在没人看得见的海报上时，老师会再讲一遍。

tip: repeat 后直接接内容，不说 repeat again 除非强调又一次。

senses.en: to greet someone in a friendly way
gladly received
a friendly greeting

ex.en: We welcome new students on the first day.
ex.zh: 我们在第一天欢迎新生。

ex.en: A town should welcome questions about a new road before the machines arrive.
ex.zh: 在机器到来之前，城镇应该欢迎关于新路的提问。

tip: welcome 作形容词是“受欢迎的”：You are welcome。

senses.en: to answer or react

ex.en: Please respond to the e-mail today.
ex.zh: 请今天回复这封电子邮件。

ex.en: Schools should respond to a broken step before they respond to a complaint about paint.
ex.zh: 学校应当先回应坏掉的台阶，再回应关于油漆的投诉。

tip: respond to something。表里这一行的音标是 respect，本库不用。

senses.en: a shared decision, or the state of agreeing

ex.en: The two classes reached an agreement about the hall.
ex.zh: 两个班就礼堂的使用达成了协议。

ex.en: An agreement on water use fails if nobody writes down who may pump on a dry day.
ex.zh: 如果没人写下干旱日谁可以抽水，用水协议就会失败。

tip: 达成协议用 reach 或 come to an agreement。

senses.en: a period of seven days

ex.en: We have a test next week.
ex.zh: 我们下周有一次测验。

ex.en: A four-day school week may cut costs, but it can also lengthen each remaining day beyond what children can manage.
ex.zh: 每周上四天课也许能省钱，但也可能把剩下的每天拉长到孩子承受不了。

tip: next week 前不加 the。

senses.en: a set of connected people, computers, or routes

ex.en: The bus network does not reach our village.
ex.zh: 公交网络到不了我们村。

ex.en: A phone network that fails in a storm leaves the people who need a warning without one.
ex.zh: 在风暴中失灵的电话网络，会让最需要警报的人收不到警报。

tip: network 可指计算机网络，也可指交通或人际网络。

senses.en: to have inside
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This box may contain old letters.
ex.zh: 这个盒子里可能装有旧信。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: a sudden feeling of fear
to feel sudden fear

ex.en: There was no need to panic.
ex.zh: 没有必要惊慌。

ex.en: A clear alarm prevents panic better than a shout.
ex.zh: 清楚的警报比一声喊叫更能避免惊慌。

tip: panic 作动词是惊慌。过去式 panicked。本条不写制造恐慌的做法。

senses.en: difficult, or strong and not easily broken

ex.en: The first chapter is tough, but it gets clearer.
ex.zh: 第一章很难，但后面会清楚些。

ex.en: A tough timetable is fairer when every class, not only the top set, can use the lab.
ex.zh: 艰难的课表若让每个班而不只是尖子班都能用实验室，就更公平。

tip: tough 可形容任务难，也可形容人或材料结实。表里音标是 totally，本库不用。

senses.en: very bad or strict

ex.en: The storm caused severe damage.
ex.zh: 暴风雨造成了严重损失。

ex.en: Severe rules without an explanation teach fear more than safety.
ex.zh: 没有解释的严厉规定，教给人们的是害怕多于安全。

tip: severe 比 serious 语气更强。

senses.en: before noon

ex.en: The reading room opens at 7 a.m.
ex.zh: 阅览室早上七点开门。

ex.en: Starting lessons at 7 a.m. may suit adults, but many teenagers are still at their sleepiest then.
ex.zh: 早上七点上课也许适合成年人，但许多青少年那时仍处于最困的时候。

tip: a.m. 表示午夜到中午；书写时数字与 a.m. 之间留空格。

senses.en: an informal hello

ex.en: She said hi to the new student.
ex.zh: 她向新同学说了声嗨。

ex.en: A friendly hi at the gate does not replace a safe road, but it can make the first day easier.
ex.zh: 门口一声友好的嗨替代不了安全的路，但能让第一天容易些。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，正式场合少用。

senses.en: a set of beliefs in a god or gods

ex.en: The class studies religion as history, not as a test of faith.
ex.zh: 这个班把宗教当历史来学，而不是信仰测验。

ex.en: A public school can explain a religion without telling students to join it.
ex.zh: 公立学校可以讲解一种宗教，而不要求学生加入。

tip: 形容词 religious 已在本库。

senses.en: a talk in which people share opinions

ex.en: The discussion lasted twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 讨论持续了二十分钟。

ex.en: A discussion about the bus route should include the students who miss it.
ex.zh: 关于公交路线的讨论应当包括那些赶不上车的学生。

tip: 动词是 discuss，已在本库。discuss 后不加 about，名词 discussion 后常用 about 或 of。

senses.en: a marriage ceremony

ex.en: The wedding is in the town hall.
ex.zh: 婚礼在市政厅举行。

ex.en: A school should not assume every family celebrates a wedding in the same way.
ex.zh: 学校不应当假定每个家庭都以同样的方式庆祝婚礼。

tip: wedding 是仪式。婚姻关系用 marriage。

senses.en: a thin string of cotton or similar material
to put thread through

ex.en: The button needs a stronger thread.
ex.zh: 这颗扣子需要更结实的线。

ex.en: A thread of the story is the late bus, not the joke.
ex.zh: 故事的一条线索是晚班车，不是那个笑话。

tip: thread 也可比喻线索。作动词是穿线。

senses.en: the act of finding something, or the thing found

ex.en: The discovery is explained in the last chapter.
ex.zh: 这个发现在最后一章说明。

ex.en: A discovery in the lab is useful only when the notes can be read by the next class.
ex.zh: 实验室里的发现，只有在下一班能读懂笔记时才有用。

tip: 动词 discover 已在本库。discovery 可数。

senses.en: the red liquid in the body

ex.en: The nurse stopped the blood with a clean cloth.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的布止住了血。

ex.en: Loss of blood is one reason a village clinic must be close, not an hour away.
ex.zh: 失血是乡村诊所必须在近处、而不是一小时之外的原因之一。

tip: blood 不可数。

senses.en: a series of actions
to treat or deal with something in stages

ex.en: Learning a word is a slow process.
ex.zh: 学会一个词是一个缓慢的过程。

ex.en: The process of cleaning a river includes factories upstream, not only the park in the city.
ex.zh: 清理一条河的过程包括上游的工厂，而不只是城里的公园。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: process 作动词是“加工、处理”，名词重音常在前，动词重音可在后。

senses.en: films, music, and other things people enjoy

ex.en: The entertainment starts after the speeches.
ex.zh: 娱乐节目在讲话之后开始。

ex.en: Free entertainment in the square still needs a toilet and a way home.
ex.zh: 广场上的免费娱乐仍然需要厕所和回家的办法。

tip: entertainment 通常不可数。具体一场节目有时可用 an entertainment。

senses.en: parents and children, or relatives

ex.en: My family has dinner together on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们家周日一起吃晚饭。

ex.en: When housing is too expensive, a family may spend so much on rent that little remains for books or clinics.
ex.zh: 当住房太贵时，一个家庭可能把太多钱花在房租上，书籍和看病就所剩无几。

tip: family 作整体时谓语用单数；强调家庭成员时有时用复数。

senses.en: to want to know, or to feel surprise
a feeling of surprise, or something wonderful

ex.en: I wonder whether the museum is open.
ex.zh: 我想知道博物馆是否开着。

ex.en: Residents wonder why a new mall was finished before the leaking school roof.
ex.zh: 居民想知道为什么新商场比漏雨的校舍屋顶先完工。

tip: wonder 后常接 if 或 whether。

senses.en: something added, or the process of adding

ex.en: The new lab is a useful addition to the school.
ex.zh: 新实验室是学校有用的增添。

ex.en: In addition to more roads, the town needs pavements if children are to walk safely.
ex.zh: 除了更多的路，如果孩子要安全走路，城镇还需要人行道。

tip: in addition to 后接名词或 doing。

senses.en: to take to a place; to give a speech
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The post office will deliver the package.
ex.zh: 邮局会递送这个包裹。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: to dislike very strongly
a strong dislike

ex.en: I hate waiting in the rain.
ex.zh: 我讨厌在雨里等。

ex.en: People hate a rule they do not understand more than a rule that is strict but clear.
ex.zh: 人们对不理解的规则的反感，超过对严格但清楚的规则。

tip: hate 后接 doing 或 to do。

senses.en: a large group of people in one place
to fill a place

ex.en: A crowd waited at the gate.
ex.zh: 一群人在门口等着。

ex.en: A crowd at a school gate is a design problem if the pavement is too narrow.
ex.zh: 如果人行道太窄，校门口的人群就是一个设计问题。

tip: crowd 作动词是拥挤。crowded 是形容词。

senses.en: a strong wish
to want something strongly

ex.en: Her desire to study medicine is clear.
ex.zh: 她学医的愿望很明确。

ex.en: A desire for a high score should not cancel a night of sleep.
ex.zh: 想得高分的愿望不应当取消一夜睡眠。

tip: desire 比 wish 更强，也更正式。作动词直接接名词或 to do。

senses.en: to rest with the eyes closed
the rest you get at night

ex.en: I sleep for eight hours on school nights.
ex.zh: 上学的晚上我睡八小时。

ex.en: Teenagers sleep better when phones stay out of the bedroom.
ex.zh: 手机不放在卧室时，青少年睡得更好。

tip: sleep 是动词或不可数名词。睡着了用 asleep。

senses.en: a piece of furniture, or a list of figures

ex.en: Please clear the table after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后请把桌子收拾干净。

ex.en: A table of bus times is useless if the last bus leaves before school ends.
ex.zh: 如果末班车在放学前离开，一份公交时刻表就没有用。

tip: table 也可指表格。

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The delay occurred after lunch.
ex.zh: 晚点发生在午饭之后。

ex.en: Floods occur in the same streets when the drain stays blocked.
ex.zh: 排水口一直堵着时，洪水就发生在同样的街道上。

tip: occur 比 happen 正式。It occurred to me that... 表示我想到。

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想谢谢你的帮助。

ex.en: Cities should thank the workers who collect rubbish before dawn, not only the people who design the posters.
ex.zh: 城市应该感谢黎明前收垃圾的工人，而不只是设计海报的人。

tip: thank 是动词，后面接人；名词用 thanks。

senses.en: to become a member, or to connect

ex.en: I want to join the choir.
ex.zh: 我想加入合唱团。

ex.en: A new road that does not join the bus network still leaves many people walking.
ex.zh: 不与公交网络相连的新路，仍然让许多人走路。

tip: join 后接团体表示加入；join in 后接活动。

senses.en: a reduction in price

ex.en: The discount is for students.
ex.zh: 这个折扣是给学生的。

ex.en: A discount that is not written down is not a price a family can check.
ex.zh: 没写下来的折扣，不是家庭能核对的价格。

tip: discount 作动词是打折。

senses.en: to pay to use something, or to employ someone
an act of hiring

ex.en: The school will hire a bus.
ex.zh: 学校将租一辆公交。

ex.en: Do not hire a driver who has already worked a full night.
ex.zh: 不要雇用已经上了一整夜班的司机。

col: hire sb to do｜雇某人做
tip: 英式 hire 可指租用。美式 hire 多指雇用，租用常用 rent。

senses.en: most important
a leader

ex.en: The chief reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的主要原因是下雨。

ex.en: The chief cost of a new road may be the playground it replaces, not the stone it uses.
ex.zh: 一条新路的主要代价，可能是它取代的操场，而不是它用的石头。

tip: chief 作名词是“首领”。

senses.en: helpful for a purpose

ex.en: The map was useful on the trip.
ex.zh: 这张地图在旅途中很有用。

ex.en: A useful rule is one a new student can follow on the first day.
ex.zh: 有用的规定是新生第一天就能照做的。

tip: 说 sth is useful to sb，或 useful for doing。

senses.en: hopeful, or certain

ex.en: She gave a positive answer.
ex.zh: 她给了肯定的回答。

ex.en: A positive test result should be explained in words a family can understand.
ex.zh: 阳性的检测结果应该用一个家庭能懂的话来解释。

tip: positive 在检测里表示阳性，在态度里表示积极。

senses.en: a short piece of writing
to notice or write down

ex.en: I wrote a note to remind myself.
ex.zh: 我写了张便条提醒自己。

ex.en: A note in the margin of a shared textbook can help the next reader if the handwriting is clear.
ex.zh: 如果字迹清楚，共用课本页边的笔记能帮助下一个读者。

tip: note 作动词是“注意”或“记下”。

senses.en: to drop down
a drop, or autumn in American English

ex.en: Leaves fall from the tree in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天树叶落下。

ex.en: If wages fall while rents rise, families move farther from the schools they wanted.
ex.zh: 如果工资下降而房租上升，家庭会搬得离他们想去的学校更远。

tip: fall 的过去式是 fell，过去分词是 fallen。秋天是 autumn，美式常用 fall。

senses.en: higher in position

ex.en: The upper floor is for the art rooms.
ex.zh: 楼上是美术教室。

ex.en: Students on the upper floor need a plan for when the lift stops.
ex.zh: 楼上的学生需要电梯停运时的方案。

tip: upper 是形容词，不单独作名词表示“上面”。

senses.en: a sudden increase, or a deep loud sound
to increase suddenly, or to make a deep sound

ex.en: The boom in bus use started in September.
ex.zh: 公交使用量的激增从九月开始。

ex.en: A boom in new flats still needs a clinic and a late bus.
ex.zh: 新公寓的激增仍然需要诊所和晚班车。

tip: boom 作动词是激增或发出隆隆声。

senses.en: having a value that makes something sensible

ex.en: The museum is worth a visit.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆值得一看。

ex.en: A long meeting is worth the time if it stops a road being built in the wrong place.
ex.zh: 如果一次长会能避免路修在错误的地方，它就值得花时间。

tip: be worth doing 用主动形式表示被动含义，不说 worth to be done。

senses.en: harm to the body

ex.en: The injury kept him out of the match.
ex.zh: 这次受伤让他没能参赛。

ex.en: A small injury reported early is easier to treat than one hidden until Friday.
ex.zh: 早报告的小伤比拖到周五才说的更容易处理。

tip: injury 可数。动词是 injure。

senses.en: able to be trusted

ex.en: The clock is reliable.
ex.zh: 这块钟是可靠的。

ex.en: A reliable bus is one whose time is written down.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交是时间被写下来的那种。

tip: 动词 rely 是本批的另一词。

senses.en: an electronic machine for storing and using information

ex.en: The computer in the library is free to use.
ex.zh: 图书馆的电脑可以免费使用。

ex.en: A computer in a school helps only when students are also taught how to check a source.
ex.zh: 学校里的电脑只有在同时教会学生核对来源时才有帮助。

tip: computer 是可数名词。

senses.en: the outside or top layer

ex.en: The surface of the desk is still wet.
ex.zh: 桌面还是湿的。

ex.en: Oil on the surface of a river is a warning, even when the water below looks calm.
ex.zh: 河面上的油是警告，即使下面的水看起来平静。

tip: on the surface 常比喻“表面上”，和 in reality 相对。

senses.en: a person who trains a team, or a bus for long trips

ex.en: The coach spoke after the match.
ex.zh: 教练在比赛后讲了话。

ex.en: A coach who listens can improve a team more than one who only shouts.
ex.zh: 肯听的教练比只会喊的教练更能提高一支队伍。

tip: coach 也可指长途客车。作动词是“指导”。

senses.en: a machine that produces power to move something

ex.en: The engine of the old bus is loud.
ex.zh: 这辆旧公交的发动机声音很大。

ex.en: An electric engine changes the noise of a street, and it still needs a clean source of power.
ex.zh: 电动机改变一条街的噪音，它仍然需要清洁的电力来源。

tip: search engine 是搜索引擎，不是机械发动机。

senses.en: the activity of buying things

ex.en: We do the shopping on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们周六买东西。

ex.en: Online shopping arrives at a door, and someone still has to carry the box upstairs.
ex.zh: 网购送到门口，仍然得有人把箱子搬上楼。

tip: shopping 是名词。商店是 shop，已在本库。

senses.en: a rule made by a government, or a scientific rule

ex.en: The new law limits plastic bags in shops.
ex.zh: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。

ex.en: A law that nobody can understand is hard to follow, even when its aim is fair.
ex.zh: 一部没人读得懂的法律很难被遵守，即使它的目的是公平的。

tip: law 表示法律时可不可数；一条法律用 a law。

senses.en: the details of where someone lives, or a formal speech
to speak to, or to deal with

ex.en: Write your address on the form.
ex.zh: 把地址写在表格上。

ex.en: An address that a delivery van cannot find is also a problem for an ambulance.
ex.zh: 快递车找不到的地址，对救护车也是问题。

col: address a problem｜处理一个问题
tip: address 作动词是“对……说话”或“处理”。

senses.en: a form of something that is slightly different

ex.en: This is the latest version of the form.
ex.zh: 这是表格的最新版本。

ex.en: An online version of a warning helps only people who can open it.
ex.zh: 警报的网络版本只帮助打得开它的人。

tip: version 是可数名词。

senses.en: a list of money owed, or a proposed law

ex.en: The electricity bill was higher this month.
ex.zh: 这个月的电费账单更高。

ex.en: A bill that limits plastic bags needs shops that will actually follow it.
ex.zh: 限制塑料袋的法案需要真正会执行的商店。

tip: 美式英语里 bill 也可指纸币。

senses.en: a computer for one person

ex.en: The lab has one personal computer for two students.
ex.zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。

ex.en: A personal computer at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
ex.zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。

tip: 常缩写为 PC。表里没有这一条的音标，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: connected with a god or religion

ex.en: Visitors should be quiet in the holy place.
ex.zh: 参观者在圣地应当保持安静。

ex.en: A holy day for one community may be an ordinary school day for another.
ex.zh: 对一个群体是圣日的日子，对另一个群体可能只是普通上学日。

tip: holy 描述宗教上的神圣。不要用来泛指“很好”。

senses.en: an organization for education or research

ex.en: The institute offers a Saturday lab.
ex.zh: 这个研究所周六开放实验室。

ex.en: An institute near a factory can train local students for work that already exists.
ex.zh: 工厂附近的学院可以为当地学生培训已经存在的工作。

tip: institute 常指专科院校或研究所。institution 更泛，可以是制度或较大的机构。

senses.en: as good as possible
to make something as good as it can be

ex.en: Nobody expects a perfect first draft.
ex.zh: 没人指望第一稿就完美。

ex.en: A perfect score on one test does not show whether a student can work with other people.
ex.zh: 一次考试的满分并不能说明学生能否与他人合作。

tip: perfect 作动词是“使完善”，重音常在第二音节。

senses.en: to be the best or to get a prize

ex.en: Our team wants to win the basketball match.
ex.zh: 我们队想赢得篮球赛。

ex.en: A city does not win public trust by announcing a plan it never carries out.
ex.zh: 一座城市不会因为宣布一个从不执行的计划就赢得公众信任。

tip: win 的宾语是比赛、奖品或胜利，不是对手。打败某人用 beat sb。

senses.en: to become larger, or to raise plants

ex.en: Tomatoes grow well on this side of the wall.
ex.zh: 西红柿在墙的这一侧长得好。

ex.en: Cities that grow too fast may run out of classrooms before they run out of building plans.
ex.zh: 发展太快的城市，可能在规划还没用完之前教室就不够了。

tip: grow 的过去式是 grew，过去分词是 grown。grow up 表示长大。

senses.en: great happiness, or something that causes it

ex.en: The concert was a joy.
ex.zh: 这场音乐会是一件乐事。

ex.en: Joy at a win should still leave room to thank the person who passed the ball.
ex.zh: 胜利的欢乐仍然应当留出位置，去谢谢传球的人。

col: to one joy｜令某人高兴的是
jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
tip: joy 作情感时常不可数。a joy 表示一件令人高兴的事。

senses.en: a container with straight sides

ex.en: Put the bottles in the recycling box.
ex.zh: 把瓶子放进回收箱。

ex.en: A box of shared books can keep a village reading when the library bus comes only once a month.
ex.zh: 当图书车每月只来一次时，一箱共用的书能让村子继续有书读。

tip: box 的复数是 boxes。

senses.en: difficult in an interesting or demanding way

ex.en: The question is challenging, and it has a source.
ex.zh: 这道题有挑战性，而且有来源。

ex.en: A challenging timetable still fails if it hides the last bus.
ex.zh: 有挑战性的课表如果藏起末班车，仍然会失败。

col: a challenging task｜有挑战性的任务
tip: challenge 已在本库。challenging 形容事物。

senses.en: a person or thing that protects
to watch and protect

ex.en: A guard stands at the stadium gate.
ex.zh: 体育场门口站着一名守卫。

ex.en: A guard at a school gate should know how to help, not only how to stop people.
ex.zh: 校门口的守卫应当知道如何帮忙，而不只是如何拦人。

tip: guard 作动词是守卫。be on your guard 表示提防。

senses.en: happening once a week
once a week
