ex.en: Regular walks are good for the heart.
ex.zh: 经常走路对心脏有好处。

ex.en: A market in the heart of a town keeps daily life there; a mall on the edge can empty the centre.
ex.zh: 镇中心的市场维持着那里的日常生活；边缘的商场可能掏空中心。

tip: by heart 表示靠记忆，不是“靠心脏”。

senses.en: a vehicle or firework that is driven upward by burning fuel

ex.en: The textbook shows a rocket and a diagram.
ex.zh: 课本展示火箭和一张图。

ex.en: A lesson about a rocket should stay with the diagram, not a method.
ex.zh: 关于火箭的课应当停在图上，而不是做法。

tip: 本条是科普词汇。不写如何制造或发射。

senses.en: not wet
to make or become dry

ex.en: Hang the coats where they can dry.
ex.zh: 把外套挂在能晾干的地方。

ex.en: A dry year raises the price of vegetables before it empties the school taps.
ex.zh: 干旱的一年会先抬高菜价，然后才会让学校的水龙头没水。

tip: dry 作动词是使变干。

senses.en: written works, especially those valued as art

ex.en: We read literature from more than one country.
ex.zh: 我们读的文学不止来自一个国家。

ex.en: Literature class is richer when the list includes writers the textbook forgot.
ex.zh: 如果书单包括课本忘掉的作家，文学课会更丰富。

tip: literature 通常不可数。

senses.en: words changed from one language into another

ex.en: The translation is on the right.
ex.zh: 译文在右边。

ex.en: A translation of the bus notice helps the parent who does not read the first language.
ex.zh: 公交通知的翻译能帮助读不懂第一种语言的家长。

tip: translation 可数。

senses.en: wanting food

ex.en: The class was hungry before lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭前班级饿了。

ex.en: A hungry student cannot use a speech about diet as a meal.
ex.zh: 饥饿的学生不能把一篇关于饮食的讲话当成一餐。

tip: hungry 是形容词。名词是 hunger。

senses.en: the state of continuing to live

ex.en: Survival after the flood depended on a dry room.
ex.zh: 洪水后的幸存靠的是一间干房间。

ex.en: The survival of a small shop depends on the rent.
ex.zh: 小店能否留下来取决于租金。

tip: 动词 survive 已在本库。survival 通常不可数。

senses.en: before now

ex.en: The museum closed two years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆两年前关门了。

ex.en: A factory that shut ten years ago can still leave chemicals in the soil beside a school.
ex.zh: 十年前关闭的工厂，仍可能把化学物质留在学校旁边的土壤里。

tip: ago 用于过去时，放在时间段后面：three days ago。不与现在完成时连用。

senses.en: fully grown, or behaving in a sensible adult way
to become fully grown

ex.en: The plan is mature enough to name a person.
ex.zh: 这个计划成熟到能写出一个人的名字。

ex.en: A mature reply admits a mistake.
ex.zh: 成熟的回答会承认错误。

tip: mature 也可作动词“成熟”。

senses.en: the sweet part of a plant

ex.en: The canteen has fruit on Monday.
ex.zh: 食堂周一有水果。

ex.en: Fruit that students can take without paying is a policy, not only a bowl.
ex.zh: 学生可以不付钱拿走的水果是一项办法，而不只是一只碗。

tip: fruit 作总称通常不可数。a fruit 可指一种水果。

senses.en: shaped like a circle
around
one stage of an event

ex.en: They sat at a round table.
ex.zh: 他们坐在圆桌旁。

ex.en: A round of talks about the river should include the farms upstream, not only the city.
ex.zh: 关于这条河的一轮会谈应该包括上游的农场，而不只是城市。

col: all the year round｜一年到头
tip: 英式里 round 常作介词“围绕”；美式多用 around。

senses.en: a male child

ex.en: Her son walks to school with a neighbour.
ex.zh: 她儿子和邻居一起走路上学。

ex.en: A son who leaves for the city may still send money home, but the village loses his daily help.
ex.zh: 去城市的儿子也许仍会寄钱回家，但村子失去了他日常的帮忙。

tip: son 的复数是 sons。

senses.en: personality; a person in a story
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Honesty is part of his character.
ex.zh: 诚实是他性格的一部分。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: something that may happen or be true

ex.en: There is a possibility of rain.
ex.zh: 有下雨的可能。

ex.en: The possibility of a late bus should be written down before the trip, not during it.
ex.zh: 晚班车的可能性应当在出行前写下来，而不是在途中。

tip: possible 已在本库。possibility 是名词，后接 of 或 that。

senses.en: not one and not the other of two
not either of two

ex.en: Neither answer is fully right.
ex.zh: 两个答案都不完全对。

ex.en: Neither the early bus nor the late one stops at the new housing block.
ex.zh: 早班车和晚班车都不在新建的住宅区停。

tip: neither 作主语时谓语常用单数。nor 已在本库。

senses.en: a special day or period of public celebration

ex.en: The town festival is next weekend.
ex.zh: 镇上的节日在下个周末。

ex.en: A school festival should name which dates belong to which community, and not assume one calendar.
ex.zh: 学校的节日活动应当写明哪些日子属于哪个群体，而不假定只有一种日历。

tip: festival 可数。on the festival 不如 at the festival 或 during the festival 常见。

senses.en: to get something that is given or sent

ex.en: I received your message this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上收到了你的信息。

ex.en: Students who receive help early are less likely to hide a problem until the exam.
ex.zh: 早点得到帮助的学生，不太会把问题藏到考试。

tip: 拼写是 receive：c 后面是 ei。收到并不等于接受，接受用 accept。

senses.en: a supporting structure, or a set of ideas

ex.en: The framework of the essay is three points.
ex.zh: 这篇作文的框架是三个要点。

ex.en: A framework for the bus plan should include the return time.
ex.zh: 公交计划的框架应当包括返回时间。

tip: framework 可数。

senses.en: perhaps

ex.en: Maybe we can meet after the club.
ex.zh: 也许我们可以在社团活动后见面。

ex.en: Maybe a later school start would help, but only if buses change their times too.
ex.zh: 也许推迟上学时间会有帮助，但只有公交也改时间才行。

tip: maybe 是一个副词；may be 是情态动词加动词，要分开写。

senses.en: a point given for work, or a sign
to write a sign, or to give a score

ex.en: She got a high mark in the reading test.
ex.zh: 她阅读测验得了高分。

ex.en: A single mark on one test should not decide whether a student can join the science club.
ex.zh: 一次测验的一个分数，不该决定学生能否参加科学社团。

tip: mark 作动词是“做标记”或“打分”。

senses.en: the worth or importance of something
to think something is important

ex.en: The old map still has value for the history class.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图对历史课仍有价值。

ex.en: The value of a library is not only the books, but the quiet hour it gives after school.
ex.zh: 图书馆的价值不只是书，还有它在放学后提供的安静一小时。

tip: value 作动词是“重视”或“估价”。

senses.en: a person who follows Islam
of Muslims or Islam

ex.en: The museum explains how local Muslims mark the festival.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解当地穆斯林如何过这个节日。

ex.en: A school calendar that names one holiday should also leave room for a Muslim student to be absent for another.
ex.zh: 只写一个节日的校历，也应当给穆斯林学生为另一个节日请假留出空间。

tip: Muslim 作名词和形容词都要大写。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: a formal talk, or the power of speaking

ex.en: Her speech at the ceremony was three minutes.
ex.zh: 她在典礼上的演讲只有三分钟。

ex.en: A speech that names no fact can still sound confident, which is why the class checks sources.
ex.zh: 一篇不提事实的演讲仍可能听起来自信，所以班级要核来源。

tip: speech 表示一次演讲时可数。表示说话能力时不可数。

senses.en: the design of buildings

ex.en: The architecture of the hall is simple.
ex.zh: 礼堂的建筑很简单。

ex.en: Good architecture includes a door a wheelchair can use.
ex.zh: 好的建筑包括一扇轮椅能用的门。

tip: architecture 通常不可数。

senses.en: a person who cooks
to prepare food by heating it

ex.en: The cook knows which students cannot eat nuts.
ex.zh: 厨师知道哪些学生不能吃坚果。

ex.en: A school cook who labels the food saves more trouble than a long speech about diet.
ex.zh: 给食物贴标签的学校厨师，比一篇关于饮食的长讲话更能省麻烦。

tip: cook 是人。炉具是 cooker。作动词是烹调。

senses.en: a large area of water surrounded by land

ex.en: We are not allowed to swim in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们不准在湖里游泳。

ex.en: A clean lake supports birds and a town's drinking water at the same time.
ex.zh: 干净的湖同时养活鸟类和一座城镇的饮用水。

tip: lake 是被陆地包围的湖。sea 是海。

senses.en: to show a feeling or idea in words
a fast train or delivery
travelling or sent very fast

ex.en: She could not express the idea in one sentence.
ex.zh: 她没法用一句话表达这个想法。

ex.en: Students who express a worry early give the school time to change the plan.
ex.zh: 早点说出担心的学生，给学校留下改变计划的时间。

tip: express 作名词或形容词可指快车或特快。

senses.en: a level used for judging
usual or accepted

ex.en: The school raised its safety standard.
ex.zh: 学校提高了安全标准。

ex.en: A national standard for school buses helps only if villages can afford to meet it.
ex.zh: 校车的国家标准只有在乡村负担得起时才有帮助。

tip: standard 作形容词是“标准的”。

senses.en: to or at a distance

ex.en: She put the phone away during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭时她把手机收起来了。

ex.en: Moving factories away from rivers can protect drinking water for the towns downstream.
ex.zh: 把工厂迁离河流，可以保护下游城镇的饮用水。

tip: away 是副词，不单独接宾语；表示离开某地用 away from。

senses.en: inside a limit of time, distance, or area

ex.en: Please reply within three days.
ex.zh: 请在三天内回复。

ex.en: A clinic within walking distance saves families the cost of a long bus ride.
ex.zh: 步行能到的诊所，能为家庭省下长途公交的费用。

col: within reach｜在够得着的范围内
tip: within 强调不超过某个范围；in 更一般。

senses.en: a test done to learn something
to do a test

ex.en: The experiment is on the board.
ex.zh: 实验写在黑板上。

ex.en: An experiment without notes cannot be repeated by the next class.
ex.zh: 没有笔记的实验，下一班无法重复。

tip: experiment 作动词是做实验。本条不写危险操作。

senses.en: the front of the chest, or a part of the body

ex.en: The clinic form uses the word breast in a medical sense.
ex.zh: 诊所表格在医学意义上使用 breast 这个词。

ex.en: A health lesson can name the breast and still stay respectful.
ex.zh: 健康课可以提到胸部，同时仍然保持尊重。

tip: breast 是身体部位的普通词。本条用医务和课堂的说法，不写其他内容。

senses.en: to put a hand on something
an act of touching, or the sense

ex.en: Do not touch the wet paint on the door.
ex.zh: 别碰门上还没干的油漆。

ex.en: A museum that lets students touch a copy of an old tool teaches more than a glass case alone.
ex.zh: 让学生触摸一件古工具复制品的博物馆，比只有玻璃柜教得更多。

tip: keep in touch 表示保持联系，不是身体接触。

senses.en: to ask someone to come or to do something

ex.en: Invite the new student to the table.
ex.zh: 邀请新同学到这张桌子来。

ex.en: A school should invite the parent who works nights, and then choose a time they can come.
ex.zh: 学校应当邀请上夜班的家长，然后选一个他们能来的时间。

tip: 名词常用 invitation。本库目前是动词 invite。

senses.en: the same in size, value, or rights
to be the same as

ex.en: The two teams had an equal chance.
ex.zh: 两队机会相等。

ex.en: Equal time at the microphone matters when one class is louder than the other.
ex.zh: 当一个班比另一个班更吵时，话筒前相等的时间就很重要。

tip: equal 作动词是等于。be equal to 还可表示胜任。

senses.en: to leave a place or stop doing something

ex.en: He did not quit the team; he was ill.
ex.zh: 他没有退出队伍，他是病了。

ex.en: Students who quit a subject in silence give the school no chance to help.
ex.zh: 默默放弃一门课的学生，没给学校留下帮忙的机会。

tip: quit 后接 doing，不接 to do。过去式仍是 quit。

senses.en: to encourage something, or to care for a child in your home

ex.en: The club fosters a reading habit.
ex.zh: 社团培养学生的阅读习惯。

ex.en: Foster care should name the adult who meets the child.
ex.zh: 寄养应当写明来接孩子的成年人。

tip: 表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: including many different kinds

ex.en: The class is diverse.
ex.zh: 这个班是多样的。

ex.en: A diverse reading list still needs books the library actually has.
ex.zh: 多样的书单仍然需要图书馆真的有的书。

tip: diverse 是形容词。表里标成动词，本库按形容词写。

senses.en: the writer of a book or article

ex.en: The author of the article is a local teacher.
ex.zh: 这篇文章的作者是一位本地老师。

ex.en: An author who hides their name makes it harder to judge the facts.
ex.zh: 隐瞒姓名的作者让人更难判断事实。

tip: author 是可数名词。

senses.en: a country, or a people

ex.en: The nation celebrates this day in October.
ex.zh: 这个国家在十月庆祝这一天。

ex.en: A nation that funds rural schools changes who gets to sit a university exam.
ex.zh: 资助乡村学校的国家，会改变谁有机会参加大学考试。

tip: nation 强调人民或政治共同体。country 更常指国土。

senses.en: to act or play for an audience, or to do a duty

ex.en: The choir will perform on Friday.
ex.zh: 合唱团周五演出。

ex.en: Schools perform better when the first bus arrives before the bell.
ex.zh: 如果第一班车在铃响前到达，学校会运转得更好。

tip: 名词 performance 已在本库，可指演出，也可指表现。

senses.en: a device for speaking to someone at a distance

ex.en: I left my phone in the classroom.
ex.zh: 我把电话落在教室了。

ex.en: A phone warning about a storm helps only the people who still have power and a signal.
ex.zh: 关于风暴的手机警报，只帮助那些还有电和信号的人。

tip: phone 作动词是“打电话”：phone sb。

senses.en: the quality of being important

ex.en: The importance of sleep is in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 睡眠的重要性在第一章。

ex.en: The importance of the last bus is clear on the day it does not come.
ex.zh: 末班车没来的那天，它的重要性就很清楚。

tip: important 已在本库。be of importance 等于 be important，更正式。

senses.en: to fail to catch, or to feel sad someone is away

ex.en: I missed the early bus this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我错过了早班车。

ex.en: Students miss more than a lesson when a flood closes the only road to school.
ex.zh: 当洪水封了唯一的上学路，学生错过的不只是一节课。

tip: Miss 大写是对未婚女性的称呼，和动词 miss 不同。

senses.en: to send something through the air with the hand

ex.en: Do not throw bags on the stairs.
ex.zh: 不要把包扔在楼梯上。

ex.en: Players who throw the ball too hard in a small hall break both windows and the game.
ex.zh: 在小礼堂里扔球太用力的人，既会打碎窗户，也会毁掉比赛。

tip: throw 的过去式是 threw，过去分词是 thrown。

senses.en: to go from one place to another
the activity of travelling

ex.en: We travel to school by bus.
ex.zh: 我们乘公交去上学。

ex.en: Waste can travel downstream farther than the factory that produced it.
ex.zh: 废物可以向下游流到比产生它的工厂更远的地方。

tip: travel 作名词“旅行”通常不可数。

senses.en: to come after, or to obey

ex.en: Follow the signs to the hall.
ex.zh: 按指示牌去大厅。

ex.en: Students follow a timetable, but the buses they need may follow a different one.
ex.zh: 学生遵守课表，但他们需要的公交可能遵守另一份时刻表。

tip: follow 是及物动词，后面直接接宾语，通常不加 to。

senses.en: to make something clear

ex.en: Can you explain this sentence in English?
ex.zh: 你能用英语解释这个句子吗？

ex.en: Charts that explain a water shortage help a town argue for repairs before the next dry summer.
ex.zh: 解释缺水的图表，能帮助一座城镇在下一个干旱的夏天之前争取维修。

col: explain sth to sb｜向某人解释
tip: 说 explain something to somebody，不说 explain somebody something。

senses.en: uncomfortable, or difficult to use

ex.en: The silence was awkward.
ex.zh: 那阵沉默很尴尬。

ex.en: An awkward door for a wheelchair is a design problem, not a student problem.
ex.zh: 轮椅不好用的门是设计问题，不是学生的问题。

col: an awkward silence｜令人尴尬的沉默
tip: awkward 可形容场面、人或物体。

senses.en: a room in a hospital for patients

ex.en: The ward is quiet after nine.
ex.zh: 九点以后病房很安静。

ex.en: A children ward needs a chair for the parent who stays.
ex.zh: 儿童病房需要给留下来的家长一把椅子。

tip: ward 也可指受监护的人。本条以病房为主。

senses.en: to show

ex.en: The chart indicates the bus times.
ex.zh: 图表标出公交时间。

ex.en: A sign should indicate the clinic, not only the hall.
ex.zh: 牌子应当标出医务室，而不只是礼堂。

tip: indicate 比 show 正式。

senses.en: a shiny grey-white metal

ex.en: The medal is silver, not gold.
ex.zh: 这块奖牌是银的，不是金的。

ex.en: A silver cup in a cabinet teaches less than the practice that won it.
ex.zh: 柜子里的银杯，比赢得它的那次练习教得少。

tip: silver 也可作形容词“银色的”。

senses.en: how deep something is

ex.en: The depth of the pool is marked on the wall.
ex.zh: 泳池深度标在墙上。

ex.en: The depth of a flood matters more than a photo of the street.
ex.zh: 洪水的深度比一张街道照片更重要。

tip: 形容词 deep 已在本库。depth 是名词。

senses.en: one of a number of the same thing
to write or reproduce the same thing

ex.en: I need a copy of the reading list.
ex.zh: 我需要一份阅读清单。

ex.en: A library with one copy of a set text cannot serve a whole grade on the same afternoon.
ex.zh: 一套课文只有一本的图书馆，没法在同一个下午服务整个年级。

tip: copy 作动词是抄写或复制。考试里照抄别人的答案是作弊。

senses.en: a number; an important person
a person, their outline, or the shape of their body
to think or decide something after considering it

ex.en: The figure on the board is wrong.
ex.zh: 黑板上的数字错了。

ex.en: Recent employment figures suggest that investment in public transport can create substantial opportunities for local workers.
ex.zh: 近期就业数据显示，投资公共交通能为当地劳动者创造大量机会。

tip: 数据常用复数figures；figure out意为弄懂。

senses.en: a very hard precious stone, or a card suit

ex.en: The museum shows a diamond, and also the tools that cut stone.
ex.zh: 博物馆展示一颗钻石，也展示切石头的工具。

ex.en: A diamond on a poster does not pay the canteen staff.
ex.zh: 海报上的钻石付不了食堂职工的工资。

tip: 纸牌里的方块也叫 diamond。

senses.en: related to business and profit
an advertisement on television

ex.en: The commercial street is busy on Sundays.
ex.zh: 商业街周日很忙。

ex.en: Commercial pressure can make a news site publish before the facts are checked.
ex.zh: 商业压力会让新闻网站在事实核对之前就发表。

tip: commercial 是形容词；commerce 是名词“商业”。

senses.en: a person with authority in an organisation

ex.en: A police officer helped the children cross.
ex.zh: 一位警官帮助孩子们过马路。

ex.en: An officer who explains a rule in plain words is more useful than a sign nobody reads.
ex.zh: 用浅显的话解释规则的官员，比没人读的牌子更有用。

tip: officer 是人；office 是办公室。

senses.en: a strong metal made from iron

ex.en: The bridge is made of steel.
ex.zh: 这座桥是钢做的。

ex.en: Steel gates last, and they still need a person who will open them for a late bus.
ex.zh: 钢门耐用，但晚到的校车仍然需要有人开门。

tip: steel 作材料不可数。不要和 steal（偷）混淆。

senses.en: the male ruler of an empire

ex.en: The history text names the emperor and the year.
ex.zh: 历史课文写出皇帝和年份。

ex.en: A chapter about an emperor should also say who did the work.
ex.zh: 关于皇帝的一章也应当说是谁在干活。

tip: emperor 可数。

senses.en: to succeed in doing something

ex.en: He worked hard to achieve his goals.
ex.zh: 他努力工作以实现目标。

ex.en: Governments can achieve significant reductions in air pollution by investing in clean energy and improving public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过投资清洁能源和改善公共交通，大幅减少空气污染。

tip: 直接接目标或成果，不说achieve to do。

senses.en: the condition of the air at a particular time

ex.en: The weather turned cold after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后天气变冷了。

ex.en: Bad weather is a poor excuse for cancelling sport if the hall is empty and safe.
ex.zh: 如果礼堂空着而且安全，坏天气就不是取消体育课的好理由。

col: in all weathers｜无论什么天气
tip: weather 不可数，不说 a weather。表里这一行的音标是 wear，本库不用。

senses.en: the act of making something longer or larger

ex.en: The library got an extension until six.
ex.zh: 图书馆延长到六点。

ex.en: An extension of the bus route helps the students who live past the old stop.
ex.zh: 公交线路的延长能帮助住在旧站以外的学生。

tip: extension 可数。电话分机也叫 extension。

senses.en: the time of being young, or young people

ex.en: The club is open to local youth.
ex.zh: 这个社团对本地青年开放。

ex.en: A youth centre with no evening bus is a building many of its users cannot reach.
ex.zh: 没有夜班车的青年中心，是一座许多使用者到不了的楼。

col: in one youth｜在某人青年时代
tip: the youth 可指青年群体，谓语常用复数。

senses.en: two times

ex.en: I have read the notice twice.
ex.zh: 这则通知我读了两遍。

ex.en: Checking a source twice is cheaper than correcting a story the whole school has already shared.
ex.zh: 把来源核对两遍，比纠正全校已经转发的故事代价更小。

tip: 次数用 once、twice，三次起用 three times。

senses.en: a usual practice
made to meet a particular customer's needs
the business customers give to a shop or company

ex.en: Shaking hands is a common custom.
ex.zh: 握手是一种常见习俗。

ex.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
ex.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

tip: custom指风俗或惯例；customs还可指海关。

senses.en: to make music with the voice

ex.en: The class will sing after the speech.
ex.zh: 讲话之后班级要唱歌。

ex.en: A hall where students can sing still needs a quiet room for those who cannot.
ex.zh: 学生能唱歌的礼堂，仍然需要一间给不能唱的人的安静房间。

tip: sing 的过去式是 sang，过去分词是 sung。

senses.en: to become or make larger

ex.en: The number of bikes increased this term.
ex.zh: 这学期自行车的数量增加了。

ex.en: If rents increase faster than wages, workers move farther from the jobs a city needs.
ex.zh: 如果房租涨得比工资快，工人会搬得离城市需要的工作更远。

tip: increase 作名词时重音常在前，作动词时重音常在后。

senses.en: to be the property of, or to be a member

ex.en: The books belong to the library.
ex.zh: 这些书属于图书馆。

ex.en: Every student belongs in the lab, not only the ones with high scores.
ex.zh: 每个学生都属于实验室，而不只是高分的那些。

tip: belong to 后接人或组织。没有被动式。

senses.en: very nearly

ex.en: I almost missed the early bus.
ex.zh: 我差点错过早班车。

ex.en: A plan that is almost finished still fails if the last step, such as a safe crossing, is missing.
ex.zh: 一个几乎完成的计划，如果缺了最后一步，比如安全的过街处，仍然会失败。

tip: almost 可修饰 all、every、no；nearly 一般不修饰 no 和 never 的否定极限，习惯上用 almost no。

senses.en: a place of higher education

ex.en: She hopes to study biology at university.
ex.zh: 她希望在大学学生物。

ex.en: A university that ignores the town around it will not see the housing problems its students face.
ex.zh: 忽视周围城镇的大学，看不到自己学生面对的住房问题。

tip: go to university 泛指上大学，常不加 the。

senses.en: to bend the head or body to show respect
a bending of the body, or a curved shape

ex.en: The actor will bow at the end.
ex.zh: 演员会在结束时鞠躬。

ex.en: A bow is a greeting in some places, and a handshake is a greeting in others.
ex.zh: 有的地方用鞠躬打招呼，有的地方用握手。

tip: 鞠躬和弓形物读 /bəʊ/。武器“弓”读 /baʊ/。本条以鞠躬为主。

senses.en: one or the other of two

ex.en: You may take either seat.
ex.zh: 两个座位你坐哪个都行。

ex.en: Either the bus comes on time or students start arriving late, and then the first lesson suffers.
ex.zh: 要么公交准时，要么学生开始迟到，然后第一节课受影响。

tip: either...or 连接主语时，谓语与靠近的主语一致。否定句末的“也”用 either，不用 too。

senses.en: to hand something to someone, or to provide

ex.en: Please give the form to your class teacher.
ex.zh: 请把表格交给班主任。

ex.en: Cities that give buses their own lanes often move more people than cities that only widen roads.
ex.zh: 给公交车专用车道的城市，往往比只拓宽马路的城市运送更多人。

tip: give sb sth 或 give sth to sb，两种语序都可以。

senses.en: in every place, or in any place

ex.en: Sit wherever you can see the board.
ex.zh: 坐在你能看见黑板的任何地方。

ex.en: Wherever the bus stops, the time should be written.
ex.zh: 无论公交停在哪里，时间都应当写下来。

col: wherever you go｜无论你去哪里
tip: wherever 也可作副词。

senses.en: a piece of clothing for the upper body

ex.en: He wore a white shirt to the photo.
ex.zh: 他穿着白衬衫去拍照。

ex.en: A spare shirt at school matters when the morning rain soaks the first one.
ex.zh: 早晨的雨打湿第一件时，学校里的备用衬衫就有用。

tip: T-shirt 是另一词，本批另有词条。shirt 通常有领。

senses.en: a group chosen to decide or organise something

ex.en: The committee will meet on Friday.
ex.zh: 委员会周五开会。

ex.en: A committee that never visits the street may approve a road the residents do not want.
ex.zh: 从不走那条街的委员会，可能会批准居民不想要的路。

col: a member of the committee｜委员会成员
tip: committee 作整体时谓语可用单数。

senses.en: your name written by yourself

ex.en: The signature is missing.
ex.zh: 签名缺了。

ex.en: A signature on a fee form should be a person the family can name.
ex.zh: 费用表上的签名应当是家庭能说出名字的人。

tip: signature 可数。

senses.en: a place where people stay in tents or simple buildings
to stay in a tent

ex.en: The summer camp lasts five days.
ex.zh: 夏令营为期五天。

ex.en: A camp near a river needs a night plan for rain, not only a list of games.
ex.zh: 河边的营地需要夜里下雨的方案，而不只是一份游戏清单。

tip: camp 作动词是野营。

senses.en: a substance like air, or fuel

ex.en: The science class learned about natural gas.
ex.zh: 科学课学习了天然气。

ex.en: A gas leak near a school is an emergency, not a smell to ignore until tomorrow.
ex.zh: 学校附近的煤气泄漏是紧急情况，不是可以拖到明天的气味。

tip: 美式 gas 常指汽油；英式汽油多用 petrol。

senses.en: connected with religion

ex.en: The museum has a room of religious art.
ex.zh: 博物馆有一间宗教艺术展室。

ex.en: A public school can teach religious history without telling students which faith to follow.
ex.zh: 公立学校可以教宗教史，而不必告诉学生该追随哪种信仰。

tip: religious 是形容词。宗教本身是 religion。

senses.en: strength, or a group organised to use power
to make someone do something

ex.en: The wind had enough force to shut the door.
ex.zh: 风力大得把门关上了。

ex.en: A city should not use force as the first answer to a peaceful student march.
ex.zh: 一座城市不该把武力当作对学生和平游行的第一反应。

tip: force sb to do 表示强迫某人做。

senses.en: used to agree or accept

ex.en: Yes, I can stay after class to help.
ex.zh: 是的，我可以课后留下来帮忙。

ex.en: A quick yes from a committee means little if nobody records who will do the work.
ex.zh: 委员会随口答应没什么用，如果没人记下谁来干活。

tip: yes 用来肯定；对否定疑问句回答要按事实，而不是顺着问句。

senses.en: at the back of
at the back

ex.en: The lab is behind the library.
ex.zh: 实验室在图书馆后面。

ex.en: The reasons behind a high absence rate may be buses and jobs, not only a lack of interest.
ex.zh: 高缺勤率背后的原因可能是公交和工作，而不只是缺乏兴趣。

tip: behind 是介词或副词。落后用 fall behind。

senses.en: low in price

ex.en: The notebook is cheap and strong.
ex.zh: 这个笔记本又便宜又结实。

ex.en: A cheap fare that does not stop near the school is not cheap for the student who must take a taxi.
ex.zh: 不在学校附近停的便宜票价，对必须改乘出租车的学生并不便宜。

tip: cheap 有时含质量差的意思。只说价格低可用 inexpensive。

senses.en: related to seeing

ex.en: The visual aid is a map, not a speech.
ex.zh: 这个直观教具是一张地图，不是一篇讲话。

ex.en: A visual warning at the crossing helps the student who cannot hear the bell.
ex.zh: 路口的视觉警告能帮助听不见铃的学生。

tip: visual 是形容词。视力是 sight 或 vision。

senses.en: very good, important, or large

ex.en: We had a great time at the school fair.
ex.zh: 我们在校园义卖上玩得很开心。

ex.en: A great increase in visitors can damage the very places people travel to see.
ex.zh: 游客的大量增加，可能破坏人们专程去看的那些地方。

tip: a great many 后接可数名词复数。

senses.en: the reflexive form of he

ex.en: He fixed the bike himself.
ex.zh: 他自己修好了自行车。

ex.en: A mayor who walks the flooded street himself learns more than one who only reads a report.
ex.zh: 亲自走过积水街道的市长，比只读报告的市长了解得更多。

tip: himself 不能代替 he 作主语。

senses.en: a television station, a narrow sea, or a way through

ex.en: We changed the channel to hear the news.
ex.zh: 我们换了频道听新闻。

ex.en: The English Channel is one channel; a student hotline is another kind of channel.
ex.zh: 英吉利海峡是一种 channel，学生热线是另一种渠道。

tip: channel 可以是电视频道、海峡或沟通渠道。

senses.en: water falling from the sky
to fall as rain

ex.en: The rain started during the match.
ex.zh: 比赛时下起了雨。

ex.en: Heavy rain on a school morning is a reason to open the hall, not only to cancel sport.
ex.zh: 上学日早晨的大雨是开放礼堂的理由，而不只是取消体育课。

tip: rain 作名词通常不可数。作动词：It rains。

senses.en: the part at the back of an animal

ex.en: The cat's tail is under the desk.
ex.zh: 猫的尾巴在桌子底下。

ex.en: The tail of the queue still needs a seat on the bus.
ex.zh: 队伍末尾的人在公交上仍然需要一个座位。

tip: tail 也可指队伍或飞机的尾部。

senses.en: belonging to the person mentioned
to possess

ex.en: I wrote the speech in my own words.
ex.zh: 我用自己的话写了这篇演讲。

ex.en: A town that grows its own vegetables is less shaken when outside supplies are delayed.
ex.zh: 自己种菜的城镇，在外部供应延误时受到的冲击更小。

tip: own 前要有物主代词：my own，不能单独说 own book。

senses.en: the people who work for an organization

ex.en: The personnel office is on the ground floor.
ex.zh: 人事办公室在一楼。

ex.en: School personnel need the same fire plan as the students.
ex.zh: 学校职员需要和学生同一份消防方案。

tip: personnel 是集体名词，通常不可数。不要和 personal（个人的）拼混，personal 已在本库。

senses.en: the two together

ex.en: Both answers are possible.
ex.zh: 两个答案都有可能。

ex.en: A city needs both affordable housing and good schools if it wants families to stay.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市希望家庭留下来，就既需要付得起的住房，也需要好学校。

tip: both...and... 连接并列成分，谓语用复数。

senses.en: worth a lot of money or very useful

ex.en: The old map is valuable.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图很有价值。

ex.en: A valuable seat on the late bus is the one a tired student can actually use.
ex.zh: 晚班车上有价值的座位，是疲惫的学生真正能用的那个。

tip: value 已在本库。valuable 是形容词。

senses.en: around a place

ex.en: The surrounding streets flood first.
ex.zh: 周围的街道最先进水。

ex.en: The surrounding hills keep the wind off the yard and also block the late sun.
ex.zh: 周围的山挡住了院子的风，也挡住了傍晚的太阳。

tip: 名词环境常用复数 surroundings。动词是 surround。

senses.en: medical surgery, or the way something works

ex.en: The operation was successful.
ex.zh: 手术成功了。

ex.en: The operation of a night bus depends on drivers, fuel, and a timetable people trust.
ex.zh: 夜班公交的运转取决于司机、燃料，以及人们信任的时刻表。

tip: operation 可指手术或运转，要看语境。

senses.en: to believe someone is honest or reliable
belief that someone is reliable

ex.en: I trust her to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 我信任她会锁好实验室。

ex.en: People trust a clinic more when the same nurse is there every week.
ex.zh: 当同一位护士每周都在时，人们更信任一家诊所。

col: trust sb to do｜相信某人会做
tip: trust 后可接 sb to do。

senses.en: a period of time used for an activity

ex.en: The next session starts at two.
ex.zh: 下一节两点开始。

ex.en: A short session every day beats one long session that nobody can finish.
ex.zh: 每天一小节，胜过谁也完成不了的一长节。

tip: session 可指一节课、一次会议或一段时间。

senses.en: in the inner part of
in the inner part

ex.en: Please wait inside the hall.
ex.zh: 请在大厅里面等。

ex.en: Noise from inside a factory can be lower than the noise of trucks waiting outside it.
ex.zh: 工厂内部的噪音，可能低于在外面等候的卡车的噪音。

tip: inside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: a wide street, often with trees

ex.en: The library is on the next avenue.
ex.zh: 图书馆在下一条大街上。

ex.en: An avenue of trees cools the walk to school.
ex.zh: 大街两旁的树让上学的路凉快一些。

tip: avenue 可数。比喻“途径”时说 an avenue to。

senses.en: needed

ex.en: A pencil is necessary for the drawing test.
ex.zh: 绘画测验必须带铅笔。

ex.en: It is necessary to tell students why a rule exists, not only what they must not do.
ex.zh: 有必要告诉学生一条规则为什么存在，而不只是不准做什么。

tip: 常用 It is necessary to do，不说 somebody is necessary to do。

senses.en: to put forward an idea

ex.en: I suggest leaving ten minutes early.
ex.zh: 我建议早走十分钟。

ex.en: Reports suggest that later school starts can improve attention in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 报告提出，上学时间晚一点可能提高第一节课的注意力。

tip: suggest 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。从句里常用 should 或动词原形。

senses.en: to choose officially
a choice made in an election

ex.en: The class will vote for a monitor.
ex.zh: 班级将投票选班长。

ex.en: People vote more calmly when the polling place is near and the rules are posted in plain words.
ex.zh: 当投票点很近、规则用浅显的话贴出来时，人们投票会更从容。

tip: vote 作名词是“选票”或“投票”。

senses.en: a journey, often a short one

ex.en: Our class trip is to the history museum.
ex.zh: 我们班的旅行是去历史博物馆。

ex.en: A school trip teaches more when students write what they saw, not only where they went.
ex.zh: 如果学生写下看到了什么，而不只是去了哪里，学校旅行就教得更多。

tip: trip 常指较短或有目的的出行。动词 trip 是绊倒。

senses.en: a person who drives a vehicle

ex.en: The bus driver waited for the last student.
ex.zh: 公交司机等了最后一名学生。

ex.en: A tired driver on a school route is a reason to limit hours, not only to print a slogan.
ex.zh: 校车路线上疲劳的司机，是限制工时的理由，而不只是印一句口号。

tip: 动词开车是 drive，已在本库。

senses.en: related to music
a play with songs

ex.en: The musical evening is on Friday.
ex.zh: 音乐晚会在周五。

ex.en: A musical instrument that students can borrow matters more than a poster of a star.
ex.zh: 学生能借到的乐器，比一张明星海报更重要。

tip: musical 作名词是音乐剧。music 已在本库。

senses.en: to move quickly from side to side

ex.en: Shake the bottle before you open it.
ex.zh: 打开前先摇瓶子。

ex.en: Do not shake a labelled bottle in the lab.
ex.zh: 不要在实验室里摇一个贴了标签的瓶子。

tip: 过去式 shook，过去分词 shaken。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

senses.en: to stop being angry with someone

ex.en: Please forgive the delay.
ex.zh: 请原谅这次延误。

ex.en: A school can forgive a late form and still write the rule.
ex.zh: 学校可以原谅迟交的表格，同时仍然把规定写下来。

tip: 过去式 forgave，过去分词 forgiven。

senses.en: a vehicle that can fly

ex.en: No aircraft landed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间没有飞机降落。

ex.en: An aircraft over a school is a noise problem even when the lesson is about flight.
ex.zh: 即使课上讲的是飞行，学校上空的飞机也是噪音问题。

tip: aircraft 单复数同形。不说 aircrafts。

senses.en: a person who operates a machine or a phone service

ex.en: The operator checked the machine.
ex.zh: 操作员检查了机器。

ex.en: A night operator needs the late bus as much as a student does.
ex.zh: 上夜班的操作员需要晚班车，和学生一样。

tip: 动词 operate 已在本库。

senses.en: willing to give
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: She is generous with her time.
ex.zh: 她在时间上很大方。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: to use rude words, or to promise formally

ex.en: Do not swear at a classmate.
ex.zh: 不要咒骂同学。

ex.en: Witnesses swear to tell what they saw, not what they fear.
ex.zh: 证人发誓讲他们看见的，而不是他们害怕的。

tip: swear 的过去式是 swore，过去分词是 sworn。本条不列举骂人的话。

senses.en: a piece of furniture for sleeping

ex.en: I went to bed at ten.
ex.zh: 我十点上床睡觉。

ex.en: A student who goes to bed after midnight will feel the cost in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 午夜后才上床的学生，会在第一节课感受到代价。

tip: go to bed 指去睡觉；sleep 是睡觉这个动作。

senses.en: a large amount of water covering land
to cover with water

ex.en: The flood reached the school gate.
ex.zh: 洪水到了校门口。

ex.en: A flood plan should name who calls parents.
ex.zh: 防汛方案应当写明谁给家长打电话。

tip: flood 作动词是淹没。

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the news on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了新闻。

ex.en: TV can warn a town about a storm, but only if people still have electricity.
ex.zh: 电视可以警告城镇有风暴，但前提是人们还有电。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写，前面常用 on。

senses.en: a wild animal with a bushy tail

ex.en: A fox crossed the path at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时一只狐狸穿过小路。

ex.en: Stories use the fox as a clever character, which is not a reason to feed one near school.
ex.zh: 故事把狐狸写成聪明的角色，这不是在学校附近喂它的理由。

tip: fox 可数。复数是 foxes。

senses.en: having the usual qualities of a type

ex.en: This is a typical Monday: the bus is full.
ex.zh: 这是典型的周一：公交是满的。

ex.en: A typical lunch in the canteen should be one a student can actually afford.
ex.zh: 食堂里典型的午餐，应当是学生真正买得起的。

tip: be typical of 表示是某类人或事物的典型。

senses.en: not different

ex.en: We took the same bus home.
ex.zh: 我们乘了同一班车回家。

ex.en: Two schools can follow the same timetable and still offer very different support to struggling students.
ex.zh: 两所学校可以执行同样的课表，但对学习吃力的学生提供的帮助仍然很不一样。

tip: same 前面通常加 the。

senses.en: to think something will happen

ex.en: I expect the bus at eight.
ex.zh: 我预计公交八点到。

ex.en: Parents expect a safe walk to school, not only a high score at the end of the year.
ex.zh: 家长期待的是安全的上学路，而不只是年底的高分。

col: expect sb to do｜期望某人做
tip: expect 后接 to do 或 sb to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: the feeling of a place; air around Earth
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: The classroom had a friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教室里气氛友好。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: a recording of moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short video about the river.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段关于这条河的短视频。

ex.en: A video can spread a false claim widely before anyone has time to check the pictures.
ex.zh: 一段视频可以在任何人来得及核对画面之前，把一个虚假说法传得很广。

tip: video 可数。看视频用 watch a video。

senses.en: a hard part of the body

ex.en: The model shows one bone of the arm.
ex.zh: 模型展示手臂的一根骨头。

ex.en: A broken bone is a reason to call an adult, not to finish the match.
ex.zh: 骨折是叫成年人的理由，不是把比赛打完。

tip: bone 可数。bones 可指骨骼。

senses.en: throughout a period of time

ex.en: Please do not talk during the exam.
ex.zh: 考试期间请不要说话。

ex.en: During a drought, schools can show families how small daily changes save a surprising amount of water.
ex.zh: 干旱期间，学校可以向家庭展示，日常的小改变能省下惊人的水量。

tip: during 后接名词，不接句子；接句子用 while 或 when。

senses.en: a glass that shows a reflection

ex.en: There is a mirror by the bathroom door.
ex.zh: 卫生间门边有一面镜子。

ex.en: A mirror in the hall does not tell you whether the bus is late.
ex.zh: 大厅里的镜子不会告诉你公交是否晚点。

tip: mirror 作动词是反映。

senses.en: not boastful; not large
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: She is modest about her success.
ex.zh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: facts that prove something
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: There is no evidence of cheating.
ex.zh: 没有作弊的证据。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: a way of dealing with something
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: A new approach may solve the problem.
ex.zh: 新方法可能解决这个问题。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: about right and wrong
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The story has a moral lesson.
ex.zh: 这个故事有道德寓意。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: to carry out; to lead
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Scientists conduct experiments in the lab.
ex.zh: 科学家在实验室进行实验。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Students will debate the topic in class.
ex.zh: 学生们将在课堂上辩论这个话题。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: helpful

ex.en: Walking is beneficial to health.
ex.zh: 散步有益健康。

ex.en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: a line that marks a limit
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: Respect personal boundary at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。

ex.en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
ex.zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: to try
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 她将尝试爬山。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: enough

ex.en: Food supply is adequate.
ex.zh: 食物供应是足够的。

ex.en: Schools need adequate funding to maintain safe buildings and provide effective support for students with additional needs.
ex.zh: 学校需要充足的资金来保障校舍安全，并为有额外需求的学生提供有效支持。

col: adequate for the task｜足以胜任任务
tip: 表示达到所需标准，不等于优秀；常接for或to。

senses.en: real

ex.en: The actual cost was higher.
ex.zh: 实际费用更高。

ex.en: Governments should measure the actual impact of transport policies rather than relying solely on predicted benefits.
ex.zh: 政府应衡量交通政策的实际影响，而不是仅仅依赖预期收益。

tip: actual指实际的，不等于表示目前的current。

senses.en: easy to see; seeming
Seeming to be true, though possibly not actually true.

ex.en: It was apparent that he was tired.
ex.zh: 很明显他累了。

ex.en: Despite the apparent benefits of remote learning, some students struggle without direct support from teachers.
ex.zh: 尽管远程学习看似有诸多好处，一些学生在缺乏教师直接帮助时仍感到吃力。

col: for no apparent reason｜无明显原因
tip: 可指“明显的”，也可指“看似的”，须看语境。

senses.en: happening slowly
Rising or falling gently rather than steeply

ex.en: Progress is often gradual.
ex.zh: 进步往往是逐渐的。

ex.en: A gradual transition to renewable energy can help communities adapt without causing sudden job losses.
ex.zh: 逐步转向可再生能源有助于社区适应变化，避免就业岗位骤减。

tip: 强调变化缓慢、分阶段；副词形式为gradually。

senses.en: to suppose; to take on
To take on a duty, responsibility, or position.
To begin to have a particular appearance or quality.

ex.en: Don't assume that everyone knows the rules.
ex.zh: 不要假定人人都知道规则。

ex.en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。

tip: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

senses.en: to take up; to take as one's own
To legally take someone else's child into your family.
To formally approve a proposal, policy, or rule.

ex.en: The school will adopt a new teaching method.
ex.zh: 学校将采用一种新的教学方法。

ex.en: Governments should adopt long-term strategies that improve public transport rather than simply building more roads.
ex.zh: 政府应采取改善公共交通的长期策略，而不是一味增建道路。

col: adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
adopt a policy｜采纳一项政策
tip: adopt是采用或收养；adapt是适应或改编。

senses.en: power to make decisions
an official body responsible for a particular area or service
a person with extensive knowledge of a particular subject

ex.en: The school authority made a new rule.
ex.zh: 学校当局制定了新规则。

ex.en: Local authorities should consult residents before introducing policies that significantly affect access to public services.
ex.zh: 地方当局在推出显著影响公共服务获取的政策前，应征求居民意见。

col: have authority to do something｜有权做某事
an authority on｜某方面的权威
tip: 表权力通常不可数；the authorities常指当局。

senses.en: something given to help
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: His contribution to science was huge.
ex.zh: 他对科学的贡献巨大。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to value or be thankful for
Recognise and enjoy the value or quality of something.
Understand the importance or difficulty of a situation.

ex.en: I really appreciate your help.
ex.zh: 我真心感激你的帮助。

ex.en: Policymakers need to appreciate the difficulties rural communities face when accessing healthcare and other essential services.
ex.zh: 政策制定者需要理解农村社区在获取医疗及其他基本服务时面临的困难。

col: appreciate your help｜感谢你的帮助
appreciate the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

senses.en: correct and exact
able to hit or reach the intended target

ex.en: Give an accurate answer, please.
ex.zh: 请给出准确答案。

ex.en: Accurate information about air quality enables residents to make informed decisions about outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 准确的空气质量信息能帮助居民在充分知情的情况下决定是否进行户外锻炼。

tip: accurate强调准确无误；precise更强调细节精确。

senses.en: the right to act freely
The state of not experiencing something unpleasant.

ex.en: Speech freedom is valued in many places.
ex.zh: 许多地方重视言论自由。

ex.en: Universities should protect academic freedom while encouraging researchers to consider the social consequences of their work.
ex.zh: 大学应保护学术自由，同时鼓励研究人员考虑其工作的社会影响。

tip: freedom to do表示做某事的自由；from表示免受。

senses.en: basic and important
A basic principle or skill, usually considered with others.

ex.en: Honesty is a fundamental value.
ex.zh: 诚实是基本价值观。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water is a fundamental requirement for improving public health in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水是改善弱势社区公共卫生的基本条件。

tip: 名词通常用复数 fundamentals，表示基本原理。

senses.en: a matter or event
a romantic relationship involving someone committed to another partner

ex.en: Public affair need careful attention.
ex.zh: 公共事务需要认真关注。

ex.en: Schools can encourage young people to take an interest in current affairs through regular discussions of global events.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过定期讨论全球事件，鼓励年轻人关注时事。

tip: 表公共事务常用复数affairs，如current affairs。

senses.en: first
The first letter of a person's name
To mark a document with the first letters of your names

ex.en: My initial plan was wrong.
ex.zh: 我最初的计划是错的。

ex.en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
ex.zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。

tip: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

senses.en: to state officially
to officially report goods, income or other required information

ex.en: The mayor will declare the festival open.
ex.zh: 市长将宣布节日开幕。

ex.en: Local authorities may declare a public holiday to encourage participation in an important community celebration.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能宣布放假一天，以鼓励民众参加重要的社区庆典。

col: declare an emergency｜宣布进入紧急状态
tip: declare强调公开或正式宣布；海关申报也用此词。

senses.en: facts and figures

ex.en: Scientists collect data from tests.
ex.zh: 科学家从实验中收集数据。

ex.en: Reliable data allows policymakers to assess whether environmental regulations are reducing pollution in urban areas.
ex.zh: 可靠的数据能让政策制定者评估环境法规是否正在减少城市污染。

tip: 日常常作不可数名词；学术语境也用复数谓语。

senses.en: a condition around an event
the conditions of someone's life, especially their financial situation

ex.en: Under no circumstance should you lie.
ex.zh: 在任何情况下你都不该说谎。

ex.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
ex.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

col: under the circumstances｜在这种情况下
tip: 常用复数；under no circumstances置句首须倒装。

senses.en: fine; easily broken
Requiring careful handling to avoid problems or offence.
Fine, subtle, or gentle in appearance, flavour, or smell.

ex.en: Handle the glass with delicate care.
ex.zh: 轻拿轻放这些玻璃。

ex.en: Tourism in coastal regions must be carefully managed to protect delicate ecosystems from lasting damage.
ex.zh: 沿海地区的旅游业必须得到妥善管理，以保护脆弱的生态系统免遭长期破坏。

col: delicate negotiations｜需谨慎进行的谈判
tip: 既可形容易损物品，也可形容需谨慎处理的问题。

senses.en: to tell apart
to make someone or something different from others
to see or hear something clearly enough to recognize it

ex.en: Babies learn to distinguish colors early.
ex.zh: 婴儿很早就能学会辨别颜色。

ex.en: Students should learn to distinguish reliable evidence from personal opinion when evaluating information online.
ex.zh: 学生在评估网络信息时，应学会区分可靠证据与个人观点。

col: distinguish A from B｜把A与B区分开
tip: 常用distinguish A from B或between A and B。

senses.en: able to change easily
able to bend easily without breaking

ex.en: Keep a flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 保持灵活的时间安排。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees balance professional responsibilities with their family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助员工兼顾工作职责与家庭责任。

col: flexible working hours｜弹性工作时间
tip: 既可形容安排灵活，也可形容材料易弯曲。

senses.en: a feeling of worry

ex.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
ex.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can reduce anxiety among students facing demanding examinations and uncertain career prospects.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可以减轻学生面对高难度考试和不确定就业前景时的焦虑。

tip: anxiety about后接担忧的事情；形容词是anxious。

senses.en: a serious disagreement
A situation where different needs or ideas cannot agree.
To disagree with or be incompatible with something.

ex.en: Talking can reduce family conflict.
ex.zh: 沟通可以减少家庭冲突。

ex.en: Economic growth can conflict with environmental protection when industries rely heavily on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 当工业高度依赖化石燃料时，经济增长可能与环境保护相冲突。

col: a conflict of interest｜利益冲突
tip: 名词重音在首音节，动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: to send out by radio or TV
A programme transmitted through radio, television, or the internet.

ex.en: The match will broadcast live tonight.
ex.zh: 比赛今晚将直播。

ex.en: Public television should broadcast educational programmes that help children understand science and develop an interest in learning.
ex.zh: 公共电视台应播出教育节目，帮助儿童理解科学并培养学习兴趣。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常都为broadcast。

senses.en: the purpose of something
To work or operate in the intended way.
A mathematical relationship assigning each input exactly one output.

ex.en: What is the function of this button?
ex.zh: 这个按钮的功能是什么？

ex.en: Urban parks serve an important function by providing space for exercise, relaxation, and social interaction.
ex.zh: 城市公园提供运动、休闲和社交的空间，发挥着重要作用。

tip: function as后接名词，表示起……作用。

senses.en: a worry or interest

senses.zh: 令人担忧的事；关注事项
senses.en: An issue that matters or causes worry
To relate to someone or something, or cause worry

ex.en: Health is a shared concern for all.
ex.zh: 健康是所有人共同的关切。

ex.en: Growing concern about air pollution has encouraged many cities to invest in cleaner public transport systems.
ex.zh: 人们对空气污染日益担忧，促使许多城市投资建设更清洁的公共交通系统。

col: concern about safety｜对安全的担忧
a major concern｜一个主要问题
concern for others｜对他人的关心
tip: concern about多指对事情的担忧；for常指关心某人。

senses.en: the state of being away
a situation in which something does not exist or occur

ex.en: His absence from class worried the teacher.
ex.zh: 他缺课让老师担心。

ex.en: In the absence of reliable public transport, many residents have little choice but to drive.
ex.zh: 在缺乏可靠公共交通的情况下，许多居民别无选择，只能开车。

col: in someone's absence｜在某人不在时
in the absence of｜在缺乏……的情况下
tip: 缺席某活动用absence from；缺乏某物用absence of。

senses.en: happening all the time
remaining the same over time
a value or quantity that does not change

ex.en: There is constant noise from the street.
ex.zh: 街上有持续的噪音。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。

senses.en: made by people, not natural
Not sincere or natural in appearance or behaviour

ex.en: artificial light can hurt sleep.
ex.zh: 人造光可能影响睡眠。

ex.en: Excessive artificial lighting in urban areas can disrupt wildlife behaviour and reduce the visibility of stars.
ex.zh: 城市中过量的人工照明会扰乱野生动物的行为，并使星星难以看清。

tip: artificial指人造的；artistic才是艺术的。

senses.en: to give out
to spread something over an area

ex.en: Volunteers distribute food to the poor.
ex.zh: 志愿者向穷人分发食物。

ex.en: Governments must distribute healthcare resources fairly so that rural communities receive the same quality of care as urban residents.
ex.zh: 政府必须公平分配医疗资源，让农村社区享有与城市居民同等质量的医疗服务。

tip: distribute A to B 表示“把A分发给B”。

senses.en: to give for a purpose
To help cause a particular result
To write material for a publication or website

ex.en: Everyone can contribute to the project.
ex.zh: 每个人都能为这个项目做贡献。

ex.en: Limited access to affordable housing can contribute to social inequality and force workers to accept longer commutes.
ex.zh: 难以获得可负担住房可能加剧社会不平等，并迫使劳动者接受更长的通勤时间。

col: contribute to a discussion｜参与讨论
contribute to economic growth｜促进经济增长
tip: contribute to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: total; complete
not limited by conditions, rules, or other authorities

ex.en: He has absolute confidence in the team.
ex.zh: 他对团队有绝对信心。

ex.en: Giving any single institution absolute power can weaken accountability and reduce public trust in government.
ex.zh: 赋予任何单一机构不受限制的权力，都可能削弱问责机制并降低公众对政府的信任。

col: an absolute necessity｜绝对必需的事物
tip: 常表示程度已达极限，通常不用 very 修饰。

senses.en: to decide firmly; to find out
To control or strongly influence what happens.
To make a firm decision to do something.

ex.en: Tests help determine your progress.
ex.zh: 测试有助于测定你的进步。

ex.en: Researchers must determine whether smaller classes improve learning outcomes before governments invest heavily in additional teaching staff.
ex.zh: 在政府投入大量资金增聘教师之前，研究人员必须确定小班教学是否能改善学习成果。

tip: determine whether 意为查明是否；后接从句。

senses.en: not guilty; pure
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The child looked innocent.
ex.zh: 孩子看上去很天真。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: suitable
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wear appropriate clothes for the interview.
ex.zh: 面试穿合适的衣服。

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: ease of use
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: Online shopping offers great convenience.
ex.zh: 网购提供极大便利。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: a result of an action
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Every choice has a consequence.
ex.zh: 每个选择都有后果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: to leave or give up
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon the plan after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后我们不得不放弃那个计划。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。
